Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

For i = 0 To n - 1
        Dim tk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        If tk <> "TYPE_REF" Or UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).role)) <> "TASK_RESULT_TYPE" Then Continue For
        If UXBLibraryTypeRegistryFind(ps.ast.nodes(i).value) >= 0 Then
            errText = "semantic: TASK OF " & UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) & " desteklenmiyor (S-146 D3: kutuphane tipinin gorev sozlesmesi taskTransfer/threadSafety henuz yok) -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
            Return 0
        End If
        If StiTypeTransferable(ps.ast.nodes(i).value) = 0 Then
            errText = "semantic: TASK OF " & StiTypeLabel(ps.ast.nodes(i).value) & " desteklenmiyor (S-146 R3: gorev sonucu yalniz I8..U64, F32/F64/F80, BOOLEAN ya da STRING olabilir) -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
            Return 0
        End If
    Next i

    ' Senkron kumesi her analizde yeniden kurulur (SPAWN yoksa bos: hicbir global kilitlenmez).
    gStiSyncGlobals = "|"
    gStiGlobalOrder = "|"
    gStiNodeUnsafe = 0

    ' SPAWN yoksa baska is yok (TRIGGER'li programlar etkilenmez).
    Dim hasSpawn As Integer = 0
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) = "SPAWN_EXPR" Then hasSpawn = 1: Exit For
    Next i
    If hasSpawn = 0 Then Return 1

    ReDim gStiRoutineOf(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiBucketFirst(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiBucketNext(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiEff(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiReason(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiReasonBit(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiSkip(n - 1)
    ReDim gStiRoutineGlobals(n - 1)
    gStiEdgeCount = 0
    gStiGlobals = "|"
    gStiNamespaces = "|"
    gStiClassStatic = "|"

    For i = 0 To n - 1
        gStiBucketFirst(i) = -1
        gStiBucketNext(i) = -1
        gStiRoutineOf(i) = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, i)
    Next i
    ' Kovalar (ters sirayla ekle ki kaynak sirasi korunsun).
    For i = n - 1 To 0 Step -1
        Dim ro As Integer = gStiRoutineOf(i)
        If ro >= 0 Then
            gStiBucketNext(i) = gStiBucketFirst(ro)
            gStiBucketFirst(ro) = i
        End If
    Next i

    ' Ad referansi olmayan dugumler: FIELD_EXPR uye adlari; SPAWN'in kendi gorev cagrisi
    ' (hedef ayri bir gorevdir -- kendi basina denetlenir; argumanlari yine taranir).
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        Dim sk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        If sk = "FIELD_EXPR" Then
            If ps.ast.nodes(i).right <> -1 Then gStiSkip(ps.ast.nodes(i).right) = 1
        ElseIf sk = "SPAWN_EXPR" Then
            If ps.ast.nodes(i).left <> -1 Then gStiSkip(ps.ast.nodes(i).left) = 1
        End If
    Next i

    ' Program geneli degistirilebilir degiskenler, ad alanlari, sinif STATIC alanlari.
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        Dim gk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        Select Case gk
        Case "NAMESPACE_STMT", "MODULE_STMT"
            StiSetAdd gStiNamespaces, ps.ast.nodes(i).value
        Case "CLASS_FIELD"
            Dim fc As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).firstChild
            Do While fc <> -1
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(fc).kind)) = "CLASS_FIELD_FLAG" AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(fc).value)) = "STATIC" Then
                    StiSetAdd gStiClassStatic, StiEnclosingClassName(ps, i) & "." & UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value))
                    Exit Do
                End If
                fc = ps.ast.nodes(fc).nextSibling
            Loop
        End Select
        If gStiRoutineOf(i) <> -1 Then Continue For
        If StiEnclosingClassName(ps, i) <> "" Then Continue For
        Select Case gk
        Case "DIM_DECL", "REDIM_DECL", "FOR_STMT"
            StiSetAdd gStiGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(i).value
        Case "FOR_EACH_STMT", "DO_EACH_STMT"
            StiSetAdd gStiGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(i).value
            StiSetAdd gStiGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(i).op
        Case "ASSIGN_STMT"
            ' Program duzeyinde DIM'siz atama ortuk global olusturur.
            Dim lhs As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).left
            If lhs <> -1 Then
                Dim lk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(lhs).kind))
                If lk = "IDENT" Or lk = "IDENTIFIER" Then StiSetAdd gStiGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(lhs).value
            End If
        End Select
    Next i

    gStiGlobalOrder = gStiGlobals   ' bildirim sirasi = kilit sirasi (lockOrderId)

    ' Rutin basina dogrudan etkiler ve kenarlar.
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If UXBTaskIsRoutineKind(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind) <> 0 Then StiScanRoutine ps, i
    Next i
    gStiNodeUnsafe = 0

    ' Gecisli yayilim (D1/R5): sabit nokta; ozyineleme de boylece sonlanir.
    Dim changed As Integer = 1
    Dim rounds As Integer = 0
    Do While changed <> 0 And rounds <= n + 1
        changed = 0
        rounds += 1
        Dim e As Integer
        For e = 0 To gStiEdgeCount - 1
            Dim f As Integer = gStiEdgeFrom(e)
            Dim t As Integer = gStiEdgeTo(e)
            ' Model D: dokunulan global kumeleri de cagri grafiginde yayilir (madde 13: etki analizi).
            Dim gpos As Integer = 2
            Dim gtext As String = gStiRoutineGlobals(t)
            Do While gpos < Len(gtext)
                Dim gend As Integer = InStr(gpos, gtext, "|")
                If gend = 0 Then Exit Do
                Dim gname As String = Mid(gtext, gpos, gend - gpos)
                If gname <> "" AndAlso StiSetHas(gStiRoutineGlobals(f), gname) = 0 Then
                    StiSetAdd gStiRoutineGlobals(f), gname
                    changed = 1
                End If
                gpos = gend + 1
            Loop
            Dim newBits As Integer = gStiEff(t) And (Not gStiEff(f))
            If newBits <> 0 Then
                gStiEff(f) Or= newBits
                If gStiReason(f) = "" Then
                    gStiReason(f) = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(t).value) & "() -> " & gStiReason(t)
                    gStiReasonBit(f) = gStiReasonBit(t)
                End If
                changed = 1
            End If
        Next e
    Loop

    ' SPAWN noktalari: R1 argumanlar, R2 parametreler, R3 sonuc tipi, R4-R6 + I3 govde etkileri.
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) <> "SPAWN_EXPR" Then Continue For
        Dim callIdx As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).left
        If callIdx = -1 Then Continue For
        Dim targetName As String = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(callIdx).value)
        Dim target As Integer = StiFindSpawnTarget(ps, targetName)
        If target = -1 Then Continue For   ' SemValidateSpawnCalls zaten reddetti

        Dim argNo As Integer = 0
        Dim a As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(callIdx).firstChild
        Do While a <> -1
            argNo += 1
            Dim argType As String
            Dim argErr As String
            If UXBStep3InferExprType(ps, a, argType, argErr) = 0 Then argType = ""
            If StiTypeTransferable(argType) = 0 Then
                errText = "semantic: SPAWN " & targetName & ": " & LTrim(Str(argNo)) & ". arguman tipi " & StiTypeLabel(argType) & " gorev sinirindan gecemez (S-146 R1: yalniz I8..U64, F32/F64/F80, BOOLEAN, STRING; CLASS/LIST/DICT/PTR/TASK ve kutuphane tipleri icin MOVE/CLONE sonraki halkada)"
                Return 0
            End If
            a = ps.ast.nodes(a).nextSibling
        Loop

        Dim pc As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(target).firstChild
        Do While pc <> -1
            Dim pk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(pc).kind))
            If pk = "PARAM_DECL" Then
                Dim pType As String = StiTypeRefOf(ps, pc)
                If StiTypeTransferable(pType) = 0 Then
                    errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & ": parametre '" & Trim(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) & "' tipi " & StiTypeLabel(pType) & " gorev sinirindan gecemez (S-146 R2)"
                    Return 0
                End If
            ElseIf pk = "RETURN_TYPE" Then
                If StiTypeTransferable(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) = 0 Then
                    errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & ": sonuc tipi " & StiTypeLabel(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) & " gorev sinirindan gecemez (S-146 R3)"
                    Return 0
                End If
            End If
            pc = ps.ast.nodes(pc).nextSibling
        Loop

        If gStiEff(target) <> 0 Then
            errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & " gorev sinirini asiyor: " & Trim(ps.ast.nodes(target).value) & ": " & gStiReason(target) & " (" & StiRuleText(gStiReasonBit(target)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If

        ' Senkron kumesi: bu gorevin (gecisli) dokundugu globaller.
        Dim spos As Integer = 2
        Dim stext As String = gStiRoutineGlobals(target)
        Do While spos < Len(stext)
            Dim send As Integer = InStr(spos, stext, "|")
            If send = 0 Then Exit Do
            StiSetAdd gStiSyncGlobals, Mid(stext, spos, send - spos)
            spos = send + 1
        Loop
    Next i

    ' Senkron global icin henuz uygulanmamis adimlar (sessiz yaris yerine acik tani).
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        Dim dk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))

65	Private Function StiSetHas(ByRef setText As String, ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
66	    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
67	    If n = "" Then Return 0
68	    Return IIf(InStr(setText, "|" & n & "|") > 0, 1, 0)
69	End Function
70	
71	Private Sub StiSetAdd(ByRef setText As String, ByVal nameRaw As String)
72	    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
73	    If n = "" Then Exit Sub
74	    If setText = "" Then setText = "|"
75	    If InStr(setText, "|" & n & "|") = 0 Then setText &= n & "|"
76	End Sub
77	
78	Private Function StiParentOf(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
79	    If nodeIdx < 0 Or nodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return -1
80	    Dim p As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx).parent
81	    If p = -1 Then p = UXBAstFindOwner(ps, nodeIdx)
82	    If p = nodeIdx Then Return -1
83	    Return p
84	End Function
85	
86	' Dugumu iceren CLASS_STMT'nin adi; yoksa "".
87	Private Function StiEnclosingClassName(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As String
88	    Dim p As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, nodeIdx)
89	    Dim guard As Integer = 0
90	    Do While p >= 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count
91	        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind)) = "CLASS_STMT" Then Return UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).value))
92	        p = StiParentOf(ps, p)
93	        guard += 1
94	    Loop
95	    Return ""
96	End Function
97	
98	Private Function StiFindClassNode(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
99	    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))

    Return IIf(InStr(setText, "|" & n & "|") > 0, 1, 0)

Private Sub StiSetAdd(ByRef setText As String, ByVal nameRaw As String)
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    If n = "" Then Exit Sub
    If setText = "" Then setText = "|"
    If InStr(setText, "|" & n & "|") = 0 Then setText &= n & "|"
End Sub

Private Function StiParentOf(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
    If nodeIdx < 0 Or nodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return -1
    Dim p As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(nodeIdx).parent
    If p = -1 Then p = UXBAstFindOwner(ps, nodeIdx)
    If p = nodeIdx Then Return -1
    Return p
End Function

' Dugumu iceren CLASS_STMT'nin adi; yoksa "".
Private Function StiEnclosingClassName(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As String
    Dim p As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, nodeIdx)
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do While p >= 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind)) = "CLASS_STMT" Then Return UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).value))
        p = StiParentOf(ps, p)
        guard += 1
    Loop
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function MIRLowerTopLevelStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    MIRSetCurrentSourceFromAstNode ps, stmtIdx
    If stmtIdx < 0 Or stmtIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 1

    Dim st As ASTNode
    st = ps.ast.nodes(stmtIdx)
    Dim k As String
    k = UCase(st.kind)

    Select Case k
    Case "LABEL_STMT"
        Dim labelName As String
        labelName = Trim(st.value)
        If labelName = "" Then
            errText = "mir: LABEL name missing"
            Return 0
        End If
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_LABEL, "", 1, labelName
        Return 1
    Case "GOTO_STMT"
        Dim gotoTarget As String
        gotoTarget = Trim(st.value)
        If gotoTarget = "" Then
            errText = "mir: GOTO target missing"
            Return 0
        End If
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_GOTO, "", 1, gotoTarget
        Return 1
    Case "GOSUB_STMT"
        Dim gosubTarget As String
        gosubTarget = Trim(st.value)
        If gosubTarget = "" Then
            errText = "mir: GOSUB target missing"
            Return 0
        End If
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_GOSUB, "", 1, gosubTarget
        Return 1
    End Select

    If k = "INLINE_STMT" Then
        Dim inlineHeader As String
        Dim inlineBody As String
        Dim inlineLabel As String
        inlineHeader = Trim(st.value)
        inlineBody = st.op
        inlineLabel = "__uxb_inline_" & LTrim(Str(stmtIdx))
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "INLINE", "", 3, inlineLabel, inlineHeader, inlineBody
        Return 1
    End If

    Dim handledIoConsole As Integer
    handledIoConsole = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtIoConsole(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledIoConsole, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledIoConsole <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledMemoryStmt As Integer
    handledMemoryStmt = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtMemory(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledMemoryStmt, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledMemoryStmt <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledSlotLane As Integer
    handledSlotLane = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelSlotLane(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledSlotLane, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledSlotLane <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledFlowCore As Integer
    handledFlowCore = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtFlowCore(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledFlowCore, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledFlowCore <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledCallDispatch As Integer
    handledCallDispatch = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtCallDispatch(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledCallDispatch, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledCallDispatch <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledErrorFlow As Integer
    handledErrorFlow = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtErrorFlow(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledErrorFlow, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledErrorFlow <> 0 Then Return 1
    Dim handledAssignIncDec As Integer
    handledAssignIncDec = 0
    If MIRLowerTopLevelStmtAssignIncDec(ps, stmtIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, handledAssignIncDec, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    If handledAssignIncDec <> 0 Then Return 1

    Dim handledCoreA As Integer

Private Function MIRLowerStmtRange(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal parentIdx As Integer, ByVal fromPos As Integer, ByVal toPos As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim p As Integer
    For p = fromPos To toPos
        Dim stIdx As Integer
        stIdx = MIRChildAt(ps, parentIdx, p)
        If stIdx = -1 Then
            errText = "mir: statement child missing"
            Return 0
        End If
        If MIRLowerTopLevelStmt(ps, stIdx, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Next p
    Return 1
End Function

@'
DIM g AS I32 = 0
DIM s AS STRING = "a"
DIM arr(10) AS I32

' uXBasic MIR model/opcode/declaration surface
#include once "../common/source_location.fbs"

Type MIRIRInstruction
    opcode As String  ' LOAD, STORE, ADD, SUB, MUL, DIV, CALL, JMP, JZ, JNZ, RET, etc.
    operands(0 To 15) As String  ' Operand listesi (variable names, constants, labels)
    operandCount As Integer
    result As String  ' Result variable name (for assignments)
    blockId As Integer  ' Which block this belongs to
    srcLoc As SourceLocation
    comment As String
    flags As Integer
    resultType As String
    ffiStubId As Integer
    ffiArgStart As Integer
End Type

Type MIRBasicBlock
    id As Integer
    instructions(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
    instructionCount As Integer
    predecessors(Any) As Integer  ' Block IDs that can jump here
    predecessorCount As Integer
    successors(Any) As Integer  ' Block IDs this can jump to
    successorCount As Integer
    isEntry As Integer  ' 1 if this is entry block
    isExit As Integer   ' 1 if this is exit block
End Type

Type MIRFunction

' Therefore a pure AST-x64 build must still build semantic MIR for diagnostics
' and coverage evidence; otherwise ADIM25 fails with "... FAIL_MIR_NOT_READY"
' before x64 codegen is even tested.
If x64EmitMode <> 0 Or codegenMode <> 0 Or x64BuildMode <> 0 Then needMirModule = 1

Dim mirModule As MIRModule
If needMirModule <> 0 Then
    UxbTraceBegin "MIR_BUILD", "MIRBuildModuleFromAST + MIROptimizeModule"
    UXBLayerEventBegin "MIR_BUILD", sourcePath
    Dim mirBuildErr As String
    Dim mirOptErr As String

    If MIRBuildModuleFromAST(ps, mirModule, mirBuildErr) = 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "MIR_BUILD", "UXB_MIR_BUILD_FAILED", mirBuildErr
        UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_BUILD", "fail", mirBuildErr
        UxbError "MIR build basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(mirBuildErr)
        UxbTraceEnd "MIR_BUILD", "FAIL", mirBuildErr
        End 11
    End If

    If MIROptimizeModule(mirModule, mirOptErr) = 0 Then
        UXBLayerEventDiagnostic "MIR_BUILD", "UXB_MIR_OPTIMIZE_FAILED", mirOptErr
        UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_BUILD", "fail", mirOptErr
        UxbError "MIR optimize basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(mirOptErr)
        UxbTraceEnd "MIR_BUILD", "FAIL", mirOptErr
        End 12
    End If

    mirModuleReady = 1

    If Trim(outputContractPaths.semanticMirJsonOutPath) <> "" Then
        Dim semanticMirJsonErr As String
        If MIRWriteModuleJson(mirModule, outputContractPaths.semanticMirJsonOutPath, semanticMirJsonErr) = 0 Then
            UxbError "semantic_mir.json yazilamadi: " & semanticMirJsonErr
            End 16
        End If
        UXBActiveBindPlanAdd activeBindPlan, "MIR", "semantic_mir_json", "MIRWriteModuleJson", "PASS", outputContractPaths.semanticMirJsonOutPath
    End If

    UXBLayerEventEnd "MIR_BUILD", "ok", "mir module ready"
    UxbTraceEnd "MIR_BUILD", "OK", "mir module ready"
    If Trim(mirModuleJsonOutPath) <> "" Then
        Dim mirModuleJsonErr As String
        If MIRWriteModuleJson(mirModule, mirModuleJsonOutPath, mirModuleJsonErr) = 0 Then
            UxbError "MIR module JSON cikti yazimi basarisiz: " & LocalizeErrorMessage(mirModuleJsonErr)
            End 16
        End If
        If debugMode Then UxbInfo "MIR module JSON yazildi: " & mirModuleJsonOutPath
    End If

    ' ADIM11: MIR verifier artik zorunlu gate.
    Dim As UXBMIRGateResult mirGateResult
    Dim As String mirGateErr
    If UXBMIRMandatoryGate(mirModule, mirGateResult, mirGateErr) = 0 Then
        Dim semanticMirVerifyWriteErr As String
        UXBMIRWriteGateJson mirGateResult, outputContractPaths.mirVerifySemanticJsonOutPath, semanticMirVerifyWriteErr
        UxbError "MIR dogrulama basarisiz: " & mirGateErr
        End 18
    End If
    mirVerifiedForPolicy = 1

Function MIROptimizeModule(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    If module.functionCount <= 0 Then Return 1

    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To module.functionCount - 1
        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To module.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim knownNames(Any) As String
            Dim knownVals(Any) As MIRValue
            Dim knownCount As Integer
            knownCount = 0

            Dim ii As Integer
            For ii = 0 To module.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
                Dim inst As MIRIRInstruction
                inst = module.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(ii)

                If inst.opcode = MIR_OP_LOAD_CONST And Trim(inst.result) <> "" And inst.operandCount >= 1 Then
                    Dim cv As MIRValue
                    If MIRValueFromString(inst.operands(0), cv) <> 0 Then
                        Dim found As Integer
                        found = -1
                        Dim k As Integer
                        For k = 0 To knownCount - 1
                            If UCase(knownNames(k)) = UCase(inst.result) Then found = k
                        Next k
                        If found = -1 Then
                            If knownCount = 0 Then
                                ReDim knownNames(0)
                                ReDim knownVals(0)
                            Else
                                ReDim Preserve knownNames(knownCount)
                                ReDim Preserve knownVals(knownCount)
                            End If
                            knownNames(knownCount) = inst.result
                            knownVals(knownCount) = cv
                            knownCount += 1
                        Else
                            knownVals(found) = cv
                        End If
                    End If
                End If
            Next ii
        Next bi
    Next fi

    Return 1
End Function

Function MIRBuildModuleFromAST(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef moduleOut As MIRModule, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    gMirLowerLoopDepth = 0
    gMirLowerTryDepth = 0
    moduleOut.functionCount = 0
    moduleOut.globalVarCount = 0
    moduleOut.sourceFileCount = 0
    Erase moduleOut.functions
    Erase moduleOut.globalVars
    Erase moduleOut.globalVarTypes
    Erase moduleOut.globalVarIsArray
    Erase moduleOut.sourceFiles

    ' UXB_MIR_FULL_JSON_V2_20260728: retain the root source file in MIRModule
    ' so every backend/analysis consumer sees it through the same MIR object.
    If Trim(ps.lx.sourceFile) <> "" Then
        ReDim moduleOut.sourceFiles(0)
        moduleOut.sourceFiles(0) = ps.lx.sourceFile
        moduleOut.sourceFileCount = 1
    End If

    If ps.rootNode = -1 Then
        errText = "mir: ast root missing"
        Return 0
    End If

    MIREnsureMain moduleOut
    moduleOut.functions(0).returnType = "I64"

    If MIRRegisterStaticClassMembers(ps, moduleOut, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    MIRPreRegisterArrayGlobals ps, moduleOut

    Dim tempSeed As Integer
    tempSeed = 0

    If MIRLowerAllRoutineNodes(ps, moduleOut, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim curBlock As Integer
    curBlock = 0

    Dim explicitMainNode As Integer
    explicitMainNode = MIRFindFirstMainStmtNode(ps, ps.rootNode)

    If explicitMainNode >= 0 Then
        If MIRLowerProgramTaskPrelude(ps, ps.rootNode, moduleOut, curBlock, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        If MIRLowerExplicitMainStmtNode(ps, explicitMainNode, moduleOut, curBlock, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Else
        If MIRLowerFallbackProgramTopLevel(ps, moduleOut, curBlock, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    End If

    MIRAppendInstruction moduleOut, 0, curBlock, MIR_OP_RET, "", 1, "__result__"

    MIRAnnotateModuleResultTypes moduleOut

    If MIRFinalizeCfg(moduleOut, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    ' Build MIR-level vtable map from AST (uses CLASS_METHOD_SLOT metadata)
    If MIRBuildVTableMap(ps, moduleOut, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Return 1
End Function

#ifndef UXB_MIR_EMIT_API_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_EMIT_API_FBS

#include once "mir_instruction_builder.fbs"

Function MIRCommitInstruction(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByRef b As MIRInstrBuilder, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim inst As MIRIRInstruction
    If MIRBuilderToInstruction(b, inst, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    inst.blockId = blockIdx
    Dim blk As MIRBasicBlock Ptr
    blk = @module.functions(fnIdx).blocks(blockIdx)
    Dim cnt As Integer
    cnt = blk->instructionCount
    If cnt = 0 Then
        ReDim blk->instructions(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve blk->instructions(cnt)
    End If
    blk->instructions(cnt) = inst
    blk->instructionCount = cnt + 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function MIREmitLoadConst(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal constText As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "LOAD_CONST", resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, constText, MIR_OPR_CONST, typeText
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitLoadVar(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal varName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "LOAD_VAR", resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, varName, MIR_OPR_VAR, typeText, symbolIdx
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitStoreVar(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal targetName As String, ByVal sourceName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "STORE_VAR", targetName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, sourceName, MIR_OPR_SOURCE, typeText, symbolIdx
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitBinary(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal opcodeText As String, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal leftName As String, ByVal rightName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, opcodeText, resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, leftName, MIR_OPR_VALUE, typeText
    MIRBuilderAddText b, rightName, MIR_OPR_VALUE, typeText
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

#endif

  mutex YOK. İlgisiz depolara erişen görevler gerçekten paralel çalışır.
- **Açık LOCK ile otomatik kilit birbirini tanır:** `LOCK hesap` içindeki `hesap.balance += 10` kilidi yeniden almaz
  (sahiplik tanınır). Kullanıcının aynı kilidi ikinci kez açıkça LOCK etmesi `SELF_DEADLOCK`.
- **MUTEX** yalnız dış kaynak/programcı tanımlı kritik bölge içindir (`DIM dllLock AS MUTEX : LOCK dllLock ... END LOCK`).
- **UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE** yalnız o bölgedeki belirli statik güvenceleri kaldırır (ham adres, sözleşmesiz FFI);
  görev modelini C'ye çevirmez. `--unsafe-tasks` varsa bir derleyici profili olur, dilin anlamını değiştirmez.
- **Motorlar arası:** AST/MIR/native/JS/WASM aynı gözlenebilir veri semantiği; yalnız görevler arası zamanlama/çıktı
  sırası garanti değildir (sıra gerekiyorsa JOIN).
- **Etki analizi** yasak listesi değil, kod üretim bilgisidir: READS/WRITES_GLOBAL, USES_SHARED/ATOMIC/RAW_MEMORY/FILE/
  CONSOLE/RANDOM/FFI, WAITS_TASK, SPAWNS, TERMINATES_PROCESS. Tek yasak: görev zincirinde END.

**Claude uygulama kuralı (§10.1, anlamı daraltmaz):** "Deyim tek güvenli işlem" garantisi, deyim içinde kullanıcı
FUNCTION çağrısı olsa da korunur ve kilitlenmeye (deadlock) yol açmaz: deyimdeki kullanıcı rutini çağrıları önce
hesaplanıp geçici değere alınır; deyimin kendi ortak depo okumaları/yazmaları ardından tek kilit kümesi altında yapılır.
Kilitler hiçbir zaman bir kullanıcı rutini çağrısı boyunca tutulmaz (açık LOCK bloğu hariç — orada programcı bölgeyi
kendisi açmıştır). Tek sonuç: çağrılan rutin aynı deyimin okuduğu globali değiştiriyorsa okuma çağrıdan SONRA yapılır.

**Uygulama sırası (Mete onayı 2026-09-26):** 1) global/STATIC otomatik senkronizasyon + LOCK + ATOMIC + MUTEX + UNSAFE
sözdizimi; 2) görev başına RND, iş parçacığı güvenli dosya tablosu, konsol kilidi + LOCK CONSOLE, SHELL; 3) TASK
tutamaçları görevler arası + bekleme çevrimi; 4) BYREF ömür + yerel SHARED + BYSHARED; 5) MOVE/CLONE + kütüphane tipi
görev tanımları (Codex ile); 6) FFI iş parçacığı üst verisi; 7) işaretçi/MemoryRef paylaşımı. Uygulanmamış adıma
dokunan program "henüz uygulanmadı (S-146 adım N)" tanısı alır; bu bir dil kuralı değildir, sessiz yanlış sonuç asla.

---

# Çoklu LOCK sırası

Claude belgesinde “adres sırasına göre” önerilmiş. 

Bunu değiştirelim.

Adres kullanmayalım.

JS ve WASM'da bunun anlamı bile aynı değil.

Her `SHARED/MUTEX` için:

```text
lockOrderId
```

olsun.

```basic
LOCK a, b, c
    ...
END LOCK
```

yapıldığında:

1. ifadeler soldan sağa yalnız bir kez değerlendirilir,
2. alias olan aynı kilitler tekilleştirilir,
3. `lockOrderId` sırasına dizilir,
4. kilitler alınır,
5. çıkışta ters sırada bırakılır.

Böylece platformdan bağımsız olur.

---

# LOCK transaction değildir

Bu da önemli bir düzeltme.

Şu kod:

```basic
LOCK hesap

    hesap.a = 100
    RiskliIslem()
    hesap.b = 200

END LOCK
```

`RiskliIslem()` hata verirse:

```text
hesap.a
```

eski değerine otomatik dönmez.

`LOCK`:

> karşılıklı dışlama sağlar.

Ama:

> rollback/transaction sağlamaz.

Bu ayrımı belgeye açık yazalım.

Transaction istersek sonra ayrı sistem.

---

# CANCEL ve LOCK ilişkisi

Kararımızı koruyalım:

```text
LOCK dışında → CANCEL uygulanabilir

LOCK içindeyken
    CANCEL requested olur
    ancak kritik bölüm yarıda kesilmez

END LOCK
    kilit bırakılır
    ardından cancellation uygulanır
```

Ayrıca:

```basic
LOCK x
    t.JOIN()
END LOCK
```

yasak.

Aynı şekilde:

```text
WAIT
JOIN
RESULT
TASKGROUP.JOIN
```

#ifndef UXB_MIR_INTERP_TASK_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_INTERP_TASK_FBS

' S-030 Faz 1B (Mete K7, 2026-09-24): canonical-MIR yorumlayicisinin gorev
' saglayicisi -- AST referans uygulamasinin (src/runtime/exec/exec_task_handle.fbs)
' SENKRON esi. Kanonik adlar (mir_lower_expr.fbs basindaki sozlesme):
'   TASK_SPAWN(lane, tur, ad, sonucTipi, arg1..) TASK_WAIT TASK_JOIN TASK_CANCEL
'   TASK_STATUS TASK_RESULT TASK_ERROR TASK_GROUP_CREATE TASK_GROUP_ADD TASK_GROUP_JOIN
' Faz 1 siniri (acikca belgelenmis, placeholder degil): TASK_SPAWN gorev govdesini
' ayni cagri yiginda hemen calistirir; tutamac DONE/ERROR durumunda dogar,
' .STATUS PENDING/RUNNING gormez. Govde hatasi (THROW dahil) YAKALANIR, gorevde
' tutulur, bekleyen istisna durumu temizlenir; JOIN/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN hatayi
' cagirana aktarir (Mete K6: CANCELLED icin de).
'
' Tutamac: heap slotu (LIST/DICT/SET ile ayni yol), deger turu UXB_VAL_ARRAY +
' typeName "TASK"/"TASKGROUP" -- UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType heap tutamaclarini
' sayiya cevirmez (S-037). `DIM t AS TASK` 0 (I32) ile dogar = NULL; heap id'leri
' 0'dan basladigi icin NULL, degerin TURUNE bakilarak ayirt edilir.
' TASK slotu: values(0)=sonuc, names(0)=durum, names(1)=hata, names(2)=gorev adi, names(3)=tur,
' names(4)="1" hata okundu (K5: JOIN/RESULT/GROUP_JOIN ile yukseldi ya da STATUS/ERRORTEXT ile sorgulandi).
' TASKGROUP slotu: values(0..count-1)=uye TASK tutamaclari (ekleme sirasi).

Private Function UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ByVal s As String) As String
    s = Trim(s)
    If Len(s) >= 2 AndAlso Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) AndAlso Right(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return Mid(s, 2, Len(s) - 2)
    Return s
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRTaskHandleValue(ByVal kindText As String, ByVal id As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim v As UXBInterpValue
    v.kind = UXB_VAL_ARRAY
    v.typeName = kindText
    v.handleId = id
    v.objectId = id
    v.arrayId = id
    v.intValue = id
    Return v
End Function

' 1 = gecerli tutamac (slotOut dolu); 0 = NULL / baska turde deger.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskSlot(ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef v As UXBInterpValue, ByVal kindText As String, ByRef slotOut As Integer) As Integer
    slotOut = -1
    If v.kind <> UXB_VAL_ARRAY Then Return 0
    If UCase(Trim(v.typeName)) <> kindText Then Return 0
    If v.arrayId < 0 Or v.arrayId >= ctx.heap.slotCount Then Return 0
    If ctx.heap.slots(v.arrayId).active = 0 Then Return 0
    If UCase(Trim(ctx.heap.slots(v.arrayId).slotKind)) <> kindText Then Return 0
    slotOut = v.arrayId
    Return 1
End Function

' Mete K6: ERROR ya da CANCELLED bitmis gorev -> 1 ve errText dolu.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskFailureText(ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByVal slotId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Select Case ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0)
    Case "ERROR"
        ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(4) = "1"
        errText = "gorev hatasi (" & ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(2) & "): " & ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(1)
        Return 1
    Case "CANCELLED"
        ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(4) = "1"
        errText = "gorev iptal edildi (" & ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(2) & "): CANCELLED"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' K5: program sonunda hic okunmamis ERROR gorevleri (iptal hata sayilmaz). 1 = var (errOut dolu).
Function UXBMIRTaskUnreadErrors(ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef errOut As String) As Integer
    errOut = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ctx.heap.slotCount - 1
        If ctx.heap.slots(i).active = 0 Then Continue For
        If UCase(Trim(ctx.heap.slots(i).slotKind)) <> "TASK" Then Continue For
        If UBound(ctx.heap.slots(i).names) < 4 Then Continue For
        If ctx.heap.slots(i).names(0) <> "ERROR" Or ctx.heap.slots(i).names(4) = "1" Then Continue For
        If errOut <> "" Then errOut &= "; "
        errOut &= "okunmamis gorev hatasi (" & ctx.heap.slots(i).names(2) & "): " & ctx.heap.slots(i).names(1)
    Next i
    Return IIf(errOut <> "", 1, 0)
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRTaskError(ByVal textValue As String) As UXBInterpValue
    Return UXBInterpValueError(UXB_INTERP_ERR_RUNTIME_SERVICE, textValue)
End Function

' TASK_SPAWN: lane rutininin parametrelerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir, sonucu/hatayi
' tutamaca yazar. Yalniz BAGLAMA hatasi (hedef yok, arguman sayisi) SPAWN cagrisinin
' kendi hatasidir; govde hatasi gorevde kalir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskSpawn(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    If ins.operandCount < 5 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: TASK_SPAWN lane, tur, ad ve sonuc tipi ister")
    Dim laneName As String = UCase(UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(1)))
    Dim kindText As String = UCase(UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(2)))
    Dim taskName As String = UCase(UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(3)))
    Dim resultType As String = UCase(UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(4)))

    Dim labelIdx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindLabel(st, laneName)
    If labelIdx < 0 Or labelIdx >= instructionCount Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: SPAWN hedef rutini bulunamadi: " & taskName & " (" & laneName & ")")

    Dim laneLabel As UXBMIRInstructionRecord = instructions(labelIdx)
    Dim paramCount As Integer = laneLabel.operandCount - 1
    If paramCount < 0 Then paramCount = 0
    Dim argCount As Integer = ins.operandCount - 5
    If argCount <> paramCount Then
        Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: SPAWN cagri argumani uyusmuyor " & taskName & " beklenen=" & LTrim(Str(paramCount)) & " gelen=" & LTrim(Str(argCount)))
    End If

    ' Argumanlar CAGIRANIN kapsaminda degerlendirilir (BYVAL kopya), sonra yeni kapsama baglanir.
    Dim argValues(Any) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim i As Integer
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim argValues(paramCount - 1)
    For i = 0 To paramCount - 1
        argValues(i) = UXBInterpLibraryValueCopy(UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(5 + i)))
        If UXBInterpIsError(argValues(i)) <> 0 Then Return argValues(i)
    Next i

    Dim taskId As Integer = UXBInterpHeapAlloc(ctx.heap, "TASK", "TASK")
    With ctx.heap.slots(taskId)
        ReDim .values(0)
        ReDim .names(4)
        .values(0) = UXBInterpValueVoid()
        .names(0) = "RUNNING"
        .names(1) = ""
        .names(2) = taskName
        .names(3) = kindText
        .count = 1
    End With

    UXBMIRInterpEnterScope st
    For i = 0 To paramCount - 1
        Dim paramName As String = Trim(laneLabel.operands(i + 1))
        If Left(paramName, Len(UXB_MIR_CANONICAL_BYREF_PARAM_PREFIX)) = UXB_MIR_CANONICAL_BYREF_PARAM_PREFIX Then
            UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope st
            Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: SPAWN: BYREF parametre asenkron gorevde desteklenmiyor: " & taskName)
        End If
        If paramName <> "" Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, paramName, argValues(i)
    Next i

    Dim bodyErr As String
    Dim bodyValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpInvokeLabel(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, laneName, bodyErr)
    UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope st

    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 AndAlso bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_SIGNAL_PROGRAM_END Then
        ' S-156 sinyali gorev hatasi degildir (izolasyon denetimi gorevde END'i zaten reddeder).
        Return bodyValue
    End If
    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 Then
        ' Mete: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata gorev nesnesinde tutulur" -- cagirana SIZMAZ.
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "ERROR"
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(1) = bodyValue.errorText
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_active", "0"
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_value", ""
    Else
        ' S-149: `THREAD ... AS <tip>` -> sonuc bildirilen tipte (FUNCTION donusu gibi).
        If resultType <> "" Then bodyValue = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(bodyValue, resultType)
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).values(0) = bodyValue
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "DONE"
    End If
    Return UXBMIRTaskHandleValue("TASK", taskId)
End Function

Function UXBMIRInterpExecTaskCall(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByRef handledOut As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    handledOut = 0
    If UXBMIRStep4CanonicalOpcode(ins.opcode) <> "MIR_CALL" Or ins.operandCount < 1 Then Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
    Dim callName As String = UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0)))
    Select Case callName
    Case "TASK_SPAWN", "TASK_WAIT", "TASK_JOIN", "TASK_CANCEL", "TASK_STATUS", "TASK_RESULT", "TASK_ERROR", _
         "TASK_GROUP_CREATE", "TASK_GROUP_ADD", "TASK_GROUP_JOIN"
        handledOut = 1
    Case Else
        Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
    End Select

    Dim resultValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBInterpValueVoid()
    Dim slotId As Integer
    Dim failText As String

    Select Case callName
    Case "TASK_SPAWN"
        resultValue = UXBMIRTaskSpawn(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, ins)
        If UXBInterpIsError(resultValue) <> 0 Then Return resultValue

    Case "TASK_WAIT", "TASK_JOIN", "TASK_CANCEL", "TASK_STATUS", "TASK_RESULT", "TASK_ERROR"
        If ins.operandCount <> 2 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: " & callName & " tek bir TASK tutamaci ister")
        Dim taskValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(1))
        Dim isValid As Integer = UXBMIRTaskSlot(ctx, taskValue, "TASK", slotId)
        Select Case callName
        Case "TASK_STATUS"
            ' AST ile ayni: SPAWN edilmemis (NULL) tutamacin durumu PENDING.
            If isValid = 0 Then
                resultValue = UXBInterpValueString("PENDING")
            Else
                If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) = "ERROR" Or ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) = "CANCELLED" Then ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(4) = "1"
                resultValue = UXBInterpValueString(ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0))
            End If
        Case "TASK_ERROR"
            If isValid = 0 Then
                resultValue = UXBInterpValueString("")
            Else
                If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(1) <> "" Then ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(4) = "1"
                resultValue = UXBInterpValueString(ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(1))
            End If
        Case "TASK_WAIT"
            If isValid = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASK.WAIT(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci")
            ' Faz 1: gorev SPAWN aninda bitti; WAIT hemen doner.
        Case "TASK_CANCEL"
            If isValid = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASK.CANCEL(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci")
            ' K6: yalniz iptal ISTEGI; tekrar CANCEL zararsiz; baslamamis gorev CANCELLED olur.
            If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) = "PENDING" Then
                ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) = "CANCELLED"
                ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(1) = "CANCELLED"
            End If
        Case "TASK_JOIN", "TASK_RESULT"
            If isValid = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError(IIf(callName = "TASK_JOIN", "TASK.JOIN()", "TASK.RESULT") & ": bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci")
            If UXBMIRTaskFailureText(ctx, slotId, failText) <> 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError(failText)
            resultValue = ctx.heap.slots(slotId).values(0)
        End Select

    Case "TASK_GROUP_CREATE"
        If ins.operandCount <> 1 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("MIR: TASK_GROUP_CREATE arguman almaz")
        Dim groupId As Integer = UXBInterpHeapAlloc(ctx.heap, "TASKGROUP", "TASKGROUP")
        ctx.heap.slots(groupId).count = 0
        resultValue = UXBMIRTaskHandleValue("TASKGROUP", groupId)

    Case "TASK_GROUP_ADD"
        If ins.operandCount <> 3 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASKGROUP.ADD(gorev) tam bir arguman ister")
        Dim addGroup As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(1))
        If UXBMIRTaskSlot(ctx, addGroup, "TASKGROUP", slotId) = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASKGROUP.ADD(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci")
        Dim member As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(2))
        Dim memberSlot As Integer
        If UXBMIRTaskSlot(ctx, member, "TASK", memberSlot) = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASKGROUP.ADD(): arguman bir TASK olmali")
        With ctx.heap.slots(slotId)
            If .count = 0 Then
                ReDim .values(0)
            Else
                ReDim Preserve .values(.count)
            End If
            .values(.count) = member
            .count += 1
        End With

    Case "TASK_GROUP_JOIN"
        If ins.operandCount <> 2 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASKGROUP.JOIN() arguman almaz")
        Dim joinGroup As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(1))
        If UXBMIRTaskSlot(ctx, joinGroup, "TASKGROUP", slotId) = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError("TASKGROUP.JOIN(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci")
        ' Faz 1: uyeler zaten bitti; ilk HATALI/IPTAL uye (ekleme sirasina gore) cagirana yukselir.
        Dim gi As Integer
        For gi = 0 To ctx.heap.slots(slotId).count - 1
            Dim memberSlotId As Integer
            If UXBMIRTaskSlot(ctx, ctx.heap.slots(slotId).values(gi), "TASK", memberSlotId) <> 0 Then
                If UXBMIRTaskFailureText(ctx, memberSlotId, failText) <> 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskError(failText)
            End If
        Next gi
    End Select

    If Trim(ins.resultName) <> "" Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, ins.resultName, resultValue
    Return resultValue
End Function

#endif

194	        ' S-156: rutin icindeki END -- calisma zamani K5 kapanisini yapip sureci bitirir (donmez).
195	        handledOut = 1
196	        MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall0 cg, "__uxb_rt_program_end"
197	        Return 1
198	    Case "TASK_GROUP_ADD"
199	        handledOut = 1
200	        If ins.operandCount <> 3 Then
201	            errText = "MIR x64 emitter: TASK_GROUP_ADD grup ve gorev ister"

220	    If targetBlockId > gMirX64CurrentBlockId Then Exit Sub
221	    Dim okLabel As String = MIRX64NextLabel(cg, "task_not_cancelled")
222	    MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall0 cg, "__uxb_rt_task_cancel_point"
223	    MIRX64Emit cg, "    test rax, rax"
224	    MIRX64Emit cg, "    jz " & okLabel
225	    MIRX64Emit cg, "    xor eax, eax"

239	Function MIRX64EmitSpawnThunks(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
240	    If MIRX64ModuleUsesSpawn() = 0 Then Return 1
241	    Dim fi As Integer
242	    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
243	        If MIRX64IsSpawnLane(m.functions(fi).name) = 0 Then Continue For
244	        Dim fn As MIRFunction Ptr = @m.functions(fi)
245	        Dim argCount As Integer = fn->paramVarCount
246	        Dim extraCount As Integer = argCount - 4
247	        If extraCount < 0 Then extraCount = 0
248	        ' Giriste rsp = 16k+8; push rbp, push rbx sonrasi 16k+8 -> cagrida 16 hizali olmali.
249	        Dim frameBytes As Integer = 32 + extraCount * 8
250	        If (frameBytes Mod 16) = 0 Then frameBytes += 8
251	
252	        MIRX64Emit cg, MIRX64TaskThunkLabel(fn->name) & ":"
253	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    push rbp"
254	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rbp, rsp"
255	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    push rbx"
256	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(frameBytes)
257	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rbx, rcx"
258	        Dim i As Integer
259	        For i = 4 To argCount - 1
260	            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rax, qword [rbx+" & MIRX64ToStr(8 + i * 8) & "]"
261	            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp+" & MIRX64ToStr(32 + (i - 4) * 8) & "], rax"
262	        Next i
263	        For i = 0 To IIf(argCount < 4, argCount, 4) - 1
264	            Dim paramType As String
265	            paramType = UCase(Trim(fn->paramVarTypes(i)))
266	            Dim off As String = MIRX64ToStr(8 + i * 8)
267	            If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(paramType) <> 0 Then
268	                If paramType = "F32" Then
269	                    MIRX64Emit cg, "    movd " & UXBWin64FloatArgReg(i) & ", dword [rbx+" & off & "]"
270	                Else
271	                    MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq " & UXBWin64FloatArgReg(i) & ", qword [rbx+" & off & "]"
272	                End If
273	            Else
274	                MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov " & UXBWin64IntegerArgReg(i) & ", qword [rbx+" & off & "]"
275	            End If
276	        Next i
277	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    call " & MIRX64FunctionLabel(fn->name)
278	        If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(fn->returnType) <> 0 Then
279	            If UCase(Trim(fn->returnType)) = "F32" Then MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtss2sd xmm0, xmm0"
280	            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq qword [rbx], xmm0"
281	        Else
282	            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rbx], rax"
283	        End If
284	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    xor eax, eax"
285	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    add rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(frameBytes)
286	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    pop rbx"
287	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    pop rbp"
288	        MIRX64Emit cg, "    ret"
289	    Next fi
290	    Return 1
291	End Function
292	
293	#endif

#ifndef UXB_MIR_X64_TASK_V2_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_X64_TASK_V2_FBS

' ===========================================================================
' S-030 Faz 2A: native x64'te gercek eszamanli gorevler (gorev ABI v2).
' Plan: docs/tasarim/UXB_S030_FAZ2A_NATIVE_ASYNC_PLANI_20260925_TR.md
' Calisma zamani: native/uxb_runtime/uxb_runtime_task_v2.cpp (thunk sozlesmesi orada).
'
' Kanonik MIR cagrilari (mir_lower_expr.fbs basindaki sozlesme) calisma zamani
' fonksiyonlarina iner:
'   TASK_SPAWN   -> arguman blogu yigina yazilir + __uxb_rt_task_spawn(thunk, blok, ...)
'   TASK_JOIN/RESULT/WAIT/CANCEL/STATUS/ERROR, TASK_GROUP_CREATE/ADD/JOIN -> __uxb_rt_task_*
' Her SPAWN hedefi lane icin bir thunk uretilir: bloktan argumanlari Win64 kuraliyla
' (ilk 4 register/xmm, kalani yigin) yukleyip lane'i cagirir, sonucu blok[0]'a yazar.
' Blok duzeni: [0..7] sonuc, [8 + 8*i] i. arguman (tamsayi degeri / F64 bitleri /
' F32 icin alt 32 bit / STRING adresi -- calisma zamani STRING'i SPAWN aninda kopyalar).
' ===========================================================================

Dim Shared gMirX64SpawnLanes As String   ' "|__SLOTLANE_THREAD_WORKER|..." -- MIRX64EmitModule doldurur
' K4: --task-workers N (0 = verilmedi -> AUTO). main_program_entry.fbs ayristirir; SPAWN kullanan
' programin main girisinde __uxb_rt_task_set_workers ile calisma zamanina gomulur.
Dim Shared gMirX64TaskWorkers As Integer

Private Function MIRX64TaskUnquote(ByVal s As String) As String
    s = Trim(s)
    If Len(s) >= 2 AndAlso Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) AndAlso Right(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return Mid(s, 2, Len(s) - 2)
    Return s
End Function

Sub MIRX64CollectSpawnLanes(ByRef m As MIRModule)
    gMirX64SpawnLanes = "|"
    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim ii As Integer
            For ii = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
                Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction
                ins = m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(ii)
                If MIRX64CanonicalEmitterOpcode(ins.opcode) <> "CALL" Or ins.operandCount < 5 Then Continue For
                If UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0))) <> "TASK_SPAWN" Then Continue For
                Dim lane As String
                lane = UCase(MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(1)))
                If InStr(gMirX64SpawnLanes, "|" & lane & "|") = 0 Then gMirX64SpawnLanes &= lane & "|"
            Next ii
        Next bi
    Next fi
End Sub

Function MIRX64ModuleUsesSpawn() As Integer
    Return IIf(Len(gMirX64SpawnLanes) > 1, 1, 0)
End Function

Function MIRX64IsSpawnLane(ByRef functionName As String) As Integer
    Return IIf(InStr(gMirX64SpawnLanes, "|" & UCase(Trim(functionName)) & "|") > 0, 1, 0)
End Function

Private Function MIRX64TaskThunkLabel(ByRef laneName As String) As String
    Return "__uxb_task_thunk_" & MIRX64SanitizeSymbolName(UCase(Trim(laneName)))
End Function

' 0=VOID, 1=I64, 2=F64, 3=STRING (calisma zamani ile ayni). Tipsiz gorev de tamsayi
' sonuc tasiyabilir (AST/MIR'de `THREAD W(x) ... RETURN x` degeri JOIN ile okunur).
Private Function MIRX64TaskResultKind(ByVal typeText As String) As Integer
    Dim t As String = UCase(Trim(typeText))
    If t = "STRING" Then Return 3
    If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(t) <> 0 Then Return 2
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir sonucu (rax'taki 64 bit) MIR sonuc degiskenine turune gore yazar.
Private Function MIRX64TaskStoreRaxResult(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If Trim(ins.result) = "" Then Return 1
    If MIRX64OperandIsFloat(cg, ins.result) <> 0 Then
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq xmm0, rax"
        Return MIRX64StoreXmmToVar(cg, "xmm0", ins.result, errText)
    End If
    Return MIRX64StoreRegToVar(cg, "rax", ins.result, errText)
End Function

Private Function MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef symbolName As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If ins.operandCount <> 2 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: " & UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0))) & " tek bir tutamac ister"
        Return 0
    End If
    If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, ins.operands(1), "r10", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall1Reg cg, symbolName, "r10"
    Return MIRX64TaskStoreRaxResult(ins, cg, errText)
End Function

Private Function MIRX64EmitTaskSpawnCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If ins.operandCount < 5 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: TASK_SPAWN lane, tur, ad ve sonuc tipi ister"
        Return 0
    End If
    Dim laneName As String = MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(1))
    Dim taskName As String = MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(3))
    Dim resultType As String = MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(4))
    Dim laneIdx As Integer = MIRX64FindUserFunctionIndex(cg, laneName)
    If laneIdx < 0 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: SPAWN hedef rutini bulunamadi: " & laneName
        Return 0
    End If
    Dim argCount As Integer = ins.operandCount - 5
    If argCount <> cg.modulePtr->functions(laneIdx).paramVarCount Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: SPAWN arguman sayisi uyusmuyor: " & taskName
        Return 0
    End If
    If argCount > 61 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: SPAWN en fazla 61 arguman alir"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim blockBytes As Integer = 8 + argCount * 8
    If (blockBytes Mod 16) <> 0 Then blockBytes += 8
    Dim stringMask As LongInt = 0

    MIRX64Emit cg, "    ; S-030 SPAWN " & taskName & " -> " & laneName
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(blockBytes)
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp], 0"
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To argCount - 1
        Dim paramType As String
        paramType = UCase(Trim(cg.modulePtr->functions(laneIdx).paramVarTypes(i)))
        Dim slotRef As String = "qword [rsp+" & MIRX64ToStr(8 + i * 8) & "]"
        If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(paramType) <> 0 Then
            If MIRX64LoadFloatOperandToXmm(cg, ins.operands(5 + i), "xmm0", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
            If paramType = "F32" Then
                MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtsd2ss xmm0, xmm0"
                MIRX64Emit cg, "    movd eax, xmm0"
            Else
                MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq rax, xmm0"
            End If
        Else
            If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, ins.operands(5 + i), "rax", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
            If paramType = "STRING" Then stringMask = stringMask Or (1LL Shl i)
        End If
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov " & slotRef & ", rax"
    Next i

    Dim nameLabel As String
    If MIRX64EnsureStringLiteralLabel(cg, Chr(34) & taskName & Chr(34), nameLabel) = 0 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: SPAWN gorev adi etiketi olusturulamadi"
        Return 0
    End If
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeExtern cg, "__uxb_rt_task_spawn"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rdx, rsp"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, 48"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    lea rcx, [rel " & MIRX64TaskThunkLabel(laneName) & "]"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov r8, " & MIRX64ToStr(blockBytes)
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    lea r9, [rel " & nameLabel & "]"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp+32], " & MIRX64ToStr(MIRX64TaskResultKind(resultType))
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rax, " & LTrim(Str(stringMask))
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp+40], rax"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    call __uxb_rt_task_spawn"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    add rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(48 + blockBytes)
    Return MIRX64StoreRegToVar(cg, "rax", ins.result, errText)
End Function

Function MIRX64TryEmitTaskV2Call(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef handledOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    handledOut = 0
    If ins.operandCount < 1 Then Return 1
    Dim target As String = UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0)))
    Select Case target
    Case "TASK_SPAWN"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64EmitTaskSpawnCall(ins, cg, errText)
    Case "TASK_JOIN"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_join", errText)
    Case "TASK_RESULT"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_result", errText)
    Case "TASK_WAIT"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_wait", errText)
    Case "TASK_CANCEL"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_cancel", errText)
    Case "TASK_STATUS"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_status", errText)
    Case "TASK_ERROR"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_error", errText)
    Case "TASK_GROUP_CREATE"
        handledOut = 1
        MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall0 cg, "__uxb_rt_task_group_create"
        Return MIRX64TaskStoreRaxResult(ins, cg, errText)
    Case "TASK_GROUP_JOIN"
        handledOut = 1
        Return MIRX64TaskEmitHandleCall(ins, cg, "__uxb_rt_task_group_join", errText)
    Case "PROGRAM_END"
        ' S-156: rutin icindeki END -- calisma zamani K5 kapanisini yapip sureci bitirir (donmez).
        handledOut = 1
        MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall0 cg, "__uxb_rt_program_end"
        Return 1
    Case "TASK_GROUP_ADD"
        handledOut = 1
        If ins.operandCount <> 3 Then
            errText = "MIR x64 emitter: TASK_GROUP_ADD grup ve gorev ister"
            Return 0
        End If
        If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, ins.operands(1), "r10", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, ins.operands(2), "r11", errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall2Reg cg, "__uxb_rt_task_group_add", "r10", "r11"
        Return MIRX64TaskStoreRaxResult(ins, cg, errText)
    End Select
    Return 1
End Function

' K6 isbirlikci iptal noktasi: SPAWN lane'inde her DONGU GERI DONUSUNDE (hedef blok <= mevcut blok)
' calisma zamanina sorulur; iptal istendiyse lane derhal doner (calisma zamani gorevi CANCELLED yapar).
' Bilinen sinir (plan belgesi): lane'in cagirdigi yardimci rutinlerin kendi donguleri iptali
' ancak lane'e dondukten sonra gorur -- native'de cagrilar arasi erken donus mekanizmasi yok.
Dim Shared gMirX64CurrentBlockId As Integer

Sub MIRX64EmitTaskCancelPointIfBackEdge(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByVal targetBlockId As Integer)
    If MIRX64IsSpawnLane(cg.currentFunctionName) = 0 Then Exit Sub
    If targetBlockId > gMirX64CurrentBlockId Then Exit Sub
    Dim okLabel As String = MIRX64NextLabel(cg, "task_not_cancelled")
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall0 cg, "__uxb_rt_task_cancel_point"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    test rax, rax"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    jz " & okLabel
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    xor eax, eax"
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    jmp " & MIRX64CurrentEpilogueLabel(cg)
    MIRX64Emit cg, okLabel & ":"
End Sub

' Yakalanmamis THROW, SPAWN lane'inde ekrana basilmaz: gorev kaydina ERROR olarak yazilir
' (Mete: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata gorev nesnesinde tutulur"). Deger rax'ta.
Sub MIRX64EmitTaskFailFromRax(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByVal valueIsString As Integer)
    Dim sym As String
    sym = IIf(valueIsString <> 0, "__uxb_rt_task_fail_cstr", "__uxb_rt_task_fail_i64")
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeCall1Reg cg, sym, "rax"
End Sub

' SPAWN hedefi her lane icin thunk: int64 thunk(void* blok).
Function MIRX64EmitSpawnThunks(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If MIRX64ModuleUsesSpawn() = 0 Then Return 1
    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        If MIRX64IsSpawnLane(m.functions(fi).name) = 0 Then Continue For
        Dim fn As MIRFunction Ptr = @m.functions(fi)
        Dim argCount As Integer = fn->paramVarCount
        Dim extraCount As Integer = argCount - 4
        If extraCount < 0 Then extraCount = 0
        ' Giriste rsp = 16k+8; push rbp, push rbx sonrasi 16k+8 -> cagrida 16 hizali olmali.
        Dim frameBytes As Integer = 32 + extraCount * 8
        If (frameBytes Mod 16) = 0 Then frameBytes += 8

        MIRX64Emit cg, MIRX64TaskThunkLabel(fn->name) & ":"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    push rbp"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rbp, rsp"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    push rbx"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(frameBytes)
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rbx, rcx"
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 4 To argCount - 1
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rax, qword [rbx+" & MIRX64ToStr(8 + i * 8) & "]"
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp+" & MIRX64ToStr(32 + (i - 4) * 8) & "], rax"
        Next i
        For i = 0 To IIf(argCount < 4, argCount, 4) - 1
            Dim paramType As String
            paramType = UCase(Trim(fn->paramVarTypes(i)))
            Dim off As String = MIRX64ToStr(8 + i * 8)
            If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(paramType) <> 0 Then
                If paramType = "F32" Then
                    MIRX64Emit cg, "    movd " & UXBWin64FloatArgReg(i) & ", dword [rbx+" & off & "]"
                Else
                    MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq " & UXBWin64FloatArgReg(i) & ", qword [rbx+" & off & "]"
                End If
            Else
                MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov " & UXBWin64IntegerArgReg(i) & ", qword [rbx+" & off & "]"
            End If
        Next i
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    call " & MIRX64FunctionLabel(fn->name)
        If MIRX64TypeIsFloat(fn->returnType) <> 0 Then
            If UCase(Trim(fn->returnType)) = "F32" Then MIRX64Emit cg, "    cvtss2sd xmm0, xmm0"
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    movq qword [rbx], xmm0"
        Else
            MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rbx], rax"
        End If
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    xor eax, eax"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    add rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(frameBytes)
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    pop rbx"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    pop rbp"
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    ret"
    Next fi
    Return 1
End Function

#ifndef UXB_MIR_EMIT_API_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_EMIT_API_FBS

#include once "mir_instruction_builder.fbs"

Function MIRCommitInstruction(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByRef b As MIRInstrBuilder, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim inst As MIRIRInstruction
    If MIRBuilderToInstruction(b, inst, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    inst.blockId = blockIdx
    Dim blk As MIRBasicBlock Ptr
    blk = @module.functions(fnIdx).blocks(blockIdx)
    Dim cnt As Integer
    cnt = blk->instructionCount
    If cnt = 0 Then
        ReDim blk->instructions(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve blk->instructions(cnt)
    End If
    blk->instructions(cnt) = inst
    blk->instructionCount = cnt + 1
    Return 1
End Function

Function MIREmitLoadConst(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal constText As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "LOAD_CONST", resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, constText, MIR_OPR_CONST, typeText
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitLoadVar(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal varName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "LOAD_VAR", resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, varName, MIR_OPR_VAR, typeText, symbolIdx
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitStoreVar(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal targetName As String, ByVal sourceName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByVal symbolIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, "STORE_VAR", targetName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, sourceName, MIR_OPR_SOURCE, typeText, symbolIdx
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function

Function MIREmitBinary(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blockIdx As Integer, ByVal opcodeText As String, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal leftName As String, ByVal rightName As String, ByVal typeText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim b As MIRInstrBuilder
    MIRBuilderInit b, opcodeText, resultName, typeText
    MIRBuilderSetSource b, gMIRCurrentSource
    MIRBuilderAddText b, leftName, MIR_OPR_VALUE, typeText
    MIRBuilderAddText b, rightName, MIR_OPR_VALUE, typeText
    Return MIRCommitInstruction(module, fnIdx, blockIdx, b, errText)
End Function
