input.content:
#ifndef UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS

' ===========================================================================
' S-146 Model D (Mete 2026-09-26, belge §10 + §10.1): gorevlerle paylasilan
' globallere OTOMATIK senkron. Dil garantisi: iki gorev `toplam += x` yaparsa
' sonuc her motorda kesindir.
'
' Girdi: semantic_task_isolation.fbs'in senkron kumesi (SPAWN hedeflerinin gecisli
' dokundugu globaller) ve her MIR buyrugunun stmtSeq'i (ureten deyim).
' Cikti (kanonik MIR_CALL'lar, tum motorlar ayni):
'   SYNC_ENTER "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"   -- depo basina kilit, lockOrderId sirasiyla
'   SYNC_LEAVE "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"
'   STR_SNAPSHOT t                   -- kilitli okunan STRING'in kilit disina tasinan kopyasi
'
' Kurallar:
'  - Bir deyimin ayni bloktaki ardisik buyruklari tek parca kilitlenir ("deyim tek
'    guvenli islem"). Kilit asla bir kullanici rutini cagrisi, gorev islemi, bekleyen
'    giris ya da dallanma boyunca tutulmaz.
'  - §10.1: deyimdeki kullanici rutini cagrilari (argumanlariyla) deyimin ortak depo
'    okumalarindan ONCE hesaplanir; aradaki buyruklar yan etkisizse cagri dilimi one
'    alinir. Boylece `g = g * 2 + F()` de tek kilit altinda okunup yazilir.
'  - Cagriya/dallanmaya dogrudan islenen olarak giden ortak global once kendi kisa
'    kilidi altinda gecici degere okunur.
'  - Senkron kumesi bos (SPAWN yok) ise gecis hicbir sey yapmaz: sifir maliyet.
' ===========================================================================

Declare Function UXBTaskSyncActive() As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer

Dim Shared gMirSyncLocals As String       ' "|AD|" gecerli fonksiyonun yerel+parametre adlari
Dim Shared gMirSyncUserFns As String      ' "|AD|" modul fonksiyon adlari (kullanici kodu)
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeNames(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeValues(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeCount As Integer

Private Function MIRSyncUnquote(ByVal s As String) As String
    s = Trim(s)
    If Len(s) >= 2 AndAlso Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) AndAlso Right(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return Mid(s, 2, Len(s) - 2)
    Return s
End Function

' Islenenin depo adi (alan yolu "PT.X" -> "PT"); gecici/sabit/etiket icin "".
Private Function MIRSyncBaseName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As String
    Dim s As String = UCase(Trim(operandRaw))
    If s = "" Then Return ""
    Dim c As String = Left(s, 1)
    If c = Chr(34) Or c = "-" Or c = "+" Or c = "." Or (c >= "0" And c <= "9") Then Return ""
    If Left(s, 2) = "__" Then Return ""
    Dim cut As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        Dim ch As String = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If ch = "." Or ch = "(" Or ch = "[" Then cut = i: Exit For
    Next i
    If cut > 0 Then s = Left(s, cut - 1)
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsSyncName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If InStr(gMirSyncLocals, "|" & b & "|") > 0 Then Return 0
    Return UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(b)
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsCallOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "CALL", "MIR_CALL", "METHOD_CALL", "MIR_METHOD_CALL", "MIR_VIRTUAL_CALL", "MIR_OBJECT_NEW", "NEW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsControlOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "RET", "JMP", "JZ", "JNZ", "LABEL", "GOTO", "GOSUB", "INLINE", "MIR_RET", "MIR_JMP", "MIR_JZ", "MIR_JNZ", "RETURN_GOSUB"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Kilit tutulurken yapilamayacak cagri: kullanici kodu, gorev/kilit islemi, bekleyen giris.
Private Function MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) = 0 Then Return 0
    Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    If op <> "CALL" And op <> "MIR_CALL" Then Return 1   ' metot/sanal cagri/nesne kurucu = kullanici kodu
    If ins.operandCount < 1 Then Return 0
    Dim n As String = UCase(MIRSyncUnquote(ins.operands(0)))
    If InStr(gMirSyncUserFns, "|" & n & "|") > 0 Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "TASK_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SYNC_" Or Left(n, 5) = "LOCK_" Or Left(n, 6) = "MUTEX_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SLOT_" Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "SHELL" Or Left(n, 5) = "EVENT" Or Left(n, 7) = "TRIGGER" Or Left(n, 4) = "PIPE" Then Return 1
    Select Case n
    Case "PROGRAM_END", "INPUT", "INPUTF", "LINE_INPUT", "LINEINPUT", "GETKEY", "SLEEP", "DELAY", "RAISE", "EMIT", "CALLPTR", "CALL_PTR", "INVOKE", "DISPATCH", "THROW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Buyrugun ortak global islenen indeksleri (CALL'da hedef adi haric). Bulunanlari "|i|" olarak dondurur;
' sonuc (hedef) ortak ise resultIsSync = 1.
Private Function MIRSyncTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef resultIsSync As Integer) As String
    resultIsSync = 0
    Dim found As String = ""
    If Trim(ins.result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.result) <> 0 Then resultIsSync = 1
    Dim firstOp As Integer = 0
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then firstOp = 1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = firstOp To ins.operandCount - 1
        If MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.operands(i)) <> 0 Then found &= "|" & LTrim(Str(i)) & "|"
    Next i
    Return found
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncInstrTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Dim r As Integer
    Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, r)
    Return IIf(r <> 0 Or f <> "", 1, 0)
End Function

' Yan etkisiz (one alinan cagri diliminin atlayabilecegi) buyruk.
Private Function MIRSyncIsPure(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    If MIRSyncIsControlOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "STORE_VAR", "STORE_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_STORE", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_STORE", "DIM", "REDIM", "CONST", "DEF_TYPE", _
         "SETSTRINGSIZE", "MIR_MEMORY_COPY", "MIR_MEMORY_FILL", "MIR_MEMORY_STORE", "MIR_MEMORY_WRITE_SEQUENCE", "MIR_VIRTUAL_INIT"
        Return 0
    End Select
    Return 1
End Function

' Depo adinin tipi: once modul globali, sonra ayni adi yazan/okuyan buyrugun notu.
Private Function MIRSyncTypeOf(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As String
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return UCase(Trim(m.globalVarTypes(i)))
    Next i
    For i = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
        If gMirSyncTypeNames(i) = n Then Return gMirSyncTypeValues(i)
    Next i
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return IIf(m.globalVarIsArray(i) <> 0, 1, 0)
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncCollectTypeNotes(ByRef m As MIRModule)
    gMirSyncTypeCount = 0
    Erase gMirSyncTypeNames
    Erase gMirSyncTypeValues
    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim ii As Integer
            For ii = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
                Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(ii)
                Dim nm As String = ""
                Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
                If op = "STORE_VAR" Then nm = ins.result
                If op = "LOAD_VAR" AndAlso ins.operandCount >= 1 Then nm = ins.operands(0)
                nm = UCase(Trim(nm))
                If nm = "" Or InStr(nm, ".") = 0 Then Continue For
                Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(ins.resultType))
                If ty = "" Or ty = "MISSING" Then Continue For
                Dim k As Integer
                Dim have As Integer = 0
                For k = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
                    If gMirSyncTypeNames(k) = nm Then have = 1: Exit For
                Next k
                If have Then Continue For
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount) = nm
                gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount) = ty
                gMirSyncTypeCount += 1
            Next ii
        Next bi
    Next fi
End Sub

' Kume "|AD|" -> lockOrderId sirasiyla "id1,id2" ve "AD1,AD2".
Private Sub MIRSyncOrderedLists(ByVal nameSet As String, ByRef idsOut As String, ByRef namesOut As String)
    idsOut = ""
    namesOut = ""
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim ids(Any) As Integer
    Dim cnt As Integer = 0
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(nameSet)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, nameSet, "|")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim nm As String = Mid(nameSet, p, q - p)
        If nm <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
            ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
            names(cnt) = nm
            ids(cnt) = UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(nm)
            cnt += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As Integer = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If i > 0 Then idsOut &= ",": namesOut &= ","
        idsOut &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
        namesOut &= names(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncMake(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal opcode As String, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal resultType As String, ByVal nOps As Integer, ByVal op0 As String = "", ByVal op1 As String = "", ByVal op2 As String = "")
    Dim blank As MIRIRInstruction
    ins = blank
    ins.opcode = opcode
    ins.result = resultName
    ins.resultType = resultType
    ins.blockId = tmpl.blockId
    ins.srcLoc = tmpl.srcLoc
    ins.flags = tmpl.flags
    ins.stmtSeq = tmpl.stmtSeq
    ins.operandCount = nOps
    If nOps > 0 Then ins.operands(0) = op0
    If nOps > 1 Then ins.operands(1) = op1
    If nOps > 2 Then ins.operands(2) = op2
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncPush(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction)
    If outCount > UBound(outArr) Then ReDim Preserve outArr(outCount * 2 + 8)
    outArr(outCount) = ins
    outCount += 1
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal isEnter As Integer, ByVal nameSet As String)
    Dim idsCsv As String, namesCsv As String
    MIRSyncOrderedLists nameSet, idsCsv, namesCsv
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction
    MIRSyncMake ins, tmpl, "CALL", "", "", 3, IIf(isEnter <> 0, "SYNC_ENTER", "SYNC_LEAVE"), Chr(34) & idsCsv & Chr(34), Chr(34) & namesCsv & Chr(34)
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
End Sub

Private Function MIRSyncAddName(ByRef setText As String, ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If setText = "" Then setText = "|"
    If InStr(setText, "|" & b & "|") = 0 Then setText &= b & "|"
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir dilimin (runArr[a..b]) ortak depo kumesi.
Private Function MIRSyncSetOf(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As String
    Dim s As String = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = a To b
        Dim r As Integer
        Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(runArr(i), r)
        If r <> 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).result
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If InStr(f, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") > 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).operands(k)
        Next k
    Next i
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsLoadOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "LOAD_VAR", "LOAD_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_LOAD", "FIELD_GET", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_LOAD"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Fonksiyonda (gecis sonrasi dizi haric tutularak) ad kullaniliyor mu.
Private Function MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal fi As Integer, ByVal tempName As String, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer) As Integer
    Dim t As String = UCase(Trim(tempName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If i >= a And i <= b Then Continue For
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
        Next k
    Next i
    ' Deyim disindaki kullanimlar (baska bloklar dahil): sonuc gecicisi deyimler arasi tasinabilir.
    Dim bi As Integer
    For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
        For i = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
            With m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(i)
                If .stmtSeq = runArr(a).stmtSeq Then Continue For
                For k = 0 To .operandCount - 1
                    If UCase(Trim(.operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
                Next k
            End With
        Next i
    Next bi
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncRenameUses(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal fromIdx As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer, ByVal oldName As String, ByVal newName As String)
    Dim o As String = UCase(Trim(oldName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = fromIdx To runCount - 1
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = o Then runArr(i).operands(k) = newName
        Next k
    Next i
End Sub

' §10.1: runArr icinde, ilk ortak depo erisiminden sonra gelen engelleyici cagrilarin
' bagimlilik dilimini (cagri + ayni deyimde urettigi islenenlerin ureticileri) one alir.
Private Sub MIRSyncHoistCalls(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer)
    Dim moved(Any) As Integer
    If runCount <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    ReDim moved(runCount - 1)
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do
        guard += 1
        If guard > runCount + 1 Then Exit Do
        ' Ilk ortak depo erisimi (one alinmis dilimler haric).
        Dim firstTouch As Integer = -1
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then firstTouch = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If firstTouch < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' firstTouch'tan sonraki ilk tasinmamis engelleyici cagri.
        Dim c As Integer = -1
        For i = firstTouch + 1 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then c = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If c < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Dilim: c ve [firstTouch, c) icindeki gecisli ureticileri.
        Dim inSlice(Any) As Integer
        ReDim inSlice(runCount - 1)
        inSlice(c) = 1
        Dim changed As Integer = 1
        Do While changed
            changed = 0
            For i = c - 1 To firstTouch Step -1
                If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
                Dim rn As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).result))
                If rn = "" Then Continue For
                Dim j As Integer, k As Integer
                For j = i + 1 To c
                    If inSlice(j) = 0 Then Continue For
                    For k = 0 To runArr(j).operandCount - 1
                        If UCase(Trim(runArr(j).operands(k))) = rn Then inSlice(i) = 1: changed = 1: Exit For
                    Next k
                    If inSlice(i) Then Exit For
                Next j
            Next i
        Loop
        ' Atlanacak buyruklar yan etkisiz olmali; degilse deyim cagri noktasinda bolunur (erisim basina kilit).
        Dim ok As Integer = 1
        For i = firstTouch To c - 1
            If inSlice(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsPure(runArr(i)) = 0 Then ok = 0: Exit For
        Next i
        If ok = 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Yeniden sirala: [0,firstTouch) + dilim + [firstTouch,c] dilim disi + (c, son].
        Dim tmp(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
        Dim tmpMoved(Any) As Integer
        ReDim tmp(runCount - 1)
        ReDim tmpMoved(runCount - 1)
        Dim w As Integer = 0
        For i = 0 To firstTouch - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = 1: w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) = 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = c + 1 To runCount - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            runArr(i) = tmp(i)
            moved(i) = tmpMoved(i)
        Next i
    Loop
End Sub

' Engelleyici buyrugun (cagri/dallanma) ortak global islenenlerini kisa kilit altinda gecicilere okur;
' sonucu ortak globalse gecici uzerinden kilitli yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitBarrier(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByVal insIn As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = insIn
    Dim resultIsSync As Integer
    Dim found As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, resultIsSync)
    If found <> "" Then
        Dim nameSet As String = ""
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim base As String = MIRSyncBaseName(ins.operands(k))
            If MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(m, base) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ins.operands(k))) = base Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan dizi '" & base & "' bir cagriya butun olarak veriliyor -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (BYREF/dizi paylasiminin omur ve senkron sozlesmesi)"
                Return 0
            End If
            MIRSyncAddName nameSet, ins.operands(k)
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, nameSet
        Dim snaps As String = ""
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim ty As String = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, ins.operands(k))
            Dim tLoad As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
            Dim ld As MIRIRInstruction
            MIRSyncMake ld, ins, "LOAD_VAR", tLoad, ty, 1, ins.operands(k)
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ld
            If ty = "STRING" Then
                Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                MIRSyncMake sn, ins, "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", tLoad
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                tLoad = tSnap
            End If
            ins.operands(k) = tLoad
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, nameSet
    End If
    If resultIsSync <> 0 Then
        Dim target As String = ins.result
        Dim tRes As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
        ins.result = tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
        Dim rs As String = ""
        MIRSyncAddName rs, target
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, rs
        Dim st As MIRIRInstruction
        MIRSyncMake st, ins, "STORE_VAR", target, ins.resultType, 1, tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, st
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, rs
        Return 1
    End If
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir deyim parcasini (ayni stmtSeq, dallanmasiz) kilitleyerek yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitRun(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal fi As Integer, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If runCount <= 0 Then Return 1
    Dim anyTouch As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then anyTouch = 1: Exit For
    Next i
    If anyTouch = 0 Then
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
        Next i
        Return 1
    End If

    ' Adresi alinan ortak global: ham erisim kilidi atlar (UNSAFE disinda tani).
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).opcode)) = "MIR_VARPTR" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
            If UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ps, runArr(i).flags) = 0 Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan global icin VARPTR -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 7 (isaretci/MemoryRef paylasimi); ham adresle erisim sorumlulugu UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE ile alinabilir"
                Return 0
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    MIRSyncHoistCalls runArr(), runCount

    ' Engelleyici cagrilarla bolunmus parcalar; her parca ilk..son erisim arasinda kilitlenir.
    Dim segStart As Integer = 0
    Do While segStart < runCount
        Dim segEnd As Integer = segStart
        Do While segEnd < runCount AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(segEnd)) = 0
            segEnd += 1
        Loop
        ' [segStart, segEnd) kilitlenebilir parca; segEnd (varsa) engelleyici.
        Dim first As Integer = -1, last As Integer = -1
        For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                If first < 0 Then first = i
                last = i
            End If
        Next i
        If first < 0 Then
            For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        Else
            For i = segStart To first - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
            Dim nameSet As String = MIRSyncSetOf(runArr(), first, last)
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(first), 1, nameSet
            For i = first To last
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
                ' Kilit disina tasinan STRING okuma: sahibi olan global yazildiginda eski metin serbest
                ' birakilir; kilit bitmeden kopyalanir ve sonraki kullanimlar kopyaya yonlenir.
                If MIRSyncIsLoadOp(runArr(i)) <> 0 AndAlso Trim(runArr(i).result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                    Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).resultType))
                    If ty <> "STRING" AndAlso runArr(i).operandCount >= 1 Then ty = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, runArr(i).operands(0))
                    If ty = "STRING" AndAlso MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(m, fi, runArr(i).result, runArr(), first, last, runCount) <> 0 Then
                        Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                        Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                        MIRSyncMake sn, runArr(i), "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", runArr(i).result
                        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                        MIRSyncRenameUses runArr(), last + 1, runCount, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                        MIRSyncRenameLaterUses m, fi, runArr(i).stmtSeq, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(last), 0, nameSet
            For i = last + 1 To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        End If
        If segEnd < runCount Then
            If MIRSyncEmitBarrier(m, ps, outArr(), outCount, runArr(segEnd), tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
            segEnd += 1
        End If
        segStart = segEnd
    Loop
    Return 1
End Function

#ifndef UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS

' ===========================================================================
' S-146 Model D (Mete 2026-09-26, belge §10 + §10.1): gorevlerle paylasilan
' globallere OTOMATIK senkron. Dil garantisi: iki gorev `toplam += x` yaparsa
' sonuc her motorda kesindir.
'
' Girdi: semantic_task_isolation.fbs'in senkron kumesi (SPAWN hedeflerinin gecisli
' dokundugu globaller) ve her MIR buyrugunun stmtSeq'i (ureten deyim).
' Cikti (kanonik MIR_CALL'lar, tum motorlar ayni):
'   SYNC_ENTER "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"   -- depo basina kilit, lockOrderId sirasiyla
'   SYNC_LEAVE "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"
'   STR_SNAPSHOT t                   -- kilitli okunan STRING'in kilit disina tasinan kopyasi
'
' Kurallar:
'  - Bir deyimin ayni bloktaki ardisik buyruklari tek parca kilitlenir ("deyim tek
'    guvenli islem"). Kilit asla bir kullanici rutini cagrisi, gorev islemi, bekleyen
'    giris ya da dallanma boyunca tutulmaz.
'  - §10.1: deyimdeki kullanici rutini cagrilari (argumanlariyla) deyimin ortak depo
'    okumalarindan ONCE hesaplanir; aradaki buyruklar yan etkisizse cagri dilimi one
'    alinir. Boylece `g = g * 2 + F()` de tek kilit altinda okunup yazilir.
'  - Cagriya/dallanmaya dogrudan islenen olarak giden ortak global once kendi kisa
'    kilidi altinda gecici degere okunur.
'  - Senkron kumesi bos (SPAWN yok) ise gecis hicbir sey yapmaz: sifir maliyet.
' ===========================================================================

Declare Function UXBTaskSyncActive() As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer

Dim Shared gMirSyncLocals As String       ' "|AD|" gecerli fonksiyonun yerel+parametre adlari
Dim Shared gMirSyncUserFns As String      ' "|AD|" modul fonksiyon adlari (kullanici kodu)
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeNames(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeValues(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeCount As Integer

Private Function MIRSyncUnquote(ByVal s As String) As String
    s = Trim(s)
    If Len(s) >= 2 AndAlso Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) AndAlso Right(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return Mid(s, 2, Len(s) - 2)
    Return s
End Function

' Islenenin depo adi (alan yolu "PT.X" -> "PT"); gecici/sabit/etiket icin "".
Private Function MIRSyncBaseName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As String
    Dim s As String = UCase(Trim(operandRaw))
    If s = "" Then Return ""
    Dim c As String = Left(s, 1)
    If c = Chr(34) Or c = "-" Or c = "+" Or c = "." Or (c >= "0" And c <= "9") Then Return ""
    If Left(s, 2) = "__" Then Return ""
    Dim cut As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        Dim ch As String = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If ch = "." Or ch = "(" Or ch = "[" Then cut = i: Exit For
    Next i
    If cut > 0 Then s = Left(s, cut - 1)
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsSyncName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If InStr(gMirSyncLocals, "|" & b & "|") > 0 Then Return 0
    Return UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(b)
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsCallOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "CALL", "MIR_CALL", "METHOD_CALL", "MIR_METHOD_CALL", "MIR_VIRTUAL_CALL", "MIR_OBJECT_NEW", "NEW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsControlOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "RET", "JMP", "JZ", "JNZ", "LABEL", "GOTO", "GOSUB", "INLINE", "MIR_RET", "MIR_JMP", "MIR_JZ", "MIR_JNZ", "RETURN_GOSUB"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Kilit tutulurken yapilamayacak cagri: kullanici kodu, gorev/kilit islemi, bekleyen giris.
Private Function MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) = 0 Then Return 0
    Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    If op <> "CALL" And op <> "MIR_CALL" Then Return 1   ' metot/sanal cagri/nesne kurucu = kullanici kodu
    If ins.operandCount < 1 Then Return 0
    Dim n As String = UCase(MIRSyncUnquote(ins.operands(0)))
    If InStr(gMirSyncUserFns, "|" & n & "|") > 0 Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "TASK_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SYNC_" Or Left(n, 5) = "LOCK_" Or Left(n, 6) = "MUTEX_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SLOT_" Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "SHELL" Or Left(n, 5) = "EVENT" Or Left(n, 7) = "TRIGGER" Or Left(n, 4) = "PIPE" Then Return 1
    Select Case n
    Case "PROGRAM_END", "INPUT", "INPUTF", "LINE_INPUT", "LINEINPUT", "GETKEY", "SLEEP", "DELAY", "RAISE", "EMIT", "CALLPTR", "CALL_PTR", "INVOKE", "DISPATCH", "THROW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Buyrugun ortak global islenen indeksleri (CALL'da hedef adi haric). Bulunanlari "|i|" olarak dondurur;
' sonuc (hedef) ortak ise resultIsSync = 1.
Private Function MIRSyncTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef resultIsSync As Integer) As String
    resultIsSync = 0
    Dim found As String = ""
    If Trim(ins.result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.result) <> 0 Then resultIsSync = 1
    Dim firstOp As Integer = 0
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then firstOp = 1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = firstOp To ins.operandCount - 1
        If MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.operands(i)) <> 0 Then found &= "|" & LTrim(Str(i)) & "|"
    Next i
    Return found
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncInstrTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Dim r As Integer
    Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, r)
    Return IIf(r <> 0 Or f <> "", 1, 0)
End Function

' Yan etkisiz (one alinan cagri diliminin atlayabilecegi) buyruk.
Private Function MIRSyncIsPure(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    If MIRSyncIsControlOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "STORE_VAR", "STORE_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_STORE", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_STORE", "DIM", "REDIM", "CONST", "DEF_TYPE", _
         "SETSTRINGSIZE", "MIR_MEMORY_COPY", "MIR_MEMORY_FILL", "MIR_MEMORY_STORE", "MIR_MEMORY_WRITE_SEQUENCE", "MIR_VIRTUAL_INIT"
        Return 0
    End Select
    Return 1
End Function

' Depo adinin tipi: once modul globali, sonra ayni adi yazan/okuyan buyrugun notu.
Private Function MIRSyncTypeOf(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As String
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return UCase(Trim(m.globalVarTypes(i)))
    Next i
    For i = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
        If gMirSyncTypeNames(i) = n Then Return gMirSyncTypeValues(i)
    Next i
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return IIf(m.globalVarIsArray(i) <> 0, 1, 0)
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncCollectTypeNotes(ByRef m As MIRModule)
    gMirSyncTypeCount = 0
    Erase gMirSyncTypeNames
    Erase gMirSyncTypeValues
    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim ii As Integer
            For ii = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
                Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(ii)
                Dim nm As String = ""
                Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
                If op = "STORE_VAR" Then nm = ins.result
                If op = "LOAD_VAR" AndAlso ins.operandCount >= 1 Then nm = ins.operands(0)
                nm = UCase(Trim(nm))
                If nm = "" Or InStr(nm, ".") = 0 Then Continue For
                Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(ins.resultType))
                If ty = "" Or ty = "MISSING" Then Continue For
                Dim k As Integer
                Dim have As Integer = 0
                For k = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
                    If gMirSyncTypeNames(k) = nm Then have = 1: Exit For
                Next k
                If have Then Continue For
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount) = nm
                gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount) = ty
                gMirSyncTypeCount += 1
            Next ii
        Next bi
    Next fi
End Sub

' Kume "|AD|" -> lockOrderId sirasiyla "id1,id2" ve "AD1,AD2".
Private Sub MIRSyncOrderedLists(ByVal nameSet As String, ByRef idsOut As String, ByRef namesOut As String)
    idsOut = ""
    namesOut = ""
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim ids(Any) As Integer
    Dim cnt As Integer = 0
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(nameSet)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, nameSet, "|")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim nm As String = Mid(nameSet, p, q - p)
        If nm <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
            ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
            names(cnt) = nm
            ids(cnt) = UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(nm)
            cnt += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As Integer = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If i > 0 Then idsOut &= ",": namesOut &= ","
        idsOut &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
        namesOut &= names(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncMake(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal opcode As String, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal resultType As String, ByVal nOps As Integer, ByVal op0 As String = "", ByVal op1 As String = "", ByVal op2 As String = "")
    Dim blank As MIRIRInstruction
    ins = blank
    ins.opcode = opcode
    ins.result = resultName
    ins.resultType = resultType
    ins.blockId = tmpl.blockId
    ins.srcLoc = tmpl.srcLoc
    ins.flags = tmpl.flags
    ins.stmtSeq = tmpl.stmtSeq
    ins.operandCount = nOps
    If nOps > 0 Then ins.operands(0) = op0
    If nOps > 1 Then ins.operands(1) = op1
    If nOps > 2 Then ins.operands(2) = op2
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncPush(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction)
    If outCount > UBound(outArr) Then ReDim Preserve outArr(outCount * 2 + 8)
    outArr(outCount) = ins
    outCount += 1
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal isEnter As Integer, ByVal nameSet As String)
    Dim idsCsv As String, namesCsv As String
    MIRSyncOrderedLists nameSet, idsCsv, namesCsv
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction
    MIRSyncMake ins, tmpl, "CALL", "", "", 3, IIf(isEnter <> 0, "SYNC_ENTER", "SYNC_LEAVE"), Chr(34) & idsCsv & Chr(34), Chr(34) & namesCsv & Chr(34)
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
End Sub

Private Function MIRSyncAddName(ByRef setText As String, ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If setText = "" Then setText = "|"
    If InStr(setText, "|" & b & "|") = 0 Then setText &= b & "|"
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir dilimin (runArr[a..b]) ortak depo kumesi.
Private Function MIRSyncSetOf(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As String
    Dim s As String = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = a To b
        Dim r As Integer
        Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(runArr(i), r)
        If r <> 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).result
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If InStr(f, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") > 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).operands(k)
        Next k
    Next i
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsLoadOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "LOAD_VAR", "LOAD_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_LOAD", "FIELD_GET", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_LOAD"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Fonksiyonda (gecis sonrasi dizi haric tutularak) ad kullaniliyor mu.
Private Function MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal fi As Integer, ByVal tempName As String, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer) As Integer
    Dim t As String = UCase(Trim(tempName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If i >= a And i <= b Then Continue For
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
        Next k
    Next i
    ' Deyim disindaki kullanimlar (baska bloklar dahil): sonuc gecicisi deyimler arasi tasinabilir.
    Dim bi As Integer
    For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
        For i = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
            With m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(i)
                If .stmtSeq = runArr(a).stmtSeq Then Continue For
                For k = 0 To .operandCount - 1
                    If UCase(Trim(.operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
                Next k
            End With
        Next i
    Next bi
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncRenameUses(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal fromIdx As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer, ByVal oldName As String, ByVal newName As String)
    Dim o As String = UCase(Trim(oldName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = fromIdx To runCount - 1
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = o Then runArr(i).operands(k) = newName
        Next k
    Next i
End Sub

' §10.1: runArr icinde, ilk ortak depo erisiminden sonra gelen engelleyici cagrilarin
' bagimlilik dilimini (cagri + ayni deyimde urettigi islenenlerin ureticileri) one alir.
Private Sub MIRSyncHoistCalls(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer)
    Dim moved(Any) As Integer
    If runCount <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    ReDim moved(runCount - 1)
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do
        guard += 1
        If guard > runCount + 1 Then Exit Do
        ' Ilk ortak depo erisimi (one alinmis dilimler haric).
        Dim firstTouch As Integer = -1
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then firstTouch = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If firstTouch < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' firstTouch'tan sonraki ilk tasinmamis engelleyici cagri.
        Dim c As Integer = -1
        For i = firstTouch + 1 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then c = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If c < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Dilim: c ve [firstTouch, c) icindeki gecisli ureticileri.
        Dim inSlice(Any) As Integer
        ReDim inSlice(runCount - 1)
        inSlice(c) = 1
        Dim changed As Integer = 1
        Do While changed
            changed = 0
            For i = c - 1 To firstTouch Step -1
                If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
                Dim rn As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).result))
                If rn = "" Then Continue For
                Dim j As Integer, k As Integer
                For j = i + 1 To c
                    If inSlice(j) = 0 Then Continue For
                    For k = 0 To runArr(j).operandCount - 1
                        If UCase(Trim(runArr(j).operands(k))) = rn Then inSlice(i) = 1: changed = 1: Exit For
                    Next k
                    If inSlice(i) Then Exit For
                Next j
            Next i
        Loop
        ' Atlanacak buyruklar yan etkisiz olmali; degilse deyim cagri noktasinda bolunur (erisim basina kilit).
        Dim ok As Integer = 1
        For i = firstTouch To c - 1
            If inSlice(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsPure(runArr(i)) = 0 Then ok = 0: Exit For
        Next i
        If ok = 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Yeniden sirala: [0,firstTouch) + dilim + [firstTouch,c] dilim disi + (c, son].
        Dim tmp(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
        Dim tmpMoved(Any) As Integer
        ReDim tmp(runCount - 1)
        ReDim tmpMoved(runCount - 1)
        Dim w As Integer = 0
        For i = 0 To firstTouch - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = 1: w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) = 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = c + 1 To runCount - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            runArr(i) = tmp(i)
            moved(i) = tmpMoved(i)
        Next i
    Loop
End Sub

' Engelleyici buyrugun (cagri/dallanma) ortak global islenenlerini kisa kilit altinda gecicilere okur;
' sonucu ortak globalse gecici uzerinden kilitli yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitBarrier(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByVal insIn As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = insIn
    Dim resultIsSync As Integer
    Dim found As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, resultIsSync)
    If found <> "" Then
        Dim nameSet As String = ""
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim base As String = MIRSyncBaseName(ins.operands(k))
            If MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(m, base) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ins.operands(k))) = base Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan dizi '" & base & "' bir cagriya butun olarak veriliyor -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (BYREF/dizi paylasiminin omur ve senkron sozlesmesi)"
                Return 0
            End If
            MIRSyncAddName nameSet, ins.operands(k)
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, nameSet
        Dim snaps As String = ""
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim ty As String = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, ins.operands(k))
            Dim tLoad As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
            Dim ld As MIRIRInstruction
            MIRSyncMake ld, ins, "LOAD_VAR", tLoad, ty, 1, ins.operands(k)
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ld
            If ty = "STRING" Then
                Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                MIRSyncMake sn, ins, "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", tLoad
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                tLoad = tSnap
            End If
            ins.operands(k) = tLoad
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, nameSet
    End If
    If resultIsSync <> 0 Then
        Dim target As String = ins.result
        Dim tRes As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
        ins.result = tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
        Dim rs As String = ""
        MIRSyncAddName rs, target
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, rs
        Dim st As MIRIRInstruction
        MIRSyncMake st, ins, "STORE_VAR", target, ins.resultType, 1, tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, st
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, rs
        Return 1
    End If
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir deyim parcasini (ayni stmtSeq, dallanmasiz) kilitleyerek yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitRun(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal fi As Integer, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If runCount <= 0 Then Return 1
    Dim anyTouch As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then anyTouch = 1: Exit For
    Next i
    If anyTouch = 0 Then
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
        Next i
        Return 1
    End If

    ' Adresi alinan ortak global: ham erisim kilidi atlar (UNSAFE disinda tani).
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).opcode)) = "MIR_VARPTR" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
            If UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ps, runArr(i).flags) = 0 Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan global icin VARPTR -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 7 (isaretci/MemoryRef paylasimi); ham adresle erisim sorumlulugu UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE ile alinabilir"
                Return 0
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    MIRSyncHoistCalls runArr(), runCount

    ' Engelleyici cagrilarla bolunmus parcalar; her parca ilk..son erisim arasinda kilitlenir.
    Dim segStart As Integer = 0
    Do While segStart < runCount
        Dim segEnd As Integer = segStart
        Do While segEnd < runCount AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(segEnd)) = 0
            segEnd += 1
        Loop
        ' [segStart, segEnd) kilitlenebilir parca; segEnd (varsa) engelleyici.
        Dim first As Integer = -1, last As Integer = -1
        For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                If first < 0 Then first = i
                last = i
            End If
        Next i
        If first < 0 Then
            For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        Else
            For i = segStart To first - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
            Dim nameSet As String = MIRSyncSetOf(runArr(), first, last)
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(first), 1, nameSet
            For i = first To last
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
                ' Kilit disina tasinan STRING okuma: sahibi olan global yazildiginda eski metin serbest
                ' birakilir; kilit bitmeden kopyalanir ve sonraki kullanimlar kopyaya yonlenir.
                If MIRSyncIsLoadOp(runArr(i)) <> 0 AndAlso Trim(runArr(i).result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                    Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).resultType))
                    If ty <> "STRING" AndAlso runArr(i).operandCount >= 1 Then ty = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, runArr(i).operands(0))
                    If ty = "STRING" AndAlso MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(m, fi, runArr(i).result, runArr(), first, last, runCount) <> 0 Then
                        Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                        Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                        MIRSyncMake sn, runArr(i), "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", runArr(i).result
                        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                        MIRSyncRenameUses runArr(), last + 1, runCount, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                        MIRSyncRenameLaterUses m, fi, runArr(i).stmtSeq, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(last), 0, nameSet
            For i = last + 1 To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        End If
        If segEnd < runCount Then
            If MIRSyncEmitBarrier(m, ps, outArr(), outCount, runArr(segEnd), tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
            segEnd += 1
        End If
        segStart = segEnd
    Loop
    Return 1
End Function

#ifndef UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_SYNC_PASS_FBS

' ===========================================================================
' S-146 Model D (Mete 2026-09-26, belge §10 + §10.1): gorevlerle paylasilan
' globallere OTOMATIK senkron. Dil garantisi: iki gorev `toplam += x` yaparsa
' sonuc her motorda kesindir.
'
' Girdi: semantic_task_isolation.fbs'in senkron kumesi (SPAWN hedeflerinin gecisli
' dokundugu globaller) ve her MIR buyrugunun stmtSeq'i (ureten deyim).
' Cikti (kanonik MIR_CALL'lar, tum motorlar ayni):
'   SYNC_ENTER "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"   -- depo basina kilit, lockOrderId sirasiyla
'   SYNC_LEAVE "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2"
'   STR_SNAPSHOT t                   -- kilitli okunan STRING'in kilit disina tasinan kopyasi
'
' Kurallar:
'  - Bir deyimin ayni bloktaki ardisik buyruklari tek parca kilitlenir ("deyim tek
'    guvenli islem"). Kilit asla bir kullanici rutini cagrisi, gorev islemi, bekleyen
'    giris ya da dallanma boyunca tutulmaz.
'  - §10.1: deyimdeki kullanici rutini cagrilari (argumanlariyla) deyimin ortak depo
'    okumalarindan ONCE hesaplanir; aradaki buyruklar yan etkisizse cagri dilimi one
'    alinir. Boylece `g = g * 2 + F()` de tek kilit altinda okunup yazilir.
'  - Cagriya/dallanmaya dogrudan islenen olarak giden ortak global once kendi kisa
'    kilidi altinda gecici degere okunur.
'  - Senkron kumesi bos (SPAWN yok) ise gecis hicbir sey yapmaz: sifir maliyet.
' ===========================================================================

Declare Function UXBTaskSyncActive() As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As Integer

Dim Shared gMirSyncLocals As String       ' "|AD|" gecerli fonksiyonun yerel+parametre adlari
Dim Shared gMirSyncUserFns As String      ' "|AD|" modul fonksiyon adlari (kullanici kodu)
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeNames(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeValues(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirSyncTypeCount As Integer

Private Function MIRSyncUnquote(ByVal s As String) As String
    s = Trim(s)
    If Len(s) >= 2 AndAlso Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) AndAlso Right(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return Mid(s, 2, Len(s) - 2)
    Return s
End Function

' Islenenin depo adi (alan yolu "PT.X" -> "PT"); gecici/sabit/etiket icin "".
Private Function MIRSyncBaseName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As String
    Dim s As String = UCase(Trim(operandRaw))
    If s = "" Then Return ""
    Dim c As String = Left(s, 1)
    If c = Chr(34) Or c = "-" Or c = "+" Or c = "." Or (c >= "0" And c <= "9") Then Return ""
    If Left(s, 2) = "__" Then Return ""
    Dim cut As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        Dim ch As String = Mid(s, i, 1)
        If ch = "." Or ch = "(" Or ch = "[" Then cut = i: Exit For
    Next i
    If cut > 0 Then s = Left(s, cut - 1)
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsSyncName(ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If InStr(gMirSyncLocals, "|" & b & "|") > 0 Then Return 0
    Return UXBTaskIsSyncGlobal(b)
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsCallOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "CALL", "MIR_CALL", "METHOD_CALL", "MIR_METHOD_CALL", "MIR_VIRTUAL_CALL", "MIR_OBJECT_NEW", "NEW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsControlOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "RET", "JMP", "JZ", "JNZ", "LABEL", "GOTO", "GOSUB", "INLINE", "MIR_RET", "MIR_JMP", "MIR_JZ", "MIR_JNZ", "RETURN_GOSUB"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Kilit tutulurken yapilamayacak cagri: kullanici kodu, gorev/kilit islemi, bekleyen giris.
Private Function MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) = 0 Then Return 0
    Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    If op <> "CALL" And op <> "MIR_CALL" Then Return 1   ' metot/sanal cagri/nesne kurucu = kullanici kodu
    If ins.operandCount < 1 Then Return 0
    Dim n As String = UCase(MIRSyncUnquote(ins.operands(0)))
    If InStr(gMirSyncUserFns, "|" & n & "|") > 0 Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "TASK_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SYNC_" Or Left(n, 5) = "LOCK_" Or Left(n, 6) = "MUTEX_" Or Left(n, 5) = "SLOT_" Then Return 1
    If Left(n, 5) = "SHELL" Or Left(n, 5) = "EVENT" Or Left(n, 7) = "TRIGGER" Or Left(n, 4) = "PIPE" Then Return 1
    Select Case n
    Case "PROGRAM_END", "INPUT", "INPUTF", "LINE_INPUT", "LINEINPUT", "GETKEY", "SLEEP", "DELAY", "RAISE", "EMIT", "CALLPTR", "CALL_PTR", "INVOKE", "DISPATCH", "THROW"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Buyrugun ortak global islenen indeksleri (CALL'da hedef adi haric). Bulunanlari "|i|" olarak dondurur;
' sonuc (hedef) ortak ise resultIsSync = 1.
Private Function MIRSyncTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef resultIsSync As Integer) As String
    resultIsSync = 0
    Dim found As String = ""
    If Trim(ins.result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.result) <> 0 Then resultIsSync = 1
    Dim firstOp As Integer = 0
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then firstOp = 1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = firstOp To ins.operandCount - 1
        If MIRSyncIsSyncName(ins.operands(i)) <> 0 Then found &= "|" & LTrim(Str(i)) & "|"
    Next i
    Return found
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncInstrTouches(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Dim r As Integer
    Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, r)
    Return IIf(r <> 0 Or f <> "", 1, 0)
End Function

' Yan etkisiz (one alinan cagri diliminin atlayabilecegi) buyruk.
Private Function MIRSyncIsPure(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    If MIRSyncIsCallOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    If MIRSyncIsControlOp(ins) <> 0 Then Return 0
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "STORE_VAR", "STORE_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_STORE", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_STORE", "DIM", "REDIM", "CONST", "DEF_TYPE", _
         "SETSTRINGSIZE", "MIR_MEMORY_COPY", "MIR_MEMORY_FILL", "MIR_MEMORY_STORE", "MIR_MEMORY_WRITE_SEQUENCE", "MIR_VIRTUAL_INIT"
        Return 0
    End Select
    Return 1
End Function

' Depo adinin tipi: once modul globali, sonra ayni adi yazan/okuyan buyrugun notu.
Private Function MIRSyncTypeOf(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As String
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return UCase(Trim(m.globalVarTypes(i)))
    Next i
    For i = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
        If gMirSyncTypeNames(i) = n Then Return gMirSyncTypeValues(i)
    Next i
    Return ""
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim n As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To m.globalVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(m.globalVars(i))) = n Then Return IIf(m.globalVarIsArray(i) <> 0, 1, 0)
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncCollectTypeNotes(ByRef m As MIRModule)
    gMirSyncTypeCount = 0
    Erase gMirSyncTypeNames
    Erase gMirSyncTypeValues
    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim ii As Integer
            For ii = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
                Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(ii)
                Dim nm As String = ""
                Dim op As String = UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
                If op = "STORE_VAR" Then nm = ins.result
                If op = "LOAD_VAR" AndAlso ins.operandCount >= 1 Then nm = ins.operands(0)
                nm = UCase(Trim(nm))
                If nm = "" Or InStr(nm, ".") = 0 Then Continue For
                Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(ins.resultType))
                If ty = "" Or ty = "MISSING" Then Continue For
                Dim k As Integer
                Dim have As Integer = 0
                For k = 0 To gMirSyncTypeCount - 1
                    If gMirSyncTypeNames(k) = nm Then have = 1: Exit For
                Next k
                If have Then Continue For
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                ReDim Preserve gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount)
                gMirSyncTypeNames(gMirSyncTypeCount) = nm
                gMirSyncTypeValues(gMirSyncTypeCount) = ty
                gMirSyncTypeCount += 1
            Next ii
        Next bi
    Next fi
End Sub

' Kume "|AD|" -> lockOrderId sirasiyla "id1,id2" ve "AD1,AD2".
Private Sub MIRSyncOrderedLists(ByVal nameSet As String, ByRef idsOut As String, ByRef namesOut As String)
    idsOut = ""
    namesOut = ""
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim ids(Any) As Integer
    Dim cnt As Integer = 0
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(nameSet)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, nameSet, "|")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim nm As String = Mid(nameSet, p, q - p)
        If nm <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
            ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
            names(cnt) = nm
            ids(cnt) = UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(nm)
            cnt += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As Integer = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If i > 0 Then idsOut &= ",": namesOut &= ","
        idsOut &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
        namesOut &= names(i)
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncMake(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal opcode As String, ByVal resultName As String, ByVal resultType As String, ByVal nOps As Integer, ByVal op0 As String = "", ByVal op1 As String = "", ByVal op2 As String = "")
    Dim blank As MIRIRInstruction
    ins = blank
    ins.opcode = opcode
    ins.result = resultName
    ins.resultType = resultType
    ins.blockId = tmpl.blockId
    ins.srcLoc = tmpl.srcLoc
    ins.flags = tmpl.flags
    ins.stmtSeq = tmpl.stmtSeq
    ins.operandCount = nOps
    If nOps > 0 Then ins.operands(0) = op0
    If nOps > 1 Then ins.operands(1) = op1
    If nOps > 2 Then ins.operands(2) = op2
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncPush(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction)
    If outCount > UBound(outArr) Then ReDim Preserve outArr(outCount * 2 + 8)
    outArr(outCount) = ins
    outCount += 1
End Sub

Private Sub MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave(outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tmpl As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal isEnter As Integer, ByVal nameSet As String)
    Dim idsCsv As String, namesCsv As String
    MIRSyncOrderedLists nameSet, idsCsv, namesCsv
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction
    MIRSyncMake ins, tmpl, "CALL", "", "", 3, IIf(isEnter <> 0, "SYNC_ENTER", "SYNC_LEAVE"), Chr(34) & idsCsv & Chr(34), Chr(34) & namesCsv & Chr(34)
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
End Sub

Private Function MIRSyncAddName(ByRef setText As String, ByVal operandRaw As String) As Integer
    Dim b As String = MIRSyncBaseName(operandRaw)
    If b = "" Then Return 0
    If setText = "" Then setText = "|"
    If InStr(setText, "|" & b & "|") = 0 Then setText &= b & "|"
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir dilimin (runArr[a..b]) ortak depo kumesi.
Private Function MIRSyncSetOf(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer) As String
    Dim s As String = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = a To b
        Dim r As Integer
        Dim f As String = MIRSyncTouches(runArr(i), r)
        If r <> 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).result
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If InStr(f, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") > 0 Then MIRSyncAddName s, runArr(i).operands(k)
        Next k
    Next i
    Return s
End Function

Private Function MIRSyncIsLoadOp(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(ins.opcode))
    Case "LOAD_VAR", "LOAD_INDEXED", "MIR_FIELD_LOAD", "FIELD_GET", "MIR_ARRAY_FIELD_LOAD"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' Fonksiyonda (gecis sonrasi dizi haric tutularak) ad kullaniliyor mu.
Private Function MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByVal fi As Integer, ByVal tempName As String, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal b As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer) As Integer
    Dim t As String = UCase(Trim(tempName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If i >= a And i <= b Then Continue For
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
        Next k
    Next i
    ' Deyim disindaki kullanimlar (baska bloklar dahil): sonuc gecicisi deyimler arasi tasinabilir.
    Dim bi As Integer
    For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
        For i = 0 To m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount - 1
            With m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(i)
                If .stmtSeq = runArr(a).stmtSeq Then Continue For
                For k = 0 To .operandCount - 1
                    If UCase(Trim(.operands(k))) = t Then Return 1
                Next k
            End With
        Next i
    Next bi
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub MIRSyncRenameUses(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal fromIdx As Integer, ByVal runCount As Integer, ByVal oldName As String, ByVal newName As String)
    Dim o As String = UCase(Trim(oldName))
    Dim i As Integer, k As Integer
    For i = fromIdx To runCount - 1
        For k = 0 To runArr(i).operandCount - 1
            If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).operands(k))) = o Then runArr(i).operands(k) = newName
        Next k
    Next i
End Sub

' §10.1: runArr icinde, ilk ortak depo erisiminden sonra gelen engelleyici cagrilarin
' bagimlilik dilimini (cagri + ayni deyimde urettigi islenenlerin ureticileri) one alir.
Private Sub MIRSyncHoistCalls(runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer)
    Dim moved(Any) As Integer
    If runCount <= 1 Then Exit Sub
    ReDim moved(runCount - 1)
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do
        guard += 1
        If guard > runCount + 1 Then Exit Do
        ' Ilk ortak depo erisimi (one alinmis dilimler haric).
        Dim firstTouch As Integer = -1
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then Continue For
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then firstTouch = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If firstTouch < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' firstTouch'tan sonraki ilk tasinmamis engelleyici cagri.
        Dim c As Integer = -1
        For i = firstTouch + 1 To runCount - 1
            If moved(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then c = i: Exit For
        Next i
        If c < 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Dilim: c ve [firstTouch, c) icindeki gecisli ureticileri.
        Dim inSlice(Any) As Integer
        ReDim inSlice(runCount - 1)
        inSlice(c) = 1
        Dim changed As Integer = 1
        Do While changed
            changed = 0
            For i = c - 1 To firstTouch Step -1
                If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then Continue For
                Dim rn As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).result))
                If rn = "" Then Continue For
                Dim j As Integer, k As Integer
                For j = i + 1 To c
                    If inSlice(j) = 0 Then Continue For
                    For k = 0 To runArr(j).operandCount - 1
                        If UCase(Trim(runArr(j).operands(k))) = rn Then inSlice(i) = 1: changed = 1: Exit For
                    Next k
                    If inSlice(i) Then Exit For
                Next j
            Next i
        Loop
        ' Atlanacak buyruklar yan etkisiz olmali; degilse deyim cagri noktasinda bolunur (erisim basina kilit).
        Dim ok As Integer = 1
        For i = firstTouch To c - 1
            If inSlice(i) = 0 AndAlso MIRSyncIsPure(runArr(i)) = 0 Then ok = 0: Exit For
        Next i
        If ok = 0 Then Exit Do
        ' Yeniden sirala: [0,firstTouch) + dilim + [firstTouch,c] dilim disi + (c, son].
        Dim tmp(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
        Dim tmpMoved(Any) As Integer
        ReDim tmp(runCount - 1)
        ReDim tmpMoved(runCount - 1)
        Dim w As Integer = 0
        For i = 0 To firstTouch - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) <> 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = 1: w += 1
        Next i
        For i = firstTouch To c
            If inSlice(i) = 0 Then tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = c + 1 To runCount - 1
            tmp(w) = runArr(i): tmpMoved(w) = moved(i): w += 1
        Next i
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            runArr(i) = tmp(i)
            moved(i) = tmpMoved(i)
        Next i
    Loop
End Sub

' Engelleyici buyrugun (cagri/dallanma) ortak global islenenlerini kisa kilit altinda gecicilere okur;
' sonucu ortak globalse gecici uzerinden kilitli yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitBarrier(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByVal insIn As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ins As MIRIRInstruction = insIn
    Dim resultIsSync As Integer
    Dim found As String = MIRSyncTouches(ins, resultIsSync)
    If found <> "" Then
        Dim nameSet As String = ""
        Dim k As Integer
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim base As String = MIRSyncBaseName(ins.operands(k))
            If MIRSyncIsArrayGlobal(m, base) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ins.operands(k))) = base Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan dizi '" & base & "' bir cagriya butun olarak veriliyor -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (BYREF/dizi paylasiminin omur ve senkron sozlesmesi)"
                Return 0
            End If
            MIRSyncAddName nameSet, ins.operands(k)
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, nameSet
        Dim snaps As String = ""
        For k = 0 To ins.operandCount - 1
            If InStr(found, "|" & LTrim(Str(k)) & "|") = 0 Then Continue For
            Dim ty As String = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, ins.operands(k))
            Dim tLoad As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
            Dim ld As MIRIRInstruction
            MIRSyncMake ld, ins, "LOAD_VAR", tLoad, ty, 1, ins.operands(k)
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ld
            If ty = "STRING" Then
                Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                MIRSyncMake sn, ins, "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", tLoad
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                tLoad = tSnap
            End If
            ins.operands(k) = tLoad
        Next k
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, nameSet
    End If
    If resultIsSync <> 0 Then
        Dim target As String = ins.result
        Dim tRes As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
        ins.result = tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
        Dim rs As String = ""
        MIRSyncAddName rs, target
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 1, rs
        Dim st As MIRIRInstruction
        MIRSyncMake st, ins, "STORE_VAR", target, ins.resultType, 1, tRes
        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, st
        MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, ins, 0, rs
        Return 1
    End If
    MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, ins
    Return 1
End Function

' Bir deyim parcasini (ayni stmtSeq, dallanmasiz) kilitleyerek yazar.
Private Function MIRSyncEmitRun(ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal fi As Integer, runArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByVal runCount As Integer, outArr() As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef outCount As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If runCount <= 0 Then Return 1
    Dim anyTouch As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then anyTouch = 1: Exit For
    Next i
    If anyTouch = 0 Then
        For i = 0 To runCount - 1
            MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
        Next i
        Return 1
    End If

    ' Adresi alinan ortak global: ham erisim kilidi atlar (UNSAFE disinda tani).
    For i = 0 To runCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(runArr(i).opcode)) = "MIR_VARPTR" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
            If UXBTaskNodeInsideUnsafe(ps, runArr(i).flags) = 0 Then
                errText = "mir: gorevlerle paylasilan global icin VARPTR -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 7 (isaretci/MemoryRef paylasimi); ham adresle erisim sorumlulugu UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE ile alinabilir"
                Return 0
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    MIRSyncHoistCalls runArr(), runCount

    ' Engelleyici cagrilarla bolunmus parcalar; her parca ilk..son erisim arasinda kilitlenir.
    Dim segStart As Integer = 0
    Do While segStart < runCount
        Dim segEnd As Integer = segStart
        Do While segEnd < runCount AndAlso MIRSyncIsBarrierCall(runArr(segEnd)) = 0
            segEnd += 1
        Loop
        ' [segStart, segEnd) kilitlenebilir parca; segEnd (varsa) engelleyici.
        Dim first As Integer = -1, last As Integer = -1
        For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
            If MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                If first < 0 Then first = i
                last = i
            End If
        Next i
        If first < 0 Then
            For i = segStart To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        Else
            For i = segStart To first - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
            Dim nameSet As String = MIRSyncSetOf(runArr(), first, last)
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(first), 1, nameSet
            For i = first To last
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
                ' Kilit disina tasinan STRING okuma: sahibi olan global yazildiginda eski metin serbest
                ' birakilir; kilit bitmeden kopyalanir ve sonraki kullanimlar kopyaya yonlenir.
                If MIRSyncIsLoadOp(runArr(i)) <> 0 AndAlso Trim(runArr(i).result) <> "" AndAlso MIRSyncInstrTouches(runArr(i)) <> 0 Then
                    Dim ty As String = UCase(Trim(runArr(i).resultType))
                    If ty <> "STRING" AndAlso runArr(i).operandCount >= 1 Then ty = MIRSyncTypeOf(m, runArr(i).operands(0))
                    If ty = "STRING" AndAlso MIRSyncTempUsedOutside(m, fi, runArr(i).result, runArr(), first, last, runCount) <> 0 Then
                        Dim tSnap As String = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
                        Dim sn As MIRIRInstruction
                        MIRSyncMake sn, runArr(i), "CALL", tSnap, "STRING", 2, "STR_SNAPSHOT", runArr(i).result
                        MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, sn
                        MIRSyncRenameUses runArr(), last + 1, runCount, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                        MIRSyncRenameLaterUses m, fi, runArr(i).stmtSeq, runArr(i).result, tSnap
                    End If
                End If
            Next i
            MIRSyncEmitEnterLeave outArr(), outCount, runArr(last), 0, nameSet
            For i = last + 1 To segEnd - 1
                MIRSyncPush outArr(), outCount, runArr(i)
            Next i
        End If
        If segEnd < runCount Then
            If MIRSyncEmitBarrier(m, ps, outArr(), outCount, runArr(segEnd), tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
            segEnd += 1
        End If
        segStart = segEnd
    Loop
    Return 1
End Function

Function MIRSyncPassModule(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef m As MIRModule, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    If UXBTaskSyncActive() = 0 Then Return 1

    Dim fi As Integer
    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        gMirSyncUserFns &= UCase(Trim(m.functions(fi).name)) & "|"
    Next fi
    MIRSyncCollectTypeNotes m

    For fi = 0 To m.functionCount - 1
        gMirSyncLocals = "|"
        Dim li As Integer
        For li = 0 To m.functions(fi).localVarCount - 1
            gMirSyncLocals &= UCase(Trim(m.functions(fi).localVars(li))) & "|"
        Next li
        For li = 0 To m.functions(fi).paramVarCount - 1
            gMirSyncLocals &= UCase(Trim(m.functions(fi).paramVars(li))) & "|"
        Next li

        Dim bi As Integer
        For bi = 0 To m.functions(fi).blockCount - 1
            Dim n As Integer = m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount
            If n <= 0 Then Continue For
            Dim outArr(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
            ReDim outArr(n * 2 + 8)
            Dim outCount As Integer = 0
            Dim i As Integer = 0
            Do While i < n

                Do While j < n
                    If m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(j).stmtSeq <> seq Then Exit Do
                    If MIRSyncIsControlOp(m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(j)) <> 0 Then Exit Do
                    j += 1
                Loop
                Dim runArr(Any) As MIRIRInstruction
                ReDim runArr(j - i - 1)
                Dim r As Integer
                For r = i To j - 1

                Next r
                If MIRSyncEmitRun(m, ps, fi, runArr(), j - i, outArr(), outCount, tempSeed, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

            Next i
            m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructionCount = outCount
        Next bi
    Next fi
    Return 1

            Dim outCount As Integer = 0

                Dim seq As Integer = head.stmtSeq

                    If m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(j).stmtSeq <> seq Then Exit Do

                m.functions(fi).blocks(bi).instructions(i) = outArr(i)
            Next i

input.command:
@'
DIM toplam AS I64 = 0
DIM ad AS STRING = "x"
DIM yerel AS I32 = 7
FUNCTION F(n AS I64) AS I64
    RETURN n + 1
END FUNCTION
THREAD Isci(n AS I64) AS I64
    DIM i AS I64
    FOR i = 1 TO n
        toplam += 1
    NEXT i
    toplam = toplam * 1 + F(0) - 1
    ad = ad + "y"
    RETURN 0
END THREAD
DIM a AS TASK OF I64 = SPAWN Isci(1000)
DIM b AS TASK OF I64 = SPAWN Isci(1000)
a.JOIN()
b.JOIN()
PRINT toplam; LEN(ad); yerel
'@ | Set-Content build\claude1_s1.bas
& .\bin\uxb_claude1_f2c.exe mir build\claude1_s1.bas --mir-full-json-out build\claude1_s1.json 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5
$j = Get-Content build\claude1_s1.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach($f in $j.module.functions){ "== FN " + $f.name; foreach($b in $f.blocks){ "  -- blk"; foreach($ins in $b.instructions){ "    " + $ins.opcode + " [" + $ins.result + "] " + (($ins.operands) -join ' , ') } } }

Private Function MIRLowerTopLevelStmtFlowCore(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef handledOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    MIRSetCurrentSourceFromAstNode ps, stmtIdx
    handledOut = 1
    If stmtIdx < 0 Or stmtIdx >= ps.ast.count Then handledOut = 0: Return 1

    Dim st As ASTNode
    st = ps.ast.nodes(stmtIdx)
    Dim k As String
    k = UCase(st.kind)

    Select Case k
    Case "RETURN_STMT"
        Dim retValueName As String
        Dim retExprNode As Integer
        retExprNode = MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, 0)
        If retExprNode = -1 Then
            retValueName = "__result__"
        Else
            If MIRLowerExprNode(ps, retExprNode, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, retValueName, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        End If
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_RET, "", 1, retValueName
        Return 1

    Case "END_STMT"
        MIRLowerEndStmt module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed
        Return 1


    Case "EXIT_STMT"
        Dim exitBreakBlock As Integer
        Dim exitContBlock As Integer
        Dim exitWantType As String
        exitWantType = UCase(Trim(st.op))
        If exitWantType = "IF" Then
            Dim exitIfEndBlock As Integer
            If MIRCurrentIfExitTarget(exitIfEndBlock) = 0 Then errText = "mir: EXIT IF used outside IF block": Return 0
            MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_JMP, "", 1, LTrim(Str(exitIfEndBlock))
            Return 1
        End If
        If exitWantType <> "FOR" And exitWantType <> "DO" Then exitWantType = ""
        If MIRFindLoopContext(exitWantType, exitBreakBlock, exitContBlock) = 0 Then errText = "mir: EXIT icin uygun loop context yok": Return 0
        MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_JMP, "", 1, LTrim(Str(exitBreakBlock))
        Return 1

    Case Else
        handledOut = 0
        Return 1
    End Select
End Function

Private Sub MIREmitTryEscalationCheck(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer)
    Dim tryTarget As Integer
    If MIRCurrentTryTarget(tryTarget) = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim noExcBlock As Integer
    noExcBlock = MIRAllocBlock(module, fnIdx)

    Dim excActiveName As String
    excActiveName = MIRNextTemp(tempSeed)
    MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_LOAD_VAR, excActiveName, 1, "__mir_exc_active"
    MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_JZ, "", 2, excActiveName, LTrim(Str(noExcBlock))
