Private Sub MIRPushLoopContext(ByRef loopType As String, ByVal breakBlock As Integer, ByVal continueBlock As Integer)
    If gMirLowerLoopDepth = 0 Then
        ReDim gMirLowerLoopType(0)
        ReDim gMirLowerLoopBreak(0)
        ReDim gMirLowerLoopContinue(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve gMirLowerLoopType(gMirLowerLoopDepth)
        ReDim Preserve gMirLowerLoopBreak(gMirLowerLoopDepth)
        ReDim Preserve gMirLowerLoopContinue(gMirLowerLoopDepth)
    End If

    gMirLowerLoopType(gMirLowerLoopDepth) = UCase(Trim(loopType))
    gMirLowerLoopBreak(gMirLowerLoopDepth) = breakBlock
    gMirLowerLoopContinue(gMirLowerLoopDepth) = continueBlock
    gMirLowerLoopDepth += 1
End Sub

Private Sub MIRPopLoopContext()
    If gMirLowerLoopDepth <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    gMirLowerLoopDepth -= 1
End Sub

Private Function MIRFindLoopContext(ByRef wantType As String, ByRef breakBlockOut As Integer, ByRef continueBlockOut As Integer) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim w As String
    w = UCase(Trim(wantType))

    For i = gMirLowerLoopDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If w = "" Or gMirLowerLoopType(i) = w Then
            breakBlockOut = gMirLowerLoopBreak(i)
            continueBlockOut = gMirLowerLoopContinue(i)
            Return 1
        End If
    Next i

    Return 0
End Function

Private Function MIRStmtMemoryMode(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef modeOut As String, ByRef offsetOut As Integer) As Integer
    modeOut = "AUTO"
    offsetOut = 0
    Dim firstNode As Integer
    firstNode = MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, 0)
    If firstNode = -1 Then Return 1
    If UCase(ps.ast.nodes(firstNode).kind) = "KEYWORD_REF" Then
        Dim modeName As String
        modeName = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(firstNode).value))
        If modeName = "VIRTUAL" Or modeName = "NATIVE" Then
            modeOut = modeName
            offsetOut = 1
        End If
    End If
    ' S-069: no explicit mode -> AUTO resolves by the address expression's
    ' static type: a pointer-typed address means a real process address
    ' (NATIVE); anything else stays AUTO (= VIRTUAL sandbox offset). MEMCOPY
    ' has two addresses (dst, src): a pointer on EITHER side makes it NATIVE,
    ' so a plain integer paired with a pointer is then read as a real address
    ' too and fails closed (checked) if invalid -- write the mode explicitly
    ' to mix intentionally.
    If modeOut = "AUTO" Then
        Dim autoKind As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(stmtIdx).kind))
        If UXBMemoryAddrIsPointer(ps, MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, offsetOut)) <> 0 Then
            modeOut = "NATIVE"
        ElseIf Left(autoKind, 7) = "MEMCOPY" Then
            If UXBMemoryAddrIsPointer(ps, MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, offsetOut + 1)) <> 0 Then modeOut = "NATIVE"
        End If
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

Private Function MIRStmtMemoryWidth(ByRef kindName As String) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(Trim(kindName))
    Case "POKEB_STMT", "MEMCOPYB_STMT", "MEMFILLB_STMT": Return 1
    Case "POKEW_STMT", "MEMCOPYW_STMT", "MEMFILLW_STMT": Return 2
    Case "POKED_STMT", "MEMCOPYD_STMT", "MEMFILLD_STMT": Return 4
    ' S-055: Q (64-bit) memory family, parallel to B/W/D above.
    Case "POKEQ_STMT", "MEMCOPYQ_STMT", "MEMFILLQ_STMT": Return 8
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' `name` icin DIM/PARAM bildirimi: ayni rutindeki once, yoksa program geneli. Bulunamazsa -1.
Private Function StiFindDeclAny(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nameRaw As String, ByVal useNodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim wanted As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    If wanted = "" Then Return -1
    Dim useRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, useNodeIdx)
    Dim fallback As Integer = -1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        Dim k As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        If k <> "DIM_DECL" And k <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Continue For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) <> wanted Then Continue For
        Dim declRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, i)
        If declRoutine = useRoutine Then Return i
        If declRoutine = -1 And fallback = -1 Then fallback = i
    Next i
    Return fallback
End Function

' LOCK hedefi: 1 = program geneli (MUTEX olmayan) degisken, 2 = MUTEX degiskeni, 3 = CONSOLE,
' 4 = yerel (MUTEX olmayan) degisken, 0 = bulunamadi.
Function UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal targetNode As Integer) As Integer
    If targetNode < 0 Or targetNode >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0
    Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(targetNode).value))
    If nm = "CONSOLE" Then Return 3
    Dim decl As Integer = StiFindDeclAny(ps, nm, targetNode)
    If decl = -1 Then
        If StiSetHas(gStiGlobals, nm) <> 0 Then Return 1   ' DIM'siz program geneli atama ile dogan global
        Return 0
    End If
    If UXBStep3TypeCanonical(StiTypeRefOf(ps, decl)) = TYPE_MUTEX Then Return 2
    If UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, decl) = -1 Then Return 1
    Return 4
End Function

' LOCK hedeflerinin derleme zamani tanilari (tum motorlar icin semantik katmanda).
Private Function StiValidateLockTargets(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) <> "LOCK_TARGET" Then Continue For
        Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value))
        Dim lineText As String = " -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
        Select Case UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ps, i)
        Case 0
            errText = "semantic: LOCK hedefi bulunamadi: " & nm & " (program geneli degisken, MUTEX ya da CONSOLE olmali)" & lineText
            Return 0
        Case 3
            errText = "semantic: LOCK CONSOLE -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 2 (konsol kilidi)" & lineText
            Return 0
        Case 4
            errText = "semantic: LOCK hedefi '" & nm & "' yerel degisken -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (yerel veriye gorevler arasi omur: SHARED)" & lineText
            Return 0
        End Select
        ' Sozcuksel ic ice ayni kilit: SELF_DEADLOCK (cagri uzerinden olani calisma zamani yakalar).
        Dim lockNode As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, i)
        Dim p As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, lockNode)
        Dim guard As Integer = 0
        Do While p >= 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count
            If UXBTaskIsRoutineKind(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind) <> 0 Then Exit Do
            If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind)) = "LOCK_STMT" Then
                Dim t As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(p).firstChild
                Do While t <> -1
                    If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(t).kind)) = "LOCK_TARGET" AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(t).value)) = nm Then
                        errText = "semantic: SELF_DEADLOCK: '" & nm & "' zaten disaridaki LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler" & lineText
                        Return 0
                    End If
                    t = ps.ast.nodes(t).nextSibling
                Loop
            End If
            p = StiParentOf(ps, p)
            guard += 1
        Loop
    Next i
    Return 1
End Function

        Loop
    Next i
    Return 1
End Function

' `name` icin DIM/PARAM bildirimi: ayni rutindeki once, yoksa program geneli. Bulunamazsa -1.
Private Function StiFindDeclAny(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nameRaw As String, ByVal useNodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim wanted As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    If wanted = "" Then Return -1
    Dim useRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, useNodeIdx)
    Dim fallback As Integer = -1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        Dim k As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        If k <> "DIM_DECL" And k <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Continue For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) <> wanted Then Continue For
        Dim declRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, i)
        If declRoutine = useRoutine Then Return i
        If declRoutine = -1 And fallback = -1 Then fallback = i
    Next i
    Return fallback
End Function

' LOCK hedefi: 1 = program geneli (MUTEX olmayan) degisken, 2 = MUTEX degiskeni, 3 = CONSOLE,
' 4 = yerel (MUTEX olmayan) degisken, 0 = bulunamadi.
Function UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal targetNode As Integer) As Integer
    If targetNode < 0 Or targetNode >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0
    Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(targetNode).value))
    If nm = "CONSOLE" Then Return 3
    Dim decl As Integer = StiFindDeclAny(ps, nm, targetNode)
    If decl = -1 Then
        If StiSetHas(gStiGlobals, nm) <> 0 Then Return 1   ' DIM'siz program geneli atama ile dogan global
        Return 0
    End If
    If UXBStep3TypeCanonical(StiTypeRefOf(ps, decl)) = TYPE_MUTEX Then Return 2
    If UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, decl) = -1 Then Return 1
    Return 4
End Function

' LOCK hedeflerinin derleme zamani tanilari (tum motorlar icin semantik katmanda).
Private Function StiValidateLockTargets(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) <> "LOCK_TARGET" Then Continue For
        Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value))
        Dim lineText As String = " -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
        Select Case UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ps, i)
        Case 0
            errText = "semantic: LOCK hedefi bulunamadi: " & nm & " (program geneli degisken, MUTEX ya da CONSOLE olmali)" & lineText
            Return 0
        Case 3
            errText = "semantic: LOCK CONSOLE -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 2 (konsol kilidi)" & lineText
            Return 0
        Case 4
            errText = "semantic: LOCK hedefi '" & nm & "' yerel degisken -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (yerel veriye gorevler arasi omur: SHARED)" & lineText
            Return 0
        End Select
        ' Sozcuksel ic ice ayni kilit: SELF_DEADLOCK (cagri uzerinden olani calisma zamani yakalar).
        Dim lockNode As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, i)
        Dim p As Integer = StiParentOf(ps, lockNode)
        Dim guard As Integer = 0
        Do While p >= 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count
            If UXBTaskIsRoutineKind(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind) <> 0 Then Exit Do
            If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(p).kind)) = "LOCK_STMT" Then
                Dim t As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(p).firstChild
                Do While t <> -1
                    If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(t).kind)) = "LOCK_TARGET" AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(t).value)) = nm Then
                        errText = "semantic: SELF_DEADLOCK: '" & nm & "' zaten disaridaki LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler" & lineText
                        Return 0
                    End If
                    t = ps.ast.nodes(t).nextSibling
                Loop
            End If
            p = StiParentOf(ps, p)
            guard += 1
        Loop
    Next i
    Return 1
End Function

#ifndef UXB_MIR_LOWER_LOCK_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_LOWER_LOCK_FBS

' ===========================================================================
' S-146 Model D: acik `LOCK a, b ... END LOCK` ve `UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE` indirgemesi.
' Belge §10: LOCK yalniz cok deyimli bolunmezlik icindir (transaction degil); otomatik
' deyim kilidi acik LOCK'un sahipligini tanir; ayni kilidi ikinci kez acikca LOCK etmek
' SELF_DEADLOCK. Coklu hedef: tekillestirilir, lockOrderId sirasiyla alinir, ters sirada
' birakilir (calisma zamani dinamik MUTEX degerlerini de ayni kurala gore siralar).
'
' Kanonik MIR:
'   CALL LOCK_ENTER "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2" [mutexDeger...]
'   CALL LOCK_LEAVE "id1,id2" "AD1,AD2" [mutexDeger...]
'   t = CALL LOCK_MARK              (TRY girisi: bu gorevin acik kilit yigin derinligi)
'   CALL LOCK_RELEASE_TO t          (CATCH/FINALLY girisi: TRY icinde alinip istisnayla
'                                    birakilamamis kilitler)
'   t = CALL MUTEX_NEW              (DIM m AS MUTEX)
' Cikis yollari: RETURN, EXIT FOR/DO/IF ve bolum disina GOTO, atladiklari LOCK'lari
' icten disa birakir. Istisna: TRY'nin CATCH/FINALLY girisi LOCK_RELEASE_TO ile; hic
' yakalanmayan istisnada gorev bitince calisma zamani gorevin tum kilitlerini birakir.
' ===========================================================================

Declare Function UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal targetNode As Integer) As Integer

Dim Shared gMirLockDepth As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockFn(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockNode(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockLoopDepth(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockIfDepth(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockIds(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirLockNames(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirLockDyn(Any) As String   ' "|AD|AD|" MUTEX degiskenleri (calisma zamani degeri)
Dim Shared gMirProgramUsesLock As Integer

Sub MIRLockResetForModule(ByRef ps As ParseState)
    gMirLockDepth = 0
    gMirProgramUsesLock = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) = "LOCK_STMT" Then gMirProgramUsesLock = 1: Exit For
    Next i
End Sub

Private Sub MIRLockAppendCall(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal callName As String, ByVal k As Integer)
    Dim dyn As String = gMirLockDyn(k)
    Dim ops(0 To 15) As String
    Dim n As Integer = 0
    ops(n) = callName: n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockIds(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockNames(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(dyn) And n <= 15
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, dyn, "|")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        ops(n) = Mid(dyn, p, q - p): n += 1
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_CALL, "", n, ops(0), ops(1), ops(2), ops(3), ops(4), ops(5), ops(6), ops(7), ops(8), ops(9), ops(10), ops(11), ops(12), ops(13), ops(14), ops(15)
End Sub

' Yigindaki [fromK .. tepe] LOCK'lari (bu fonksiyondakiler) icten disa birakir.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesFrom(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal fromK As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To fromK Step -1
        If k < 0 Then Exit For
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

' RETURN: fonksiyondaki tum acik LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForReturn(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer)
    MIRLockEmitLeavesFrom module, fnIdx, blkIdx, 0
End Sub

' EXIT FOR/DO: hedef dongunun ICINDE acilmis LOCK'lar (targetLoopIdx = dongu yigini indeksi).
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForLoopExit(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal targetLoopIdx As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If gMirLockLoopDepth(k) <= targetLoopIdx Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

' EXIT IF: en icteki IF'in govdesinde acilmis LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForIfExit(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal currentIfDepth As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If gMirLockIfDepth(k) < currentIfDepth Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

Private Function MIRLockSubtreeHasLabel(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByVal labelName As String) As Integer
    If rootIdx < 0 Or rootIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0
    Dim want As String = UCase(Trim(labelName))
    Dim stack(Any) As Integer
    Dim sp As Integer = 0
    ReDim stack(15)
    stack(0) = rootIdx: sp = 1
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do While sp > 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count * 4
        guard += 1
        sp -= 1
        Dim cur As Integer = stack(sp)
        If cur < 0 Or cur >= ps.ast.count Then Continue Do
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(cur).kind)) = "LABEL_STMT" AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(cur).value)) = want Then Return 1
        Dim nexts(0 To 2) As Integer
        nexts(0) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).firstChild
        nexts(1) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).left
        nexts(2) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).right
        Dim c As Integer = nexts(0)
        Do While c <> -1
            If sp > UBound(stack) Then ReDim Preserve stack(sp * 2 + 8)
            stack(sp) = c: sp += 1
            c = ps.ast.nodes(c).nextSibling
        Loop
        Dim j As Integer
        For j = 1 To 2
            If nexts(j) <> -1 Then
                If sp > UBound(stack) Then ReDim Preserve stack(sp * 2 + 8)
                stack(sp) = nexts(j): sp += 1
            End If
        Next j
    Loop
    Return 0
End Function

' GOTO: etiketi icermeyen (bolum disina atlanan) LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForGoto(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal labelName As String)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If MIRLockSubtreeHasLabel(ps, gMirLockNode(k), labelName) <> 0 Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

Function MIRLowerLockStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim staticSet As String = ""
    Dim dyn As String = "|"
    Dim bodyStart As Integer = 0
    Dim cnt As Integer = MIRChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    Dim p As Integer
    For p = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim ch As Integer = MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, p)
        If ch = -1 Then Exit For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).kind)) <> "LOCK_TARGET" Then Exit For
        bodyStart = p + 1
        Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).value))
        Select Case UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ps, ch)
        Case 1
            If staticSet = "" Then staticSet = "|"
            If InStr(staticSet, "|" & nm & "|") = 0 Then staticSet &= nm & "|"
        Case 2
            If InStr(dyn, "|" & nm & "|") = 0 Then dyn &= nm & "|"
        Case Else
            ' Semantik katman (StiValidateLockTargets) bu durumlari zaten reddeder.
            errText = "mir: LOCK hedefi indirgenemedi: " & nm
            Return 0
        End Select
    Next p
    If staticSet = "" Then staticSet = "|"

    Dim idsCsv As String, namesCsv As String
    MIRSyncOrderedLists staticSet, idsCsv, namesCsv

    Dim k As Integer = gMirLockDepth
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockFn(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockNode(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockLoopDepth(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockIfDepth(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockIds(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockNames(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockDyn(k)
    gMirLockFn(k) = fnIdx
    gMirLockNode(k) = stmtIdx
    gMirLockLoopDepth(k) = gMirLowerLoopDepth
    gMirLockIfDepth(k) = gMirLowerIfDepth
    gMirLockIds(k) = idsCsv
    gMirLockNames(k) = namesCsv
    gMirLockDyn(k) = dyn
    gMirLockDepth = k + 1

    MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_ENTER", k
    Dim ok As Integer = 1
    If bodyStart <= cnt - 1 Then ok = MIRLowerStmtRange(ps, stmtIdx, bodyStart, cnt - 1, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, errText)
    If ok <> 0 Then MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    gMirLockDepth = k
    Return ok
End Function

Function MIRLowerUnsafeStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    ' UNSAFE yalniz semantik guvenceleri kaldirir (analizci ham bellek/FFI etkisini atlar);
    ' kod uretimi normal govdedir -- otomatik senkron da aynen gecerlidir.
    Dim cnt As Integer = MIRChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    If cnt <= 0 Then Return 1
    Return MIRLowerStmtRange(ps, stmtIdx, 0, cnt - 1, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, errText)
End Function

#endif

Dim Shared gMirLockDepth As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockFn(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockNode(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockLoopDepth(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockIfDepth(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLockIds(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirLockNames(Any) As String

    gMirLockDepth = 0

    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1

    Next i

Private Sub MIRLockAppendCall(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal callName As String, ByVal k As Integer)
    Dim dyn As String = gMirLockDyn(k)
    Dim ops(0 To 15) As String
    Dim n As Integer = 0
    ops(n) = callName: n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockIds(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockNames(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(dyn) And n <= 15

        p = q + 1

    Dim sp As Integer = 0

    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do While sp > 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count * 4

        sp -= 1

        nexts(0) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).firstChild
        nexts(1) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).left
        nexts(2) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).right
        Dim c As Integer = nexts(0)
        Do While c <> -1
            If sp > UBound(stack) Then ReDim Preserve stack(sp * 2 + 8)
            stack(sp) = c: sp += 1
            c = ps.ast.nodes(c).nextSibling
        Loop
        Dim j As Integer
        For j = 1 To 2
            If nexts(j) <> -1 Then

            End If

    ops(n) = callName: n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockIds(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    ops(n) = Chr(34) & gMirLockNames(k) & Chr(34): n += 1
    Dim p As Integer = 2
    Do While p < Len(dyn) And n <= 15
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, dyn, "|")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        ops(n) = Mid(dyn, p, q - p): n += 1
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    MIRAppendInstruction module, fnIdx, blkIdx, MIR_OP_CALL, "", n, ops(0), ops(1), ops(2), ops(3), ops(4), ops(5), ops(6), ops(7), ops(8), ops(9), ops(10), ops(11), ops(12), ops(13), ops(14), ops(15)
End Sub

' Yigindaki [fromK .. tepe] LOCK'lari (bu fonksiyondakiler) icten disa birakir.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesFrom(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal fromK As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To fromK Step -1
        If k < 0 Then Exit For
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

' RETURN: fonksiyondaki tum acik LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForReturn(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer)
    MIRLockEmitLeavesFrom module, fnIdx, blkIdx, 0
End Sub

' EXIT FOR/DO: hedef dongunun ICINDE acilmis LOCK'lar (targetLoopIdx = dongu yigini indeksi).
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForLoopExit(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal targetLoopIdx As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If gMirLockLoopDepth(k) <= targetLoopIdx Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

' EXIT IF: en icteki IF'in govdesinde acilmis LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForIfExit(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal currentIfDepth As Integer)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If gMirLockIfDepth(k) < currentIfDepth Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

Private Function MIRLockSubtreeHasLabel(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal rootIdx As Integer, ByVal labelName As String) As Integer
    If rootIdx < 0 Or rootIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 0
    Dim want As String = UCase(Trim(labelName))
    Dim stack(Any) As Integer
    Dim sp As Integer = 0
    ReDim stack(15)
    stack(0) = rootIdx: sp = 1
    Dim guard As Integer = 0
    Do While sp > 0 And guard <= ps.ast.count * 4
        guard += 1
        sp -= 1
        Dim cur As Integer = stack(sp)
        If cur < 0 Or cur >= ps.ast.count Then Continue Do
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(cur).kind)) = "LABEL_STMT" AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(cur).value)) = want Then Return 1
        Dim nexts(0 To 2) As Integer
        nexts(0) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).firstChild
        nexts(1) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).left
        nexts(2) = ps.ast.nodes(cur).right
        Dim c As Integer = nexts(0)
        Do While c <> -1
            If sp > UBound(stack) Then ReDim Preserve stack(sp * 2 + 8)
            stack(sp) = c: sp += 1
            c = ps.ast.nodes(c).nextSibling
        Loop
        Dim j As Integer
        For j = 1 To 2
            If nexts(j) <> -1 Then
                If sp > UBound(stack) Then ReDim Preserve stack(sp * 2 + 8)
                stack(sp) = nexts(j): sp += 1
            End If
        Next j
    Loop
    Return 0
End Function

' GOTO: etiketi icermeyen (bolum disina atlanan) LOCK'lar.
Sub MIRLockEmitLeavesForGoto(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByVal blkIdx As Integer, ByVal labelName As String)
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = gMirLockDepth - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLockFn(k) <> fnIdx Then Continue For
        If MIRLockSubtreeHasLabel(ps, gMirLockNode(k), labelName) <> 0 Then Exit For
        MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    Next k
End Sub

Function MIRLowerLockStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim staticSet As String = ""
    Dim dyn As String = "|"
    Dim bodyStart As Integer = 0
    Dim cnt As Integer = MIRChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    Dim p As Integer
    For p = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim ch As Integer = MIRChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, p)
        If ch = -1 Then Exit For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).kind)) <> "LOCK_TARGET" Then Exit For
        bodyStart = p + 1
        Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).value))
        Select Case UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ps, ch)
        Case 1
            If staticSet = "" Then staticSet = "|"
            If InStr(staticSet, "|" & nm & "|") = 0 Then staticSet &= nm & "|"
        Case 2
            If InStr(dyn, "|" & nm & "|") = 0 Then dyn &= nm & "|"
        Case Else
            ' Semantik katman (StiValidateLockTargets) bu durumlari zaten reddeder.
            errText = "mir: LOCK hedefi indirgenemedi: " & nm
            Return 0
        End Select
    Next p
    If staticSet = "" Then staticSet = "|"

    Dim idsCsv As String, namesCsv As String
    MIRSyncOrderedLists staticSet, idsCsv, namesCsv

    Dim k As Integer = gMirLockDepth
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockFn(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockNode(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockLoopDepth(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockIfDepth(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockIds(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockNames(k)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLockDyn(k)
    gMirLockFn(k) = fnIdx
    gMirLockNode(k) = stmtIdx
    gMirLockLoopDepth(k) = gMirLowerLoopDepth
    gMirLockIfDepth(k) = gMirLowerIfDepth
    gMirLockIds(k) = idsCsv
    gMirLockNames(k) = namesCsv
    gMirLockDyn(k) = dyn
    gMirLockDepth = k + 1

    MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_ENTER", k
    Dim ok As Integer = 1
    If bodyStart <= cnt - 1 Then ok = MIRLowerStmtRange(ps, stmtIdx, bodyStart, cnt - 1, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, errText)
    If ok <> 0 Then MIRLockAppendCall module, fnIdx, blkIdx, "LOCK_LEAVE", k
    gMirLockDepth = k
    Return ok
End Function

Function MIRLowerUnsafeStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef blkIdx As Integer, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    ' UNSAFE yalniz semantik guvenceleri kaldirir (analizci ham bellek/FFI etkisini atlar);
    ' kod uretimi normal govdedir -- otomatik senkron da aynen gecerlidir.
    Dim cnt As Integer = MIRChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    If cnt <= 0 Then Return 1
    Return MIRLowerStmtRange(ps, stmtIdx, 0, cnt - 1, module, fnIdx, blkIdx, tempSeed, errText)
End Function

' Runs the program, then copies the collected output into the result ONCE -- on
' success and on every failure path alike, so a failing run still reports what it
' had printed (S-074) without any per-PRINT bookkeeping (S-109).
Function UXBMIRInterpRunInstructions(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef errText As String) As UXBInterpResult
    Dim res As UXBInterpResult
    res = UXBMIRInterpRunInstructionsCore(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, errText)
    ' S-030 K5: okunmamis gorev hatasi sessiz kaybolmaz -- basarili bitis bile basarisiz sayilir.
    If res.statusText = "PASS" Then
        Dim unreadTaskErr As String
        If UXBMIRTaskUnreadErrors(ctx, unreadTaskErr) <> 0 Then
            res.statusText = "FAIL"

' TASK_SPAWN: lane rutininin parametrelerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir, sonucu/hatayi
' tutamaca yazar. Yalniz BAGLAMA hatasi (hedef yok, arguman sayisi) SPAWN cagrisinin
' kendi hatasidir; govde hatasi gorevde kalir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskSpawn(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
input.new_string:
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' S-146 Model D: kilit tablosu ve ertelenmis gorevler (tek is parcacikli referans).
' Kilit sahibi GOREVDIR (anahtar: ana program 0, gorev = TASK slotu + 1). Yorumlayici
' gorevi SPAWN aninda calistirir; bir gorev ya da ana program ACIK LOCK tutarken yapilan
' SPAWN ertelenir (native'de o gorev kilidi bekleyecekti): kilit sayisi sifira inince,
' gorevin JOIN/WAIT/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN'inde ya da program sonunda calisir. Bu, native
' zamanlamasinin gecerli bir ornegidir (gorevler arasi sira dil garantisi degil).
' SYNC_ENTER/SYNC_LEAVE (otomatik deyim kilidi) tek is parcacikta cakisamaz: etkisiz.
' Sahibi baska gorev olan kilidi istemek tek is parcacikta ilerleyemez = LOCK_DEADLOCK;
' ayni gorevin ayni kilidi ikinci kez acikca istemesi = SELF_DEADLOCK. Ikisi de olumcul.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim Shared gMirLkIds(Any) As LongInt
Dim Shared gMirLkOwner(Any) As Integer      ' -1 = serbest
Dim Shared gMirLkName(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirLkCount As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLkHeldTotal As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLkStackKey(Any) As Integer   ' acik kilit yigini: girdi basina sahip anahtari
Dim Shared gMirLkStackIds(Any) As String    ' ve alinan kimlikler "id,id"
Dim Shared gMirLkStackCount As Integer
Dim Shared gMirCurrentTaskKey As Integer
Dim Shared gMirMutexNext As LongInt

Dim Shared gMirDefSlot(Any) As Integer      ' ertelenmis gorevler (FIFO)
Dim Shared gMirDefLane(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirDefResult(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirDefArgStart(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirDefArgCount(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirDefDone(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gMirDefCount As Integer
Dim Shared gMirDefArgs(Any) As UXBInterpValue
Dim Shared gMirDefArgTotal As Integer

Sub UXBMIRSyncReset()
    gMirLkCount = 0
    gMirLkHeldTotal = 0
    gMirLkStackCount = 0
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = 0
    gMirMutexNext = 0
    gMirDefCount = 0
    gMirDefArgTotal = 0
    Erase gMirLkIds, gMirLkOwner, gMirLkName, gMirLkStackKey, gMirLkStackIds
    Erase gMirDefSlot, gMirDefLane, gMirDefResult, gMirDefArgStart, gMirDefArgCount, gMirDefDone, gMirDefArgs
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRLockFatal(ByVal textValue As String) As UXBInterpValue
    Return UXBInterpValueError(UXB_INTERP_ERR_LOCK_FATAL, textValue)
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockRecord(ByVal id As LongInt, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gMirLkCount - 1
        If gMirLkIds(i) = id Then
            If gMirLkName(i) = "" Then gMirLkName(i) = nameText
            Return i
        End If
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkIds(gMirLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkOwner(gMirLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkName(gMirLkCount)
    gMirLkIds(gMirLkCount) = id
    gMirLkOwner(gMirLkCount) = -1
    gMirLkName(gMirLkCount) = nameText
    gMirLkCount += 1
    Return gMirLkCount - 1
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockLabel(ByVal rec As Integer) As String
    If gMirLkName(rec) <> "" Then Return "'" & gMirLkName(rec) & "'"
    Return "MUTEX #" & LTrim(Str(gMirLkIds(rec) - (1LL Shl 32)))
End Function

' Hedef listesi: "id,id" (statik) + MUTEX degerleri; lockOrderId sirasi, tekil. names paralel.
Private Sub UXBMIRLockCollect(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ids() As LongInt, names() As String, ByRef cnt As Integer)
    cnt = 0
    Dim idsCsv As String = UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(1)) & ","
    Dim namesCsv As String = ""
    If ins.operandCount >= 3 Then namesCsv = UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(2)) & ","
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Dim np As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(idsCsv)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, idsCsv, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(idsCsv, p, q - p))
        Dim nm As String = ""
        Dim nq As Integer = InStr(np, namesCsv, ",")
        If nq > 0 Then nm = Mid(namesCsv, np, nq - np): np = nq + 1
        If part <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
            ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
            ids(cnt) = ValLng(part)
            names(cnt) = nm
            cnt += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = 3 To ins.operandCount - 1
        Dim v As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(k))
        ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
        ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
        ids(cnt) = v.intValue
        names(cnt) = ""
        cnt += 1
    Next k
    ' Siralama + tekillestirme.
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As LongInt = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    Dim w As Integer = 0
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If w > 0 AndAlso ids(w - 1) = ids(i) Then Continue For
        ids(w) = ids(i)
        names(w) = names(i)
        w += 1
    Next i
    cnt = w
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRLockReleaseIds(ByVal idsCsv As String)
    Dim s As String = idsCsv & ","
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(s)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, s, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(s, p, q - p))
        If part <> "" Then
            Dim id As LongInt = ValLng(part)
            Dim i As Integer
            For i = 0 To gMirLkCount - 1
                If gMirLkIds(i) = id AndAlso gMirLkOwner(i) <> -1 Then
                    gMirLkOwner(i) = -1
                    gMirLkHeldTotal -= 1
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRLockPopEntry(ByVal entryIdx As Integer)
    UXBMIRLockReleaseIds gMirLkStackIds(entryIdx)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = entryIdx To gMirLkStackCount - 2
        gMirLkStackKey(i) = gMirLkStackKey(i + 1)
        gMirLkStackIds(i) = gMirLkStackIds(i + 1)
    Next i
    gMirLkStackCount -= 1
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRLockKeyDepth(ByVal key As Integer) As Integer
    Dim n As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gMirLkStackCount - 1
        If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then n += 1
    Next i
    Return n
End Function

' Anahtarin acik kilit yiginini `mark` derinligine indirir (icten disa).
Private Sub UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo(ByVal key As Integer, ByVal mark As Integer)
    Do While UXBMIRLockKeyDepth(key) > mark
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = gMirLkStackCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
            If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then UXBMIRLockPopEntry i: Exit For
        Next i
    Loop
End Sub

Declare Function UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue

Private Function UXBMIRLockEnter(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim ids(Any) As LongInt
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim cnt As Integer
    UXBMIRLockCollect st, ins, ids(), names(), cnt
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) = key Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("SELF_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " bu gorev tarafindan zaten LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler")
        End If
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) <> -1 Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("LOCK_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " kilidini tutan gorev, bu gorevin bitmesini bekliyor (LOCK icinde JOIN/WAIT ile karsilikli bekleme)")
        End If
    Next i
    Dim taken As String = ""
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec2 As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        gMirLkOwner(rec2) = key
        gMirLkHeldTotal += 1
        If taken <> "" Then taken &= ","
        taken &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount)
    gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount) = key
    gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount) = taken
    gMirLkStackCount += 1
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockLeave(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = gMirLkStackCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then
            UXBMIRLockPopEntry i
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    If gMirLkHeldTotal = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st)
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' TASK_SPAWN: lane rutininin parametrelerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir, sonucu/hatayi
' tutamaca yazar. Yalniz BAGLAMA hatasi (hedef yok, arguman sayisi) SPAWN cagrisinin
' kendi hatasidir; govde hatasi gorevde kalir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal taskId As Integer, ByVal laneName As String, ByVal resultType As String, argValues() As UXBInterpValue, ByVal argStart As Integer, ByVal argCount As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim labelIdx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindLabel(st, laneName)
    Dim laneLabel As UXBMIRInstructionRecord = instructions(labelIdx)
    ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "RUNNING"
    UXBMIRInterpEnterScope st
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To argCount - 1
        Dim paramName As String = Trim(laneLabel.operands(i + 1))
        If paramName <> "" Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, paramName, argValues(argStart + i)
    Next i

    Dim prevKey As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = taskId + 1
    Dim bodyErr As String
    Dim bodyValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpInvokeLabel(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, laneName, bodyErr)
    ' Gorev biterken (normal ya da hatayla) hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir.
    UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo taskId + 1, 0
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = prevKey
    UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope st

    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 AndAlso (bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_SIGNAL_PROGRAM_END Or bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_ERR_LOCK_FATAL) Then
        ' S-156 sinyali ve olumcul kilit hatasi gorev hatasi degildir: programin kendisini bitirir.
        Return bodyValue
    End If
    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 Then
        ' Mete: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata gorev nesnesinde tutulur" -- cagirana SIZMAZ.
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "ERROR"
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(1) = bodyValue.errorText
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_active", "0"
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_value", ""
    Else
        ' S-149: `THREAD ... AS <tip>` -> sonuc bildirilen tipte (FUNCTION donusu gibi).
        If resultType <> "" Then bodyValue = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(bodyValue, resultType)
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).values(0) = bodyValue
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "DONE"
    End If
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Ertelenmis gorevi (varsa, baslamamissa) simdi calistirir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal slotId As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer
    For d = 0 To gMirDefCount - 1
        If gMirDefSlot(d) <> slotId Or gMirDefDone(d) <> 0 Then Continue For
        gMirDefDone(d) = 1
        If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) <> "PENDING" Then Return UXBInterpValueVoid()   ' K6: baslamadan iptal
        Return UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, slotId, gMirDefLane(d), gMirDefResult(d), gMirDefArgs(), gMirDefArgStart(d), gMirDefArgCount(d))
    Next d
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Function UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer = 0
    Do While d < gMirDefCount
        If gMirDefDone(d) = 0 Then
            Dim r As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, gMirDefSlot(d))
            If UXBInterpIsError(r) <> 0 Then Return r
        End If
        d += 1
    Loop
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Program sonu (K5): ana programin hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir (END LOCK icinde

' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' S-146 Model D: kilit tablosu ve ertelenmis gorevler (tek is parcacikli referans).

' gorevi SPAWN aninda calistirir; bir gorev ya da ana program ACIK LOCK tutarken yapilan
' SPAWN ertelenir (native'de o gorev kilidi bekleyecekti): kilit sayisi sifira inince,
' gorevin JOIN/WAIT/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN'inde ya da program sonunda calisir. Bu, native
' zamanlamasinin gecerli bir ornegidir (gorevler arasi sira dil garantisi degil).

' ayni gorevin ayni kilidi ikinci kez acikca istemesi = SELF_DEADLOCK. Ikisi de olumcul.
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dim Shared gMirLkIds(Any) As LongInt
Dim Shared gMirLkOwner(Any) As Integer      ' -1 = serbest
Dim Shared gMirLkName(Any) As String
Dim Shared gMirLkCount As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLkHeldTotal As Integer
Dim Shared gMirLkStackKey(Any) As Integer   ' acik kilit yigini: girdi basina sahip anahtari

Dim Shared gMirDefCount As Integer

Dim Shared gMirDefArgTotal As Integer

Sub UXBMIRSyncReset()
    gMirLkCount = 0
    gMirLkHeldTotal = 0
    gMirLkStackCount = 0
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = 0
    gMirMutexNext = 0
    gMirDefCount = 0
    gMirDefArgTotal = 0
    Erase gMirLkIds, gMirLkOwner, gMirLkName, gMirLkStackKey, gMirLkStackIds
    Erase gMirDefSlot, gMirDefLane, gMirDefResult, gMirDefArgStart, gMirDefArgCount, gMirDefDone, gMirDefArgs
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRLockFatal(ByVal textValue As String) As UXBInterpValue
    Return UXBInterpValueError(UXB_INTERP_ERR_LOCK_FATAL, textValue)
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockRecord(ByVal id As LongInt, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gMirLkCount - 1
        If gMirLkIds(i) = id Then
            If gMirLkName(i) = "" Then gMirLkName(i) = nameText
            Return i
        End If
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkIds(gMirLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkOwner(gMirLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkName(gMirLkCount)
    gMirLkIds(gMirLkCount) = id
    gMirLkOwner(gMirLkCount) = -1
    gMirLkName(gMirLkCount) = nameText
    gMirLkCount += 1
    Return gMirLkCount - 1
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockLabel(ByVal rec As Integer) As String
    If gMirLkName(rec) <> "" Then Return "'" & gMirLkName(rec) & "'"
    Return "MUTEX #" & LTrim(Str(gMirLkIds(rec) - (1LL Shl 32)))
End Function

' Hedef listesi: "id,id" (statik) + MUTEX degerleri; lockOrderId sirasi, tekil. names paralel.
Private Sub UXBMIRLockCollect(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ids() As LongInt, names() As String, ByRef cnt As Integer)
    cnt = 0
    Dim idsCsv As String = UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(1)) & ","
    Dim namesCsv As String = ""
    If ins.operandCount >= 3 Then namesCsv = UXBMIRTaskUnquote(ins.operands(2)) & ","
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Dim np As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(idsCsv)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, idsCsv, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(idsCsv, p, q - p))
        Dim nm As String = ""
        Dim nq As Integer = InStr(np, namesCsv, ",")
        If nq > 0 Then nm = Mid(namesCsv, np, nq - np): np = nq + 1
        If part <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
            ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
            ids(cnt) = ValLng(part)
            names(cnt) = nm
            cnt += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim k As Integer
    For k = 3 To ins.operandCount - 1
        Dim v As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(k))
        ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
        ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
        ids(cnt) = v.intValue
        names(cnt) = ""
        cnt += 1
    Next k
    ' Siralama + tekillestirme.
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As LongInt = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    Dim w As Integer = 0
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If w > 0 AndAlso ids(w - 1) = ids(i) Then Continue For
        ids(w) = ids(i)
        names(w) = names(i)
        w += 1
    Next i
    cnt = w
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRLockReleaseIds(ByVal idsCsv As String)
    Dim s As String = idsCsv & ","
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(s)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, s, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(s, p, q - p))
        If part <> "" Then
            Dim id As LongInt = ValLng(part)
            Dim i As Integer
            For i = 0 To gMirLkCount - 1
                If gMirLkIds(i) = id AndAlso gMirLkOwner(i) <> -1 Then
                    gMirLkOwner(i) = -1
                    gMirLkHeldTotal -= 1
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRLockPopEntry(ByVal entryIdx As Integer)
    UXBMIRLockReleaseIds gMirLkStackIds(entryIdx)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = entryIdx To gMirLkStackCount - 2
        gMirLkStackKey(i) = gMirLkStackKey(i + 1)
        gMirLkStackIds(i) = gMirLkStackIds(i + 1)
    Next i
    gMirLkStackCount -= 1
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRLockKeyDepth(ByVal key As Integer) As Integer
    Dim n As Integer = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gMirLkStackCount - 1
        If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then n += 1
    Next i
    Return n
End Function

' Anahtarin acik kilit yiginini `mark` derinligine indirir (icten disa).
Private Sub UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo(ByVal key As Integer, ByVal mark As Integer)
    Do While UXBMIRLockKeyDepth(key) > mark
        Dim i As Integer
        For i = gMirLkStackCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
            If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then UXBMIRLockPopEntry i: Exit For
        Next i
    Loop
End Sub

Declare Function UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue

Private Function UXBMIRLockEnter(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim ids(Any) As LongInt
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim cnt As Integer
    UXBMIRLockCollect st, ins, ids(), names(), cnt
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) = key Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("SELF_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " bu gorev tarafindan zaten LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler")
        End If
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) <> -1 Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("LOCK_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " kilidini tutan gorev, bu gorevin bitmesini bekliyor (LOCK icinde JOIN/WAIT ile karsilikli bekleme)")
        End If
    Next i
    Dim taken As String = ""
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec2 As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        gMirLkOwner(rec2) = key
        gMirLkHeldTotal += 1
        If taken <> "" Then taken &= ","
        taken &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount)
    gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount) = key
    gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount) = taken
    gMirLkStackCount += 1
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockLeave(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = gMirLkStackCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then
            UXBMIRLockPopEntry i
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    If gMirLkHeldTotal = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st)
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' TASK_SPAWN: lane rutininin parametrelerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir, sonucu/hatayi
' tutamaca yazar. Yalniz BAGLAMA hatasi (hedef yok, arguman sayisi) SPAWN cagrisinin
' kendi hatasidir; govde hatasi gorevde kalir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal taskId As Integer, ByVal laneName As String, ByVal resultType As String, argValues() As UXBInterpValue, ByVal argStart As Integer, ByVal argCount As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim labelIdx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindLabel(st, laneName)
    Dim laneLabel As UXBMIRInstructionRecord = instructions(labelIdx)
    ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "RUNNING"
    UXBMIRInterpEnterScope st
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To argCount - 1
        Dim paramName As String = Trim(laneLabel.operands(i + 1))
        If paramName <> "" Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, paramName, argValues(argStart + i)
    Next i

    Dim prevKey As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = taskId + 1
    Dim bodyErr As String
    Dim bodyValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpInvokeLabel(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, laneName, bodyErr)
    ' Gorev biterken (normal ya da hatayla) hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir.
    UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo taskId + 1, 0
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = prevKey
    UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope st

    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 AndAlso (bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_SIGNAL_PROGRAM_END Or bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_ERR_LOCK_FATAL) Then
        ' S-156 sinyali ve olumcul kilit hatasi gorev hatasi degildir: programin kendisini bitirir.
        Return bodyValue
    End If
    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 Then
        ' Mete: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata gorev nesnesinde tutulur" -- cagirana SIZMAZ.
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "ERROR"
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(1) = bodyValue.errorText
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_active", "0"
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_value", ""
    Else
        ' S-149: `THREAD ... AS <tip>` -> sonuc bildirilen tipte (FUNCTION donusu gibi).
        If resultType <> "" Then bodyValue = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(bodyValue, resultType)
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).values(0) = bodyValue
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "DONE"
    End If
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Ertelenmis gorevi (varsa, baslamamissa) simdi calistirir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal slotId As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer
    For d = 0 To gMirDefCount - 1
        If gMirDefSlot(d) <> slotId Or gMirDefDone(d) <> 0 Then Continue For
        gMirDefDone(d) = 1
        If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) <> "PENDING" Then Return UXBInterpValueVoid()   ' K6: baslamadan iptal
        Return UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, slotId, gMirDefLane(d), gMirDefResult(d), gMirDefArgs(), gMirDefArgStart(d), gMirDefArgCount(d))
    Next d
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Function UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer = 0
    Do While d < gMirDefCount
        If gMirDefDone(d) = 0 Then
            Dim r As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, gMirDefSlot(d))
            If UXBInterpIsError(r) <> 0 Then Return r
        End If
        d += 1
    Loop
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Program sonu (K5): ana programin hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir (END LOCK icinde
' olabilir), ertelenmis gorevler calistirilir.
Function UXBMIRTaskFinishProgram(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue
    UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo 0, 0
    Return UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st)
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockEnter(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim ids(Any) As LongInt
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim cnt As Integer
    UXBMIRLockCollect st, ins, ids(), names(), cnt
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) = key Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("SELF_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " bu gorev tarafindan zaten LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler")
        End If
        If gMirLkOwner(rec) <> -1 Then
            Return UXBMIRLockFatal("LOCK_DEADLOCK: " & UXBMIRLockLabel(rec) & " kilidini tutan gorev, bu gorevin bitmesini bekliyor (LOCK icinde JOIN/WAIT ile karsilikli bekleme)")
        End If
    Next i
    Dim taken As String = ""
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec2 As Integer = UXBMIRLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        gMirLkOwner(rec2) = key
        gMirLkHeldTotal += 1
        If taken <> "" Then taken &= ","
        taken &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount)
    ReDim Preserve gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount)
    gMirLkStackKey(gMirLkStackCount) = key
    gMirLkStackIds(gMirLkStackCount) = taken
    gMirLkStackCount += 1
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRLockLeave(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByRef ins As UXBMIRInstructionRecord) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim key As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = gMirLkStackCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If gMirLkStackKey(i) = key Then
            UXBMIRLockPopEntry i
            Exit For
        End If
    Next i
    If gMirLkHeldTotal = 0 Then Return UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st)
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' TASK_SPAWN: lane rutininin parametrelerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir, sonucu/hatayi
' tutamaca yazar. Yalniz BAGLAMA hatasi (hedef yok, arguman sayisi) SPAWN cagrisinin
' kendi hatasidir; govde hatasi gorevde kalir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal taskId As Integer, ByVal laneName As String, ByVal resultType As String, argValues() As UXBInterpValue, ByVal argStart As Integer, ByVal argCount As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim labelIdx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindLabel(st, laneName)
    Dim laneLabel As UXBMIRInstructionRecord = instructions(labelIdx)
    ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "RUNNING"
    UXBMIRInterpEnterScope st
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To argCount - 1
        Dim paramName As String = Trim(laneLabel.operands(i + 1))
        If paramName <> "" Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, paramName, argValues(argStart + i)
    Next i

    Dim prevKey As Integer = gMirCurrentTaskKey
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = taskId + 1
    Dim bodyErr As String
    Dim bodyValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpInvokeLabel(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, laneName, bodyErr)
    ' Gorev biterken (normal ya da hatayla) hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir.
    UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo taskId + 1, 0
    gMirCurrentTaskKey = prevKey
    UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope st

    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 AndAlso (bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_SIGNAL_PROGRAM_END Or bodyValue.errorCode = UXB_INTERP_ERR_LOCK_FATAL) Then
        ' S-156 sinyali ve olumcul kilit hatasi gorev hatasi degildir: programin kendisini bitirir.
        Return bodyValue
    End If
    If UXBInterpIsError(bodyValue) <> 0 Then
        ' Mete: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata gorev nesnesinde tutulur" -- cagirana SIZMAZ.
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "ERROR"
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(1) = bodyValue.errorText
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_active", "0"
        UXBMIRInterpSetTextVar st, "__mir_exc_value", ""
    Else
        ' S-149: `THREAD ... AS <tip>` -> sonuc bildirilen tipte (FUNCTION donusu gibi).
        If resultType <> "" Then bodyValue = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(bodyValue, resultType)
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).values(0) = bodyValue
        ctx.heap.slots(taskId).names(0) = "DONE"
    End If
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Ertelenmis gorevi (varsa, baslamamissa) simdi calistirir.
Private Function UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal slotId As Integer) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer
    For d = 0 To gMirDefCount - 1
        If gMirDefSlot(d) <> slotId Or gMirDefDone(d) <> 0 Then Continue For
        gMirDefDone(d) = 1
        If ctx.heap.slots(slotId).names(0) <> "PENDING" Then Return UXBInterpValueVoid()   ' K6: baslamadan iptal
        Return UXBMIRTaskRunBody(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, slotId, gMirDefLane(d), gMirDefResult(d), gMirDefArgs(), gMirDefArgStart(d), gMirDefArgCount(d))
    Next d
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

Function UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim d As Integer = 0
    Do While d < gMirDefCount
        If gMirDefDone(d) = 0 Then
            Dim r As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRTaskRunDeferredSlot(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st, gMirDefSlot(d))
            If UXBInterpIsError(r) <> 0 Then Return r
        End If
        d += 1
    Loop
    Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
End Function

' Program sonu (K5): ana programin hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir (END LOCK icinde
' olabilir), ertelenmis gorevler calistirilir.
Function UXBMIRTaskFinishProgram(instructions() As UXBMIRInstructionRecord, ByVal instructionCount As Integer, ByRef ctx As UXBInterpContext, ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState) As UXBInterpValue
    UXBMIRLockReleaseKeyTo 0, 0
    Return UXBMIRTaskDrainDeferred(instructions(), instructionCount, ctx, st)
End Function

' S-146 Model D: SYNC_ENTER/SYNC_LEAVE (mode 0) ve LOCK_ENTER/LOCK_LEAVE (mode 1).
' Kimlik dizisi yigina yazilir: once statik "id1,id2" (lockOrderId), sonra MUTEX degerleri.
'   __uxb_rt_sync_enter(ids, count, "AD1,AD2", mode) / __uxb_rt_sync_leave(ids, count, mode)
Private Function MIRX64EmitSyncCall(ByRef ins As MIRIRInstruction, ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByVal isEnter As Integer, ByVal modeValue As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If ins.operandCount < 3 Then
        errText = "MIR x64 emitter: " & UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0))) & " kimlik ve ad listesi ister"
        Return 0
    End If
    Dim idsCsv As String = MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(1)) & ","
    Dim namesText As String = MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(2))
    Dim staticIds(Any) As String
    Dim staticCount As Integer = 0
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(idsCsv)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, idsCsv, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(idsCsv, p, q - p))
        If part <> "" Then
            ReDim Preserve staticIds(staticCount)
            staticIds(staticCount) = part
            staticCount += 1
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
    Dim dynCount As Integer = ins.operandCount - 3
    Dim total As Integer = staticCount + dynCount
    If total <= 0 Then Return 1
    Dim bytes As Integer = total * 8
    If (bytes Mod 16) <> 0 Then bytes += 8

    Dim sym As String = IIf(isEnter <> 0, "__uxb_rt_sync_enter", "__uxb_rt_sync_leave")
    MIRX64EmitRuntimeExtern cg, sym
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    ; S-146 " & UCase(Trim(ins.operands(0))) & " " & MIRX64TaskUnquote(ins.operands(2))
    MIRX64Emit cg, "    sub rsp, " & MIRX64ToStr(bytes)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To staticCount - 1
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov rax, " & staticIds(i)
        MIRX64Emit cg, "    mov qword [rsp+" & MIRX64ToStr(i * 8) & "], rax"
    Next i
    For i = 0 To dynCount - 1
        If MIRX64LoadOperandToReg(cg, ins.operands(3 + i), "rax", errText) = 0 Then Return 0

        throwCode = throwValue.intValue
    ElseIf UCase(throwValue.valueType) = "FLOAT" Then
        throwCode = CInt(throwValue.floatValue)
    End If

    ExecExceptionRaise ps, es, stmtIdx, "THROW", throwCode, throwMsg, throwValue
    errText = ExecExceptionBuildMessage(es)

End Function

Private Function ExecRunAssertStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim assertCondExpr As Integer
    assertCondExpr = ExecChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, 0)
    If assertCondExpr = -1 Then
        errText = "exec: ASSERT condition missing"
        Return 0
    End If

    ' ABI10_ASSERT_TYPED_EXPR_FIX_20260706:
    ' Use typed expression evaluation for ASSERT conditions.  The old
    ' integer-only ExecEvalNode path converts 0.0001 to 0, so expressions
    ' such as ASSERT ABS(mixed - 38.0) < 0.0001 fail even when mixed=38.0.
    Dim condEval As ExecValue
    If ExecEvalExpression(ps, assertCondExpr, es, condEval, errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim condValue As Integer
    condValue = ExecValueToInteger(condEval)
    If condValue <> 0 Then Return 1

    Dim payload As ExecValue
    payload = condEval

    Dim assertMsgExpr As Integer
    assertMsgExpr = ExecChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, 1)
    If assertMsgExpr = -1 Then
        ExecExceptionRaise ps, es, stmtIdx, "ASSERT", EXEC_EXC_CODE_ASSERT, "ASSERT failed", payload
        errText = ExecExceptionBuildMessage(es)
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim assertMsg As String
    If ExecEvalNodeAsText(ps, es, assertMsgExpr, assertMsg, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    ExecExceptionRaise ps, es, stmtIdx, "ASSERT", EXEC_EXC_CODE_ASSERT, "ASSERT failed: " & assertMsg, payload
    errText = ExecExceptionBuildMessage(es)
    Return 0
End Function

Private Function ExecRunFlowStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef st As ASTNode, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Select Case UCase(st.kind)
    Case "IF_STMT"
        Return ExecRunIfStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, errText)

    Case "SELECT_STMT"
        Return ExecRunSelectStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, errText)

    Case "FOR_STMT"
        Return ExecRunForStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, st, errText)

    Case "DO_STMT"
        Return ExecRunDoStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, st, errText)

    Case "FOR_EACH_STMT"
        Return ExecRunForEachStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, st, errText)

    Case "DO_EACH_STMT"
        Return ExecRunDoEachStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, st, errText)

    Case "TRY_STMT"
        Return ExecRunTryStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, errText)

    Case "THROW_STMT"
        Return ExecRunThrowStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, errText)

    Case "ASSERT_STMT"
        Return ExecRunAssertStmt(ps, es, stmtIdx, errText)
    End Select

    Return -2
End Function
