1	' S-030: TASK / TASKGROUP calisma zamani tutamaclari -- AST yorumlayicisi (`run`).
2	'
3	' Faz 1 (bu dosya): SPAWN, hedef THREAD/PARALEL govdesini HEMEN, ayni cagri
4	' yiginda calistirir -- TASK tutamaci DONE/ERROR durumunda dogar; .STATUS hic
5	' PENDING/RUNNING gormez. Bu, acikca belgelenmis, gecici bir Faz 1 siniridir
6	' (bkz. ai_koordinasyon/SORUN_TAKIP.md "## S-030"), placeholder DEGILDIR: her
7	' uc nokta (SPAWN, .STATUS/.WAIT()/.RESULT/.JOIN()/.CANCEL()/.ERRORTEXT,
8	' TASKGROUP) gercekten calisir ve test edilir. Faz 2 native gercek is
9	' parcacigi havuzuna gectiginde yalniz YURUTME (ExecSpawnRunTaskBody) degisir;
10	' tutamacin disariya gorunen sozlesmesi ayni kalir.
11	'
12	' Onemli: sonuc/hata BURADA, tutamacin KENDI alaninda tasinir -- eski
13	' UXB_TASK_RESULT_NAME/UXB_TASK_INPUT_NAME sozde-genel degiskenleri (bkz.
14	' src/common/task_context_names.fbs) TRIGGER'in senkron EVENT/PIPE/eski-ABI
15	' yolunda degismeden kalir, TASK tutamaci bunlari YENIDEN KULLANMAZ.
16	
17	Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING As String = "PENDING"
18	Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING As String = "RUNNING"
19	Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE As String = "DONE"
20	Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR As String = "ERROR"
21	Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED As String = "CANCELLED"
22	
23	Type ExecTaskHandleRecord
24	    used As Integer
25	    statusText As String
26	    kindText As String       ' THREAD / PARALEL
27	    taskName As String
28	    resultValue As ExecValue
29	    hasResult As Integer
30	    errorText As String
31	    errorObserved As Integer ' K5: hata JOIN/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN ile yukseldi ya da STATUS/ERRORTEXT ile okundu
32	End Type
33	
34	Type ExecTaskGroupRecord
35	    used As Integer
36	    memberIds(Any) As Integer
37	    memberCount As Integer
38	End Type
39	
40	Dim Shared gExecTaskHandles(Any) As ExecTaskHandleRecord
41	Dim Shared gExecTaskHandleCount As Integer
42	Dim Shared gExecTaskGroups(Any) As ExecTaskGroupRecord
43	Dim Shared gExecTaskGroupCount As Integer
44	
45	Private Sub ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
46	    If gExecTaskHandleCount = 0 Then
47	        ReDim gExecTaskHandles(0)
48	        gExecTaskHandleCount = 1  ' id 0 = NULL gonderge, hic gercek tutamac olarak verilmez
49	    End If
50	    If gExecTaskGroupCount = 0 Then
51	        ReDim gExecTaskGroups(0)
52	        gExecTaskGroupCount = 1   ' id 0 = NULL gonderge (TASK ile ayni kural)
53	    End If
54	End Sub
55	
56	Private Function ExecTaskHandleAlloc() As Integer
57	    ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
58	    ReDim Preserve gExecTaskHandles(gExecTaskHandleCount)
59	    Dim idx As Integer
60	    idx = gExecTaskHandleCount
61	    gExecTaskHandleCount += 1
62	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).used = 1
63	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING
64	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).kindText = ""
65	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).taskName = ""
66	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).hasResult = 0
67	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).errorText = ""
68	    gExecTaskHandles(idx).errorObserved = 0
69	    ExecValueInit gExecTaskHandles(idx).resultValue
70	    Return idx
71	End Function
72	
73	Function ExecTaskHandleValid(ByVal id As Integer) As Integer
74	    If id <= 0 Or id >= gExecTaskHandleCount Then Return 0
75	    Return gExecTaskHandles(id).used
76	End Function
77	
78	Private Function ExecTaskGroupAlloc() As Integer
79	    ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
80	    ReDim Preserve gExecTaskGroups(gExecTaskGroupCount)
81	    Dim idx As Integer
82	    idx = gExecTaskGroupCount
83	    gExecTaskGroupCount += 1
84	    gExecTaskGroups(idx).used = 1
85	    gExecTaskGroups(idx).memberCount = 0
86	    Return idx
87	End Function
88	
89	Function ExecTaskGroupValid(ByVal id As Integer) As Integer
90	    If id <= 0 Or id >= gExecTaskGroupCount Then Return 0
91	    Return gExecTaskGroups(id).used
92	End Function
93	
94	' Hedef THREAD/PARALEL rutininin PARAM_DECL'lerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir,
95	' RETURN degerini (varsa) yakalar. Yalnizca BAGLAMA (arity/tip/BYREF/dizi
96	' parametre) basarisiz olursa 0 doner (bindErrText dolu) -- bu, cagiranin
97	' KENDI hatasi sayilir (semantik katman zaten derleme zamaninda yakalamis
98	' olmali). Govde calisirken olusan HER hata yakalanir, bodyErrText'e yazilir,
99	' fonksiyon yine de 1 doner -- Mete'nin karari: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata
100	' gorev nesnesinde tutulur, WAIT/JOIN/RESULT'ta cagirana aktarilir."
101	Private Function ExecSpawnBindAndRunBody(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal routineIdx As Integer, ByVal callExprIdx As Integer, ByRef resultOut As ExecValue, ByRef hasResultOut As Integer, ByRef bodyErrText As String, ByRef bindErrText As String) As Integer
102	    Dim routineNodeIdx As Integer
103	    routineNodeIdx = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nodeIdx
104	    Dim callName As String
105	    callName = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nameText
106	
107	    Dim paramNames(Any) As String
108	    Dim paramTypes(Any) As String
109	    Dim paramCount As Integer
110	    paramCount = 0
111	
112	    Dim bodyStart As Integer
113	    bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).firstChild
114	    Do While bodyStart <> -1
115	        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).kind)) <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Exit Do
116	
117	        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).op)) = "BYREF" Then
118	            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN: BYREF parametre asenkron gorevde henuz desteklenmiyor: " & callName
119	            Return 0
120	        End If
121	
122	        If paramCount = 0 Then
123	            ReDim paramNames(0)
124	            ReDim paramTypes(0)
125	        Else
126	            ReDim Preserve paramNames(paramCount)
127	            ReDim Preserve paramTypes(paramCount)
128	        End If
129	
130	        paramNames(paramCount) = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).value
131	        paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).typeName))
132	        If paramTypes(paramCount) = "" Then
133	            Dim paramTypeChild As Integer
134	            paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).firstChild
135	            Do While paramTypeChild <> -1
136	                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).kind)) = "TYPE_REF" Then
137	                    paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).value))
138	                    Exit Do
139	                End If
140	                paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).nextSibling
141	            Loop
142	        End If
143	
144	        If Len(paramTypes(paramCount)) > 2 AndAlso Right(paramTypes(paramCount), 2) = "[]" Then
145	            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN: dizi parametreli gorev henuz desteklenmiyor: " & callName
146	            Return 0
147	        End If
148	
149	        paramCount += 1
150	        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
151	    Loop
152	
153	    Do While bodyStart <> -1 And ExecIsRoutineMetadataNode(ps, bodyStart) <> 0
154	        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
155	    Loop
156	
157	    Dim explicitArgCount As Integer
158	    explicitArgCount = ExecChildCount(ps, callExprIdx)
159	
160	    If explicitArgCount <> paramCount Then
161	        bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN cagri argumani uyusmuyor " & callName & " beklenen=" & LTrim(Str(paramCount)) & " gelen=" & LTrim(Str(explicitArgCount))
162	        Return 0
163	    End If
164	
165	    Dim argValues(Any) As ExecValue
166	    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim argValues(paramCount - 1)
167	    Dim ai As Integer
168	    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
169	        Dim argNode As Integer
170	        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callExprIdx, ai)
171	        If argNode = -1 Then
172	            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN cagri argumani eksik: " & callName
173	            Return 0
174	        End If
175	        If ExecEvalExpression(ps, argNode, es, argValues(ai), bindErrText) = 0 Then Return 0
176	    Next ai
177	
178	    Dim boundValues(Any) As ExecValue
179	    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim boundValues(paramCount - 1)
180	    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
181	        If ExecApplyDeclaredType(argValues(ai), paramTypes(ai), boundValues(ai), bindErrText) = 0 Then Return 0
182	    Next ai
183	
184	    Dim snapshotVars(Any) As ExecVar
185	    Dim snapshotCount As Integer
186	    Dim snapshotNextAddr As UInteger
187	    ExecSnapshotVars es, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr
188	
189	    If es.runtime.callContextDepth >= 63 Then
190	        bindErrText = "exec: call stack limit exceeded"
191	        Return 0
192	    End If
193	    es.runtime.callContextDepth += 1
194	    es.runtime.callFrameBase(es.runtime.callContextDepth) = es.count
195	
196	    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
197	        If ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(ai)) < es.runtime.callFrameBase(es.runtime.callContextDepth) Then
198	            If ExecAppendFrameVar(es, paramNames(ai)) = -1 Then
199	                bindErrText = "exec: local frame variable capacity exceeded"
200	                es.runtime.callContextDepth -= 1
201	                Return 0
202	            End If
203	        End If
204	        ExecSetVarValue es, paramNames(ai), boundValues(ai)
205	        Dim boundVarIdx As Integer
206	        boundVarIdx = ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(ai))
207	        If boundVarIdx <> -1 Then es.vars(boundVarIdx).declType = paramTypes(ai)
208	    Next ai
209	
210	    Dim savedReturnValue As Integer
211	    Dim savedReturnValueEx As ExecValue
212	    Dim savedReturnHasValue As Integer
213	    Dim savedRoutineName As String
214	    Dim savedRoutineNodeIdx As Integer
215	    savedReturnValue = es.runtime.callReturnValue
216	    savedReturnValueEx = es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
217	    savedReturnHasValue = es.runtime.callReturnHasValue
218	    savedRoutineName = es.runtime.currentRoutineName
219	    savedRoutineNodeIdx = es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx
220	    es.runtime.callReturnValue = 0
221	    ExecValueInit es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
222	    es.runtime.callReturnHasValue = 0
223	    es.runtime.currentRoutineName = callName
224	    es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx = routineNodeIdx
225	
226	    Dim noByRefFlags(0) As Integer
227	    Dim noCallerArgNames(0) As String
228	
229	    Dim bodyRunErr As String
230	    Dim bodyOk As Integer
231	    bodyOk = 1
232	    Dim bodyNode As Integer
233	    bodyNode = bodyStart
234	    Do While bodyNode <> -1
235	        If ExecIsRoutineMetadataNode(ps, bodyNode) <> 0 Then
236	            bodyNode = ps.ast.nodes(bodyNode).nextSibling
237	            Continue Do
238	        End If
239	
240	        If ExecRunStmt(ps, es, bodyNode, bodyRunErr) = 0 Then
241	            bodyOk = 0
242	            Exit Do
243	        End If
244	
245	        If es.runtime.exitRequest <> "" Then
246	            Dim callReq As String
247	            callReq = UCase(es.runtime.exitRequest)
248	            If callReq = "RETURN_CALL" Then
249	                es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
250	                Exit Do
251	            End If
252	            If callReq = "RETURN" Then
253	                es.runtime.exitRequest = "RETURN_CALL"
254	                Exit Do
255	            End If
256	            ' GOTO/GOSUB/EXIT/END: gorev govdesinden disari sizmamali -- Faz 1'de
257	            ' bunu bir govde hatasi say (Faz 2'de gercek is parcacigi sinirinda
258	            ' zaten anlamsiz olacak).
259	            bodyOk = 0
260	            bodyRunErr = "exec: SPAWN gorev govdesinde beklenmeyen kontrol akisi: " & es.runtime.exitRequest
261	            es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
262	            Exit Do
263	        End If
264	
265	        bodyNode = ps.ast.nodes(bodyNode).nextSibling
266	    Loop
267	
268	    hasResultOut = 1
269	    If bodyOk <> 0 Then
270	        If es.runtime.callReturnHasValue <> 0 Then
271	            resultOut = es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
272	            ' S-149: `THREAD Worker(...) AS I32` -- sonuc, FUNCTION donusu gibi
273	            ' bildirilen tipe cevrilir (TASK OF I32'nin .RESULT'u gercekten I32).
274	            Dim laneRetNode As Integer
275	            laneRetNode = ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).firstChild
276	            Do While laneRetNode <> -1
277	                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).kind)) = "RETURN_TYPE" Then
278	                    Dim typedResult As ExecValue
279	                    Dim convErr As String
280	                    If ExecApplyDeclaredType(resultOut, UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).value)), typedResult, convErr) = 0 Then
281	                        bodyOk = 0
282	                        bodyRunErr = convErr
283	                    Else
284	                        resultOut = typedResult
285	                    End If
286	                    Exit Do
287	                End If
288	                laneRetNode = ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).nextSibling
289	            Loop
290	        Else
291	            ExecValueInit resultOut
292	        End If
293	    Else
294	        ExecValueInit resultOut
295	    End If
296	
297	    es.runtime.callContextDepth -= 1
298	    es.runtime.callReturnValue = savedReturnValue
299	    es.runtime.callReturnValueEx = savedReturnValueEx
300	    es.runtime.callReturnHasValue = savedReturnHasValue
301	    es.runtime.currentRoutineName = savedRoutineName
302	    es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx = savedRoutineNodeIdx
303	    ExecRestoreRoutineVars ps, es, routineNodeIdx, paramNames(), paramCount, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr, noByRefFlags(), 0, noCallerArgNames()
304	
305	    If bodyOk = 0 Then
306	        bodyErrText = bodyRunErr
307	        Return 1
308	    End If
309	
310	    bodyErrText = ""
311	    Return 1
312	End Function
313	
314	' SPAWN_EXPR -> TASK tutamaci. Faz 1: govde HEMEN calisir; tutamac DONE/ERROR
315	' durumunda doner.
316	Function ExecRunSpawnExpr(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal spawnNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef result As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
317	    Dim callExprIdx As Integer
318	    callExprIdx = ps.ast.nodes(spawnNodeIdx).left
319	    If callExprIdx = -1 Then
320	        errText = "exec: SPAWN gorev cagrisi eksik"
321	        Return 0
322	    End If
323	
324	    Dim taskName As String
325	    taskName = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(callExprIdx).value)
326	    Dim routineIdx As Integer
327	    routineIdx = ExecRoutineIndexOf(es, taskName)
328	    If routineIdx = -1 Then
329	        errText = "exec: SPAWN hedefi bulunamadi: " & taskName
330	        Return 0
331	    End If
332	
333	    Dim routineKind As String
334	    routineKind = UCase(Trim(es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).routineKind))
335	    If routineKind <> "THREAD_STMT" And routineKind <> "PARALEL_STMT" Then
336	        errText = "exec: SPAWN hedefi THREAD veya PARALEL gorevi olmali: " & taskName
337	        Return 0
338	    End If
339	
340	    Dim handleId As Integer
341	    handleId = ExecTaskHandleAlloc()
342	    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).kindText = IIf(routineKind = "THREAD_STMT", "THREAD", "PARALEL")
343	    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName = taskName
344	    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING
345	
346	    Dim bodyResult As ExecValue
347	    Dim bodyHasResult As Integer
348	    Dim bodyErrText As String
349	    Dim bindErrText As String
350	    If ExecSpawnBindAndRunBody(ps, es, routineIdx, callExprIdx, bodyResult, bodyHasResult, bodyErrText, bindErrText) = 0 Then
351	        ' Baglama hatasi (arity/tip/BYREF/dizi/yigin siniri) -- cagiranin kendi
352	        ' hatasi, TASK'a degil SPAWN cagrisinin kendisine mal edilir.
353	        errText = bindErrText
354	        Return 0
355	    End If
356	
357	    If bodyErrText <> "" Then
358	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
359	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = bodyErrText
360	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = 0
361	    Else
362	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE
363	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = bodyHasResult
364	        If bodyHasResult <> 0 Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue = bodyResult
365	    End If
366	
367	    ' S-030: TASK, bu koddaki TUM diger opak tutamaclarla (CLASS ornegi adresi,
368	    ' LIST/DICT/SET tutamaci) AYNI kurali izler -- deger duz bir "INTEGER"
369	    ' ExecValue'dur (0 = NULL); TASK/TASKGROUP oldugu bilgisi degiskenin KENDI
370	    ' declType alaninda tutulur (bkz. ExecTaskReceiverInfo). ExecValue'ya ozel
371	    ' bir "TASK" valueType etiketi eklemek, ExecValueToInteger/ToU64/ToFloat/
372	    ' ApplyDeclaredType gibi HER genel deger yardimcisina ayri ayri Case
373	    ' eklemeyi gerektirirdi -- bu, tutarsizlik riskini artiran gereksiz bir
374	    ' ikinci sinif deger turu olustururdu.
375	    ExecValueSetInteger result, handleId
376	    errText = ""
377	    Return 1
378	End Function
379	
380	' Bilesik alici ifadesinin (g(i), F(), s.alan, (ifade) ...) STATIK tipi -- ayni
381	' tip cikarimi (UXBStep3InferExprType) semantik kapinin `t = g(i)` atamasini
382	' denetlerken kullandigi fonksiyondur; AST yorumlayicisi bunu zaten calisma
383	' aninda kullaniyor (bkz. UXBMemoryAddrIsPointer, S-069). Sonuc dugum basina
384	' bir kez hesaplanip saklanir: CLASS metot zincirleri de bu on-kontrolden
385	' gectigi icin sicak dongude tekrar tekrar tip cikarimi yapilmaz.
386	'   memo: 0 = hesaplanmadi, 1 = TASK, 2 = TASKGROUP, 3 = ikisi de degil
387	Dim Shared gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(Any) As Byte
388	Dim Shared gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize As Integer
389	
390	Private Function ExecTaskStaticReceiverKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As String
391	    If gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize <> ps.ast.count Then
392	        gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize = ps.ast.count
393	        If gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize > 0 Then ReDim gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize - 1)
394	    End If
395	
396	    If gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 0 Then
397	        Dim inferredType As String
398	        Dim inferErr As String
399	        gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 3
400	        If UXBStep3InferExprType(ps, nodeIdx, inferredType, inferErr) <> 0 Then
401	            ' Bazi dallar (ornegin FUNCTION donus tipi) ham bildirim adini
402	            ' ("TASK") dondurur; karsilastirma kanonik adla yapilir.
403	            inferredType = UXBStep3TypeCanonical(inferredType)
404	            If inferredType = TYPE_TASK Then
405	                gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 1
406	            ElseIf inferredType = TYPE_TASKGROUP Then
407	                gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 2
408	            End If
409	        End If
410	    End If
411	
412	    Select Case gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx)
413	    Case 1: Return "TASK"
414	    Case 2: Return "TASKGROUP"
415	    End Select
416	    Return ""
417	End Function
418	
419	' Alicinin TASK/TASKGROUP turunde olup olmadigini tespit eder ve tutamaci
420	' okur. Alici ifadesi en fazla BIR kez degerlendirilir (cift-degerlendirme
421	' YOK -- bkz. S-124); cagiran, 1 donuste aliciyi yeniden degerlendirmez.
422	'   -1 = alici TASK/TASKGROUP degil (baska bir cozumleyici denesin)
423	'    0 = TASK/TASKGROUP ama hata olustu (errText dolu)
424	'    1 = basarili (kindOut="TASK"/"TASKGROUP", handleIdOut = tutamac id, 0=NULL)
425	Private Function ExecTaskReceiverInfo(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal receiverNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef kindOut As String, ByRef handleIdOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
426	    kindOut = ""
427	    handleIdOut = 0
428	    If receiverNodeIdx < 0 Or receiverNodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return -1
429	
430	    Dim rk As String
431	    rk = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(receiverNodeIdx).kind))
432	
433	    If rk = "IDENT" Or rk = "KEYWORD_REF" Then
434	        Dim receiverName As String
435	        receiverName = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(receiverNodeIdx).value)
436	        Dim varIdx As Integer
437	        varIdx = ExecFindVar(es, receiverName)
438	        If varIdx = -1 Then Return -1
439	        Dim declT As String
440	        declT = UCase(Trim(es.vars(varIdx).declType))
441	        ' Parametre degiskenleri declType'i PARAM_DECL typeName'inden alir; semantik kapi
442	        ' onu kanonik "TYPE_TASK" bicimine cevirir (Step3InferNodeDeclaredOrInitializerType).
443	        If Left(declT, 5) = "TYPE_" Then declT = Mid(declT, 6)
444	        If declT <> "TASK" And declT <> "TASKGROUP" Then Return -1
445	        If es.vars(varIdx).isArray <> 0 Then
446	            errText = "exec: " & declT & " dizisi eleman indeksi olmadan alici olamaz: " & receiverName & " -- " & receiverName & "(i) yazin"
447	            Return 0
448	        End If
449	        kindOut = declT
450	        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(es.vars(varIdx).value)
451	        Return 1
452	    End If
453	
454	    If rk = "SPAWN_EXPR" Then
455	        Dim v As ExecValue
456	        If ExecRunSpawnExpr(ps, es, receiverNodeIdx, v, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
457	        kindOut = "TASK"
458	        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(v)
459	        Return 1
460	    End If
461	
462	    ' Bilesik alici: dizi elemani g(i), TASK donduren FUNCTION F(), TASK alani
463	    ' s.gorev, parantezli/kosullu ifade. Tip statik cikarimdan gelir; deger
464	    ' tek kez degerlendirilir.
465	    Select Case rk
466	    Case "CALL_EXPR", "INDEX_EXPR", "FIELD_EXPR", "MEMBER_EXPR", "PAREN_EXPR", "GROUP_EXPR", "EXPR_GROUP", "TERNARY_EXPR"
467	        Dim staticKind As String
468	        staticKind = ExecTaskStaticReceiverKind(ps, receiverNodeIdx)
469	        If staticKind = "" Then Return -1
470	        Dim recvValue As ExecValue
471	        If ExecEvalExpression(ps, receiverNodeIdx, es, recvValue, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
472	        kindOut = staticKind
473	        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(recvValue)
474	        Return 1
475	    End Select
476	
477	    Return -1
478	End Function
479	
480	' K6 (Mete, 2026-09-24): ERROR veya CANCELLED bitmis gorevin .RESULT/.JOIN()
481	' okumasi ve TASKGROUP.JOIN() hatayi cagirana aktarir. 1 = basarisiz bitmis
482	' (errText dolu), 0 = basarisiz degil.
483	Private Function ExecTaskFailureText(ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
484	    Select Case gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText
485	    Case UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
486	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
487	        errText = "exec: gorev hatasi (" & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName & "): " & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText
488	        Return 1
489	    Case UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
490	        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
491	        errText = "exec: gorev iptal edildi (" & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName & "): CANCELLED"
492	        Return 1
493	    End Select
494	    Return 0
495	End Function
496	
497	' K5 (Mete, 2026-09-24): "Okunmamis gorev hatasi sessiz kaybolmaz: hata cikisina yazilir, cikis
498	' kodu basarisiz olur." Program sonunda cagrilir. Iptal (CANCELLED) programin kendi istegidir,
499	' hata sayilmaz; yalniz hic okunmamis ERROR raporlanir. 1 = en az bir okunmamis hata (errText dolu).
500	Function ExecTaskUnreadErrors(ByRef errText As String) As Integer
501	    errText = ""
502	    Dim i As Integer
503	    For i = 1 To gExecTaskHandleCount - 1
504	        If gExecTaskHandles(i).used = 0 Then Continue For
505	        If gExecTaskHandles(i).statusText <> UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR Then Continue For
506	        If gExecTaskHandles(i).errorObserved <> 0 Then Continue For
507	        If errText <> "" Then errText &= "; "
508	        errText &= "okunmamis gorev hatasi (" & gExecTaskHandles(i).taskName & "): " & gExecTaskHandles(i).errorText
509	    Next i
510	    If errText = "" Then Return 0
511	    errText = "exec: " & errText
512	    Return 1
513	End Function
514	
515	' TASK/TASKGROUP alan OKUMASI: .STATUS / .RESULT / .ERRORTEXT (FIELD_EXPR).
516	Private Function ExecReadTaskField(ByRef kindText As String, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef fieldName As String, ByRef valueOut As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
517	    Dim f As String
518	    f = UCase(Trim(fieldName))
519	
520	    If kindText <> "TASK" Then
521	        errText = "exec: TASKGROUP uzerinde alan yok: " & fieldName
522	        Return 0
523	    End If
524	
525	    Select Case f
526	    Case "STATUS"
527	        ExecValueInit valueOut
528	        valueOut.valueType = "STRING"
529	        If handleId = 0 Then
530	            valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING  ' hic SPAWN edilmemis (NULL) tutamac
531	        Else
532	            valueOut.stringValue = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText
533	            If valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR Or valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
534	        End If
535	        Return 1
536	
537	    Case "ERRORTEXT"
538	        ExecValueInit valueOut
539	        valueOut.valueType = "STRING"
540	        If handleId = 0 Then
541	            valueOut.stringValue = ""
542	        Else
543	            valueOut.stringValue = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText
544	            If valueOut.stringValue <> "" Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
545	        End If
546	        Return 1
547	
548	    Case "RESULT"
549	        If handleId = 0 Then
550	            errText = "exec: TASK.RESULT: bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
551	            Return 0
552	        End If
553	        If ExecTaskFailureText(handleId, errText) <> 0 Then Return 0
554	        If gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult <> 0 Then
555	            valueOut = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue
556	        Else
557	            ExecValueInit valueOut
558	        End If
559	        Return 1
560	    End Select
561	
562	    errText = "exec: TASK uzerinde bilinmeyen alan: " & fieldName
563	    Return 0
564	End Function
565	
566	' TASK/TASKGROUP metot CAGRISI: .WAIT()/.JOIN()/.CANCEL() (TASK),
567	' .ADD()/.JOIN()/.JOINALL() (TASKGROUP) (dotted CALL_EXPR).
568	Private Function ExecInvokeTaskMember(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef kindText As String, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef methodName As String, ByVal callNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef valueOut As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
569	    Dim m As String
570	    m = UCase(Trim(methodName))
571	    ExecValueInit valueOut
572	
573	    If kindText = "TASK" Then
574	        Select Case m
575	        Case "WAIT"
576	            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
577	                errText = "exec: TASK.WAIT() arguman almaz"
578	                Return 0
579	            End If
580	            If handleId = 0 Then
581	                errText = "exec: TASK.WAIT(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
582	                Return 0
583	            End If
584	            ' Faz 1: gorev SPAWN aninda zaten bitti (senkron referans uygulama) --
585	            ' WAIT hemen doner. Faz 2 gercek eszamanlilikta burasi gercekten bloke
586	            ' edecek; disariya gorunen sozlesme (arguman yok, deger yok) ayni kalir.
587	            Return 1
588	
589	        Case "CANCEL"
590	            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
591	                errText = "exec: TASK.CANCEL() arguman almaz"
592	                Return 0
593	            End If
594	            If handleId = 0 Then
595	                errText = "exec: TASK.CANCEL(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
596	                Return 0
597	            End If
598	            ' K6: yalniz iptal ISTEGI; tekrar CANCEL zararsiz. Baslamamis (PENDING)
599	            ' gorev hic calismadan CANCELLED olur, ERRORTEXT = "CANCELLED".
600	            If gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING Then
601	                gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
602	                gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
603	            End If
604	            ' Faz 1: govde SPAWN aninda zaten calisip bittigi icin CANCEL onu asla
605	            ' PENDING yakalayamaz -- belgelenmis Faz 1 siniri (bkz. dosya basi).
606	            Return 1
607	
608	        Case "JOIN"
609	            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
610	                errText = "exec: TASK.JOIN() arguman almaz"
611	                Return 0
612	            End If
613	            If handleId = 0 Then
614	                errText = "exec: TASK.JOIN(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
615	                Return 0
616	            End If
617	            Return ExecReadTaskField(kindText, handleId, "RESULT", valueOut, errText)
618	
619	        Case Else
620	            errText = "exec: TASK uzerinde bilinmeyen metot: " & methodName
621	            Return 0
622	        End Select
623	    End If
624	
625	    If kindText = "TASKGROUP" Then
626	        Select Case m
627	        Case "ADD"
628	            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 1 Then
629	                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(gorev) tam bir arguman ister"
630	                Return 0
631	            End If
632	            If handleId = 0 Then
633	                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci"
634	                Return 0
635	            End If
636	            Dim argNode As Integer
637	            argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, 0)
638	            Dim argKind As String
639	            Dim argHandleId As Integer
640	            Dim argRv As Integer
641	            argRv = ExecTaskReceiverInfo(ps, es, argNode, argKind, argHandleId, errText)
642	            If argRv = 0 Then Return 0
643	            If argRv < 0 Or argKind <> "TASK" Then
644	                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(): arguman bir TASK olmali"
645	                Return 0
646	            End If
647	            Dim ByRef grpRec As ExecTaskGroupRecord = gExecTaskGroups(handleId)
648	            Dim newCount As Integer
649	            newCount = grpRec.memberCount
650	            If newCount = 0 Then
651	                ReDim grpRec.memberIds(0)
652	            Else
653	                ReDim Preserve grpRec.memberIds(newCount)
654	            End If
655	            grpRec.memberIds(newCount) = argHandleId
656	            grpRec.memberCount += 1
657	            Return 1
658	
659	        Case "JOIN"
660	            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
661	                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOIN() arguman almaz"
662	                Return 0
663	            End If
664	            If handleId = 0 Then
665	                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOIN(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci"
666	                Return 0
667	            End If
668	            ' Faz 1: her uye ADD aninda zaten bitmis; ilk HATALI/IPTAL uyeyi
669	            ' (varsa, EKLENME sirasina gore) cagirana yukselt.
670	            Dim gi As Integer
671	            For gi = 0 To gExecTaskGroups(handleId).memberCount - 1
672	                Dim memberId As Integer
673	                memberId = gExecTaskGroups(handleId).memberIds(gi)
674	                If ExecTaskHandleValid(memberId) <> 0 AndAlso ExecTaskFailureText(memberId, errText) <> 0 Then Return 0
675	            Next gi
676	            Return 1
677	
678	        Case "JOINALL"
679	            errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOINALL() henuz desteklenmiyor (Faz 1 siniri) -- TASKGROUP.JOIN() ile bekleyip her uyenin .RESULT alanini okuyun"
680	            Return 0
681	
682	        Case Else
683	            errText = "exec: TASKGROUP uzerinde bilinmeyen metot: " & methodName
684	            Return 0
685	        End Select
686	    End If
687	
688	    errText = "exec: bilinmeyen tutamac turu: " & kindText
689	    Return 0
690	End Function

' S-030: TASK / TASKGROUP calisma zamani tutamaclari -- AST yorumlayicisi (`run`).
'
' Faz 1 (bu dosya): SPAWN, hedef THREAD/PARALEL govdesini HEMEN, ayni cagri
' yiginda calistirir -- TASK tutamaci DONE/ERROR durumunda dogar; .STATUS hic
' PENDING/RUNNING gormez. Bu, acikca belgelenmis, gecici bir Faz 1 siniridir
' (bkz. ai_koordinasyon/SORUN_TAKIP.md "## S-030"), placeholder DEGILDIR: her
' uc nokta (SPAWN, .STATUS/.WAIT()/.RESULT/.JOIN()/.CANCEL()/.ERRORTEXT,
' TASKGROUP) gercekten calisir ve test edilir. Faz 2 native gercek is
' parcacigi havuzuna gectiginde yalniz YURUTME (ExecSpawnRunTaskBody) degisir;
' tutamacin disariya gorunen sozlesmesi ayni kalir.
'
' Onemli: sonuc/hata BURADA, tutamacin KENDI alaninda tasinir -- eski
' UXB_TASK_RESULT_NAME/UXB_TASK_INPUT_NAME sozde-genel degiskenleri (bkz.
' src/common/task_context_names.fbs) TRIGGER'in senkron EVENT/PIPE/eski-ABI
' yolunda degismeden kalir, TASK tutamaci bunlari YENIDEN KULLANMAZ.

Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING As String = "PENDING"
Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING As String = "RUNNING"
Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE As String = "DONE"
Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR As String = "ERROR"
Const UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED As String = "CANCELLED"

Type ExecTaskHandleRecord
    used As Integer
    statusText As String
    kindText As String       ' THREAD / PARALEL
    taskName As String
    resultValue As ExecValue
    hasResult As Integer
    errorText As String
    errorObserved As Integer ' K5: hata JOIN/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN ile yukseldi ya da STATUS/ERRORTEXT ile okundu
End Type

Type ExecTaskGroupRecord
    used As Integer
    memberIds(Any) As Integer
    memberCount As Integer
End Type

Dim Shared gExecTaskHandles(Any) As ExecTaskHandleRecord
Dim Shared gExecTaskHandleCount As Integer
Dim Shared gExecTaskGroups(Any) As ExecTaskGroupRecord
Dim Shared gExecTaskGroupCount As Integer

Private Sub ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
    If gExecTaskHandleCount = 0 Then
        ReDim gExecTaskHandles(0)
        gExecTaskHandleCount = 1  ' id 0 = NULL gonderge, hic gercek tutamac olarak verilmez
    End If
    If gExecTaskGroupCount = 0 Then
        ReDim gExecTaskGroups(0)
        gExecTaskGroupCount = 1   ' id 0 = NULL gonderge (TASK ile ayni kural)
    End If
End Sub

Private Function ExecTaskHandleAlloc() As Integer
    ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
    ReDim Preserve gExecTaskHandles(gExecTaskHandleCount)
    Dim idx As Integer
    idx = gExecTaskHandleCount
    gExecTaskHandleCount += 1
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).used = 1
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).kindText = ""
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).taskName = ""
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).hasResult = 0
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).errorText = ""
    gExecTaskHandles(idx).errorObserved = 0
    ExecValueInit gExecTaskHandles(idx).resultValue
    Return idx
End Function

Function ExecTaskHandleValid(ByVal id As Integer) As Integer
    If id <= 0 Or id >= gExecTaskHandleCount Then Return 0
    Return gExecTaskHandles(id).used
End Function

Private Function ExecTaskGroupAlloc() As Integer
    ExecTaskHandleEnsureInit()
    ReDim Preserve gExecTaskGroups(gExecTaskGroupCount)
    Dim idx As Integer
    idx = gExecTaskGroupCount
    gExecTaskGroupCount += 1
    gExecTaskGroups(idx).used = 1
    gExecTaskGroups(idx).memberCount = 0
    Return idx
End Function

Function ExecTaskGroupValid(ByVal id As Integer) As Integer
    If id <= 0 Or id >= gExecTaskGroupCount Then Return 0
    Return gExecTaskGroups(id).used
End Function

' Hedef THREAD/PARALEL rutininin PARAM_DECL'lerini baglar, govdeyi calistirir,
' RETURN degerini (varsa) yakalar. Yalnizca BAGLAMA (arity/tip/BYREF/dizi
' parametre) basarisiz olursa 0 doner (bindErrText dolu) -- bu, cagiranin
' KENDI hatasi sayilir (semantik katman zaten derleme zamaninda yakalamis
' olmali). Govde calisirken olusan HER hata yakalanir, bodyErrText'e yazilir,
' fonksiyon yine de 1 doner -- Mete'nin karari: "yakalanmamis asenkron hata
' gorev nesnesinde tutulur, WAIT/JOIN/RESULT'ta cagirana aktarilir."
Private Function ExecSpawnBindAndRunBody(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal routineIdx As Integer, ByVal callExprIdx As Integer, ByRef resultOut As ExecValue, ByRef hasResultOut As Integer, ByRef bodyErrText As String, ByRef bindErrText As String) As Integer
    Dim routineNodeIdx As Integer
    routineNodeIdx = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nodeIdx
    Dim callName As String
    callName = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nameText

    Dim paramNames(Any) As String
    Dim paramTypes(Any) As String
    Dim paramCount As Integer
    paramCount = 0

    Dim bodyStart As Integer
    bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).firstChild
    Do While bodyStart <> -1
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).kind)) <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Exit Do

        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).op)) = "BYREF" Then
            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN: BYREF parametre asenkron gorevde henuz desteklenmiyor: " & callName
            Return 0
        End If

        If paramCount = 0 Then
            ReDim paramNames(0)
            ReDim paramTypes(0)
        Else
            ReDim Preserve paramNames(paramCount)
            ReDim Preserve paramTypes(paramCount)
        End If

        paramNames(paramCount) = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).value
        paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).typeName))
        If paramTypes(paramCount) = "" Then
            Dim paramTypeChild As Integer
            paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).firstChild
            Do While paramTypeChild <> -1
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).kind)) = "TYPE_REF" Then
                    paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).value))
                    Exit Do
                End If
                paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).nextSibling
            Loop
        End If

        If Len(paramTypes(paramCount)) > 2 AndAlso Right(paramTypes(paramCount), 2) = "[]" Then
            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN: dizi parametreli gorev henuz desteklenmiyor: " & callName
            Return 0
        End If

        paramCount += 1
        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
    Loop

    Do While bodyStart <> -1 And ExecIsRoutineMetadataNode(ps, bodyStart) <> 0
        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
    Loop

    Dim explicitArgCount As Integer
    explicitArgCount = ExecChildCount(ps, callExprIdx)

    If explicitArgCount <> paramCount Then
        bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN cagri argumani uyusmuyor " & callName & " beklenen=" & LTrim(Str(paramCount)) & " gelen=" & LTrim(Str(explicitArgCount))
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim argValues(Any) As ExecValue
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim argValues(paramCount - 1)
    Dim ai As Integer
    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
        Dim argNode As Integer
        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callExprIdx, ai)
        If argNode = -1 Then
            bindErrText = "exec: SPAWN cagri argumani eksik: " & callName
            Return 0
        End If
        If ExecEvalExpression(ps, argNode, es, argValues(ai), bindErrText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Next ai

    Dim boundValues(Any) As ExecValue
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim boundValues(paramCount - 1)
    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
        If ExecApplyDeclaredType(argValues(ai), paramTypes(ai), boundValues(ai), bindErrText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Next ai

    Dim snapshotVars(Any) As ExecVar
    Dim snapshotCount As Integer
    Dim snapshotNextAddr As UInteger
    ExecSnapshotVars es, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr

    If es.runtime.callContextDepth >= 63 Then
        bindErrText = "exec: call stack limit exceeded"
        Return 0
    End If
    es.runtime.callContextDepth += 1
    es.runtime.callFrameBase(es.runtime.callContextDepth) = es.count

    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
        If ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(ai)) < es.runtime.callFrameBase(es.runtime.callContextDepth) Then
            If ExecAppendFrameVar(es, paramNames(ai)) = -1 Then
                bindErrText = "exec: local frame variable capacity exceeded"
                es.runtime.callContextDepth -= 1
                Return 0
            End If
        End If
        ExecSetVarValue es, paramNames(ai), boundValues(ai)
        Dim boundVarIdx As Integer
        boundVarIdx = ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(ai))
        If boundVarIdx <> -1 Then es.vars(boundVarIdx).declType = paramTypes(ai)
    Next ai

    Dim savedReturnValue As Integer
    Dim savedReturnValueEx As ExecValue
    Dim savedReturnHasValue As Integer
    Dim savedRoutineName As String
    Dim savedRoutineNodeIdx As Integer
    savedReturnValue = es.runtime.callReturnValue
    savedReturnValueEx = es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
    savedReturnHasValue = es.runtime.callReturnHasValue
    savedRoutineName = es.runtime.currentRoutineName
    savedRoutineNodeIdx = es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx
    es.runtime.callReturnValue = 0
    ExecValueInit es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
    es.runtime.callReturnHasValue = 0
    es.runtime.currentRoutineName = callName
    es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx = routineNodeIdx

    Dim noByRefFlags(0) As Integer
    Dim noCallerArgNames(0) As String

    Dim bodyRunErr As String
    Dim bodyOk As Integer
    bodyOk = 1
    Dim bodyNode As Integer
    bodyNode = bodyStart
    Do While bodyNode <> -1
        If ExecIsRoutineMetadataNode(ps, bodyNode) <> 0 Then
            bodyNode = ps.ast.nodes(bodyNode).nextSibling
            Continue Do
        End If

        If ExecRunStmt(ps, es, bodyNode, bodyRunErr) = 0 Then
            bodyOk = 0
            Exit Do
        End If

        If es.runtime.exitRequest <> "" Then
            Dim callReq As String
            callReq = UCase(es.runtime.exitRequest)
            If callReq = "RETURN_CALL" Then
                es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
                Exit Do
            End If
            If callReq = "RETURN" Then
                es.runtime.exitRequest = "RETURN_CALL"
                Exit Do
            End If
            ' GOTO/GOSUB/EXIT/END: gorev govdesinden disari sizmamali -- Faz 1'de
            ' bunu bir govde hatasi say (Faz 2'de gercek is parcacigi sinirinda
            ' zaten anlamsiz olacak).
            bodyOk = 0
            bodyRunErr = "exec: SPAWN gorev govdesinde beklenmeyen kontrol akisi: " & es.runtime.exitRequest
            es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
            Exit Do
        End If

        bodyNode = ps.ast.nodes(bodyNode).nextSibling
    Loop

    hasResultOut = 1
    If bodyOk <> 0 Then
        If es.runtime.callReturnHasValue <> 0 Then
            resultOut = es.runtime.callReturnValueEx
            ' S-149: `THREAD Worker(...) AS I32` -- sonuc, FUNCTION donusu gibi
            ' bildirilen tipe cevrilir (TASK OF I32'nin .RESULT'u gercekten I32).
            Dim laneRetNode As Integer
            laneRetNode = ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).firstChild
            Do While laneRetNode <> -1
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).kind)) = "RETURN_TYPE" Then
                    Dim typedResult As ExecValue
                    Dim convErr As String
                    If ExecApplyDeclaredType(resultOut, UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).value)), typedResult, convErr) = 0 Then
                        bodyOk = 0
                        bodyRunErr = convErr
                    Else
                        resultOut = typedResult
                    End If
                    Exit Do
                End If
                laneRetNode = ps.ast.nodes(laneRetNode).nextSibling
            Loop
        Else
            ExecValueInit resultOut
        End If
    Else
        ExecValueInit resultOut
    End If

    es.runtime.callContextDepth -= 1
    es.runtime.callReturnValue = savedReturnValue
    es.runtime.callReturnValueEx = savedReturnValueEx
    es.runtime.callReturnHasValue = savedReturnHasValue
    es.runtime.currentRoutineName = savedRoutineName
    es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx = savedRoutineNodeIdx
    ExecRestoreRoutineVars ps, es, routineNodeIdx, paramNames(), paramCount, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr, noByRefFlags(), 0, noCallerArgNames()

    If bodyOk = 0 Then
        bodyErrText = bodyRunErr
        Return 1
    End If

    bodyErrText = ""
    Return 1
End Function

' SPAWN_EXPR -> TASK tutamaci. Faz 1: govde HEMEN calisir; tutamac DONE/ERROR
' durumunda doner.
Function ExecRunSpawnExpr(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal spawnNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef result As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim callExprIdx As Integer
    callExprIdx = ps.ast.nodes(spawnNodeIdx).left
    If callExprIdx = -1 Then
        errText = "exec: SPAWN gorev cagrisi eksik"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim taskName As String
    taskName = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(callExprIdx).value)
    Dim routineIdx As Integer
    routineIdx = ExecRoutineIndexOf(es, taskName)
    If routineIdx = -1 Then
        errText = "exec: SPAWN hedefi bulunamadi: " & taskName
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim routineKind As String
    routineKind = UCase(Trim(es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).routineKind))
    If routineKind <> "THREAD_STMT" And routineKind <> "PARALEL_STMT" Then
        errText = "exec: SPAWN hedefi THREAD veya PARALEL gorevi olmali: " & taskName
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim handleId As Integer
    handleId = ExecTaskHandleAlloc()
    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).kindText = IIf(routineKind = "THREAD_STMT", "THREAD", "PARALEL")
    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName = taskName
    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING

    Dim bodyResult As ExecValue
    Dim bodyHasResult As Integer
    Dim bodyErrText As String
    Dim bindErrText As String
    If ExecSpawnBindAndRunBody(ps, es, routineIdx, callExprIdx, bodyResult, bodyHasResult, bodyErrText, bindErrText) = 0 Then
        ' Baglama hatasi (arity/tip/BYREF/dizi/yigin siniri) -- cagiranin kendi
        ' hatasi, TASK'a degil SPAWN cagrisinin kendisine mal edilir.
        errText = bindErrText
        Return 0
    End If

    If bodyErrText <> "" Then
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = bodyErrText
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = 0
    Else
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = bodyHasResult
        If bodyHasResult <> 0 Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue = bodyResult
    End If

    ' S-030: TASK, bu koddaki TUM diger opak tutamaclarla (CLASS ornegi adresi,
    ' LIST/DICT/SET tutamaci) AYNI kurali izler -- deger duz bir "INTEGER"
    ' ExecValue'dur (0 = NULL); TASK/TASKGROUP oldugu bilgisi degiskenin KENDI
    ' declType alaninda tutulur (bkz. ExecTaskReceiverInfo). ExecValue'ya ozel
    ' bir "TASK" valueType etiketi eklemek, ExecValueToInteger/ToU64/ToFloat/
    ' ApplyDeclaredType gibi HER genel deger yardimcisina ayri ayri Case
    ' eklemeyi gerektirirdi -- bu, tutarsizlik riskini artiran gereksiz bir
    ' ikinci sinif deger turu olustururdu.
    ExecValueSetInteger result, handleId
    errText = ""
    Return 1
End Function

' Bilesik alici ifadesinin (g(i), F(), s.alan, (ifade) ...) STATIK tipi -- ayni
' tip cikarimi (UXBStep3InferExprType) semantik kapinin `t = g(i)` atamasini
' denetlerken kullandigi fonksiyondur; AST yorumlayicisi bunu zaten calisma
' aninda kullaniyor (bkz. UXBMemoryAddrIsPointer, S-069). Sonuc dugum basina
' bir kez hesaplanip saklanir: CLASS metot zincirleri de bu on-kontrolden
' gectigi icin sicak dongude tekrar tekrar tip cikarimi yapilmaz.
'   memo: 0 = hesaplanmadi, 1 = TASK, 2 = TASKGROUP, 3 = ikisi de degil
Dim Shared gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(Any) As Byte
Dim Shared gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize As Integer

Private Function ExecTaskStaticReceiverKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nodeIdx As Integer) As String
    If gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize <> ps.ast.count Then
        gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize = ps.ast.count
        If gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize > 0 Then ReDim gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(gExecTaskRecvKindMemoSize - 1)
    End If

    If gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 0 Then
        Dim inferredType As String
        Dim inferErr As String
        gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 3
        If UXBStep3InferExprType(ps, nodeIdx, inferredType, inferErr) <> 0 Then
            ' Bazi dallar (ornegin FUNCTION donus tipi) ham bildirim adini
            ' ("TASK") dondurur; karsilastirma kanonik adla yapilir.
            inferredType = UXBStep3TypeCanonical(inferredType)
            If inferredType = TYPE_TASK Then
                gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 1
            ElseIf inferredType = TYPE_TASKGROUP Then
                gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx) = 2
            End If
        End If
    End If

    Select Case gExecTaskRecvKindMemo(nodeIdx)
    Case 1: Return "TASK"
    Case 2: Return "TASKGROUP"
    End Select
    Return ""
End Function

' Alicinin TASK/TASKGROUP turunde olup olmadigini tespit eder ve tutamaci
' okur. Alici ifadesi en fazla BIR kez degerlendirilir (cift-degerlendirme
' YOK -- bkz. S-124); cagiran, 1 donuste aliciyi yeniden degerlendirmez.
'   -1 = alici TASK/TASKGROUP degil (baska bir cozumleyici denesin)
'    0 = TASK/TASKGROUP ama hata olustu (errText dolu)
'    1 = basarili (kindOut="TASK"/"TASKGROUP", handleIdOut = tutamac id, 0=NULL)
Private Function ExecTaskReceiverInfo(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal receiverNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef kindOut As String, ByRef handleIdOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    kindOut = ""
    handleIdOut = 0
    If receiverNodeIdx < 0 Or receiverNodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return -1

    Dim rk As String
    rk = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(receiverNodeIdx).kind))

    If rk = "IDENT" Or rk = "KEYWORD_REF" Then
        Dim receiverName As String
        receiverName = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(receiverNodeIdx).value)
        Dim varIdx As Integer
        varIdx = ExecFindVar(es, receiverName)
        If varIdx = -1 Then Return -1
        Dim declT As String
        declT = UCase(Trim(es.vars(varIdx).declType))
        ' Parametre degiskenleri declType'i PARAM_DECL typeName'inden alir; semantik kapi
        ' onu kanonik "TYPE_TASK" bicimine cevirir (Step3InferNodeDeclaredOrInitializerType).
        If Left(declT, 5) = "TYPE_" Then declT = Mid(declT, 6)
        If declT <> "TASK" And declT <> "TASKGROUP" Then Return -1
        If es.vars(varIdx).isArray <> 0 Then
            errText = "exec: " & declT & " dizisi eleman indeksi olmadan alici olamaz: " & receiverName & " -- " & receiverName & "(i) yazin"
            Return 0
        End If
        kindOut = declT
        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(es.vars(varIdx).value)
        Return 1
    End If

    If rk = "SPAWN_EXPR" Then
        Dim v As ExecValue
        If ExecRunSpawnExpr(ps, es, receiverNodeIdx, v, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        kindOut = "TASK"
        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(v)
        Return 1
    End If

    ' Bilesik alici: dizi elemani g(i), TASK donduren FUNCTION F(), TASK alani
    ' s.gorev, parantezli/kosullu ifade. Tip statik cikarimdan gelir; deger
    ' tek kez degerlendirilir.
    Select Case rk
    Case "CALL_EXPR", "INDEX_EXPR", "FIELD_EXPR", "MEMBER_EXPR", "PAREN_EXPR", "GROUP_EXPR", "EXPR_GROUP", "TERNARY_EXPR"
        Dim staticKind As String
        staticKind = ExecTaskStaticReceiverKind(ps, receiverNodeIdx)
        If staticKind = "" Then Return -1
        Dim recvValue As ExecValue
        If ExecEvalExpression(ps, receiverNodeIdx, es, recvValue, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        kindOut = staticKind
        handleIdOut = ExecValueToInteger(recvValue)
        Return 1
    End Select

    Return -1
End Function

' K6 (Mete, 2026-09-24): ERROR veya CANCELLED bitmis gorevin .RESULT/.JOIN()
' okumasi ve TASKGROUP.JOIN() hatayi cagirana aktarir. 1 = basarisiz bitmis
' (errText dolu), 0 = basarisiz degil.
Private Function ExecTaskFailureText(ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Select Case gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText
    Case UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
        errText = "exec: gorev hatasi (" & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName & "): " & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText
        Return 1
    Case UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
        errText = "exec: gorev iptal edildi (" & gExecTaskHandles(handleId).taskName & "): CANCELLED"
        Return 1
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

' K5 (Mete, 2026-09-24): "Okunmamis gorev hatasi sessiz kaybolmaz: hata cikisina yazilir, cikis
' kodu basarisiz olur." Program sonunda cagrilir. Iptal (CANCELLED) programin kendi istegidir,
' hata sayilmaz; yalniz hic okunmamis ERROR raporlanir. 1 = en az bir okunmamis hata (errText dolu).
Function ExecTaskUnreadErrors(ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    errText = ""
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To gExecTaskHandleCount - 1
        If gExecTaskHandles(i).used = 0 Then Continue For
        If gExecTaskHandles(i).statusText <> UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR Then Continue For
        If gExecTaskHandles(i).errorObserved <> 0 Then Continue For
        If errText <> "" Then errText &= "; "
        errText &= "okunmamis gorev hatasi (" & gExecTaskHandles(i).taskName & "): " & gExecTaskHandles(i).errorText
    Next i
    If errText = "" Then Return 0
    errText = "exec: " & errText
    Return 1
End Function

' TASK/TASKGROUP alan OKUMASI: .STATUS / .RESULT / .ERRORTEXT (FIELD_EXPR).
Private Function ExecReadTaskField(ByRef kindText As String, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef fieldName As String, ByRef valueOut As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim f As String
    f = UCase(Trim(fieldName))

    If kindText <> "TASK" Then
        errText = "exec: TASKGROUP uzerinde alan yok: " & fieldName
        Return 0
    End If

    Select Case f
    Case "STATUS"
        ExecValueInit valueOut
        valueOut.valueType = "STRING"
        If handleId = 0 Then
            valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING  ' hic SPAWN edilmemis (NULL) tutamac
        Else
            valueOut.stringValue = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText
            If valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR Or valueOut.stringValue = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
        End If
        Return 1

    Case "ERRORTEXT"
        ExecValueInit valueOut
        valueOut.valueType = "STRING"
        If handleId = 0 Then
            valueOut.stringValue = ""
        Else
            valueOut.stringValue = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText
            If valueOut.stringValue <> "" Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorObserved = 1
        End If
        Return 1

    Case "RESULT"
        If handleId = 0 Then
            errText = "exec: TASK.RESULT: bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
            Return 0
        End If
        If ExecTaskFailureText(handleId, errText) <> 0 Then Return 0
        If gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult <> 0 Then
            valueOut = gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue
        Else
            ExecValueInit valueOut
        End If
        Return 1
    End Select

    errText = "exec: TASK uzerinde bilinmeyen alan: " & fieldName
    Return 0
End Function

' TASK/TASKGROUP metot CAGRISI: .WAIT()/.JOIN()/.CANCEL() (TASK),
' .ADD()/.JOIN()/.JOINALL() (TASKGROUP) (dotted CALL_EXPR).
Private Function ExecInvokeTaskMember(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef kindText As String, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef methodName As String, ByVal callNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef valueOut As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim m As String
    m = UCase(Trim(methodName))
    ExecValueInit valueOut

    If kindText = "TASK" Then
        Select Case m
        Case "WAIT"
            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.WAIT() arguman almaz"
                Return 0
            End If
            If handleId = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.WAIT(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
                Return 0
            End If
            ' Faz 1: gorev SPAWN aninda zaten bitti (senkron referans uygulama) --
            ' WAIT hemen doner. Faz 2 gercek eszamanlilikta burasi gercekten bloke
            ' edecek; disariya gorunen sozlesme (arguman yok, deger yok) ayni kalir.
            Return 1

        Case "CANCEL"
            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.CANCEL() arguman almaz"
                Return 0
            End If
            If handleId = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.CANCEL(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
                Return 0
            End If
            ' K6: yalniz iptal ISTEGI; tekrar CANCEL zararsiz. Baslamamis (PENDING)
            ' gorev hic calismadan CANCELLED olur, ERRORTEXT = "CANCELLED".
            If gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING Then
                gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
                gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_CANCELLED
            End If
            ' Faz 1: govde SPAWN aninda zaten calisip bittigi icin CANCEL onu asla
            ' PENDING yakalayamaz -- belgelenmis Faz 1 siniri (bkz. dosya basi).
            Return 1

        Case "JOIN"
            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.JOIN() arguman almaz"
                Return 0
            End If
            If handleId = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASK.JOIN(): bos (NULL) gorev tutamaci"
                Return 0
            End If
            Return ExecReadTaskField(kindText, handleId, "RESULT", valueOut, errText)

        Case Else
            errText = "exec: TASK uzerinde bilinmeyen metot: " & methodName
            Return 0
        End Select
    End If

    If kindText = "TASKGROUP" Then
        Select Case m
        Case "ADD"
            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 1 Then
                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(gorev) tam bir arguman ister"
                Return 0
            End If
            If handleId = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci"
                Return 0
            End If
            Dim argNode As Integer
            argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, 0)
            Dim argKind As String
            Dim argHandleId As Integer
            Dim argRv As Integer
            argRv = ExecTaskReceiverInfo(ps, es, argNode, argKind, argHandleId, errText)
            If argRv = 0 Then Return 0
            If argRv < 0 Or argKind <> "TASK" Then
                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.ADD(): arguman bir TASK olmali"
                Return 0
            End If
            Dim ByRef grpRec As ExecTaskGroupRecord = gExecTaskGroups(handleId)
            Dim newCount As Integer
            newCount = grpRec.memberCount
            If newCount = 0 Then
                ReDim grpRec.memberIds(0)
            Else
                ReDim Preserve grpRec.memberIds(newCount)
            End If
            grpRec.memberIds(newCount) = argHandleId
            grpRec.memberCount += 1
            Return 1

        Case "JOIN"
            If ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) <> 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOIN() arguman almaz"
                Return 0
            End If
            If handleId = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOIN(): bos (NULL) grup tutamaci"
                Return 0
            End If
            ' Faz 1: her uye ADD aninda zaten bitmis; ilk HATALI/IPTAL uyeyi
            ' (varsa, EKLENME sirasina gore) cagirana yukselt.
            Dim gi As Integer
            For gi = 0 To gExecTaskGroups(handleId).memberCount - 1
                Dim memberId As Integer
                memberId = gExecTaskGroups(handleId).memberIds(gi)
                If ExecTaskHandleValid(memberId) <> 0 AndAlso ExecTaskFailureText(memberId, errText) <> 0 Then Return 0
            Next gi
            Return 1

        Case "JOINALL"
            errText = "exec: TASKGROUP.JOINALL() henuz desteklenmiyor (Faz 1 siniri) -- TASKGROUP.JOIN() ile bekleyip her uyenin .RESULT alanini okuyun"
            Return 0

        Case Else
            errText = "exec: TASKGROUP uzerinde bilinmeyen metot: " & methodName
            Return 0
        End Select
    End If

    errText = "exec: bilinmeyen tutamac turu: " & kindText
    Return 0
End Function

Function ExecRunMemoryProgram(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Static es As ExecState
    gUxbExecSteps = 0
    ExecBigRuntimeReleaseAll
    ExecStateInit es
    ExecDefFnReset
    gExecAliasResolveDepth = 0
    gActiveRuntimeCtx = @es.runtime
    es.runtime.ffiPolicyEnforce = gFfiDefaultPolicyEnforce
    es.runtime.ffiPolicyPath = gFfiDefaultPolicyPath
    es.runtime.ffiResolverPath = gFfiDefaultResolverPath
    es.runtime.ffiResolverEnforce = gFfiDefaultResolverEnforce
    ExecCollectionsReset
    ExecFieldStringsReset
    ExecSlotsReset es
    ExecDebugConsoleReset
    ExecContractInit es
    ExecStaticFieldReset
    es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
    es.runtime.callContextDepth = 0
    es.runtime.callReturnValue = 0
    es.runtime.callReturnHasValue = 0
    es.runtime.currentRoutineName = ""
    es.runtime.currentRoutineNodeIdx = -1
    es.runtime.execException.active = 0
    es.runtime.execException.kindText = ""
    es.runtime.execException.code = 0
    es.runtime.execException.messageText = ""
    es.runtime.execException.lineNo = 0
    es.runtime.execException.colNo = 0
    es.runtime.execException.routineName = ""
    ExecValueInit es.runtime.execException.value

    If ps.rootNode = -1 Then
        errText = "exec: no AST root"
        ExecNormalizeError errText
        Return 0
    End If

    If ExecInitVirtualMemoryDefaults(errText) = 0 Then Return 0

    Dim labelNames(Any) As String
    Dim labelNodes(Any) As Integer
    Dim labelCount As Integer
    If ExecBuildTopLevelLabelMap(ps, ps.rootNode, labelNames(), labelNodes(), labelCount, errText) = 0 Then
        ExecNormalizeError errText
        UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
        Return 0
    End If

    If ExecBuildTopLevelRoutineMap(ps, es, ps.rootNode, errText) = 0 Then
        ExecNormalizeError errText
        UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
        Return 0
    End If

    ' Ensure runtime vtable map is built so interpreter can resolve handles
    If ExecBuildVTableMap(ps, es, errText) = 0 Then
        ExecNormalizeError errText
        UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
        Return 0
    End If
    Dim callStack(Any) As Integer
    Dim callDepth As Integer

    Dim runGuard As Integer
    runGuard = 0

    Dim st As Integer
    st = ps.ast.nodes(ps.rootNode).firstChild

    Do While st <> -1
        runGuard += 1
        ' S-110: was a fixed 1,000,000 top-level steps (a GOTO loop at top level hit it)
        If UXBStepBudgetTick(errText) = 0 Then
            ExecNormalizeError errText
            UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
            Return 0
        End If

        If ExecRunStmt(ps, es, st, errText) = 0 Then
            ' S-156: ifade icindeki bir cagri (PRINT F() gibi) END calistirdi; cagri, ifadenin
            ' geri kalanini degerlendirmemek icin basarisiz yoldan dondu. Bu bir hata degil, program biter.
            If UCase(es.runtime.exitRequest) = "END" Then
                es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
                errText = ""
                Exit Do
            End If
            ExecNormalizeError errText
            UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
            Return 0
        End If

        If es.runtime.exitRequest <> "" Then
            Dim exitReq As String
            exitReq = UCase(es.runtime.exitRequest)

            If exitReq = "END" Then
                es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
                Exit Do
            End If

            If exitReq = "RETURN" Then
                If callDepth <= 0 Then
                    errText = "exec: RETURN used without GOSUB (" & LTrim(Str(UXB_CTRL_ERR_RETURN_WITHOUT_GOSUB)) & ")"
                    ExecNormalizeError errText
                    UxbFileCloseAll es.fileIo
                    Return 0
                End If

                callDepth -= 1
                st = callStack(callDepth)
                es.runtime.exitRequest = ""
                Continue Do
            ElseIf Left(exitReq, 5) = "GOTO:" Then
                Dim gotoTarget As String
                gotoTarget = Trim(Mid(es.runtime.exitRequest, 6))

                Dim gotoIdx As Integer
                gotoIdx = ExecLabelIndexOf(labelNames(), labelCount, gotoTarget)

' SPAWN_EXPR -> TASK tutamaci. Faz 1: govde HEMEN calisir; tutamac DONE/ERROR
' durumunda doner.
Function ExecRunSpawnExpr(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal spawnNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef result As ExecValue, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
input.new_string:
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
' S-146 Model D: AST referans uygulamasinin kilit tablosu (MIR yorumlayicisiyla ayni
' kurallar ve iletiler; bkz. src/interpreter/mir/mir_interp_task.fbs). Sahip GOREVDIR
' (anahtar: ana program 0, gorev = tutamac kimligi). Acik LOCK tutulurken yapilan SPAWN
' ertelenir; kilit sayisi sifira inince, gorevin WAIT/JOIN/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN'inde ya
' da program sonunda calisir. Otomatik deyim kilidi tek is parcacikta cakisamaz (islem yok).
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Declare Function UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal targetNode As Integer) As Integer
Declare Function UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(ByVal nameRaw As String) As Integer

Dim Shared gExecLkIds(Any) As LongInt
Dim Shared gExecLkOwner(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gExecLkName(Any) As String
Dim Shared gExecLkCount As Integer
Dim Shared gExecLkHeldTotal As Integer
Dim Shared gExecLkStackKey(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gExecLkStackIds(Any) As String
Dim Shared gExecLkStackCount As Integer
Dim Shared gExecCurrentTaskKey As Integer
Dim Shared gExecMutexNext As LongInt
Dim Shared gExecDefPrep(Any) As ExecSpawnPrepared
Dim Shared gExecDefHandle(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gExecDefDone(Any) As Integer
Dim Shared gExecDefCount As Integer

Sub ExecSyncReset()
    gExecLkCount = 0
    gExecLkHeldTotal = 0
    gExecLkStackCount = 0
    gExecCurrentTaskKey = 0
    gExecMutexNext = 0
    gExecDefCount = 0
    Erase gExecLkIds, gExecLkOwner, gExecLkName, gExecLkStackKey, gExecLkStackIds
    Erase gExecDefPrep, gExecDefHandle, gExecDefDone
End Sub

' Olumcul kilit tanisi: gorev hatasi olarak tutulmaz, TRY ile yakalanmaz.
Function ExecIsLockFatal(ByRef textValue As String) As Integer
    If InStr(textValue, "SELF_DEADLOCK:") > 0 Or InStr(textValue, "LOCK_DEADLOCK:") > 0 Then Return 1
    Return 0
End Function

Function ExecMutexNew() As LongInt
    gExecMutexNext += 1
    Return (1LL Shl 32) + gExecMutexNext
End Function

Private Function ExecLockRecord(ByVal id As LongInt, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To gExecLkCount - 1
        If gExecLkIds(i) = id Then
            If gExecLkName(i) = "" Then gExecLkName(i) = nameText
            Return i
        End If
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gExecLkIds(gExecLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gExecLkOwner(gExecLkCount)
    ReDim Preserve gExecLkName(gExecLkCount)
    gExecLkIds(gExecLkCount) = id
    gExecLkOwner(gExecLkCount) = -1
    gExecLkName(gExecLkCount) = nameText
    gExecLkCount += 1
    Return gExecLkCount - 1
End Function

Private Function ExecLockLabel(ByVal rec As Integer) As String
    If gExecLkName(rec) <> "" Then Return "'" & gExecLkName(rec) & "'"
    Return "MUTEX #" & LTrim(Str(gExecLkIds(rec) - (1LL Shl 32)))
End Function

Private Sub ExecLockReleaseIds(ByVal idsCsv As String)
    Dim s As String = idsCsv & ","
    Dim p As Integer = 1
    Do While p < Len(s)
        Dim q As Integer = InStr(p, s, ",")
        If q = 0 Then Exit Do
        Dim part As String = Trim(Mid(s, p, q - p))
        If part <> "" Then
            Dim id As LongInt = ValLng(part)
            Dim i As Integer
            For i = 0 To gExecLkCount - 1
                If gExecLkIds(i) = id AndAlso gExecLkOwner(i) <> -1 Then
                    gExecLkOwner(i) = -1
                    gExecLkHeldTotal -= 1
                    Exit For
                End If
            Next i
        End If
        p = q + 1
    Loop
End Sub

Private Sub ExecLockPopEntry(ByVal entryIdx As Integer)
    ExecLockReleaseIds gExecLkStackIds(entryIdx)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = entryIdx To gExecLkStackCount - 2
        gExecLkStackKey(i) = gExecLkStackKey(i + 1)
        gExecLkStackIds(i) = gExecLkStackIds(i + 1)
    Next i
    gExecLkStackCount -= 1
End Sub

Private Sub ExecLockReleaseKeyAll(ByVal key As Integer)
    Dim i As Integer = gExecLkStackCount - 1
    Do While i >= 0
        If gExecLkStackKey(i) = key Then ExecLockPopEntry i
        i -= 1
    Loop
End Sub

Declare Function ExecTaskDrainDeferred(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer

' Hazirlanmis gorevi handleId tutamacina calistirir (anahtar = handleId). 0 = olumcul kilit hatasi.
Private Function ExecTaskRunPreparedInto(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef prep As ExecSpawnPrepared, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING
    Dim prevKey As Integer = gExecCurrentTaskKey
    gExecCurrentTaskKey = handleId
    Dim bodyResult As ExecValue
    Dim bodyHasResult As Integer
    Dim bodyErrText As String
    Dim bindErrText As String
    Dim ok As Integer = ExecSpawnRunPrepared(ps, es, prep, bodyResult, bodyHasResult, bodyErrText, bindErrText)
    ' Gorev biterken (normal ya da hatayla) hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir.
    ExecLockReleaseKeyAll handleId
    gExecCurrentTaskKey = prevKey
    If ok = 0 Then
        errText = bindErrText
        Return 0
    End If
    If bodyErrText <> "" AndAlso ExecIsLockFatal(bodyErrText) <> 0 Then
        errText = bodyErrText
        Return 0
    End If
    If bodyErrText <> "" Then
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = bodyErrText
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = 0
    Else
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = bodyHasResult
        If bodyHasResult <> 0 Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue = bodyResult
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' Ertelenmis (baslamamis) gorevi simdi calistirir. 0 = olumcul hata (errText dolu).
Function ExecTaskRunIfDeferred(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim d As Integer
    For d = 0 To gExecDefCount - 1
        If gExecDefHandle(d) <> handleId Or gExecDefDone(d) <> 0 Then Continue For
        gExecDefDone(d) = 1
        If gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText <> UXB_TASK_STATUS_PENDING Then Return 1   ' K6: baslamadan iptal
        Return ExecTaskRunPreparedInto(ps, es, gExecDefPrep(d), handleId, errText)
    Next d
    Return 1
End Function

Function ExecTaskDrainDeferred(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim d As Integer = 0
    Do While d < gExecDefCount
        If gExecDefDone(d) = 0 Then
            If ExecTaskRunIfDeferred(ps, es, gExecDefHandle(d), errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        End If
        d += 1
    Loop
    Return 1
End Function

' Program sonu (K5): ana programin kalan acik kilitleri birakilir, ertelenmis gorevler calisir.
Function ExecTaskFinishProgram(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    ExecLockReleaseKeyAll 0
    Return ExecTaskDrainDeferred(ps, es, errText)
End Function

' LOCK a, b ... END LOCK
Function ExecRunLockStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim ids(Any) As LongInt
    Dim names(Any) As String
    Dim cnt As Integer = 0
    Dim bodyStart As Integer = 0
    Dim total As Integer = ExecChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    Dim p As Integer
    For p = 0 To total - 1
        Dim ch As Integer = ExecChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, p)
        If ch = -1 Then Exit For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).kind)) <> "LOCK_TARGET" Then Exit For
        bodyStart = p + 1
        Dim nm As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ch).value))
        Dim id As LongInt
        Select Case UXBTaskLockTargetKind(ps, ch)
        Case 1
            id = UXBTaskSyncLockOrder(nm)
        Case 2
            Dim mv As ExecValue
            If ExecGetVarValue(es, nm, mv) = 0 Then
                errText = "exec: LOCK: MUTEX degiskeni okunamadi: " & nm
                Return 0
            End If
            id = ExecValueToInteger(mv)
            nm = ""
        Case Else
            errText = "exec: LOCK hedefi cozulemedi: " & nm
            Return 0
        End Select
        ReDim Preserve ids(cnt)
        ReDim Preserve names(cnt)
        ids(cnt) = id
        names(cnt) = nm
        cnt += 1
    Next p
    ' lockOrderId sirasi + tekillestirme.
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    For i = 1 To cnt - 1
        Dim ki As LongInt = ids(i)
        Dim kn As String = names(i)
        j = i - 1
        Do While j >= 0 AndAlso ids(j) > ki
            ids(j + 1) = ids(j)
            names(j + 1) = names(j)
            j -= 1
        Loop
        ids(j + 1) = ki
        names(j + 1) = kn
    Next i
    Dim w As Integer = 0
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        If w > 0 AndAlso ids(w - 1) = ids(i) Then Continue For
        ids(w) = ids(i)
        names(w) = names(i)
        w += 1
    Next i
    cnt = w

    Dim key As Integer = gExecCurrentTaskKey
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec As Integer = ExecLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        If gExecLkOwner(rec) = key Then
            errText = "SELF_DEADLOCK: " & ExecLockLabel(rec) & " bu gorev tarafindan zaten LOCK ile tutuluyor; ayni kilidi ikinci kez LOCK etmek kendini kilitler"
            Return 0
        End If
        If gExecLkOwner(rec) <> -1 Then
            errText = "LOCK_DEADLOCK: " & ExecLockLabel(rec) & " kilidini tutan gorev, bu gorevin bitmesini bekliyor (LOCK icinde JOIN/WAIT ile karsilikli bekleme)"
            Return 0
        End If
    Next i
    Dim taken As String = ""
    For i = 0 To cnt - 1
        Dim rec2 As Integer = ExecLockRecord(ids(i), names(i))
        gExecLkOwner(rec2) = key
        gExecLkHeldTotal += 1
        If taken <> "" Then taken &= ","
        taken &= LTrim(Str(ids(i)))
    Next i
    ReDim Preserve gExecLkStackKey(gExecLkStackCount)
    ReDim Preserve gExecLkStackIds(gExecLkStackCount)
    gExecLkStackKey(gExecLkStackCount) = key
    gExecLkStackIds(gExecLkStackCount) = taken
    Dim myEntry As Integer = gExecLkStackCount
    gExecLkStackCount += 1

    ' Govde: her cikis yolunda (normal, RETURN/EXIT/GOTO istegi, hata/THROW) kilit birakilir.
    Dim bodyOk As Integer = 1
    For p = bodyStart To total - 1
        Dim bodyStmt As Integer = ExecChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, p)
        If bodyStmt = -1 Then Exit For
        If ExecRunStmt(ps, es, bodyStmt, errText) = 0 Then bodyOk = 0: Exit For
        If es.runtime.exitRequest <> "" Then Exit For
    Next p
    If myEntry < gExecLkStackCount AndAlso gExecLkStackKey(myEntry) = key Then ExecLockPopEntry myEntry
    If bodyOk = 0 Then Return 0
    If gExecLkHeldTotal = 0 Then
        If ExecTaskDrainDeferred(ps, es, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

' UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE: yalniz semantik guvenceleri kaldirir; govde normal calisir.
Function ExecRunUnsafeStmt(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal stmtIdx As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim total As Integer = ExecChildCount(ps, stmtIdx)
    Dim p As Integer
    For p = 0 To total - 1
        Dim bodyStmt As Integer = ExecChildAt(ps, stmtIdx, p)
        If bodyStmt = -1 Then Exit For
        If ExecRunStmt(ps, es, bodyStmt, errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        If es.runtime.exitRequest <> "" Then Exit For
    Next p
    Return 1
End Function

' Hazirlanmis gorevi handleId tutamacina calistirir (anahtar = handleId). 0 = olumcul kilit hatasi.
Private Function ExecTaskRunPreparedInto(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef prep As ExecSpawnPrepared, ByVal handleId As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_RUNNING
    Dim prevKey As Integer = gExecCurrentTaskKey
    gExecCurrentTaskKey = handleId
    Dim bodyResult As ExecValue
    Dim bodyHasResult As Integer
    Dim bodyErrText As String
    Dim bindErrText As String
    Dim ok As Integer = ExecSpawnRunPrepared(ps, es, prep, bodyResult, bodyHasResult, bodyErrText, bindErrText)
    ' Gorev biterken (normal ya da hatayla) hala tuttugu acik kilitler birakilir.
    ExecLockReleaseKeyAll handleId
    gExecCurrentTaskKey = prevKey
    If ok = 0 Then
        errText = bindErrText
        Return 0
    End If
    If bodyErrText <> "" AndAlso ExecIsLockFatal(bodyErrText) <> 0 Then
        errText = bodyErrText
        Return 0
    End If
    If bodyErrText <> "" Then
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_ERROR
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).errorText = bodyErrText
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = 0
    Else
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).statusText = UXB_TASK_STATUS_DONE
        gExecTaskHandles(handleId).hasResult = bodyHasResult
        If bodyHasResult <> 0 Then gExecTaskHandles(handleId).resultValue = bodyResult
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

    Dim d As Integer

    Next d
