(metot, `x = x ± c`, x'i okumayan ifadeyle yazım) hiç kilitlenmez; tek bir karmaşık yazım (`x = x * 2 + 5`) ya da o
değişkene açık LOCK varsa değişkenin tüm erişimleri deyim kilidine geçer (karışık erişimde kayıp güncelleme olmaz).

**6. UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE.** Yalnız o bölgede ham bellek / sözleşmesiz FFI etkisini görev denetiminden çıkarır ve
paylaşılan global için VARPTR'a izin verir; otomatik senkron bölge içinde de geçerlidir.

**7. Yorumlayıcılarda zamanlama.** AST ve MIR yorumlayıcıları görevi SPAWN anında çalıştırır; açık LOCK tutulurken
yapılan SPAWN ertelenir (kilit sayısı sıfıra inince, JOIN/WAIT/RESULT/TASKGROUP.JOIN'de ya da program sonunda
çalışır). Bu, native zamanlamasının geçerli bir örneğidir; görevler arası çıktı sırası dil garantisi değildir.

**8. Henüz uygulanmamış adıma dokunan program** "henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim N" tanısı alır: TASK/TASKGROUP
tipli paylaşılan global ve TASK/MUTEX argümanı (adım 3), paylaşılan globalin BYREF'e ya da bütün dizi olarak çağrıya
verilmesi ve LOCK'ta yerel hedef (adım 4), CLASS nesnesi / sınıf STATIC alanı / iş parçacığı sözleşmesi olmayan
kütüphane tipi globali ve CLASS/LIST argümanları, TASK OF LIST (adım 5), UNSAFE dışında PTR / VARPTR(paylaşılan
global) (adım 7), RND/dosya/konsol/INPUT/SHELL görevde (adım 2). LIST/DICT/SET globalleri serbesttir (çalışma zamanı
koleksiyon tablosu kilitli + deyim kilidi).

**Bu çalışmada bulunan, önceden var olan hatalar:** S-160 (THROW rutin sınırını geçmiyordu — düzeltiliyor), S-161
(ifadede global okuma ile o globali değiştiren çağrının sırası AST'de farklı — karar bekliyor), S-162 (NAMESPACE
değişkenleri AST/native'de çalışmıyor).

------------  §12 MODEL D — 2. ADIM UYGULAMA NOTU (Claude 1, 2026-09-26)  ------------

**Durum:** 2. adım (görev başına RND, iş parçacığı güvenli dosya tablosu, konsol kilidi + `LOCK CONSOLE`, SHELL)
uygulandı. Görevde RND/RANDOMIZE, OPEN/PRINT #/INPUT #/CLOSE, PRINT/INPUT/CLS/COLOR/LOCATE ve SHELL artık serbest
(eski "henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 2" tanısı kalktı). Testler: `tests/task_sync` (92/92), `tests/task_model` iso_task_*.

- **RND (S-163 ile birlikte):** tek ortak üreteç (xoshiro256**, SplitMix64 tohumlama) AST, MIR ve native'de birebir aynı;
  `RND` [0,1) F64; `RND(0)` son değer; `RND(x<0)` x ile yeniden tohum; `RANDOMIZE n` / `RANDOMIZE` (zaman). Her görev
  SPAWN anında atasının sıradaki 64 bitlik değeriyle tohumlanır → aynı program her motorda aynı sayıları üretir.
- **Dosya tablosu:** native tablo kilitli; `PRINT #` satırı iş parçacığına özel tamponda birleşip dosyaya tek kilitle
  yazılır (görevlerin satırları karışmaz). Aynı kanal numarasını iki görevin aynı anda kullanması programcının
  sorumluluğudur (kanal bir kaynaktır; gerekirse MUTEX).
- **Konsol:** PRINT satırı zaten bölünmez (K9). `LOCK CONSOLE ... END LOCK` birden çok konsol deyimini bölünmez yapar;
  program LOCK CONSOLE kullanıyorsa ve görev içeriyorsa tüm konsol deyimleri (PRINT, INPUT, CLS, COLOR, LOCATE...)
  otomatik olarak konsol kilidine girer (kimlik: tüm globallerden sonra). Kullanmıyorsa ek maliyet yok. LOCK CONSOLE
  tutarken konsola yazan görevi JOIN etmek LOCK_DEADLOCK; iç içe LOCK CONSOLE SELF_DEADLOCK.
- **Kilit alımı (1. adıma düzeltme):** bir deyimin ya da LOCK satırının kilitlerinden biri doluysa o çağrıda alınanlar
  bırakılır, dolu olan beklenir, baştan denenir ("ya hepsi ya hiçbiri"). Böylece `LOCK y` içinde `x`'e dokunan görev
  ile tek deyimde `x` ve `y`'ye dokunan görev kilitlenmez; kilitlenme tanısı yalnız programcının tutarsız sırayla iç
  içe açık LOCK kullandığı gerçek durumda verilir.

------------  §13 MODEL D — 3. ADIM UYGULAMA NOTU (Claude 1, 2026-09-26)  ------------

TASK/TASKGROUP/MUTEX tutamaçları görevler arasında geçer: SPAWN argümanı ve parametresi olabilir (`THREAD Tuket(t AS
TASK OF I64)`), paylaşılan global olabilir (erişim otomatik kilitli; değer bir kimliktir, çalışma zamanı tabloları iş
parçacığı güvenlidir). Sonuç tipi kuralı değişmedi (`TASK OF TASK` S-149 gereği reddedilir).
Bekleme çevrimi (A, B'yi; B, A'yı JOIN/WAIT/RESULT ile bekler; görev kendi tutamacını bekler) her motorda ölümcül
`TASK_WAIT_CYCLE: gorevler birbirini bekliyor (A.JOIN <-> B.JOIN)` tanısıdır: native'de bekleme grafiği (görev → beklenen
görev / kilit sahibi) çevrimi; yorumlayıcılarda beklenen görev hâlâ RUNNING ise (tek iş parçacığında bu, çağrı
yığınında bekleyen bir atadır). Test: `tests/task_sync/neg_task_wait_cycle` (MUTEX ile her motorda belirlenimci).

        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind)) <> "SPAWN_EXPR" Then Continue For
        Dim callIdx As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).left
        If callIdx = -1 Then Continue For
        Dim targetName As String = Trim(ps.ast.nodes(callIdx).value)
        Dim target As Integer = StiFindSpawnTarget(ps, targetName)
        If target = -1 Then Continue For   ' SemValidateSpawnCalls zaten reddetti

        Dim argNo As Integer = 0
        Dim a As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(callIdx).firstChild
        Do While a <> -1
            argNo += 1
            Dim argType As String
            Dim argErr As String
            If UXBStep3InferExprType(ps, a, argType, argErr) = 0 Then argType = ""
            If StiTypeArgTransferable(argType) = 0 Then
                errText = "semantic: SPAWN " & targetName & ": " & LTrim(Str(argNo)) & ". arguman tipi " & StiTypeLabel(argType) & " gorev sinirindan gecemiyor -- " & StiTypeStepText(argType)
                Return 0
            End If
            a = ps.ast.nodes(a).nextSibling
        Loop

        Dim pc As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(target).firstChild
        Do While pc <> -1
            Dim pk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(pc).kind))
            If pk = "PARAM_DECL" Then
                Dim pType As String = StiTypeRefOf(ps, pc)
                If StiTypeArgTransferable(pType) = 0 Then
                    errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & ": parametre '" & Trim(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) & "' tipi " & StiTypeLabel(pType) & " gorev sinirindan gecemiyor -- " & StiTypeStepText(pType)
                    Return 0
                End If
            ElseIf pk = "RETURN_TYPE" Then
                If StiTypeTransferable(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) = 0 Then
                    errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & ": sonuc tipi " & StiTypeLabel(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value) & " gorev sinirindan gecemiyor -- " & StiTypeStepText(ps.ast.nodes(pc).value)
                    Return 0
                End If
            End If
            pc = ps.ast.nodes(pc).nextSibling
        Loop

        If gStiEff(target) <> 0 Then
            errText = "semantic: SPAWN hedefi " & StiRoutineTitle(ps, target) & " gorev sinirini asiyor: " & Trim(ps.ast.nodes(target).value) & ": " & gStiReason(target) & " (" & StiRuleText(gStiReasonBit(target)) & ")"
            Return 0
        End If
    Next i

    ' Senkron global icin henuz uygulanmamis adimlar (sessiz yaris yerine acik tani).
    For i = 0 To n - 1
        Dim dk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        ' Ham adres kilidi atlar: UNSAFE disinda VARPTR(ortak global) adim 7'ye aittir.
        If dk = "CALL_EXPR" AndAlso ps.ast.nodes(i).left = -1 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) = "VARPTR" Then
            Dim vpArg As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).firstChild
            If vpArg <> -1 Then
                Dim vpk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(vpArg).kind))
                Dim vpName As String = ""
                If vpk = "IDENT" Or vpk = "IDENTIFIER" Then vpName = ps.ast.nodes(vpArg).value
                If vpk = "CALL_EXPR" Or vpk = "INDEX_EXPR" Then vpName = ps.ast.nodes(vpArg).value
                If vpName <> "" AndAlso StiSetHas(gStiSyncGlobals, vpName) <> 0 AndAlso StiInsideUnsafe(ps, i) = 0 AndAlso UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, StiFindDeclAny(ps, vpName, i)) = -1 Then
                    errText = "semantic: gorevlerle paylasilan global '" & UCase(Trim(vpName)) & "' icin VARPTR -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 7 (isaretci/MemoryRef paylasimi); ham adresle erisim sorumlulugu UNSAFE ... END UNSAFE ile alinabilir -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
                    Return 0
                End If
            End If
        End If
        If dk = "DIM_DECL" AndAlso gStiRoutineOf(i) = -1 AndAlso StiSetHas(gStiSyncGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(i).value) <> 0 Then
            Dim gType As String = StiTypeRefOf(ps, i)
            ' S-146 adim 3: TASK/TASKGROUP tutamaci globali gorevler arasi paylasilabilir (deger = kimlik;
            ' erisim otomatik kilitli). Bekleme cevrimi calisma zamaninda TASK_WAIT_CYCLE tanisidir.
            ' LIST/DICT/SET: calisma zamani koleksiyon tablosu kilitli + deyim kilidi -> paylasim guvenli.
            ' Kullanici CLASS/INTERFACE nesnesi ve is parcacigi sozlesmesi (threadSafety) henuz olmayan
            ' kutuphane tipi adim 5'e aittir.
            Dim gUp As String = UCase(Trim(gType))
            Dim isCollection As Integer = IIf(gUp = "LIST" Or gUp = "DICT" Or gUp = "SET", 1, 0)
            If StiFindClassNode(ps, gType) <> -1 Or UXBLibraryTypeRegistryFind(gType) >= 0 Or (UXBStep3TypeCanonical(gType) = TYPE_OBJECT AndAlso isCollection = 0) Then
                errText = "semantic: global '" & UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) & "' (" & gType & ") gorevlerle paylasiliyor -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 5 (CLASS nesnesinin gorevler arasi paylasimi: nesne basina kilit / SHARE sozlesmesi) -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
                Return 0
            End If
        End If

        If (dk = "CALL_EXPR" Or dk = "CALL_STMT") AndAlso ps.ast.nodes(i).left = -1 Then
            Dim calleeName As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value))
            Dim ri As Integer
            For ri = 0 To n - 1
                Dim rk As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ri).kind))
                If rk <> "SUB_STMT" And rk <> "FUNCTION_STMT" Then Continue For
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(ri).value)) <> calleeName Then Continue For
                Dim prm As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(ri).firstChild
                Dim arg As Integer = ps.ast.nodes(i).firstChild
                Do While prm <> -1 And arg <> -1
                    If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(prm).kind)) <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Exit Do
                    Dim ak As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(arg).kind))
                    If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(prm).op)) = "BYREF" AndAlso (ak = "IDENT" Or ak = "IDENTIFIER") AndAlso StiSetHas(gStiSyncGlobals, ps.ast.nodes(arg).value) <> 0 Then
                        errText = "semantic: gorevlerle paylasilan global '" & UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(arg).value)) & "' BYREF parametreye (" & calleeName & "." & Trim(ps.ast.nodes(prm).value) & ") veriliyor -- henuz uygulanmadi: S-146 adim 4 (BYREF omur/paylasim) -- satir " & LTrim(Str(ps.ast.nodes(i).lineNo))
                        Return 0
                    End If
                    prm = ps.ast.nodes(prm).nextSibling
                    arg = ps.ast.nodes(arg).nextSibling
                Loop
                Exit For
            Next ri
        End If
    Next i
    Return 1
End Function

' `name` icin DIM/PARAM bildirimi: ayni rutindeki once, yoksa program geneli. Bulunamazsa -1.
Function StiFindDeclAny(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal nameRaw As String, ByVal useNodeIdx As Integer) As Integer
    Dim wanted As String = UCase(Trim(nameRaw))
    If wanted = "" Then Return -1
    Dim useRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, useNodeIdx)
    Dim fallback As Integer = -1
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To ps.ast.count - 1
        Dim k As String = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).kind))
        If k <> "DIM_DECL" And k <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Continue For
        If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(i).value)) <> wanted Then Continue For
        Dim declRoutine As Integer = UXBTaskEnclosingRoutine(ps, i)
        If declRoutine = useRoutine Then Return i
        If declRoutine = -1 And fallback = -1 Then fallback = i
    Next i
    Return fallback
End Function

' BYREF-aware: byRefFlags(i)<>0 and callerArgNames(i)<>"" together mean parameter
' paramNames(i) is BYREF and was called with a plain variable argument -- that
' variable's caller-side value is overwritten with the parameter's final value once
' the routine's own (snapshotted) scope is restored. Pass byRefArgCount=0 (with any
' same-named dummy arrays) from call sites that have no BYREF/caller-argument
' information available (e.g. the prepared-args calling convention, which has no
' original call-site AST to inspect). This is a copy-in/copy-out implementation of
' BYREF (the callee gets its own ordinary local, and its last value is written back
' to the caller's variable at return) rather than true pointer aliasing --
' observably identical for single-threaded, non-reentrant calls, and far simpler to
' keep consistent with this interpreter's snapshot/restore scoping model.
Private Sub ExecRestoreRoutineVars(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal routineNodeIdx As Integer, paramNames() As String, ByVal paramCount As Integer, snapshotVars() As ExecVar, ByVal snapshotCount As Integer, ByVal snapshotNextAddr As UInteger, byRefFlags() As Integer, ByVal byRefArgCount As Integer, callerArgNames() As String)
    Dim callerWrites(Any) As ExecVar
    Dim writeFlags(Any) As Integer
    If snapshotCount > 0 Then
        ReDim callerWrites(snapshotCount - 1)
        ReDim writeFlags(snapshotCount - 1)
    End If

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To snapshotCount - 1
        If ExecRoutineNameIsLocal(ps, routineNodeIdx, snapshotVars(i).nameText, paramNames(), paramCount) = 0 Then
            Dim currentIdx As Integer = ExecFindVar(es, snapshotVars(i).nameText)
            If currentIdx >= 0 Then
                callerWrites(i) = es.vars(currentIdx)
                writeFlags(i) = 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' Capture each BYREF parameter's final value (in the about-to-be-discarded callee
    ' scope) before the snapshot restore below wipes it out.
    Dim byRefFinalValues(Any) As ExecValue
    Dim byRefHasValue(Any) As Integer
    If byRefArgCount > 0 Then
        ReDim byRefFinalValues(byRefArgCount - 1)
        ReDim byRefHasValue(byRefArgCount - 1)
        For i = 0 To byRefArgCount - 1
            If byRefFlags(i) <> 0 And Trim(callerArgNames(i)) <> "" Then
                Dim paramVarIdx As Integer = ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(i))
                If paramVarIdx >= 0 Then
                    byRefFinalValues(i) = es.vars(paramVarIdx).value
                    byRefHasValue(i) = 1
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If

    ExecRestoreVars es, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr
    For i = 0 To snapshotCount - 1
        If writeFlags(i) <> 0 Then
            Dim restoredIdx As Integer = ExecFindVar(es, snapshotVars(i).nameText)
            If restoredIdx >= 0 Then
                es.vars(restoredIdx).value = callerWrites(i).value
                If es.vars(restoredIdx).pinned <> 0 Then ExecVarPinStore es, restoredIdx
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' Now that the caller's scope is back, write each BYREF parameter's final value
    ' into the caller's own variable.
    For i = 0 To byRefArgCount - 1
        If byRefHasValue(i) <> 0 Then
            ExecSetVarValue es, callerArgNames(i), byRefFinalValues(i)
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Private Function ExecInvokeRoutineByIndexOffset(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal routineIdx As Integer, ByVal callNodeIdx As Integer, ByVal firstExplicitArg As Integer, ByVal expectValue As Integer, ByVal prependReceiver As Integer, ByVal receiverAddr As Integer, ByRef valueOut As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    Dim routineNodeIdx As Integer
    Dim routineKind As String
    routineNodeIdx = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nodeIdx
    routineKind = UCase(Trim(es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).routineKind))

    Dim callName As String
    callName = es.runtime.routineDefs(routineIdx).nameText

    Dim isClassRoutine As Integer
    isClassRoutine = IIf(routineKind = "CLASS_METHOD_DECL" Or routineKind = "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL" Or routineKind = "CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_DECL" Or routineKind = "CLASS_DESTRUCTOR_DECL", 1, 0)

    Dim hasReturnValue As Integer
    hasReturnValue = IIf(routineKind = "FUNCTION_STMT" Or routineKind = "PIPE_STMT", 1, 0)
    If (routineKind = "CLASS_METHOD_DECL" Or routineKind = "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL") And ExecRoutineNodeHasReturnType(ps, routineNodeIdx) <> 0 Then hasReturnValue = 1

    If expectValue <> 0 And hasReturnValue = 0 Then
        errText = "exec: call in expression requires FUNCTION " & callName & " (function-like routine)"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim paramNames(Any) As String
    Dim paramTypes(Any) As String
    Dim paramByRef(Any) As Integer
    Dim paramCount As Integer

    Dim bodyStart As Integer
    bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).firstChild
    Do While bodyStart <> -1
        Dim childKind As String
        childKind = UCase(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).kind)
        If childKind <> "PARAM_DECL" Then Exit Do

        If paramCount = 0 Then
            ReDim paramNames(0)
            ReDim paramTypes(0)
            ReDim paramByRef(0)
        Else
            ReDim Preserve paramNames(paramCount)
            ReDim Preserve paramTypes(paramCount)
            ReDim Preserve paramByRef(paramCount)
        End If

        paramByRef(paramCount) = IIf(UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).op)) = "BYREF", 1, 0)
        paramNames(paramCount) = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).value
        paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).typeName))
        If paramTypes(paramCount) = "" Then
            Dim paramTypeChild As Integer
            paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).firstChild
            Do While paramTypeChild <> -1
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).kind)) = "TYPE_REF" Then
                    paramTypes(paramCount) = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).value))
                    Exit Do
                End If
                paramTypeChild = ps.ast.nodes(paramTypeChild).nextSibling
            Loop
        End If
        paramCount += 1
        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
    Loop

    Do While bodyStart <> -1 And ExecIsRoutineMetadataNode(ps, bodyStart) <> 0
        bodyStart = ps.ast.nodes(bodyStart).nextSibling
    Loop

    Dim explicitArgCount As Integer
    If callNodeIdx = -1 Then
        explicitArgCount = 0
    Else
        explicitArgCount = ExecChildCount(ps, callNodeIdx) - firstExplicitArg
        If explicitArgCount < 0 Then explicitArgCount = 0
    End If

    Dim actualCount As Integer
    actualCount = explicitArgCount
    If prependReceiver <> 0 And isClassRoutine = 0 Then actualCount += 1

    Dim legacyTaskPayload As Integer
    legacyTaskPayload = 0
    If paramCount = 0 And actualCount = 1 Then
        Select Case routineKind
        Case "EVENT_STMT", "PIPE_STMT", "THREAD_STMT", "PARALEL_STMT"
            legacyTaskPayload = 1
        End Select
    End If

    If actualCount <> paramCount And legacyTaskPayload = 0 Then
        errText = "exec: call arity mismatch " & callName & " expected=" & LTrim(Str(paramCount)) & " actual=" & LTrim(Str(actualCount))
        Return 0
    End If

    ' ABI10_TYPED_USER_ARG_FIX_20260706:
    ' User FUNCTION/SUB calls must preserve typed runtime values.  The old
    ' ExecEvalNode path coerced every argument to Integer before binding it to
    ' PARAM_DECL variables.  That broke wrappers such as ABI10_Mix8(1.5,...)
    ' and ABI10_PointCreate(2.25,5.25), because the downstream CALL(DLL)
    ' bridge saw integer parameters instead of F64 values.
    Dim argValues(Any) As ExecValue
    If actualCount > 0 Then ReDim argValues(actualCount - 1)
    Dim arrayArgVarIdx(Any) As Integer
    If paramCount > 0 Then
        ReDim arrayArgVarIdx(paramCount - 1)
        Dim initArrayArgIdx As Integer
        For initArrayArgIdx = 0 To paramCount - 1
            arrayArgVarIdx(initArrayArgIdx) = -1
        Next initArrayArgIdx
    End If

    Dim writePos As Integer
    writePos = 0
    If prependReceiver <> 0 And isClassRoutine = 0 Then
        ExecValueSetInteger argValues(0), receiverAddr
        writePos = 1
    End If

    ' BYREF: for each argument that binds to a BYREF parameter and is itself a plain
    ' variable reference at the call site, remember the caller's variable name so its
    ' final value can be written back after the routine returns (see
    ' ExecRestoreRoutineVars). Arguments that aren't a simple variable (a literal, an
    ' expression, a field, ...) have nowhere to write back to and are left "" -- BYREF
    ' then behaves like BYVAL for that one call, which is the only sensible fallback.
    Dim callerArgNames(Any) As String
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim callerArgNames(paramCount - 1)

    Dim ai As Integer
    For ai = 0 To explicitArgCount - 1
        Dim argNode As Integer
        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, ai + firstExplicitArg)
        If argNode = -1 Then
            errText = "exec: call argument missing"
            Return 0
        End If

        If writePos < paramCount AndAlso paramByRef(writePos) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(argNode).kind)) = "IDENT" Then
            callerArgNames(writePos) = ps.ast.nodes(argNode).value
        End If

        If writePos < paramCount Then
            Dim paramTypeForArg As String
            paramTypeForArg = UCase(Trim(paramTypes(writePos)))
            If Len(paramTypeForArg) > 2 And Right(paramTypeForArg, 2) = "[]" Then
                If UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(argNode).kind)) <> "IDENT" Then
                    errText = "exec: array parameter " & UCase(Trim(paramNames(writePos))) & " requires an array variable argument"
                    Return 0
                End If
                Dim callerArrayIdx As Integer
                callerArrayIdx = ExecFindVar(es, ps.ast.nodes(argNode).value)
                If callerArrayIdx < 0 Or callerArrayIdx >= es.count Or es.vars(callerArrayIdx).isArray = 0 Then
                    errText = "exec: array parameter " & UCase(Trim(paramNames(writePos))) & " requires an array variable argument"
                    Return 0
                End If
                arrayArgVarIdx(writePos) = callerArrayIdx
                ExecValueInit argValues(writePos)
                writePos += 1
                Continue For
            End If
        End If

        If ExecEvalExpression(ps, argNode, es, argValues(writePos), errText) = 0 Then Return 0
        writePos += 1
    Next ai

    ' Convert every argument before mutating the callee frame.  This keeps
    ' parameter binding atomic when a declared conversion fails.
    Dim boundValues(Any) As ExecValue
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim boundValues(paramCount - 1)
    For ai = 0 To paramCount - 1
        If arrayArgVarIdx(ai) <> -1 Then
            ExecValueInit boundValues(ai)
            Continue For
        End If
        If ExecApplyDeclaredType(argValues(ai), paramTypes(ai), boundValues(ai), errText) = 0 Then Return 0
    Next ai

    Dim snapshotVars(Any) As ExecVar
    Dim snapshotCount As Integer
    Dim snapshotNextAddr As UInteger
    ExecSnapshotVars es, snapshotVars(), snapshotCount, snapshotNextAddr

    ' Enter the activation record before binding parameters so parameters,
    ' receiver aliases and DIM locals can shadow outer names safely.
    If es.runtime.callContextDepth >= 63 Then
        errText = "exec: call stack limit exceeded"
        Return 0

Private Sub ExecVarPinStore(ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @es.vars(idx).pinCell(0)
    Select Case es.vars(idx).pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        *CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr) = CSng(ExecValueToFloat(es.vars(idx).value))
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        *CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr) = ExecValueToFloat(es.vars(idx).value)
    Case Else
        Dim storeBits As ULongInt = ExecValueToU64(es.vars(idx).value)
        Select Case es.vars(idx).pinWidth
        Case 1
            cellPtr[0] = CUByte(storeBits And &hFFULL)
        Case 2
            *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr) = CUShort(storeBits And &hFFFFULL)
        Case 4
            *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr) = CULng(storeBits And &hFFFFFFFFULL)
        Case Else
            *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr) = storeBits
        End Select
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub ExecVarPinLoad(ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal idx As Integer)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @es.vars(idx).pinCell(0)
    Dim loaded As ExecValue
    Select Case es.vars(idx).pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        ExecValueSetFloat loaded, CDbl(*CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr))
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        ExecValueSetFloat loaded, *CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr)
    Case Else
        Dim loadBits As ULongInt
        Select Case es.vars(idx).pinWidth
        Case 1
            loadBits = cellPtr[0]
        Case 2
            loadBits = *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case 4
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case Else
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr)
        End Select
        ExecValueSetU64 loaded, loadBits
    End Select
    Dim converted As ExecValue
    Dim pinErr As String
    If ExecApplyDeclaredType(loaded, es.vars(idx).pinType, converted, pinErr) <> 0 Then es.vars(idx).value = converted
End Sub

Private Function ExecFindVar(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim fvIdx As Integer = ExecFindVarRaw(es, nameText)
    If fvIdx >= 0 Then

' Append a variable to the current activation record even when an enclosing
' frame already contains the same name.  This is used for routine parameters,
' return slots, receiver aliases and DIM locals that shadow outer variables.
Function ExecAppendFrameVar(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef nameText As String) As Integer
    If es.count >= 256 Then Return -1
    Dim idx As Integer
    idx = es.count
    es.vars(idx).nameText = Trim(nameText)
    ExecValueInit es.vars(idx).value
    es.vars(idx).addr = es.nextVarAddr
    es.vars(idx).declType = ""
    es.vars(idx).runtimeClassType = ""
    es.vars(idx).isArray = 0
    es.vars(idx).arrayId = -1
    es.vars(idx).arrayDims = 0
    es.vars(idx).arrayLower = 0
    es.vars(idx).arrayUpper = 0
    es.vars(idx).arrayBytes = 0
    es.vars(idx).pinned = 0
    es.nextVarAddr += 4
    es.count += 1
    Return idx
End Function

Private Sub ExecSnapshotVars(ByRef es As ExecState, snapshotVars() As ExecVar, ByRef snapshotCount As Integer, ByRef snapshotNextAddr As UInteger)
    snapshotCount = es.count
    snapshotNextAddr = es.nextVarAddr

    For i = 0 To snapshotCount - 1

    Next i

#ifndef UXB_MIR_INTERP_DISPATCH_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_INTERP_DISPATCH_FBS

#include once "../../mir/mir_instruction.fbs"
#include once "../../mir/verify/mir_verify.fbs"
#include once "../common/interp_context.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_state.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_registry.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_arith.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_string.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_array_object.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_memory.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_file.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_runtime_call.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_call.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_ffi.fbs"
#include once "mir_interp_fail_closed.fbs"
#include once "../../runtime/runtime_service_dispatch.fbs"

Sub UXBMIRInterpStateInit(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState)
    Dim initFreeIdx As Integer
    For initFreeIdx = 0 To st.varCount - 1
        If st.vars(initFreeIdx) <> 0 Then Delete st.vars(initFreeIdx)
    Next initFreeIdx
    st.varCount = 0
    st.labelCount = 0
    st.gosubDepth = 0
    st.gosubMaxDepth = 4096
    st.nextIndex = 0
    st.jumpRequested = 0
    st.returnRequested = 0
    st.returnValue = UXBInterpValueVoid()
    st.currentScopeDepth = 0
    st.shellNowait = 0
    st.shellTimeoutMs = 0
    st.shellRunPath = ""
    st.shellOutPath = ""
    st.shellErrPath = ""
    st.shellOutVar = ""
    st.shellErrVar = ""
    st.shellCodeVar = ""
    st.filePrintRuntimeHandle = 0
    st.filePrintBuffer = ""
    st.filePrintTrailingSep = ""
    st.filePrintActive = 0
    Erase st.vars
    Erase st.labels
    Erase st.gosubReturns
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRInterpNormName(ByVal nameText As String) As String
    Return UCase(Trim(nameText))
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRInterpIsReferenceName(ByVal textValue As String) As Integer
    Dim s As String = Trim(textValue)
    If s = "" Then Return 0
    If Left(s, 1) = Chr(34) Then Return 0
    If UCase(s) = "TRUE" Or UCase(s) = "FALSE" Then Return 0
    If Asc(Left(s, 1)) >= Asc("0") And Asc(Left(s, 1)) <= Asc("9") Then Return 0
    If Left(s, 1) = "-" And Len(s) > 1 Then
        Dim c As String = Mid(s, 2, 1)
        If Asc(c) >= Asc("0") And Asc(c) <= Asc("9") Then Return 0
    End If
    Return 1
End Function

Function UXBMIRInterpFindVar(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBMIRInterpNormName(nameText)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = st.varCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If st.vars(i)->nameKey = key Then
            ' S-071: a pinned scalar's truth is its raw cell (a POKE through
            ' VARPTR may have changed it) -- refresh before anyone reads it.
            If st.vars(i)->pinned <> 0 Then UXBMIRInterpPinLoad *st.vars(i)
            Return i
        End If
    Next i
    Return -1
End Function

Private Function UXBMIRInterpFindCurrentVar(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBMIRInterpNormName(nameText)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = st.varCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If st.vars(i)->scopeDepth = st.currentScopeDepth And st.vars(i)->nameKey = key Then Return i
    Next i
    Return -1
End Function

Sub UXBMIRInterpEnterScope(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState)
    st.currentScopeDepth += 1
End Sub

Sub UXBMIRInterpLeaveScope(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState)
    If st.currentScopeDepth <= 0 Then Exit Sub
    If st.libraryHeap <> 0 Then UXBInterpHeapReleaseLibraryScope *st.libraryHeap, st.currentScopeDepth
    Dim writePos As Integer
    Dim readPos As Integer
    writePos = 0
    For readPos = 0 To st.varCount - 1
        If st.vars(readPos)->scopeDepth <> st.currentScopeDepth Then
            If writePos <> readPos Then st.vars(writePos) = st.vars(readPos)
            writePos += 1
        Else
            Delete st.vars(readPos)
        End If
    Next readPos
    st.varCount = writePos
    If st.varCount <= 0 Then
        Erase st.vars
    Else
        ReDim Preserve st.vars(st.varCount - 1)
    End If
    st.currentScopeDepth -= 1
End Sub

Sub UXBMIRInterpSetVar(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String, ByRef v As UXBInterpValue)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Then Exit Sub
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindCurrentVar(st, nameText)
    If idx < 0 Then
        If st.varCount = 0 Then
            ReDim st.vars(0)
        Else
            ReDim Preserve st.vars(st.varCount)
        End If
        idx = st.varCount
        st.varCount += 1
        st.vars(idx) = New UXBMIRInterpVar
        st.vars(idx)->nameText = Trim(nameText)
        st.vars(idx)->nameKey = UXBMIRInterpNormName(nameText)
        st.vars(idx)->scopeDepth = st.currentScopeDepth
    End If
    st.vars(idx)->value = v
    If st.vars(idx)->pinned <> 0 Then UXBMIRInterpPinStore *st.vars(idx)
End Sub

Sub UXBMIRInterpAssignVar(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String, ByRef v As UXBInterpValue)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Then Exit Sub
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindVar(st, nameText)
    If idx >= 0 Then
        Dim declaredType As String = st.vars(idx)->value.typeName
        ' S-160: istisna degeri her THROW'da kendi tipini tasir (sayi ya da metin).
        If UCase(Trim(nameText)) = "__MIR_EXC_VALUE" Then declaredType = ""
        If declaredType <> "" And declaredType <> "VOID" Then
            st.vars(idx)->value = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(v, declaredType)
        Else
            st.vars(idx)->value = v
        End If
        If st.vars(idx)->pinned <> 0 Then UXBMIRInterpPinStore *st.vars(idx)
        Exit Sub
    End If
    UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, nameText, v
End Sub

Function UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal operandText As String) As UXBInterpValue
    Dim key As String = Trim(operandText)
    If key = "" Then Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindVar(st, key)
    If idx >= 0 Then Return st.vars(idx)->value
    If Left(key, 1) = Chr(34) And Right(key, 1) = Chr(34) And Len(key) >= 2 Then Return UXBInterpValueString(Mid(key, 2, Len(key) - 2))
    Return UXBInterpValueFromLiteral(key)
End Function

Sub UXBMIRInterpAddLabel(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal indexValue As Integer)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Then Exit Sub
    If st.labelCount = 0 Then
        ReDim st.labels(0)
    Else

' Byte width of a declared scalar type's raw representation, 0 = no native
' scalar layout (strings, objects, F80/EXTENDED, ...): VARPTR fails closed there.
Private Function UXBMIRInterpPinWidth(ByVal typeText As String) As Integer
    Select Case typeText
    Case "I8", "BYTE", "SBYTE", "U8", "UBYTE", "BOOL", "BOOLEAN"
        Return 1
    Case "I16", "SHORT", "U16", "USHORT"
        Return 2
    Case "I32", "INTEGER", "INT", "LONG", "U32", "UINTEGER", "UINT", "ULONG", "F32", "SINGLE"
        Return 4
    Case "I64", "LONGINT", "U64", "ULONGINT", "F64", "DOUBLE", "PTR", "STRPTR", "WSTRPTR", "POINTER"
        Return 8
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub UXBMIRInterpPinStore(ByRef pv As UXBMIRInterpVar)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @pv.pinCell(0)
    Select Case pv.pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        *CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr) = CSng(pv.value.floatValue)
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        *CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr) = pv.value.floatValue
    Case Else
        Dim storeBits As ULongInt = CULngInt(pv.value.intValue)
        Select Case pv.pinWidth
        Case 1
            cellPtr[0] = CUByte(storeBits And &hFFULL)
        Case 2
            *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr) = CUShort(storeBits And &hFFFFULL)
        Case 4
            *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr) = CULng(storeBits And &hFFFFFFFFULL)
        Case Else
            *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr) = storeBits
        End Select
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRInterpPinLoad(ByRef pv As UXBMIRInterpVar)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @pv.pinCell(0)
    Dim loaded As UXBInterpValue
    Select Case pv.pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        loaded = UXBInterpValueFloat(CDbl(*CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr)))
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        loaded = UXBInterpValueFloat(*CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr))
    Case Else
        Dim loadBits As ULongInt
        Select Case pv.pinWidth
        Case 1
            loadBits = cellPtr[0]
        Case 2
            loadBits = *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case 4
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case Else
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr)
        End Select
        loaded = UXBInterpValueUInt(loadBits)
    End Select
    pv.value = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(loaded, pv.pinType)
End Sub

Sub UXBMIRInterpBindAlias(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal targetIdx As Integer)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Or targetIdx < 0 Or targetIdx >= st.varCount Then Exit Sub
    Dim target As UXBMIRInterpVar Ptr = st.vars(targetIdx)
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindCurrentVar(st, nameText)
    If idx < 0 Then

            ReDim st.vars(0)

        idx = st.varCount
        st.varCount += 1
        st.vars(idx) = New UXBMIRInterpVar

    If st.vars(idx) = target Then Exit Sub

#ifndef UXB_MIR_INTERP_STATE_FBS
#define UXB_MIR_INTERP_STATE_FBS

#include once "../../mir/mir_instruction.fbs"
#include once "../common/interp_context.fbs"

Type UXBMIRInterpVar
    nameText As String
    ' upper-cased/trimmed copy of nameText, computed once at creation: lookups used
    ' to UCase(Trim()) EVERY variable name on EVERY lookup (thousands of temporaries
    ' in a long program => milliseconds per interpreter step)
    nameKey As String
    value As UXBInterpValue
    scopeDepth As Integer
    ' S-071: once a scalar's address escapes through VARPTR, its value is kept
    ' in this raw, declared-width cell (the address VARPTR hands out) instead
    ' of only in the multi-field `value` struct. `value` holds separate
    ' intValue/floatValue fields, so its own addresses are not the variable's
    ' typed storage (an F64's bytes are NOT at &intValue, an F32 needs a 4-byte
    ' single, a 32-bit POKE must not disturb neighbouring bytes). See
    ' UXBMIRInterpPinStore/PinLoad below: FindVar refreshes `value` from the
    ' cell before any read, and every write stores back into it.
    pinned As Integer = 0
    pinWidth As Integer = 0
    pinType As String
    pinCell(0 To 15) As UByte
    ' S-167: BYREF parametre cagiranin deposunun takma adidir (kopya degil). Sifir degilse bu
    ' hucre yalniz bir ad tasir; tum okuma/yazmalar hedef hucreye gider (UXBMIRInterpFindVar /
    ' UXBMIRInterpSetVar). Hedef daima daha dis bir kapsamdadir, bu hucreden once silinmez.
    aliasOf As UXBMIRInterpVar Ptr = 0
End Type

Type UXBMIRInterpLabel
    nameText As String
    nameKey As String
    indexValue As Integer
End Type

' S-071: each variable lives in its own heap cell and vars() holds only
' POINTERS to them. With the old by-value vars(Any) As UXBMIRInterpVar, any
' ReDim (a new variable or compiler temporary appearing) relocated every
' variable, so a VARPTR address taken earlier silently went stale. Now
' ReDim moves only the pointer table; a variable's own storage keeps one
' stable address for its whole scope, which is what NATIVE PEEK/POKE/MEMCOPY
' through VARPTR need (the locked "one real backing storage" model) -- no
' mirror copy required. The destructor releases whatever is still alive when
' the interpreter run ends.
Type UXBMIRInterpState
    libraryHeap As UXBInterpHeap Ptr = 0
    vars(Any) As UXBMIRInterpVar Ptr
    varCount As Integer = 0
    Declare Destructor()
    labels(Any) As UXBMIRInterpLabel
    labelCount As Integer
    gosubReturns(Any) As Integer
    gosubDepth As Integer
    gosubMaxDepth As Integer
    nextIndex As Integer
    jumpRequested As Integer
    returnRequested As Integer
    returnValue As UXBInterpValue
    currentScopeDepth As Integer
    shellNowait As Integer
    shellTimeoutMs As Integer
    shellRunPath As String
    shellOutPath As String
    shellErrPath As String
    shellOutVar As String
    shellErrVar As String
    shellCodeVar As String
    filePrintRuntimeHandle As Integer
    filePrintBuffer As String
    filePrintTrailingSep As String
    filePrintActive As Integer
End Type

' Byte width of a declared scalar type's raw representation, 0 = no native
' scalar layout (strings, objects, F80/EXTENDED, ...): VARPTR fails closed there.
Private Function UXBMIRInterpPinWidth(ByVal typeText As String) As Integer
    Select Case typeText
    Case "I8", "BYTE", "SBYTE", "U8", "UBYTE", "BOOL", "BOOLEAN"
        Return 1
    Case "I16", "SHORT", "U16", "USHORT"
        Return 2
    Case "I32", "INTEGER", "INT", "LONG", "U32", "UINTEGER", "UINT", "ULONG", "F32", "SINGLE"
        Return 4
    Case "I64", "LONGINT", "U64", "ULONGINT", "F64", "DOUBLE", "PTR", "STRPTR", "WSTRPTR", "POINTER"
        Return 8
    End Select
    Return 0
End Function

Private Sub UXBMIRInterpPinStore(ByRef pv As UXBMIRInterpVar)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @pv.pinCell(0)
    Select Case pv.pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        *CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr) = CSng(pv.value.floatValue)
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        *CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr) = pv.value.floatValue
    Case Else
        Dim storeBits As ULongInt = CULngInt(pv.value.intValue)
        Select Case pv.pinWidth
        Case 1
            cellPtr[0] = CUByte(storeBits And &hFFULL)
        Case 2
            *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr) = CUShort(storeBits And &hFFFFULL)
        Case 4
            *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr) = CULng(storeBits And &hFFFFFFFFULL)
        Case Else
            *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr) = storeBits
        End Select
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub UXBMIRInterpPinLoad(ByRef pv As UXBMIRInterpVar)
    Dim cellPtr As UByte Ptr = @pv.pinCell(0)
    Dim loaded As UXBInterpValue
    Select Case pv.pinType
    Case "F32", "SINGLE"
        loaded = UXBInterpValueFloat(CDbl(*CPtr(Single Ptr, cellPtr)))
    Case "F64", "DOUBLE"
        loaded = UXBInterpValueFloat(*CPtr(Double Ptr, cellPtr))
    Case Else
        Dim loadBits As ULongInt
        Select Case pv.pinWidth
        Case 1
            loadBits = cellPtr[0]
        Case 2
            loadBits = *CPtr(UShort Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case 4
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULong Ptr, cellPtr)
        Case Else
            loadBits = *CPtr(ULongInt Ptr, cellPtr)
        End Select
        loaded = UXBInterpValueUInt(loadBits)
    End Select
    pv.value = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(loaded, pv.pinType)
End Sub

Destructor UXBMIRInterpState()
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To varCount - 1
        If vars(i) <> 0 Then Delete vars(i)
    Next i
End Destructor

' S-140: 1 when the running routine's own frame (parameter or local) declares `nameText`. A module-level
' constant of the same name must not win over it (`FUNCTION F(BASE AS I32)` with `CONST BASE = 10` read 10).
' Only the current frame counts -- a CALLER's local is not visible to a routine, so it never shadows a constant.
Private Function ExecCurrentFrameHasVar(ByRef es As ExecState, ByRef nameUpper As String) As Integer
    Dim depth As Integer
    depth = es.runtime.callContextDepth
    If depth > 63 Then depth = 63
    If depth <= 0 Then Return 0
    Dim frameBase As Integer
    frameBase = es.runtime.callFrameBase(depth)
    If frameBase < 0 Then frameBase = 0
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = es.count - 1 To frameBase Step -1
        If UCase(es.vars(i).nameText) = nameUpper Then Return 1
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

' BYREF-aware: byRefFlags(i)<>0 and callerArgNames(i)<>"" together mean parameter
' paramNames(i) is BYREF and was called with a plain variable argument -- that
' variable's caller-side value is overwritten with the parameter's final value once
' the routine's own (snapshotted) scope is restored. Pass byRefArgCount=0 (with any
' same-named dummy arrays) from call sites that have no BYREF/caller-argument
' information available (e.g. the prepared-args calling convention, which has no
' original call-site AST to inspect). This is a copy-in/copy-out implementation of
' BYREF (the callee gets its own ordinary local, and its last value is written back
' to the caller's variable at return) rather than true pointer aliasing --
' observably identical for single-threaded, non-reentrant calls, and far simpler to
' keep consistent with this interpreter's snapshot/restore scoping model.
Private Sub ExecRestoreRoutineVars(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef es As ExecState, ByVal routineNodeIdx As Integer, paramNames() As String, ByVal paramCount As Integer, snapshotVars() As ExecVar, ByVal snapshotCount As Integer, ByVal snapshotNextAddr As UInteger, byRefFlags() As Integer, ByVal byRefArgCount As Integer, callerArgNames() As String)

' Capture each BYREF parameter's final value (in the about-to-be-discarded callee
    ' scope) before the snapshot restore below wipes it out.
    Dim byRefFinalValues(Any) As ExecValue
    Dim byRefHasValue(Any) As Integer
    If byRefArgCount > 0 Then
        ReDim byRefFinalValues(byRefArgCount - 1)
        ReDim byRefHasValue(byRefArgCount - 1)
        For i = 0 To byRefArgCount - 1
            If byRefFlags(i) <> 0 And Trim(callerArgNames(i)) <> "" Then
                Dim paramVarIdx As Integer = ExecFindVar(es, paramNames(i))
                If paramVarIdx >= 0 Then
                    byRefFinalValues(i) = es.vars(paramVarIdx).value
                    byRefHasValue(i) = 1
                End If
            End If
        Next i
    End If

' BYREF takma ad hedeflerinin son degerleri (geri yukleme onlari ezmeden once).
    Dim aliasFinalValues(Any) As ExecValue
    Dim aliasHasValue(Any) As Integer
    If aliasCount > 0 Then
        ReDim aliasFinalValues(aliasCount - 1)
        ReDim aliasHasValue(aliasCount - 1)
        For i = 0 To aliasCount - 1
            Dim aliasSlot As Integer = aliasSlotPlus1(i) - 1
            If aliasSlot >= 0 And aliasSlot < snapshotCount And aliasSlot < es.count Then
                If es.vars(aliasSlot).pinned <> 0 Then ExecVarPinLoad es, aliasSlot
                aliasFinalValues(i) = es.vars(aliasSlot).value
                aliasHasValue(i) = 1
            End If
        Next i
    End If

' BYREF: for each argument that binds to a BYREF parameter and is itself a plain
    ' variable reference at the call site, remember the caller's variable name so its
    ' final value can be written back after the routine returns (see
    ' ExecRestoreRoutineVars). Arguments that aren't a simple variable (a literal, an
    ' expression, a field, ...) have nowhere to write back to and are left "" -- BYREF
    ' then behaves like BYVAL for that one call, which is the only sensible fallback.
    Dim callerArgNames(Any) As String
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim callerArgNames(paramCount - 1)

    Dim ai As Integer
    For ai = 0 To explicitArgCount - 1
        Dim argNode As Integer
        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, ai + firstExplicitArg)
        If argNode = -1 Then
            errText = "exec: call argument missing"
            Return 0
        End If

        If writePos < paramCount AndAlso paramByRef(writePos) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(argNode).kind)) = "IDENT" Then
            callerArgNames(writePos) = ps.ast.nodes(argNode).value
        End If
input.new_string:
' S-167 BYREF: arguman cagiranin duz (dizi olmayan) degiskeniyse parametre o yuvanin takma adi
    ' olur (aliasSlotPlus1 = yuva + 1); yuva cerceve acilmadan, cagiranin gozunden bulunur.
    ' Degisken olmayan arguman (sabit, ifade, alan...) icin baglanacak depo yoktur: parametre o
    ' cagri icin kendi yerel kopyasini alir (BYVAL gibi) -- tek anlamli yedek.
    Dim aliasSlotPlus1(Any) As Integer
    If paramCount > 0 Then ReDim aliasSlotPlus1(paramCount - 1) Else ReDim aliasSlotPlus1(0)

    Dim ai As Integer
    For ai = 0 To explicitArgCount - 1
        Dim argNode As Integer
        argNode = ExecChildAt(ps, callNodeIdx, ai + firstExplicitArg)
        If argNode = -1 Then
            errText = "exec: call argument missing"
            Return 0
        End If

        If writePos < paramCount AndAlso paramByRef(writePos) <> 0 AndAlso UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(argNode).kind)) = "IDENT" Then
            Dim byRefParamType As String = UCase(Trim(paramTypes(writePos)))
            If Not (Len(byRefParamType) > 2 AndAlso Right(byRefParamType, 2) = "[]") Then
                Dim byRefSlot As Integer = ExecFindVar(es, ps.ast.nodes(argNode).value)
                If byRefSlot < 0 Then byRefSlot = ExecEnsureVar(es, ps.ast.nodes(argNode).value)
                If byRefSlot >= 0 AndAlso es.vars(byRefSlot).isArray = 0 Then
                    aliasSlotPlus1(writePos) = byRefSlot + 1
                    ExecValueInit argValues(writePos)
                    writePos += 1
                    Continue For
                End If
            End If
        End If

' S-167: `nameText` adli, mevcut kapsamda `targetIdx` hucresinin takma adi olan bir hucre kurar.
Sub UXBMIRInterpBindAlias(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String, ByVal targetIdx As Integer)
    If Trim(nameText) = "" Or targetIdx < 0 Or targetIdx >= st.varCount Then Exit Sub
    Dim target As UXBMIRInterpVar Ptr = st.vars(targetIdx)
    Dim idx As Integer = UXBMIRInterpFindCurrentVar(st, nameText)
    If idx < 0 Then
        If st.varCount = 0 Then
            ReDim st.vars(0)
        Else
            ReDim Preserve st.vars(st.varCount)
        End If
        idx = st.varCount
        st.varCount += 1
        st.vars(idx) = New UXBMIRInterpVar
        st.vars(idx)->nameText = Trim(nameText)
        st.vars(idx)->nameKey = UXBMIRInterpNormName(nameText)
        st.vars(idx)->scopeDepth = st.currentScopeDepth
    End If
    If st.vars(idx) = target Then Exit Sub
    st.vars(idx)->aliasOf = target
End Sub

Private Function UXBMIRInterpFindCurrentVar(ByRef st As UXBMIRInterpState, ByVal nameText As String) As Integer
    Dim key As String = UXBMIRInterpNormName(nameText)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = st.varCount - 1 To 0 Step -1
        If st.vars(i)->scopeDepth = st.currentScopeDepth And st.vars(i)->nameKey = key Then Return i
    Next i
    Return -1

2149	## S-100 — WASM/WAT: bir işlev global diziye erişemiyor (geçersiz WAT: `undefined local variable "$G"`)
2150	**Bulundu:** 2026-09-20 (S-068 `shadow_global` testi, Claude 1) · **Durum:** `YAPILDI-DOGRULANDI` (2026-09-20: S-120 ile kapandı — modül düzeyi değişkenler WASM globali). Eski tanı: `DIM g(2) AS I32 : g(0) = 5 : FUNCTION F() AS I32 : RETURN g(0) : END FUNCTION : PRINT F()` → `wat2wasm`: `undefined local variable "$G"` (eski ikilide de aynı: önceden var). WASM dizisi host tutamağı (handle); tutamak MAIN'in yereli ve diğer işlevlere geçmiyor. Çözüm: global dizi tutamaklarını WASM globali yapmak (`(global $G (mut i32))`) ve `LOAD_INDEXED/STORE_INDEXED` operandını global/yerel ayrımıyla üretmek. `tests/array_params/shadow_global` bu yüzden WAT'ta geçersiz (JS ve dört yerel motor doğru).
2151	
2152	## S-101 — `LBOUND/UBOUND` dilde tanımlı değil: dizi parametresi kendi sınırlarını öğrenemiyor
2153	**Bulundu:** 2026-09-20 (S-068 tasarımı, Claude 1) · **Durum:** `KISMEN-YAPILDI-DOGRULANDI` (2026-09-21, Claude 1) — Mete kararı (2026-09-20 22:20): `LBOUND(dizi[, boyut])` / `UBOUND(dizi[, boyut])`, boyut 1'den sayılır, varsayılan 1; çok boyutlu dizide boyut başına; ayrılmamış dinamik dizide LBOUND=0/UBOUND=-1; MIR `ARRAY_LBOUND/ARRAY_UBOUND`. **Uygulama (altı motorda doğrulandı):** tür kuralı `I32` (`type_builtin_registry.fbs`); anlamsal kapı `SemValidateArrayBoundsCalls` (bir-iki argüman, ilk argüman dizi olmalı, boyut tamsayı SABİT ≥1 ve dizinin boyut sayısını aşmamalı; tek ileti dört/altı motorda aynı); MIR: derleme zamanı sınırları sabit olan diziler `LOAD_CONST`'a KATLANIR (`MIRLowerArrayBoundsCall`, `mir_lower_array_dim.fbs`: tek bildirimli sabit sınırlı 1-D ve çok boyutlu diziler; native/JS/WASM'a hiçbir çalışma zamanı desteği gerekmez), sınırı çalışma zamanında değişen/hesaplanan diziler (REDIM'li veya `DIM d(n)` 1-D dizi, `arr AS T[]` parametresi) yeni `MIR_ARRAY_LBOUND/UBOUND` (ad, boyut) komutuna iner — opcode kayıt/doğrulama/imza/yetenek tabloları güncellendi. Motorlar: AST yorumlayıcı (`ExecEvalBuiltinArrayBoundsCategory`: 1-D güncel `arrayLower/Upper`, çok boyutlu bildirimden), canonical-MIR yorumlayıcı (heap dilimi alt/üst sınırı; hiç ayrılmamış dizi 0/-1), native x64 (tanımlayıcının +8/+16'sı; parametre yuvası üzerinden — REDIM tanımlayıcıyı günceller), JS (`ux.arrayLBound/arrayUBound`, `runtime/js/common/ux_runtime_core.js` + üretilmiş `.fbs`), WASM (host_call4 83/84, `wasm_runtime_bridge.fbs`), legacy AST-x64 (yalnız bir kez bildirilmiş sabit sınırlı 1-D dizi sabite katlanır; REDIM/parametre/çok boyutlu NET reddedilir). Yüzey kayıt defterleri: `LBOUND/UBOUND` `uxb_surface_registry.fbs` (bilinen/grup BUILTIN/tür BUILTIN_FUNCTION), yüzey→MIR eşlemesi, parser/anlamsal/HIR/MIR/x64/JS/WASM katman sözleşmeleri, parser kapsam kapısı (227 giriş). **Testler:** `tests/array_bounds` (34 kontrol: static_1d [AST/MIR/x64/legacy/JS], static_multidim, redim_bounds, param_bounds, runtime_bound [AST/MIR], 5 negatif) — birleşik koşucuya `array_bounds` olarak eklendi; `tests/wasm_model` `array_bounds_static`, `array_bounds_param` (54/54, node ile gerçek WASM çalıştırma). **Açık alt işler:** (1) `DIM d() AS T` (sınırsız/ayrılmamış dinamik dizi bildirimi) dilde YOK (parser "expression expected"); karardaki "LBOUND=0/UBOUND=-1" durumu ancak bu sözdizimi eklenince görülebilir (motor tarafı hazır: MIR heap varsayılanı 0/-1) — Mete'ye sorulacak (aşağıda "Sorulacaklar"); (2) boyut argümanı SABİT tamsayı olmalı (değişken boyut reddedilir); (3) çok boyutlu dizinin REDIM'i / çok boyutlu dizi PARAMETRESİ zaten dilde yok (S-103 çizgisi), (4) native `DIM d(n)` sabit olmayan sınır hâlâ reddediliyor (ayrı iş). Eski tanı: `src/` ve `docs/`'ta hiç yok; `LBOUND(r) * 1000` "numeric operands required", `UBOUND(arr)` AST "unsupported call", MIR "RT_LIBRARY_CALL no bound implementation". Dizi parametresi kullanan bir rutin uzunluğu ayrıca argüman olarak almak zorunda (C tarzı). Native x64 tanımlayıcısı (işaretçi + alt + üst sınır) `LBOUND/UBOUND` ve parametre için `SIZEOF(arr)` altyapısını hazır tutuyor. Karar: dile eklensin mi (FreeBASIC uyumu: `LBOUND(a[, boyut])`, `UBOUND(a[, boyut])`)?

Function MIRX64FunctionLabel(ByRef functionName As String) As String
    Dim t As String
    t = MIRX64SanitizeSymbolName(functionName)
    If UCase(Trim(functionName)) = "MAIN" Then Return "main"
    Return "uxb_fn_" & t
End Function

Function MIRX64GlobalLabel(ByRef globalName As String) As String
    Return "uxb_g_" & MIRX64SanitizeSymbolName(globalName)
End Function

Function MIRX64FindGlobalSlot(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef nameText As String, ByRef idxOut As Integer) As Integer
    Dim target As String
    target = UCase(Trim(nameText))
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To cg.globalCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(cg.globals(i).nameText)) = target Then
            idxOut = i
            Return 1
        End If
    Next i
    Return 0
End Function

Function MIRX64EnsureGlobalSlot(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context, ByRef nameText As String, ByRef idxOut As Integer) As Integer
    Dim n As String
    n = UCase(Trim(nameText))
    If n = "" Then Return 0
    If MIRX64FindGlobalSlot(cg, n, idxOut) <> 0 Then Return 1

    idxOut = cg.globalCount
    If cg.globalCount = 0 Then
        ReDim cg.globals(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve cg.globals(cg.globalCount)
    End If
    cg.globalCount += 1
    cg.globals(idxOut).nameText = n
    cg.globals(idxOut).labelText = MIRX64GlobalLabel(n)
    cg.globals(idxOut).sizeBytes = 8
    cg.globals(idxOut).typeName = "I64"
    MIRX64EmitData cg, cg.globals(idxOut).labelText & ": dq 0"
    Return 1
End Function

Sub MIRX64PrepareModuleGlobals(ByRef cg As MIRX64Context)
    If cg.modulePtr = 0 Then Exit Sub
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim idx As Integer
    For i = 0 To cg.modulePtr->globalVarCount - 1
        If Trim(cg.modulePtr->globalVars(i)) <> "" Then
            MIRX64EnsureGlobalSlot cg, cg.modulePtr->globalVars(i), idx
            If i <= UBound(cg.modulePtr->globalVarTypes) Then
                If Trim(cg.modulePtr->globalVarTypes(i)) <> "" Then cg.globals(idx).typeName = UCase(Trim(cg.modulePtr->globalVarTypes(i)))
            End If
        End If

Sub MIRAppendFunctionLocal(ByRef module As MIRModule, ByVal fnIdx As Integer, ByRef localNameRaw As String, ByRef localTypeRaw As String)
    Dim localName As String
    localName = UCase(Trim(localNameRaw))
    If localName = "" Then Exit Sub
    Dim fn As MIRFunction Ptr
    fn = @module.functions(fnIdx)
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To fn->localVarCount - 1
        If UCase(Trim(fn->localVars(i))) = localName Then
            If Trim(fn->localVarTypes(i)) = "" Then fn->localVarTypes(i) = MIRCanonicalTypeName(localTypeRaw)
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
    If fn->localVarCount = 0 Then
        ReDim fn->localVars(0)
        ReDim fn->localVarTypes(0)
    Else
        ReDim Preserve fn->localVars(fn->localVarCount)
        ReDim Preserve fn->localVarTypes(fn->localVarCount)
    End If
    fn->localVars(fn->localVarCount) = localName
    fn->localVarTypes(fn->localVarCount) = MIRCanonicalTypeName(localTypeRaw)
    If fn->localVarTypes(fn->localVarCount) = "" Then fn->localVarTypes(fn->localVarCount) = "I64"
    fn->localVarCount += 1
End Sub

Private Function MIRLowerRoutineNodeCore(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByVal routineNodeIdx As Integer, ByRef module As MIRModule, ByRef tempSeed As Integer, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    If routineNodeIdx < 0 Or routineNodeIdx >= ps.ast.count Then Return 1

    Dim k As String
    k = UCase(Trim(ps.ast.nodes(routineNodeIdx).kind))
    Select Case k
    Case "SUB_STMT", "FUNCTION_STMT", "CLASS_METHOD_DECL", "CLASS_OPERATOR_DECL", "CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_DECL", "CLASS_DESTRUCTOR_DECL", "CLASS_PROPERTY_GET_STMT", "CLASS_PROPERTY_SET_STMT"
        ' supported
    Case Else
        Return 1
    End Select

    If MIRRoutineBodyStmtCount(ps, routineNodeIdx) <= 0 Then
        If k = "SUB_STMT" Or k = "FUNCTION_STMT" Then Return 1
    End If

    Dim routineName As String
    If MIRResolveRoutineEntryName(ps, routineNodeIdx, routineName) = 0 Then
        errText = "mir: routine name resolve failed"
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim fnIdx As Integer
    If MIREnsureFunctionEntry(module, routineName, fnIdx) = 0 Then
        errText = "mir: function entry create failed " & routineName
        Return 0
    End If

    Dim routineDefaultType As String
    If k = "SUB_STMT" Or k = "CLASS_PROPERTY_SET_STMT" Or k = "CLASS_CONSTRUCTOR_DECL" Or k = "CLASS_DESTRUCTOR_DECL" Then
        routineDefaultType = "VOID"

        ' ABI10_MIR_BLOCK_LABEL_FIX_20260706: labels are executable control targets;
        ' carry the visible label in operand(0) as well as resultName for verifier/interpreter symmetry.
        Dim fnLabelOperandCount As Integer
        fnLabelOperandCount = 1 + src.functions(fi).paramVarCount
        If fnLabelOperandCount > 16 Then fnLabelOperandCount = 16
        fnLabel = UXBMIRInstructionMake("LABEL", src.functions(fi).name, "TYPE_VOID", fnLabelOperandCount, src.functions(fi).name)
        fnLabel.operandTypes(0) = UXB_MIR_TYPE_STRING

            fnParamIsByRef = 0
            If fnParamLabelIdx < UBound(src.functions(fi).paramByRef) + 1 Then fnParamIsByRef = src.functions(fi).paramByRef(fnParamLabelIdx)

Case "MIR_CONST", "MIR_LOAD_CONST"
        Dim sourceText As String = ""
        If ins.operandCount > 0 Then sourceText = ins.operands(0) Else sourceText = ins.resultName
        Dim v As UXBInterpValue = UXBInterpValueFromLiteral(sourceText, ins.resultType)
        If ins.resultName <> "" And UXBMIRInterpIsReferenceName(ins.resultName) <> 0 Then UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, ins.resultName, v
        Return v
    Case "MIR_LOCAL_DECL", "MIR_GLOBAL_DECL", "MIR_PARAM_DECL"
        If ins.resultName = "" And ins.operandCount >= 3 Then
            Dim arrayName As String = Trim(ins.operands(0))
            Dim lowerValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(1))
            Dim upperValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(2))
            ' S-033 follow-up: MIR_OP_DIM (mir_lower_stmt_core_split.fbs) emits
            ' 5 operands (name,lower,upper,elemBytes,typeName) -- the element
            ' type text lives in operands(4), NOT ins.resultType (which this
            ' instruction never actually sets). Reading resultType here always
            ' produced "" (interpreted as native-scalar by coincidence for the
            ' isNativeScalar check but with elemStride=0, so isNativeScalar
            ' got forced back off in UXBInterpHeapAlloc) -- meaning canonical-
            ' MIR arrays never got a real rawData buffer at all until now,
            ' breaking MIR_MEMORY_REF/VARPTR-on-array/MEMCOPY of a bare array.
            Dim arrayElemType As String = ins.resultType
            If ins.operandCount >= 5 Then arrayElemType = ins.operands(4)
            Dim arrayId As Integer = UXBInterpHeapAlloc(ctx.heap, "ARRAY", arrayElemType)
            If UXBLibraryTypeNeedsManagedCopy(arrayElemType) <> 0 Then ctx.heap.slots(arrayId).libraryScopeDepth = st.currentScopeDepth
            ctx.heap.slots(arrayId).ownerName = "array " & arrayName
            If UXBInterpHeapSetArrayBounds(ctx.heap, arrayId, CInt(lowerValue.intValue), CInt(upperValue.intValue)) = 0 Then
                Return UXBInterpValueError(UXB_INTERP_ERR_BAD_ARGUMENT, "invalid array bounds")
            End If
            Dim arrayValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBInterpValueHandle("ARRAY", arrayId)
            UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, arrayName, arrayValue
            Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
        End If
        Dim declValue As UXBInterpValue = UXBInterpValueDefaultForType(ins.resultType)
        If ins.operandCount > 0 Then declValue = UXBInterpApplyDeclaredType(UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, ins.operands(0)), ins.resultType)
        UXBMIRInterpSetVar st, ins.resultName, declValue
        Return UXBInterpValueVoid()
    Case "MIR_LOAD_LOCAL", "MIR_LOAD_GLOBAL", "MIR_LOAD"
        Dim nameText As String = ""
        If ins.operandCount > 0 Then nameText = ins.operands(0) Else nameText = ins.resultName
        Dim v As UXBInterpValue = UXBMIRInterpGetOperand(st, nameText)

        If s159Kind <> "IDENT" And s159Kind <> "IDENTIFIER" And s159Kind <> "FIELD_EXPR" Then Continue For
        Dim s159Type As String, s159Err As String
        If UXBStep3InferExprType(ps, s159R, s159Type, s159Err) = 0 Then Continue For
        s159Type = UCase(Trim(s159Type))
        If Left(s159Type, 5) = "TYPE_" Then Continue For
        Dim s159Size As Integer, s159Align As Integer, s159RecKind As String, s159Abi As String, s159Pack As Integer, s159Explicit As Integer
        If TypeLayoutDescribeGlobal(s159Type, s159Size, s159Align, s159RecKind, s159Abi, s159Pack, s159Explicit) = 0 Then Continue For

  @{ Name = "wasm_model";      Script = "tests\wasm_model\run_wasm_model_tests.ps1";              Konu = "WASM/WAT: global degisken/dizi, golgeleme (node ile gercek calistirma)" },
  @{ Name = "cli_flags";       Script = "tests\cli_flags\run_cli_flag_tests.ps1";               Konu = "CLI fiil/bayrak: help, version, --max-steps" }
)
if ($Only.Count -gt 0) { $suites = $suites | Where-Object { $Only -contains $_.Name } }

$results = @()
$started = Get-Date
$scratch = $null
$UxbLabel = $Uxb
if (-not $KeepBuildFolders) {
  $scratch = Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ("uxb_model_runs_" + [Guid]::NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8))
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $scratch | Out-Null
  $realUxb = (Resolve-Path $Uxb).Path
  $wrapper = Join-Path $scratch "uxb_wrap.cmd"
  # her cagriya --out-root eklenir; cikis kodu aynen iletilir
  [IO.File]::WriteAllText($wrapper, "@echo off`r`n`"$realUxb`" %* --out-root `"$scratch\runs`"`r`nexit /b %ERRORLEVEL%`r`n", [Text.Encoding]::ASCII)
  $Uxb = $wrapper
}
try {
foreach ($s in $suites) {
  $scriptPath = Join-Path $root $s.Script
  $row = [ordered]@{ Paket = $s.Name; Konu = $s.Konu; Toplam = 0; Gecen = 0; Kalan = 0; Durum = "CALISMADI"; Sure = 0 }
  if (-not (Test-Path $scriptPath)) { $row.Durum = "KOSUCU-YOK"; $results += [pscustomobject]$row; continue }
  $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  # *>&1: paketlerin Write-Host (PASS/FAIL) satırları da yakalanır, konsolu doldurmaz
  $out = & $scriptPath -Uxb $Uxb *>&1 | Out-String
  $sw.Stop()
  $row.Sure = [int]$sw.Elapsed.TotalSeconds
  $m = [regex]::Match($out, "Toplam:\s*(\d+)\s+PASS:\s*(\d+)\s+FAIL:\s*(\d+)")
  if ($m.Success) {
    $row.Toplam = [int]$m.Groups[1].Value; $row.Gecen = [int]$m.Groups[2].Value; $row.Kalan = [int]$m.Groups[3].Value
    $row.Durum = if ($row.Kalan -eq 0 -and $row.Toplam -gt 0) { "GECTI" } else { "DUSTU" }
  }
  if ($row.Durum -ne "GECTI") {
    # düşen/çalışmayan paketin kanıtı: FAIL satırları
    # FAIL satiri + hemen ardindaki "beklenen/gelen" satirlari (kanit kaybolmasin)
    $lines = $out -split "`r?`n"
    $failParts = @()
    for ($li = 0; $li -lt $lines.Count -and $failParts.Count -lt 24; $li++) {
      if ($lines[$li] -match "FAIL ") { $failParts += $lines[$li]; if ($li + 1 -lt $lines.Count) { $failParts += $lines[$li + 1] }; if ($li + 2 -lt $lines.Count) { $failParts += $lines[$li + 2] } }
    }
    $fails = $failParts -join "`n"
    if ($fails) { Write-Host $fails -ForegroundColor Red }
  }
  $results += [pscustomobject]$row
  # her paketten sonra o pakete ait gecici klasorler silinir (tepe disk kullanimi bir paketle sinirli kalir)
  if ($scratch -and (Test-Path "$scratch\runs")) { try { [IO.Directory]::Delete("$scratch\runs", $true) } catch {} }
}
} finally {
  # yalniz bu betigin kendi olusturdugu gecici klasor silinir
  if ($scratch -and (Test-Path $scratch)) { try { [IO.Directory]::Delete($scratch, $true) } catch { Write-Host "UYARI: gecici klasor silinemedi: $scratch" -ForegroundColor Yellow } }
}

$toplam = ($results | Measure-Object Toplam -Sum).Sum
$gecen = ($results | Measure-Object Gecen -Sum).Sum
$bad = @($results | Where-Object { $_.Durum -ne "GECTI" })
"==================== TUM MODEL PAKETLERI ===================="
$results | Format-Table Paket, Toplam, Gecen, Kalan, Durum, Sure, Konu -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200
"Genel: $gecen / $toplam kontrol gecti; $($results.Count - $bad.Count) / $($results.Count) paket temiz.   Sure: $([int]((Get-Date) - $started).TotalSeconds) sn"

# rapor (Markdown) -- sonraki turlarda karsilastirma icin
$dir = Split-Path $ReportPath -Parent
if ($dir -and -not (Test-Path $dir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $dir | Out-Null }
$md = @("# Model paketleri özeti", "", "Tarih: $(Get-Date -Format 's')  ·  ikili: $UxbLabel", "", "| Paket | Toplam | Geçen | Kalan | Durum | Süre (sn) | Konu |", "|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---|")
foreach ($r in $results) { $md += "| $($r.Paket) | $($r.Toplam) | $($r.Gecen) | $($r.Kalan) | $($r.Durum) | $($r.Sure) | $($r.Konu) |" }
$md += ""; $md += "Genel: **$gecen / $toplam** kontrol geçti."
[IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $root $ReportPath), ($md -join "`r`n") + "`r`n", (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
if ($bad.Count -gt 0) { exit 1 }
"Tum paketler temiz."

## S-168 — Rutin yereli/parametresi aynı adlı globali gölgelemiyor (MIR yorumlayıcısı ve native x64)
**Bulundu ve düzeltildi:** 2026-09-27 (Claude 1, S-167 testlerinde) · **Durum:** `YAPILDI` (f2f) · s134 (2026-09-23), s030, f2b, f2c'de de aynı; önceden var.
`DIM g = 1 : SUB S() : DIM g : g = 77 : PRINT g : END SUB : S() : PRINT g` ve `FUNCTION F(k) : DIM g : g = k * 2 : RETURN g` → AST `77 | 1 | 10 1` (doğru), MIR `77 | 77 | 10 10` (rutin globale yazıyor), native `çöp | 77 | 1 10` (yerel okuma çöp, yazım globale; parametre `x` de globale yazılıyordu). Mevcut `tests/wasm_model/local_shadows_global` MIR ve native'de yanlıştı, ama yalnız WASM paketinde koşulduğundan görülmemişti. Kök neden: MIR adla çalışır; fonksiyon meta verisi (params/locals) doğru olsa da motorlar onu kullanmıyordu. Düzeltme: native `MIRX64FindGlobalSlot` derlenen rutinin parametresi/yereli olan adı global saymaz (`EnsureGlobalSlot` gölgelemesiz arar, ikinci etiket açılmaz); MIR köprüsü (`semantic_to_canonical_mir_bridge.fbs`) her rutin yereli için girişte `MIR_LOCAL_DECL` üretir (yorumlayıcı değişkeni rutinin kapsamında varsayılan değerle kurar). Test: `tests/routine_scope/local_shadows_global` (dört motor), `byref_with_local_shadow`.

Bu oturumda üç konu kapandı, biri bekliyor. Kapananlar üç motorda (AST, MIR, native x64) aynı ve doğru sonuç veriyor. Tam regresyon henüz bitmedi.

**claude-code-setup eklentisi:** Kurulum kartı yukarıda, eklenti kartın düğmesine tıklayınca kurulur. Ayrıca **omniroute MCP sunucusu bağlanamadı**: sunucu anahtarı "geçersiz" diye reddetti (HTTP 403). `OMNIROUTE_API_KEY` değerini senin yenilemen gerekiyor.

**S-162 (namespace değişkenleri) — YAPILDI.** Rutin içinden okuma, dışarıdan atama, namespace dizileri ve görevlerle otomatik kilit artık doğru çalışıyor. Bu sırada genel bir parser hatası da bulup düzelttim: `sayac.kutu(2) = 7` gibi bir satır atama yerine "eşit mi?" karşılaştırması olarak okunuyor ve hata vermeden hiçbir şey yapmıyordu. Önceki notumda bu testi "doğru" diye yazmıştım, yanlışmış: son sayı 7 olması gerekirken 0 çıkıyordu.

**S-167 (BYREF) — YAPILDI, önceden fark edilmemiş bir hata.** BYREF, "rutine değişkenin kopyası değil kendisi verilir" demek. Native böyle çalışıyordu, AST ve MIR yorumlayıcıları ise kopyayla çalışıp rutin bitince geri yazıyordu. Bu yüzden aynı program motora göre farklı sonuç veriyordu, örneğin takas işlemi. Artık iki yorumlayıcı da gerçek bağlantı kullanıyor. Eski AST-x64 motoru BYREF'i sessizce kopya gibi çalıştırıyordu, artık açık bir hata mesajıyla reddediyor. Projede BYREF'i doğru sonuç açısından sınayan tek test yoktu, bu yüzden görülmemiş.

**S-168 — YAPILDI, en az 23 Eylül'den beri var olan bir hata.** Bir rutin içinde global ile aynı adda `DIM g` tanımlanınca MIR ve native yerel değişken yerine globale yazıyordu. Native ayrıca çöp değer okuyordu. Bunu yakalayacak bir test aslında vardı (`tests/wasm_model/local_shadows_global`), ama yalnızca WASM için koşulduğu için MIR ve native'de hiç denenmemiş.

**Testler:**
- Yeni `tests/routine_scope` paketi 16/16 geçti. Ana regresyon listesine eklendi.
- `tests/task_sync` paketine 3 namespace testi ekledim. Bunlar tam regresyonda koşulacak.
- Hepsini içeren yeni derleyici `bin/uxb_claude1_f2f.exe` ile tam regresyon şu anda arka planda çalışıyor. Bitince sonucu yazacağım. Değişikliklerin bir kısmı yorumlayıcıların değişken arama mantığına dokunduğu için bu sonuç önemli.

Sonraki adım: regresyon temiz çıkarsa Model D adım 4. Bu adım BYREF'in görevler arasındaki ömrünü ve yerel SHARED/BYSHARED'ı kapsıyor. BYREF'in üç motorda aynı çalışması bu adımın önkoşuluydu.

Kayıtlar `ai_koordinasyon/SORUN_TAKIP.md` dosyasında güncellendi. Bir de not: `--dump-ast` ve `--dump-mir` seçenekleri okunuyor ama hiçbir dosya üretmiyor.

' uxraylib raymath core (S-052, raylib Models/3D dilimi 1). CPU only: no window or GL context is needed.
'
' Vector2/3/4 and Quaternion RESULTS are read from result registers: ResX/ResY/ResZ/ResW read register 0 (every plain
' result); functions with several results also fill registers 1 and 2 (read with ResGet(register, component 0..3)).
' A Matrix is a HANDLE (I32; 0 = invalid). Every function that produces a matrix returns a NEW handle: release it with
' MatrixRelease (MatrixLiveCount shows how many are still open). An invalid handle behaves as the identity matrix and
' MathLastError() becomes 1 (2 = handle pool full, 3 = bad vector slot); MathClearError() resets it.
' Matrix element index 0..15 follows raylib's field order (m0 m4 m8 m12 / m1 m5 m9 m13 / ...): the element in row r,
' column c has index c * 4 + r.
NAMESPACE uxraylib

FUNCTION ResGet(reg AS I32, component AS I32) AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_res_get", F64, CDECL, "I32,I32", reg, component)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION ResX() AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_res_x", F64, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION ResY() AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_res_y", F64, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION ResZ() AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_res_z", F64, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION ResW() AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_res_w", F64, CDECL)
END FUNCTION

' Vector slots (0..7) feed the functions whose arguments would exceed the 10-value CALL(DLL) limit.
SUB VectorSlotSet(slot AS I32, x AS F64, y AS F64, z AS F64, w AS F64)
    CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_vector_slot_set", VOID, CDECL, "I32,F64,F64,F64,F64", slot, x, y, z, w)
END SUB

FUNCTION MathLastError() AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_math_last_error", I32, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
SUB MathClearError()
    CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_math_clear_error", VOID, CDECL)
END SUB

SUB MatrixRelease(handle AS I32)
    CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_release", VOID, CDECL, "I32", handle)
END SUB
FUNCTION MatrixLiveCount() AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_live_count", I32, CDECL)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION MatrixCopy(handle AS I32) AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_copy", I32, CDECL, "I32", handle)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION MatrixElement(handle AS I32, index AS I32) AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_element", F64, CDECL, "I32,I32", handle, index)
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION MatrixSetElement(handle AS I32, index AS I32, value AS F64) AS I32
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_set_element", I32, CDECL, "I32,I32,F64", handle, index, value)
END FUNCTION
' The element in ROW row, COLUMN col (both 0..3).
FUNCTION MatrixAt(handle AS I32, row AS I32, col AS I32) AS F64
    RETURN CALL(DLL, "uxraylib.dll", "uxraylib_matrix_element", F64, CDECL, "I32,I32", handle, col * 4 + row)
END FUNCTION

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""uxraylib raymath sarmalayici uretici (S-052, raylib Models/3D dilimi 1: CPU-tarafi matematik).

raymath.h'nin `RMAPI` islevlerini okur ve iki dosya uretir:
  runtime_ext/uxraylib/uxraylib_math.inc      C (uxraylib_adapter.c icinden #include edilir)
  libsx/uxraylib/uxraylib_math.bas            uXBasic `NAMESPACE uxraylib` sarmalayicilari

Sozlesme (uXBasic CALL(DLL) yalniz sayi/isaretci tasir, yapi degil):
  * float/double        -> F64 (C tarafinda float'a daralir; raylib float kullanir)
  * int                 -> I32
  * Vector2/3/4, Quaternion -> bilesenlere acilir: v1x, v1y[, v1z[, v1w]] (F64)
  * Matrix              -> I32 MATRIS TUTAMACI (0 = gecersiz). Matris ureten her islev YENI bir tutamac doner;
                           isi biten tutamac MatrixRelease ile birakilir.
  * Vector/Quaternion sonucu -> islev bir SUB'dur; sonuc "kayit"ta (register 0) durur: ResX/ResY/ResZ/ResW.
    Birden cok sonuc ureten islevler kayit 1 ve 2'yi de doldurur (ResGet(kayit, bilesen)).
  * 10 argumani asan islevler (Vector3CubicHermite/Barycenter, QuaternionCubicHermiteSpline) "yuva" varyanti ile
    sunulur: VectorSlotSet(yuva, x, y, z, w) ile girdiler yuvalara yazilir, islev yuva numaralariyla cagrilir.

Kullanim: python tools/library_tools/gen_uxraylib_math.py --root . [--raymath C:\\msys64\\ucrt64\\include\\raymath.h]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import re
from pathlib import Path

HEADER_DEFAULT = r"C:\msys64\ucrt64\include\raymath.h"

SIG_RE = re.compile(r"^RMAPI\s+(?P<ret>[A-Za-z0-9_ ]+?)\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z0-9_]+)\((?P<args>[^)]*)\)\s*$")

VEC_COMPONENTS = {"Vector2": 2, "Vector3": 3, "Vector4": 4, "Quaternion": 4}
SCALAR = {"float", "double"}

# uXBasic anahtar sozcugu (S-128) ya da anlam karisikligi yaratan parametre adlari
PARAM_RENAME = {
    "start": "begin", "end": "finish", "sub": "amount", "left": "leftEdge", "right": "rightEdge",
    "top": "topEdge", "bottom": "bottomEdge", "min": "minValue", "max": "maxValue",
    "from": "fromVec", "to": "toVec", "add": "addend", "mul": "factor", "sub_": "amount",
    "in": "input", "out": "output", "step": "stepValue", "mat": "matrix", "x": "x", "y": "y", "z": "z",
}
176:     (root / "runtime_ext/uxraylib/uxraylib_math.inc").write_text("\n".join(c_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
177:     (root / "libsx/uxraylib/uxraylib_math.bas").write_text("\n".join(b_lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

@echo off

    uxraylib.MatrixRelease(a)
    uxraylib.MatrixRelease(b)

    uxraylib.MatrixRelease(a)
    uxraylib.MatrixRelease(b)
    uxraylib.MatrixRelease(b)
    PRINT "live2 "; uxraylib.MatrixLiveCount()

Private Function X64CodegenAssembleOutput(ByRef cg As X64CodegenContext, ByRef asmText As String) As Integer
    asmText = cg.textSection

    If Len(cg.dataSection) > 0 Then
        asmText &= Chr(10) & "section .data" & Chr(10) & cg.dataSection
    End If

    If Len(cg.bssSection) > 0 Then
        asmText &= Chr(10) & "section .bss" & Chr(10) & cg.bssSection
    End If

    asmText = X64CompactBlankLines(asmText)

    Return 1
End Function

Private Function GenerateX64Code(ByRef ps As ParseState, ByRef outputText As String, ByRef errText As String) As Integer
    outputText = ""
    errText = ""

    If ps.rootNode < 0 Or ps.rootNode >= ps.ast.count Then
        errText = "x64-codegen: AST root is missing"
        Return 0
    End If

    ' S-140: constants (STRING/F64/namespace/routine-local included) become their values at every use.
    X64InlineConstants ps

    Dim cg As X64CodegenContext
    cg.textSection = ""
    cg.dataSection = ""
    cg.bssSection = ""
    cg.currentRoutineLabel = ""
    cg.labelSeed = 0
    cg.symbolCount = 0
    cg.globalCount = 0
    cg.loopDepth = 0
    VarMappingInit(cg.localVars)
    cg.localCount = 0
    cg.localFrameBytes = 0
    cg.paramCount = 0
    cg.currentEpilogLabel = ""
    cg.currentRoutineIsFunction = 0
    cg.routineCount = 0

    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 0 To 4095
        gX64SymbolKeys(i) = ""
        gX64SymbolLabels(i) = ""
        gX64GlobalKeys(i) = ""
        gX64GlobalLabels(i) = ""
        gX64GlobalSlots(i) = 0
    Next i

    For i = 0 To 255
        gX64LoopVars(i) = ""
        gX64LoopStartLabels(i) = ""
        gX64LoopEndLabels(i) = ""
        gX64LoopStepLabels(i) = ""
        gX64LoopLimitLabels(i) = ""
        gX64IfEndLabels(i) = ""
        gX64TryTargetLabels(i) = ""
        gX64ParamNames(i) = ""
        gX64ParamTypes(i) = ""
    Next i
    gX64IfDepth = 0
    gX64TryDepth = 0
    gX64TryFrameDepth = 0

    For i = 0 To 1023
        gX64RoutineKeys(i) = ""
        gX64RoutineArgCounts(i) = 0
        gX64RoutineIsFunction(i) = 0
        gX64RoutineReturnTypes(i) = ""
        Dim paramTypeReset As Integer
        For paramTypeReset = 0 To 63
            gX64RoutineParamTypes(i, paramTypeReset) = ""
        Next paramTypeReset
    Next i
