# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
uXBasic derin kod analizcisi  (uxb_kod_analiz.py)

Amaç: .fbs / .bas / .bi / .inc / .uxmh / .uxb kaynaklarının tamamından, doğrulanabilir biçimde
  - her rutinin (FUNCTION, SUB, CONSTRUCTOR, DESTRUCTOR, PROPERTY, OPERATOR, METHOD) imzasını, girdisini, çıktısını,
    yerel değişkenlerini, çağırdığı rutinleri, okuduğu/yazdığı global değişkenleri, kullandığı tipleri;
  - her TYPE / UNION / ENUM / CLASS / INTERFACE'in alanlarını, metotlarını, miras zincirini;
  - global değişken ve sabitleri, makroları;
  - dosyalar arası #include ağını (döngüler, katmanlar), rutinler arası çağrı ağını;
  - SELECT CASE ve IF/ELSEIF zincirlerinden oluşan karar tablolarını
çıkarır; rutin/modül amaçlarını varsa ajan_paketi önbelleklerinden ekler.

Kaynak koda DOKUNMAZ; yalnız okur. Çıktı: <çalışma ağacı>\\reports\\uxb_kod_analiz\\<tarih_saat>\\
Sınırlar (bilerek, raporda da yazılı): satır tabanlı çözümleme (tam bir derleyici ayrıştırıcısı değil); koşullu
derleme (#if) dallarının hepsi çözümlenir; çağrılar ada göre çözülür (aşırı yüklemede adaylar listelenir);
ByRef argümanla dolaylı yazma ve işaretçi takma adları izlenmez.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import collections
import csv
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

WORKSPACE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
V4 = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
BASIC_EXTS = {".fbs", ".bas", ".bi", ".inc", ".fb", ".uxmh", ".uxb"}
SKIP_DIRS = {"bin", "build", "dist", ".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", ".venv", "venv", "index", "logs", "reports"}
DEFAULT_ROOTS = ["uxb/src", "uxb/include", "uxb/libsx", "uxb/compiler"]
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024
ROUTINE_KINDS = ("function", "sub", "constructor", "destructor", "property", "operator", "method")
TYPE_KINDS = ("type", "union", "enum", "class", "interface")

sys.setrecursionlimit(20000)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Sözcük (lexical) katman: yorum/metin ayıklama, satır birleştirme
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def scan_line(line: str, in_block: bool):
    """Bir fiziksel satırı tarar. Döner: (kod, maske, yorum, blok_yorumda_mı).
    maske = kod ile aynı uzunluk; metin sabitlerinin içi '_' ile doldurulur (tırnaklar korunur)."""
    code, mask, comment = [], [], []
    i, n = 0, len(line)
    in_str = False
    esc_str = False
    while i < n:
        c = line[i]
        if in_block:
            j = line.find("'/", i)
            if j < 0:
                comment.append(line[i:])
                i = n
                break
            comment.append(line[i:j])
            i = j + 2
            in_block = False
            code.append(" ")
            mask.append(" ")
            continue
        if in_str:
            if esc_str and c == "\\" and i + 1 < n:
                code.append(c + line[i + 1])
                mask.append("__")
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == '"':
                if i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == '"':
                    code.append('""')
                    mask.append("__")
                    i += 2
                    continue
                in_str = False
                code.append(c)
                mask.append('"')
            else:
                code.append(c)
                mask.append("_")
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == '"':
            in_str = True
            esc_str = i > 0 and line[i - 1] == "!" and (i < 2 or not (line[i - 2].isalnum() or line[i - 2] == "_"))
            code.append(c)
            mask.append(c)
            i += 1
            continue
        if c == "'":
            comment.append(line[i + 1:])
            i = n
            break
        if c == "/" and i + 1 < n and line[i + 1] == "'":
            in_block = True
            i += 2
            continue
        code.append(c)
        mask.append(c)
        i += 1
    cm = " ".join(x.strip() for x in comment if x.strip())
    return "".join(code), "".join(mask), cm, in_block


class LL:
    """Mantıksal satır (devam satırları birleşmiş)."""
    __slots__ = ("no", "end", "code", "mask", "trail", "doc")

    def __init__(self, no, end, code, mask, trail, doc):
        self.no, self.end, self.code, self.mask, self.trail, self.doc = no, end, code, mask, trail, doc


def lex_file(text: str):
    """Döner: (mantıksal satırlar, dosya başlık yorumu)."""
    phys = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").split("\n")
    in_block = False
    out: list[LL] = []
    cmt_run: list[str] = []
    header: list[str] = []
    seen_code = False
    cont = None  # [no, code, mask, trail, doc]
    cont_re = re.compile(r"(^|\s)_\s*$")
    for idx, line in enumerate(phys, start=1):
        code, mask, cm, in_block = scan_line(line, in_block)
        if re.match(r"(?i)^\s*rem(\s|$)", mask):
            cm = (cm + " " + code.strip()[3:].strip()).strip()
            code, mask = "", ""
        has_code = bool(mask.strip())
        if cont is None:
            if not has_code:
                if cm:
                    cmt_run.append(cm)
                    if not seen_code and len(header) < 14:
                        header.append(cm)
                else:
                    cmt_run = []
                continue
            seen_code = True
            cont = [idx, "", "", [], cmt_run]
            cmt_run = []
        else:
            if not has_code:
                # devam satırından sonra boş/yorum satırı: mantıksal satırı bitir
                out.append(LL(cont[0], idx - 1, cont[1], cont[2], " ".join(cont[3]), cont[4]))
                cont = None
                if cm:
                    cmt_run.append(cm)
                else:
                    cmt_run = []
                continue
        cflag = bool(cont_re.search(mask))
        if cflag:
            k = mask.rstrip().rfind("_")
            code = code[:k] + " " + code[k + 1:]
            mask = mask[:k] + " " + mask[k + 1:]
        cont[1] += code + " "
        cont[2] += mask + " "
        if cm:
            cont[3].append(cm)
        if not cflag:
            out.append(LL(cont[0], idx, cont[1], cont[2], " ".join(cont[3]), cont[4]))
            cont = None
    if cont is not None:
        out.append(LL(cont[0], len(phys), cont[1], cont[2], " ".join(cont[3]), cont[4]))
    return out, header


def split_stmts(code: str, mask: str):
    """':' ile (parantez dışında) deyimlere böler. Döner: [(ham, maske, ':' ile mi bitti)]"""
    parts = []
    depth = 0
    start = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(mask):
        if c == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif c == ")":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
        elif c == ":" and depth == 0:
            parts.append((code[start:i], mask[start:i], True))
            start = i + 1
    parts.append((code[start:], mask[start:], False))
    return [(a.strip(), b.strip(), f) for a, b, f in parts if b.strip()]


def split_top(raw: str, mask: str, sep: str = ","):
    """Üst düzey ayırıcıdan böler (parantez, süslü parantez ve <> içi korunur)."""
    res = []
    depth = 0
    start = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(mask):
        if c in "({[":
            depth += 1
        elif c in ")}]":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
        elif c == sep and depth == 0:
            res.append((raw[start:i], mask[start:i]))
            start = i + 1
    res.append((raw[start:], mask[start:]))
    return res


def match_paren(mask: str, open_idx: int) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for i in range(open_idx, len(mask)):
        if mask[i] == "(":
            depth += 1
        elif mask[i] == ")":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i
    return -1


def squash(s: str, limit: int = 0) -> str:
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    if limit and len(s) > limit:
        s = s[: limit - 1] + "…"
    return s


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Bildirim çözümleyiciler: parametreler, değişkenler, başlıklar
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RE_PARAM = re.compile(
    r"(?i)^(?:(byval|byref|bydesc)\s+)?(?:(optional)\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(\(\s*\))?\s*(?:as\s+(.+?))?\s*(?:=\s*(.+))?$"
)


def parse_params(raw: str, mask: str):
    res = []
    for pr, pm in split_top(raw, mask):
        t = pr.strip()
        if not t:
            continue
        if t == "...":
            res.append({"name": "...", "mode": "", "type": "", "default": "", "array": False, "raw": t})
            continue
        m = RE_PARAM.match(t)
        if m:
            res.append(
                {
                    "name": m.group(3),
                    "mode": (m.group(1) or "").upper(),
                    "type": squash(m.group(5) or ""),
                    "default": squash(m.group(6) or ""),
                    "array": bool(m.group(4)),
                    "raw": t,
                }
            )
        else:
            res.append({"name": t, "mode": "", "type": "", "default": "", "array": False, "raw": t})
    return res


RE_HEAD = re.compile(
    r"(?i)^(?P<pre>(?:(?:public|private|protected|static|virtual|abstract|override|export|inline|overload|friend)\s+)*)"
    r"(?P<decl>declare\s+)?"
    r"(?P<mid>(?:(?:public|private|protected|static|virtual|abstract|override|export|inline|overload)\s+)*)"
    r"(?P<kind>function|sub|constructor|destructor|property|operator|method)\b(?P<rest>.*)$"
)
RE_NAME = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*)")
RE_OPNAME = re.compile(r"^\s*(?P<name>[^\s\(\w][^\s\(]*|[A-Za-z_]\w*)")


def parse_header(raw: str, mask: str):
    """Rutin başlığını çözer. Başlık değilse None."""
    m = RE_HEAD.match(mask)
    if not m:
        return None
    kind = m.group("kind").lower()
    mods = (m.group("pre") + m.group("mid")).split()
    # rest: ham metinde aynı konumdan
    rest_start = m.start("rest")
    rest_raw = raw[rest_start:]
    rest_mask = mask[rest_start:]
    nm = (RE_OPNAME if kind == "operator" else RE_NAME).match(rest_mask)
    if not nm:
        return None
    name = re.sub(r"\s+", "", nm.group("name"))
    if kind != "operator" and not re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_]", name):
        return None
    after_raw = rest_raw[nm.end():]
    after_mask = rest_mask[nm.end():]
    # 'Function = deger' (dönüş atama) başlık değildir
    if kind != "operator" and re.match(r"^\s*=", after_mask):
        return None
    container = ""
    if "." in name:
        container, name = name.rsplit(".", 1)
    p = after_mask.find("(")
    params = []
    tail_raw, tail_mask = after_raw, after_mask
    pre_raw = after_raw
    if p >= 0:
        q = match_paren(after_mask, p)
        if q < 0:
            q = len(after_mask) - 1
        params = parse_params(after_raw[p + 1:q], after_mask[p + 1:q])
        pre_raw = after_raw[:p]
        tail_raw, tail_mask = after_raw[q + 1:], after_mask[q + 1:]
    lib = re.search(r'(?i)\blib\s+"([^"]*)"', pre_raw)
    alias = re.search(r'(?i)\balias\s+"([^"]*)"', pre_raw)
    conv = re.search(r"(?i)\b(cdecl|stdcall|pascal|fastcall|thiscall)\b", pre_raw + " " + tail_raw)
    ret = ""
    rm = re.match(
        r"(?is)^\s*as\s+(.+?)(?:\s+(?:static|export|cdecl|stdcall|pascal|alias|lib|overload|constref)\b.*)?$",
        tail_raw.strip(),
    )
    if rm:
        ret = squash(rm.group(1))
    return {
        "kind": kind.upper(),
        "name": name,
        "container": container,
        "proto": bool(m.group("decl")),
        "mods": [x.upper() for x in mods],
        "params": params,
        "ret": ret,
        "lib": lib.group(1) if lib else "",
        "alias": alias.group(1) if alias else "",
        "conv": conv.group(1).upper() if conv else "",
    }


RE_DECL_START = re.compile(
    r"(?i)^(?:(?:public|private|protected)\s+)?(?P<flags>(?:(?:dim|static|const|var|redim|common|extern|shared|preserve|export|local)\s+)+)"
)


def _first_top_char(mask: str, ch: str) -> int:
    depth = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(mask):
        if c in "({[":
            depth += 1
        elif c in ")}]":
            depth = max(0, depth - 1)
        elif c == ch and depth == 0:
            prev = mask[i - 1] if i else ""
            nxt = mask[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(mask) else ""
            if prev in "<>!" or nxt in "=<>":
                continue
            return i
    return -1


def _name_dims_type_init(seg_raw: str, seg_mask: str, inherited_type: str = ""):
    """'ad(dims) As tip = ilk' parçasını çözer."""
    mm = re.match(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", seg_mask)
    if not mm:
        return None
    name = mm.group(1)
    pos = mm.end()
    dims = ""
    rest_mask = seg_mask[pos:]
    rest_raw = seg_raw[pos:]
    st = rest_mask.lstrip()
    if st.startswith("("):
        off = len(rest_mask) - len(st)
        q = match_paren(rest_mask, off)
        if q > 0:
            dims = squash(rest_raw[off + 1:q])
            rest_mask = rest_mask[q + 1:]
            rest_raw = rest_raw[q + 1:]
    typ = inherited_type
    init = ""
    eq = _first_top_char(rest_mask, "=")
    left_raw, left_mask = (rest_raw, rest_mask) if eq < 0 else (rest_raw[:eq], rest_mask[:eq])
    if eq >= 0:
        init = squash(rest_raw[eq + 1:], 160)
    tm = re.match(r"(?is)^\s*as\s+(.+?)\s*$", left_raw)
    if tm:
        typ = squash(tm.group(1))
    return {"name": name, "type": typ, "dims": dims, "init": init}


def parse_declarators(raw: str, mask: str, flags_known: bool = True):
    """Dim/Static/Const/Var/Redim/Common satırlarını çözer. Döner: (bayraklar, [bildirim])"""
    m = RE_DECL_START.match(mask)
    flags = set()
    pos = 0
    if m:
        flags = {x.lower() for x in m.group("flags").split()}
        pos = m.end()
    body_raw, body_mask = raw[pos:], mask[pos:]
    segs = split_top(body_raw, body_mask)
    res = []
    inherited = ""
    for i, (sr, sm) in enumerate(segs):
        if not sm.strip():
            continue
        if i == 0 and re.match(r"(?i)^\s*as\s+", sm):
            # 'As Tip ad1, ad2 = 3' biçimi: tip önde
            eq = _first_top_char(sm, "=")
            left_raw, left_mask = (sr, sm) if eq < 0 else (sr[:eq], sm[:eq])
            tail = re.sub(r"(?i)^\s*as\s+", "", left_raw)
            tmask = re.sub(r"(?i)^\s*as\s+", "", left_mask)
            dims = ""
            tm = tmask.rstrip()
            if tm.endswith(")"):
                depth = 0
                for k in range(len(tm) - 1, -1, -1):
                    if tm[k] == ")":
                        depth += 1
                    elif tm[k] == "(":
                        depth -= 1
                        if depth == 0:
                            dims = squash(tail.rstrip()[k + 1:-1])
                            tail = tail.rstrip()[:k]
                            tmask = tm[:k]
                            break
            words = tail.split()
            if len(words) < 2:
                continue
            nm = words[-1]
            inherited = squash(" ".join(words[:-1]))
            init = squash(sr[eq + 1:], 160) if eq >= 0 else ""
            res.append({"name": nm, "type": inherited, "dims": dims, "init": init})
            continue
        d = _name_dims_type_init(sr, sm, inherited)
        if d:
            if d["type"] and not inherited and i == 0 and False:
                inherited = d["type"]
            res.append(d)
    return flags, res


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Birinci geçiş: dosya yapısı (ad alanı, tip, rutin, bildirimler)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RE_PRE_INCLUDE = re.compile(r'(?i)^#\s*include(?:\s+once)?\s+["<]([^">]+)[">]')
RE_INCLUDE2 = re.compile(r'(?i)^include(?:\s+once)?\s+"([^"]+)"')
RE_DEFINE = re.compile(r"(?i)^#\s*(define|macro)\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)(\([^)]*\))?\s*(.*)$")
RE_NS = re.compile(r"(?i)^namespace\s+([A-Za-z_][\w\.]*)")
RE_TYPEHEAD = re.compile(
    r"(?i)^(?:(?:public|private)\s+)?(?P<kind>type|union|enum|class|interface)\b\s*(?P<name>[A-Za-z_]\w*)?(?P<rest>.*)$"
)
RE_END = re.compile(
    r"(?i)^end\s+(function|sub|constructor|destructor|property|operator|method|type|union|enum|class|interface|namespace|extern|asm)\b"
)
RE_ACCESS = re.compile(r"(?i)^(public|private|protected)\s*:?\s*$")


class FileModel:
    def __init__(self, rel: str):
        self.rel = rel
        self.header: list[str] = []
        self.lines = 0
        self.includes: list[dict] = []
        self.routines: list[dict] = []
        self.types: list[dict] = []
        self.vars: list[dict] = []  # modül düzeyi değişken/sabit
        self.macros: list[dict] = []
        self.mainbody: list[tuple] = []
        self.diag: list[str] = []
        self.namespaces: set[str] = set()


def new_routine(fm: FileModel, h: dict, ll: LL, ns: list[str], container_default: str, access: str):
    r = {
        "id": None,
        "kind": h["kind"],
        "name": h["name"],
        "ns": ".".join(ns),
        "container": h["container"] or container_default,
        "file": fm.rel,
        "line": ll.no,
        "end_line": ll.end,
        "proto": h["proto"],
        "mods": h["mods"],
        "access": access,
        "lib": h["lib"],
        "alias": h["alias"],
        "conv": h["conv"],
        "params": h["params"],
        "ret": h["ret"],
        "doc": ll.doc[-6:],
        "trail": ll.trail,
        "body": [],
        "body_doc": [],
    }
    return r


def parse_structure(rel: str, text: str) -> FileModel:
    fm = FileModel(rel)
    lls, header = lex_file(text)
    fm.header = header
    fm.lines = text.count("\n") + 1
    ns: list[str] = []
    type_stack: list[dict] = []  # çalışan tip/sınıf kayıtları
    anon = 0
    cur: dict | None = None
    in_asm = False
    in_macro = False
    extern_depth = 0
    access = ""
    for ll in lls:
        stmts = split_stmts(ll.code, ll.mask)
        first = True
        for raw, mask, colon in stmts:
            doc = ll.doc if first else []
            first = False
            low = mask.lower()
            # makro gövdesini atla
            if in_macro:
                if re.match(r"(?i)^#\s*endmacro", mask):
                    in_macro = False
                continue
            # --- rutin gövdesi içinde ---
            if cur is not None:
                em = RE_END.match(mask)
                if in_asm:
                    if em and em.group(1).lower() == "asm":
                        in_asm = False
                    continue
                if em:
                    k = em.group(1).lower()
                    if k.upper() == cur["kind"]:
                        cur["end_line"] = ll.end
                        cur = None
                        continue
                    if k in ROUTINE_KINDS:
                        fm.diag.append(f"{ll.no}: 'End {k}' ama açık rutin {cur['kind']} {cur['name']} (satır {cur['line']})")
                        cur["end_line"] = ll.end
                        cur = None
                        continue
                    if k == "asm":
                        continue
                if re.match(r"(?i)^asm\b", mask) and not re.match(r"(?i)^asm\s*\(", mask):
                    in_asm = True
                    continue
                h = parse_header(raw, mask)
                if h and not h["proto"] and h["kind"] in {x.upper() for x in ROUTINE_KINDS}:
                    # yeni başlık: öncekinin END'i eksik
                    fm.diag.append(f"{ll.no}: {cur['kind']} {cur['name']} (satır {cur['line']}) END'siz; yeni başlık geldi")
                    cur["end_line"] = ll.no - 1
                    cur = None
                else:
                    if not cur["body_doc"] and doc and not cur["body"]:
                        cur["body_doc"] = doc[-4:]
                    cur["body"].append((ll.no, raw, mask))
                    continue
            # --- önişlemci ---
            if mask.startswith("#"):
                im = RE_PRE_INCLUDE.match(raw)
                if im:
                    fm.includes.append({"line": ll.no, "target": im.group(1)})
                    continue
                dm = RE_DEFINE.match(raw)
                if dm:
                    fm.macros.append(
                        {
                            "kind": dm.group(1).upper(),
                            "name": dm.group(2),
                            "args": dm.group(3) or "",
                            "body": squash(dm.group(4), 120),
                            "file": rel,
                            "line": ll.no,
                            "cmt": squash(ll.trail or " ".join(doc[-2:]), 100),
                        }
                    )
                    if dm.group(1).lower() == "macro":
                        in_macro = True
                    continue
                continue
            i2 = RE_INCLUDE2.match(raw)
            if i2:
                fm.includes.append({"line": ll.no, "target": i2.group(1)})
                continue
            # --- ad alanı ---
            nm = RE_NS.match(mask)
            if nm and not type_stack:
                ns.append(nm.group(1))
                fm.namespaces.add(".".join(ns))
                continue
            em = RE_END.match(mask)
            if em:
                k = em.group(1).lower()
                if k == "namespace":
                    if ns:
                        ns.pop()
                    continue
                if k == "extern":
                    extern_depth = max(0, extern_depth - 1)
                    continue
                if k in TYPE_KINDS:
                    if anon > 0 and k in ("union", "type"):
                        anon -= 1
                    elif type_stack:
                        t = type_stack.pop()
                        t["end_line"] = ll.end
                        access = ""
                    continue
                continue
            # --- tip bloğu içinde ---
            if type_stack:
                t = type_stack[-1]
                if anon == 0 or True:
                    if re.match(r"(?i)^(union|type)\s*$", mask):
                        anon += 1
                        continue
                am = RE_ACCESS.match(mask)
                if am:
                    access = am.group(1).upper()
                    continue
                h = parse_header(raw, mask)
                if h:
                    r = new_routine(fm, h, ll, ns, t["name"], access or "")
                    r["doc"] = doc[-6:]
                    r["kind"] = "METHOD" if r["kind"] in ("FUNCTION", "SUB", "PROPERTY", "OPERATOR") else r["kind"]
                    r["orig_kind"] = h["kind"]
                    fm.routines.append(r)
                    t["methods"].append(r)
                    if not r["proto"]:
                        cur = r
                    continue
                if t["kind"] == "ENUM":
                    for pr, pm in split_top(raw, mask):
                        mm = re.match(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:=\s*(.+))?$", pr.strip())
                        if mm:
                            t["members"].append(
                                {"name": mm.group(1), "value": squash(mm.group(2) or "", 80), "line": ll.no,
                                 "cmt": squash(ll.trail or " ".join(doc[-1:]), 100)}
                            )
                    continue
                if re.match(r"(?i)^(dim|static|const|var|as|[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*(\(|as\b))", mask) or re.match(
                    r"(?i)^(public|private|protected)\s+\w", mask
                ):
                    flags, decls = parse_declarators(re.sub(r"(?i)^(public|private|protected)\s+", "", raw),
                                                     re.sub(r"(?i)^(public|private|protected)\s+", "", mask))
                    for d in decls:
                        t["fields"].append(
                            {"name": d["name"], "type": d["type"], "dims": d["dims"], "init": d["init"],
                             "access": access, "static": "static" in flags, "const": "const" in flags,
                             "line": ll.no, "cmt": squash(ll.trail or " ".join(doc[-2:]), 140)}
                        )
                    continue
                continue
            # --- tip başlığı ---
            tm = RE_TYPEHEAD.match(mask)
            if tm and (tm.group("name") or tm.group("kind").lower() in ("enum", "union", "type")):
                kind = tm.group("kind").upper()
                name = tm.group("name") or ""
                rest_mask = tm.group("rest")
                # 'Type X As Y' / 'Type X As Function(...)' = takma ad (blok açmaz)
                if re.match(r"(?i)^\s+as\b", rest_mask):
                    fm.types.append(
                        {"id": None, "kind": "ALIAS", "name": name, "ns": ".".join(ns), "file": rel, "line": ll.no,
                         "end_line": ll.end, "extends": "", "implements": [], "doc": doc[-6:], "trail": ll.trail,
                         "fields": [], "methods": [], "members": [], "alias_of": squash(re.sub(r"(?i)^\s+as\s+", "", raw[tm.start("rest"):]), 160)}
                    )
                    continue
                if not name:
                    anon_hdr = True
                ext = re.search(r"(?i)\bextends\s+([A-Za-z_][\w\.]*)", rest_mask)
                imp = re.search(r"(?i)\bimplements\s+(.+)$", rest_mask)
                t = {
                    "id": None, "kind": kind, "name": name, "ns": ".".join(ns), "file": rel, "line": ll.no,
                    "end_line": ll.end, "extends": ext.group(1) if ext else "",
                    "implements": [x.strip() for x in imp.group(1).split(",")] if imp else [],
                    "doc": doc[-6:], "trail": ll.trail, "fields": [], "methods": [], "members": [], "alias_of": "",
                }
                fm.types.append(t)
                type_stack.append(t)
                access = ""
                continue
            # --- rutin başlığı ---
            h = parse_header(raw, mask)
            if h:
                r = new_routine(fm, h, ll, ns, "", "")
                r["doc"] = doc[-6:]
                fm.routines.append(r)
                if not r["proto"]:
                    cur = r
                continue
            # --- extern bloğu ---
            if re.match(r'(?i)^extern\s+"', mask):
                extern_depth += 1
                continue
            # --- modül düzeyi değişken / sabit ---
            if RE_DECL_START.match(mask):
                flags, decls = parse_declarators(raw, mask)
                for d in decls:
                    shared = bool(flags & {"shared", "common", "extern"})
                    fm.vars.append(
                        {"id": None, "name": d["name"], "type": d["type"], "dims": d["dims"], "init": d["init"],
                         "kind": "CONST" if "const" in flags else ("COMMON" if "common" in flags else
                                  ("EXTERN" if "extern" in flags else ("STATIC" if "static" in flags else "DIM"))),
                         "scope": "CONST" if "const" in flags else ("GLOBAL" if shared else "MODULE"),
                         "ns": ".".join(ns), "file": rel, "line": ll.no,
                         "cmt": squash(ll.trail or " ".join(doc[-2:]), 140)}
                    )
                continue
            # modül düzeyi çalıştırılabilir deyim
            fm.mainbody.append((ll.no, raw, mask))
    if cur is not None:
        fm.diag.append(f"EOF: {cur['kind']} {cur['name']} (satır {cur['line']}) END'siz kaldı")
        cur["end_line"] = lls[-1].end if lls else cur["line"]
    for t in type_stack:
        fm.diag.append(f"EOF: {t['kind']} {t['name']} (satır {t['line']}) END'siz kaldı")
    return fm


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. İkinci geçiş: gövde çözümlemesi (çağrılar, değişken kullanımı, karar tabloları)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RE_IDENT = re.compile(r"(?<![\w\.&$#])([A-Za-z_]\w*)")
RE_CALL = re.compile(r"(?<![\w\.&$#])([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(")
RE_QCALL = re.compile(r"(?<![\w\.&$#])([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\.\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*\(")
RE_ASSIGN = re.compile(
    r"(?is)^(?:let\s+)?(?P<lhs>[A-Za-z_]\w*)(?P<tail>(?:\s*\((?:[^()]|\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\))*\)|\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*|\s*->\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*)\s*"
    r"(?P<op>\+=|-=|\*=|/=|\\=|\^=|&=|<<=|>>=|=)(?![=])(?P<rhs>.*)$"
)
RE_DLL = re.compile(r'(?is)\bcall\s*\(\s*dll\s*,\s*"([^"]*)"\s*,\s*"([^"]*)"\s*,\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*,\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*(?:,(.*))?\)')
RE_THIS = re.compile(r"(?i)\bthis\s*\.\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)")


class Ctx:
    """Tüm dosyalardan derlenen ortak dizinler."""
    def __init__(self):
        self.routines: list[dict] = []
        self.types: list[dict] = []
        self.vars: list[dict] = []
        self.by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = collections.defaultdict(list)       # rutin adı -> kayıtlar
        self.methods_of: dict[str, dict[str, list[dict]]] = collections.defaultdict(lambda: collections.defaultdict(list))
        self.type_by_name: dict[str, dict] = {}
        self.global_by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = collections.defaultdict(list)
        self.namespaces: set[str] = set()


def rhs_assign_info(mask: str):
    m = RE_ASSIGN.match(mask)
    if not m:
        return None
    return m.group("lhs"), m.group("tail") or "", m.group("op"), m.group("rhs").strip()


def describe_case(c: dict) -> str:
    if c["calls"]:
        names = list(dict.fromkeys(c["calls"]))
        return "çağırır: " + ", ".join(names[:4]) + (" …" if len(names) > 4 else "")
    if c["returns"]:
        return "döndürür: " + squash(c["returns"][0], 60)
    if c["assigns"]:
        return "atar: " + squash(c["assigns"][0], 60)
    if c["stmts"]:
        return squash(c["stmts"][0], 70)
    return "(boş)"


def classify_table(cases: list[dict]) -> str:
    real = [c for c in cases if not c.get("else")]
    if not real:
        return "karışık"
    calls = sum(1 for c in real if c["calls"])
    maps = sum(1 for c in real if (c["returns"] or c["assigns"]) and not c["calls"])
    if calls >= 0.6 * len(real):
        return "yönlendirme (durum başına rutin çağırır)"
    if maps >= 0.6 * len(real):
        return "eşleme/dönüşüm (durum başına değer döndürür ya da atar)"
    return "karışık dallanma"


def analyze_body(r: dict, body: list[tuple], ctx: Ctx, known_ns: set[str], tables_out: list[dict], owner_label: str):
    """Rutin (ya da modül gövdesi) için yerel, çağrı, global kullanım ve karar tablosu bilgisini çıkarır."""
    r["locals"] = []
    local_names: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for p in r.get("params", []):
        local_names[p["name"].lower()] = {"type": p["type"], "param": True}
    # 1) bildirimler
    for (no, raw, mask) in body:
        if RE_DECL_START.match(mask):
            flags, decls = parse_declarators(raw, mask)
            for d in decls:
                if "redim" in flags and d["name"].lower() in local_names:
                    continue
                if d["name"].lower() in local_names and local_names[d["name"].lower()].get("param"):
                    continue
                rec = {"name": d["name"], "type": d["type"], "dims": d["dims"], "init": d["init"], "line": no,
                       "kind": "CONST" if "const" in flags else ("STATIC" if "static" in flags else "DIM"),
                       "shared": "shared" in flags}
                if "shared" in flags:
                    continue  # rutin içinde Dim Shared: global sayılır
                r["locals"].append(rec)
                local_names[d["name"].lower()] = {"type": d["type"], "param": False}
    # 2) analiz
    calls = collections.Counter()
    dll = []
    g_read: set[str] = set()
    g_write: set[str] = set()
    p_write: set[str] = set()
    p_ptr_write: set[str] = set()
    fields_read: set[str] = set()
    fields_write: set[str] = set()
    types_used: set[str] = set()
    ext_calls: collections.Counter = collections.Counter()
    amb_methods: collections.Counter = collections.Counter()
    decisions = 0
    stmt_count = 0
    returns = 0
    ret_assign = False
    frames: list[dict] = []
    byref_params = {p["name"].lower() for p in r.get("params", []) if p["mode"] == "BYREF" or p["array"]}
    param_names = {p["name"].lower() for p in r.get("params", [])}
    cont = r.get("container", "")
    my_name = r.get("name", "").lower()

    def active_cases():
        for fr in frames:
            if fr["kind"] in ("SELECT", "IF") and fr.get("cur") is not None:
                yield fr["cur"]

    def pop_to(kind: str):
        for k in range(len(frames) - 1, -1, -1):
            if frames[k]["kind"] == kind:
                popped = frames[k:]
                del frames[k:]
                for fr in reversed(popped):
                    if fr["kind"] in ("SELECT", "IF"):
                        finalize(fr)
                return

    def finalize(fr: dict):
        if fr["kind"] == "SELECT":
            cases = fr["cases"]
            if len(cases) >= 2:
                tables_out.append(
                    {"id": None, "kind": "SELECT_CASE", "subject": fr["sel"], "file": r["file"], "line": fr["line"],
                     "end_line": fr["end"], "owner": owner_label, "owner_id": r.get("id"),
                     "case_count": len([c for c in cases if not c.get("else")]),
                     "has_else": any(c.get("else") for c in cases),
                     "tur": classify_table(cases),
                     "cases": [{"label": c["label"], "line": c["line"], "action": describe_case(c),
                                "calls": list(dict.fromkeys(c["calls"])), "n": c["n"]} for c in cases]}
                )
        elif fr["kind"] == "IF":
            br = fr["branches"]
            if len(br) >= 3:
                subj = None
                ok = True
                for b in br:
                    if b["else"]:
                        continue
                    first = re.split(r"(?i)\s+(?:orelse|or)\s+", b["cond"])[0]
                    mm = re.match(r"^\s*(.+?)\s*(?:=|<>)\s*[^=<>]+$", first)
                    s = re.sub(r"\s+", "", mm.group(1)).lower() if mm else None
                    if s is None or (subj is not None and s != subj):
                        ok = False
                        break
                    subj = s
                if ok and subj:
                    tables_out.append(
                        {"id": None, "kind": "IF_ZINCIRI", "subject": squash(re.split(r"(?i)\s+(?:orelse|or)\s+",
                          [b for b in br if not b["else"]][0]["cond"])[0].split("=")[0].split("<>")[0], 60),
                         "file": r["file"], "line": fr["line"], "end_line": fr["end"], "owner": owner_label,
                         "owner_id": r.get("id"), "case_count": len([b for b in br if not b["else"]]),
                         "has_else": any(b["else"] for b in br), "tur": classify_table(br),
                         "cases": [{"label": ("ELSE" if b["else"] else squash(b["cond"], 70)), "line": b["line"],
                                    "action": describe_case(b), "calls": list(dict.fromkeys(b["calls"])), "n": b["n"]}
                                   for b in br]}
                    )

    def new_case(label: str, line: int, is_else: bool = False):
        return {"label": squash(label, 80), "cond": label, "line": line, "else": is_else, "calls": [], "returns": [],
                "assigns": [], "stmts": [], "n": 0}

    last_line = body[-1][0] if body else r.get("line", 0)
    for (no, raw, mask) in body:
        m = mask.strip()
        low = m.lower()
        stmt_count += 1
        # ---- yapı çerçeveleri ----
        structural = False
        if re.match(r"(?i)^select\s+case\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "SELECT", "sel": squash(raw[len(re.match(r"(?i)^select\s+case\s*", m).group(0)):], 80),
                           "line": no, "end": no, "cases": [], "cur": None})
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^case\b", m) and any(f["kind"] == "SELECT" for f in frames):
            fr = [f for f in frames if f["kind"] == "SELECT"][-1]
            label = raw[4:].strip()
            is_else = bool(re.match(r"(?i)^else\b", label))
            c = new_case(label, no, is_else)
            fr["cases"].append(c)
            fr["cur"] = c
            if not is_else:
                decisions += 1
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^end\s+select\b", m):
            for f in frames:
                if f["kind"] == "SELECT":
                    f["end"] = no
            pop_to("SELECT")
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^if\b", m):
            tm = re.search(r"(?i)\bthen\b", m)
            if tm:
                cond = raw[2:tm.start()].strip()
                tail = m[tm.end():].strip()
                decisions += 1
                if not tail:
                    c = new_case(cond, no)
                    c["if_kind"] = "if"
                    frames.append({"kind": "IF", "line": no, "end": no, "branches": [c], "cur": c})
                    structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^elseif\b", m) and any(f["kind"] == "IF" for f in frames):
            fr = [f for f in frames if f["kind"] == "IF"][-1]
            tm = re.search(r"(?i)\bthen\b", m)
            cond = raw[6:tm.start()].strip() if tm else raw[6:].strip()
            c = new_case(cond, no)
            fr["branches"].append(c)
            fr["cur"] = c
            decisions += 1
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^else\s*$", m) and any(f["kind"] == "IF" for f in frames):
            fr = [f for f in frames if f["kind"] == "IF"][-1]
            c = new_case("ELSE", no, True)
            fr["branches"].append(c)
            fr["cur"] = c
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^end\s+if\b", m):
            for f in frames:
                if f["kind"] == "IF":
                    f["end"] = no
            pop_to("IF")
            structural = True
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^for\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "FOR"})
            decisions += 1
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^next\b", m):
            pop_to("FOR")
            continue
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^do\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "DO"})
            decisions += 1
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^loop\b", m):
            pop_to("DO")
            continue
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^while\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "WHILE"})
            decisions += 1
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^wend\b", m):
            pop_to("WHILE")
            continue
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^try\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "TRY"})
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^end\s+try\b", m):
            pop_to("TRY")
            continue
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^with\b", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "WITH"})
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^end\s+with\b", m):
            pop_to("WITH")
            continue
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^scope\s*$", m):
            frames.append({"kind": "SCOPE"})
        elif re.match(r"(?i)^end\s+scope\b", m):
            pop_to("SCOPE")
            continue
        decisions += len(re.findall(r"(?i)\b(?:andalso|orelse)\b", m))
        if re.match(r"(?i)^return\b", m):
            returns += 1
        # ---- değişken kullanımı ----
        asg = rhs_assign_info(m)
        lhs = None
        if asg:
            lhs = asg[0].lower()
            if lhs == my_name and asg[1] == "" and r.get("kind") in ("FUNCTION", "PROPERTY", "OPERATOR"):
                ret_assign = True
        for_var = re.match(r"(?i)^for\s+([A-Za-z_]\w*)\s*=", m)
        write_roots: set[str] = set()
        ptr_roots: set[str] = set()
        if asg and not re.match(r"(?i)^(if|elseif|while|until|return|print|case|select|for|do|loop|dim|redim|static|const|var)\b", m):
            write_roots.add(lhs)
            if "->" in asg[1] or lhs in ("this",):
                ptr_roots.add(lhs)
            tailm = re.match(r"^\s*\.\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", asg[1])
            if lhs == "this" and tailm:
                fields_write.add(tailm.group(1).lower())
        if for_var:
            write_roots.add(for_var.group(1).lower())
        sw = re.match(r"(?i)^swap\s+(.+)$", m)
        if sw:
            for part, _ in split_top(sw.group(1), sw.group(1)):
                mm = re.match(r"^\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", part)
                if mm:
                    write_roots.add(mm.group(1).lower())
        rd = re.match(r"(?i)^(?:redim\s+(?:preserve\s+)?|erase\s+)([A-Za-z_]\w*)", m)
        if rd:
            write_roots.add(rd.group(1).lower())
        dp = re.match(r"^\*\s*\(?\s*([A-Za-z_]\w*)", m)
        if dp and asg is None and re.search(r"[^=<>]=[^=]", m):
            ptr_roots.add(dp.group(1).lower())
            write_roots.add(dp.group(1).lower())
        idents = {x.lower() for x in RE_IDENT.findall(m)}
        compound = asg is not None and asg[2] != "="
        for name in idents:
            is_local = name in local_names
            is_param_ = name in param_names
            if name in write_roots:
                if is_param_ and (name in byref_params or name in ptr_roots):
                    p_write.add(name)
                elif is_param_ and name in ptr_roots:
                    p_ptr_write.add(name)
                if not is_local and name in ctx.global_by_name:
                    g_write.add(name)
                if compound and not is_local and name in ctx.global_by_name:
                    g_read.add(name)
                if name in ptr_roots and is_param_:
                    p_ptr_write.add(name)
                continue
            if not is_local and name in ctx.global_by_name:
                g_read.add(name)
        # THIS.alan okumaları
        for fm_ in RE_THIS.findall(m):
            fields_read.add(fm_.lower())
        # ---- DLL çağrısı ----
        for dm in RE_DLL.finditer(raw):
            args = []
            tail = dm.group(5) or ""
            parts = [p.strip() for p, _ in split_top(tail, re.sub(r'"[^"]*"', lambda x: "_" * len(x.group(0)), tail))]
            for k in range(0, len(parts) - 1, 2):
                args.append({"type": parts[k].strip('"'), "value": squash(parts[k + 1], 40)})
            if len(parts) % 2 == 1 and parts and parts[0]:
                args.append({"type": "", "value": squash(parts[-1], 40)})
            dll.append({"lib": dm.group(1), "fn": dm.group(2), "ret": dm.group(3), "conv": dm.group(4), "args": args})
        # ---- çağrılar ----
        found_here: list[str] = []
        for q in RE_QCALL.finditer(m):
            a, b = q.group(1).lower(), q.group(2).lower()
            if a == "this" and cont:
                cand = resolve_method(ctx, cont, b)
                if cand:
                    calls[("M", cand["id"] if cand.get("id") else cand["name"])] += 1
                    found_here.append(cand["name"])
                else:
                    amb_methods[b] += 1
                continue
            if a in known_ns or any(k.lower() == a for k in known_ns):
                cands = [x for x in ctx.by_name.get(b, []) if x["ns"].lower().split(".")[-1] == a or x["ns"].lower() == a]
                if cands:
                    ids = pick_defs(cands)
                    for c in ids:
                        calls[("R", c["id"])] += 1
                    found_here.append(b)
                continue
            if a in local_names or a in ctx.global_by_name:
                ltype = (local_names.get(a, {}).get("type") or "").split()
                tname = ""
                if ltype:
                    tname = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(ptr|pointer|const)\b", "", " ".join(ltype)).strip().lower()
                if not tname and a in ctx.global_by_name:
                    gt = ctx.global_by_name[a][0]["type"]
                    tname = re.sub(r"(?i)\b(ptr|pointer|const)\b", "", gt).strip().lower()
                cand = resolve_method(ctx, tname, b) if tname else None
                if cand:
                    calls[("R", cand["id"])] += 1
                    found_here.append(cand["name"])
                else:
                    amb_methods[b] += 1
        for cm in RE_CALL.finditer(m):
            nm = cm.group(1).lower()
            if nm in local_names and local_names[nm].get("type") is not None and (nm not in ctx.by_name):
                continue
            if nm in local_names:
                continue  # yerel dizi indeksi
            cands = ctx.by_name.get(nm)
            if not cands:
                continue
            if nm == my_name and cm.start() == 0 and asg and asg[1] == "":
                continue
            ids = pick_defs(cands)
            for c in ids:
                calls[("R", c["id"])] += 1
                if c.get("proto") and c.get("lib"):
                    ext_calls[f"{c['lib']}!{c['alias'] or c['name']}"] += 1
            found_here.append(cands[0]["name"])
        # deyim başında parantezsiz SUB çağrısı
        sm_ = re.match(r"(?i)^(?:call\s+)?([A-Za-z_]\w*)(?=\s|$)", m)
        if sm_ and asg is None:
            nm = sm_.group(1).lower()
            if nm in ctx.by_name and nm not in local_names and nm not in ctx.global_by_name and not RE_CALL.match(m):
                for c in pick_defs(ctx.by_name[nm]):
                    calls[("R", c["id"])] += 1
                    if c.get("proto") and c.get("lib"):
                        ext_calls[f"{c['lib']}!{c['alias'] or c['name']}"] += 1
                found_here.append(ctx.by_name[nm][0]["name"])
        # ---- durum/dal gövdesine ekle ----
        if not structural:
            for c in active_cases():
                c["n"] += 1
                if len(c["stmts"]) < 6:
                    c["stmts"].append(raw)
                for f_ in found_here:
                    if f_ not in c["calls"]:
                        c["calls"].append(f_)
                rm = re.match(r"(?i)^return\b(.*)$", m)
                if rm:
                    c["returns"].append(raw[6:].strip() or "(değer yok)")
                elif asg and len(c["assigns"]) < 4:
                    c["assigns"].append(f"{asg[0]}{squash(asg[1])} {asg[2]} {squash(asg[3], 50)}")
    for fr in list(frames):
        if fr["kind"] in ("SELECT", "IF"):
            fr["end"] = last_line
            finalize(fr)
    r["decisions"] = decisions
    r["cc"] = 1 + decisions
    r["stmt_count"] = stmt_count
    r["returns"] = returns
    r["ret_assign"] = ret_assign
    r["calls_raw"] = calls
    r["dll"] = dll
    r["ext_calls"] = dict(ext_calls)
    r["amb_methods"] = dict(amb_methods)
    r["g_read"] = sorted(g_read - g_write | (g_read & g_write))
    r["g_write"] = sorted(g_write)
    r["p_write"] = sorted(p_write)
    r["fields_read"] = sorted(fields_read)
    r["fields_write"] = sorted(fields_write)
    # kullanılan tipler
    tn = set()
    texts = [p["type"] for p in r.get("params", [])] + [r.get("ret", "")] + [l["type"] for l in r["locals"]]
    for t in texts:
        for w in re.findall(r"[A-Za-z_]\w*", t or ""):
            if w.lower() in ctx.type_by_name:
                tn.add(ctx.type_by_name[w.lower()]["name"])
    r["types_used"] = sorted(tn)


def pick_defs(cands: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    defs = [c for c in cands if not c.get("proto")]
    return defs if defs else cands


def resolve_method(ctx: Ctx, container: str, name: str):
    """container (ve atalarında) name adlı metodu bul."""
    seen = set()
    cname = container.lower()
    while cname and cname not in seen:
        seen.add(cname)
        lst = ctx.methods_of.get(cname, {}).get(name.lower())
        if lst:
            defs = [x for x in lst if not x.get("proto")]
            return (defs or lst)[0]
        t = ctx.type_by_name.get(cname)
        cname = (t["extends"].lower() if t and t.get("extends") else "")
    return None
