ap.add_argument("--llm-yenile", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    pf.raise_to_background_priority()
    cfg = ayarlari_oku()
    src = pf.SourceCache()
    rows, _ = pf.load_inventory()
    files = sorted({r["file"] for r in rows})
    if args.paket_uret:
        idx = paketleri_uret(files, src)
        n_parca = len({v["parca"] for v in idx.values()})
        print(f"Paketler üretildi: {GONDERIM_DIR}  ({len(idx)} modül, {n_parca} parça txt)")
        return 0
    bag = Baglam(args, src, files)

    sec = (args.saglayici or cfg.get("UXB_VARSAYILAN_SAGLAYICI", "gemini")).lower()
    if sec == "zincir":
        zincir = [s.strip().lower() for s in cfg.get("UXB_ZINCIR", "gemini,gemini2,kimi,chatgpt,claude").split(",") if s.strip()]
    else:
        zincir = [sec]
    for s in zincir:
        if s not in SAGLAYICILAR:
            print(f"Bilinmeyen sağlayıcı '{s}'. Seçenekler: {', '.join(sorted(SAGLAYICILAR))}, zincir")
            return 2
    print(f"Anahtar dosyası: {ANAHTAR_DOSYASI}{'' if ANAHTAR_DOSYASI.exists() else ' — YOK'}   zincir: {' -> '.join(zincir)}", flush=True)

    jobs = ["amac", "modul"] if args.is_ == "hepsi" else [args.is_]
    if args.dry_run:
        for s in zincir:
            istemci_kur(s, cfg, args)
        for j in jobs:
            (amac_isleri if j == "amac" else modul_isleri)(args, None, bag)
        return 0

    for s in zincir:
        ist = istemci_kur(s, cfg, args)
        if ist is None:
            print(f"[{s}] anahtar yok, atlanıyor.", flush=True)
            continue
        bitti = True
        for j in jobs:
            try:
                n = (amac_isleri if j == "amac" else modul_isleri)(args, ist, bag)
                print(f"[{s}/{j}] bu çalıştırmada tamamlanan: {n}", flush=True)
            except ModelHata as e:
                dur_mesaji(f"{s}/{j}", e)
                bitti = False
                if e.kind == "SINIR":
                    print("Çalıştırma sınırı: durduruluyor.", flush=True)
                    return 0
                break  # KOTA / KALICI / GECICI -> zincirde sıradaki sağlayıcı kaldığı yerden devam eder
        if bitti:
            print(f"[{s}] tüm işler tamamlandı.", flush=True)
            break
    print("Bitti. Paketi yeniden kurmak için: python tools\\uxb_ajan_paketi.py", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
OpenClaw 'uxb' ajanının TEK komut aracı. Ajan işlerini yalnız bununla yapar (AGENTS.md kuralı).

  python uxb_ajan.py durum                      harita doldurma süreci, kotalar, bekleyen yamalar, son günlük
  python uxb_ajan.py harita-paketle             ajan paketini (rutinler.tsv, moduller, sss) yeniden kurar
  python uxb_ajan.py harita-doldur [--saglayici zincir|gemini|kimi|...]   eksik harita alanlarını doldurmayı başlatır (arka planda)
  python uxb_ajan.py sorunlar [--durum ACIK]    SORUN_TAKIP.md kayıtlarını listeler (numara, durum, başlık)
  python uxb_ajan.py sorun S-169                bir kaydın tam metni
  python uxb_ajan.py ara <Ad>                   harita: rutinin dosya:satır, amaç, imza (rutinler.tsv)
  python uxb_ajan.py sss <dosya-yolu>           bir modülün özeti + soru-cevapları
  python uxb_ajan.py yedek                      kaynak klasörlerinin zaman damgalı zip yedeği (UXBc\\yedekler)
  python uxb_ajan.py danis S-169 --dosya src/... [--dosya ...] [--not "..."]   Gemini/Kimi'den Yama Motoru emri (yalnız dry-run)
  python uxb_ajan.py uygula <çalışma-klasörü> --testler paket1,paket2          KORUMALI uygulama (taban/test/geri alma)
  python uxb_ajan.py gunluk                     OpenClaw yama günlüğünün son satırları
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
UXBC = HERE.parents[2]
UXB = UXBC / "uxb"
V4 = UXBC / "UxbRAG" / "UXB_HYBRID_RAG_V4_YORUMLU_JSON"
PKG = V4 / "ajan_paketi"
SORUN_TAKIP = UXB / "ai_koordinasyon" / "SORUN_TAKIP.md"
GUNLUK = UXB / "ai_koordinasyon" / "OPENCLAW_YAMA_GUNLUGU.md"
YEDEK_DIR = UXBC / "yedekler"
KAYNAK_KLASORLERI = ["src", "include", "libsx", "runtime_ext", "native", "tests", "compiler"]
ENV = {**os.environ, "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"}


def calistir(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None, timeout: int = 7200) -> int:
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None, env=ENV, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout or "")
    return p.returncode


def harita_sureci() -> list[str]:
    out = subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                          "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | "
                          "Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_harita_doldur.py*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_gunluk_zincir.py*' } | "
                          "ForEach-Object { \"$($_.ProcessId)\" }"], text=True, capture_output=True)
    return [x for x in out.stdout.split() if x.strip()]


def cmd_durum(_a) -> int:
    pids = harita_sureci()
    print(f"Harita doldurma süreci: {'ÇALIŞIYOR (PID ' + ', '.join(pids) + ')' if pids else 'çalışmıyor'}")
    logs = sorted((V4 / "logs").glob("harita_zincir_*.log"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
    if logs:
        lines = logs[-1].read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        print(f"Son günlük: {logs[-1].name}")
        for ln in lines[-4:]:
            print("   " + ln)
    for k in sorted((V4 / "logs").glob("kota_*.json")):
        print(f"Kota {k.stem[5:]}: {k.read_text(encoding='utf-8')}")
    kap = PKG / "kapsam.md"
    if kap.exists():
        for ln in kap.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[:16]:
            if ln.strip().startswith(("- ", "Paket", "Harita")):
                print("   " + ln.strip())
    bek = sorted((HERE / "yamalar").glob("*/SONUC.json"))
    uyg = {p.parent for p in (HERE / "yamalar").glob("*/UYGULAMA.json")}
    for s in bek:
        if s.parent not in uyg:
            d = json.loads(s.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            print(f"Uygulanmamış danışma: {s.parent.name}  durum={d.get('durum')}  test önerisi={d.get('test_onerisi', '')[:80]}")
    return 0


def cmd_harita_paketle(_a) -> int:
    return calistir([sys.executable, str(V4 / "tools" / "uxb_ajan_paketi.py")], cwd=V4)


def cmd_harita_doldur(a) -> int:
    if harita_sureci():
        print("Harita doldurma zaten çalışıyor.")
        return 0
    log = V4 / "logs" / f"harita_zincir_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.log"
    with open(log, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        # Günlük zincir: harita yenile -> doldur -> ajan paketi -> kod analizi -> ek amaç -> kod analizi (tools/uxb_gunluk_zincir.py)
        subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", "tools/uxb_gunluk_zincir.py", "--saglayici", a.saglayici],
                         cwd=str(V4), env=ENV, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                         creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0) | getattr(subprocess, "BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS", 0))
    print(f"Başlatıldı; günlük: {log}")
    return 0


def sorun_bolumleri() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    text = SORUN_TAKIP.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    out = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"^## (S-\d+[A-Z-]*)\s*[—-]\s*(.*)$", text, re.M):
        start = m.end()
        nxt = re.search(r"^## ", text[start:], re.M)
        body = text[start:start + (nxt.start() if nxt else len(text) - start)]
        dm = re.search(r"\*\*Durum:\*\*\s*`([^`]+)`", body)
        out.append((m.group(1), dm.group(1) if dm else "?", m.group(2).strip()))
    return out


def cmd_sorunlar(a) -> int:
    for sid, durum, baslik in sorun_bolumleri():
        if a.durum and a.durum.upper() not in durum.upper():
            continue
        print(f"{sid:<8} {durum:<22} {baslik[:110]}")
    return 0


def cmd_sorun(a) -> int:
    text = SORUN_TAKIP.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(rf"^## {re.escape(a.sid.upper())}\b.*?(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
    print(m.group(0).strip() if m else f"{a.sid} bulunamadı")
    return 0 if m else 1


def cmd_ara(a) -> int:
    tsv = PKG / "rutinler.tsv"
    pat = re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(a.ad)}\t" if not a.parca else rf"(?i)^[^\t]*{re.escape(a.ad)}[^\t]*\t")
    n = 0
    for ln in tsv.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if pat.search(ln):
            c = ln.split("\t")
            print(f"{c[0]} [{c[1]}] {c[3]}:{c[4]}  ({c[6]}) {c[7][:160]}")
            n += 1
            if n >= 30:
                break
    return 0 if n else 1


def cmd_sss(a) -> int:
    rel = a.dosya.replace("\\", "/")
    rel = rel if rel.startswith("uxb/") else "uxb/" + rel
    for name, key in (("modul_ozet_onbellek.jsonl", "ozet"), ("sss_onbellek.jsonl", "sss")):
        p = PKG / name
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        last = None
        for ln in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            try:
                r = json.loads(ln)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if r.get("file") == rel:
                last = r
        if last and key == "ozet":
            print(f"Rol: {last.get('rol')}\nÖzet: {last.get('ozet')}\nÖnemli: {', '.join(last.get('onemli_rutinler', []))}\n")
        elif last:
            for q in last.get("sss", []):
                print(f"S: {q.get('soru')}\nC: {q.get('cevap')}\n")
    return 0


def cmd_yedek(_a) -> int:
    YEDEK_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    z = YEDEK_DIR / f"uxb_kaynak_openclaw_oncesi_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.zip"
    n = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(z, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for d in KAYNAK_KLASORLERI:
            base = UXB / d
            if not base.exists():
                continue
            for p in base.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size < 20_000_000 and "\\tmp\\" not in str(p) and "/tmp/" not in str(p):
                    zf.write(p, p.relative_to(UXB))
                    n += 1
    print(f"Yedek: {z}  ({n} dosya, {z.stat().st_size / 1e6:.1f} MB)")
    return 0


def cmd_danis(a) -> int:
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "uxb_yama_danis.py"), "--sorun", a.sid]
    for d in a.dosya:
        cmd += ["--dosya", d]
    if a.not_:
        cmd += ["--not", a.not_]
    return calistir(cmd, cwd=HERE)


def cmd_uygula(a) -> int:
    return calistir(["pwsh", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(HERE / "uxb_yama_uygula.ps1"),
                     "-Calisma", a.calisma, "-Testler", a.testler], cwd=HERE)


def cmd_gunluk(_a) -> int:
    if GUNLUK.exists():
        for ln in GUNLUK.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[-15:]:
            print(ln)
    else:
        print("Henüz yama günlüğü yok.")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="OpenClaw uxb ajanının komut aracı")
    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest="komut", required=True)
    sp.add_parser("durum").set_defaults(f=cmd_durum)
    sp.add_parser("harita-paketle").set_defaults(f=cmd_harita_paketle)
    p = sp.add_parser("harita-doldur")
    p.add_argument("--saglayici", default="zincir")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_harita_doldur)
    p = sp.add_parser("sorunlar")
    p.add_argument("--durum", default="")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sorunlar)
    p = sp.add_parser("sorun")
    p.add_argument("sid")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sorun)
    p = sp.add_parser("ara")
    p.add_argument("ad")
    p.add_argument("--parca", action="store_true", help="ad parçası (büyük/küçük harf duyarsız)")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_ara)
    p = sp.add_parser("sss")
    p.add_argument("dosya")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sss)
    sp.add_parser("yedek").set_defaults(f=cmd_yedek)
    p = sp.add_parser("danis")
    p.add_argument("sid")
    p.add_argument("--dosya", action="append", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--not", dest="not_", default="")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_danis)
    p = sp.add_parser("uygula")
    p.add_argument("calisma")
    p.add_argument("--testler", required=True, help="virgülle ayrılmış test paketleri (tests/run_all_model_tests.ps1 adları)")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_uygula)
    sp.add_parser("gunluk").set_defaults(f=cmd_gunluk)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return a.f(a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

SORUN_TAKIP = UXB / "ai_koordinasyon" / "SORUN_TAKIP.md"
GUNLUK = UXB / "ai_koordinasyon" / "OPENCLAW_YAMA_GUNLUGU.md"
YEDEK_DIR = UXBC / "yedekler"
KAYNAK_KLASORLERI = ["src", "include", "libsx", "runtime_ext", "native", "tests", "compiler"]
ENV = {**os.environ, "PYTHONIOENCODING": "utf-8"}


def calistir(cmd: list[str], cwd: Path | None = None, timeout: int = 7200) -> int:
    p = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd) if cwd else None, env=ENV, text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace",
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout)
    sys.stdout.write(p.stdout or "")
    return p.returncode


def harita_sureci() -> list[str]:
    out = subprocess.run(["powershell", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                          "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter \"Name='python.exe'\" | "
                          "Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_harita_doldur.py*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*paketleyici31.py*' } | "
                          "ForEach-Object { \"$($_.ProcessId)\" }"], text=True, capture_output=True)
    return [x for x in out.stdout.split() if x.strip()]


def cmd_durum(_a) -> int:
    pids = harita_sureci()
    print(f"Harita doldurma süreci: {'ÇALIŞIYOR (PID ' + ', '.join(pids) + ')' if pids else 'çalışmıyor'}")
    logs = sorted((V4 / "logs").glob("harita_zincir_*.log"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
    if logs:
        lines = logs[-1].read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines()
        print(f"Son günlük: {logs[-1].name}")
        for ln in lines[-4:]:
            print("   " + ln)
    for k in sorted((V4 / "logs").glob("kota_*.json")):
        print(f"Kota {k.stem[5:]}: {k.read_text(encoding='utf-8')}")
    kap = PKG / "kapsam.md"
    if kap.exists():
        for ln in kap.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[:16]:
            if ln.strip().startswith(("- ", "Paket", "Harita")):
                print("   " + ln.strip())
    bek = sorted((HERE / "yamalar").glob("*/SONUC.json"))
    uyg = {p.parent for p in (HERE / "yamalar").glob("*/UYGULAMA.json")}
    for s in bek:
        if s.parent not in uyg:
            d = json.loads(s.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            print(f"Uygulanmamış danışma: {s.parent.name}  durum={d.get('durum')}  test önerisi={d.get('test_onerisi', '')[:80]}")
    return 0


def cmd_harita_paketle(_a) -> int:
    return calistir([sys.executable, str(V4 / "tools" / "uxb_ajan_paketi.py")], cwd=V4)


def cmd_harita_doldur(a) -> int:
    if harita_sureci():
        print("Harita doldurma zaten çalışıyor.")
        return 0
    log = V4 / "logs" / f"harita_zincir_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M')}.log"
    with open(log, "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
        # Günlük zincir: harita yenile -> doldur -> ajan paketi -> kod analizi -> ek amaç -> kod analizi (tools/uxb_gunluk_zincir.py)
        subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", "tools/uxb_gunluk_zincir.py", "--saglayici", a.saglayici],
                         cwd=str(V4), env=ENV, stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                         creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0) | getattr(subprocess, "BELOW_NORMAL_PRIORITY_CLASS", 0))
    print(f"Başlatıldı; günlük: {log}")
    return 0


def sorun_bolumleri() -> list[tuple[str, str, str]]:
    text = SORUN_TAKIP.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    out = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"^## (S-\d+[A-Z-]*)\s*[—-]\s*(.*)$", text, re.M):
        start = m.end()
        nxt = re.search(r"^## ", text[start:], re.M)
        body = text[start:start + (nxt.start() if nxt else len(text) - start)]
        dm = re.search(r"\*\*Durum:\*\*\s*`([^`]+)`", body)
        out.append((m.group(1), dm.group(1) if dm else "?", m.group(2).strip()))
    return out


def cmd_sorunlar(a) -> int:
    for sid, durum, baslik in sorun_bolumleri():
        if a.durum and a.durum.upper() not in durum.upper():
            continue
        print(f"{sid:<8} {durum:<22} {baslik[:110]}")
    return 0


def cmd_sorun(a) -> int:
    text = SORUN_TAKIP.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(rf"^## {re.escape(a.sid.upper())}\b.*?(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
    print(m.group(0).strip() if m else f"{a.sid} bulunamadı")
    return 0 if m else 1


def cmd_ara(a) -> int:
    tsv = PKG / "rutinler.tsv"
    pat = re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(a.ad)}\t" if not a.parca else rf"(?i)^[^\t]*{re.escape(a.ad)}[^\t]*\t")
    n = 0
    for ln in tsv.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if pat.search(ln):
            c = ln.split("\t")
            print(f"{c[0]} [{c[1]}] {c[3]}:{c[4]}  ({c[6]}) {c[7][:160]}")
            n += 1
            if n >= 30:
                break
    return 0 if n else 1


def cmd_sss(a) -> int:
    rel = a.dosya.replace("\\", "/")
    rel = rel if rel.startswith("uxb/") else "uxb/" + rel
    for name, key in (("modul_ozet_onbellek.jsonl", "ozet"), ("sss_onbellek.jsonl", "sss")):
        p = PKG / name
        if not p.exists():
            continue
        last = None
        for ln in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            try:
                r = json.loads(ln)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            if r.get("file") == rel:
                last = r
        if last and key == "ozet":
            print(f"Rol: {last.get('rol')}\nÖzet: {last.get('ozet')}\nÖnemli: {', '.join(last.get('onemli_rutinler', []))}\n")
        elif last:
            for q in last.get("sss", []):
                print(f"S: {q.get('soru')}\nC: {q.get('cevap')}\n")
    return 0


def cmd_yedek(_a) -> int:
    YEDEK_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    z = YEDEK_DIR / f"uxb_kaynak_openclaw_oncesi_{time.strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}.zip"
    n = 0
    with zipfile.ZipFile(z, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        for d in KAYNAK_KLASORLERI:
            base = UXB / d
            if not base.exists():
                continue
            for p in base.rglob("*"):
                if p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size < 20_000_000 and "\\tmp\\" not in str(p) and "/tmp/" not in str(p):
                    zf.write(p, p.relative_to(UXB))
                    n += 1
    print(f"Yedek: {z}  ({n} dosya, {z.stat().st_size / 1e6:.1f} MB)")
    return 0


def cmd_danis(a) -> int:
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(HERE / "uxb_yama_danis.py"), "--sorun", a.sid]
    for d in a.dosya:
        cmd += ["--dosya", d]
    if a.not_:
        cmd += ["--not", a.not_]
    return calistir(cmd, cwd=HERE)


def cmd_uygula(a) -> int:
    return calistir(["pwsh", "-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", str(HERE / "uxb_yama_uygula.ps1"),
                     "-Calisma", a.calisma, "-Testler", a.testler], cwd=HERE)


def cmd_gunluk(_a) -> int:
    if GUNLUK.exists():
        for ln in GUNLUK.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()[-15:]:
            print(ln)
    else:
        print("Henüz yama günlüğü yok.")
    return 0


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="OpenClaw uxb ajanının komut aracı")
    sp = ap.add_subparsers(dest="komut", required=True)
    sp.add_parser("durum").set_defaults(f=cmd_durum)
    sp.add_parser("harita-paketle").set_defaults(f=cmd_harita_paketle)
    p = sp.add_parser("harita-doldur")
    p.add_argument("--saglayici", default="zincir")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_harita_doldur)
    p = sp.add_parser("sorunlar")
    p.add_argument("--durum", default="")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sorunlar)
    p = sp.add_parser("sorun")
    p.add_argument("sid")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sorun)
    p = sp.add_parser("ara")
    p.add_argument("ad")
    p.add_argument("--parca", action="store_true", help="ad parçası (büyük/küçük harf duyarsız)")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_ara)
    p = sp.add_parser("sss")
    p.add_argument("dosya")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_sss)
    sp.add_parser("yedek").set_defaults(f=cmd_yedek)
    p = sp.add_parser("danis")
    p.add_argument("sid")
    p.add_argument("--dosya", action="append", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--not", dest="not_", default="")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_danis)
    p = sp.add_parser("uygula")
    p.add_argument("calisma")
    p.add_argument("--testler", required=True, help="virgülle ayrılmış test paketleri (tests/run_all_model_tests.ps1 adları)")
    p.set_defaults(f=cmd_uygula)
    sp.add_parser("gunluk").set_defaults(f=cmd_gunluk)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    return a.f(a)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Bekçi: harita doldurmayı gün gün sürdürür; harita TAMAMEN dolunca paketi yeniler ve OpenClaw oturumunu başlatır.
# - Doldurma süreci çalışmıyorsa ve son günlük "tüm işler tamamlandı" demiyorsa: yeni günde (kota yenilenince) yeniden başlatır.
# - "tüm işler tamamlandı" görülünce: harita-paketle -> uxb_oturum.ps1 -> çıkar.
# Arka planda gizli pencerede çalışır (bilgisayar yeniden başlarsa tekrar başlatılmalı: .\uxb_harita_sonrasi.ps1).
param([int]$KontrolDakika = 15)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$here = $PSScriptRoot
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = 'utf-8'
$v4 = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $here '..\..\..\UxbRAG\UXB_HYBRID_RAG_V4_YORUMLU_JSON')).Path
$bekciLog = Join-Path $here 'oturumlar\bekci.log'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Join-Path $here 'oturumlar') | Out-Null
function Yaz([string]$s) { "$(Get-Date -Format s) $s" | Add-Content $bekciLog -Encoding utf8 }
function Calisiyor {
    # Günlük zincir (uxb_gunluk_zincir.py) doldurma + paket + kod analizi + ek amaç adımlarını sırayla çalıştırır; hepsi "çalışıyor" sayılır.
    @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='python.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_harita_doldur.py*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_gunluk_zincir.py*' }).Count -gt 0
}
$diger = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='pwsh.exe'" | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -ne $PID -and $_.CommandLine -like '*uxb_harita_sonrasi.ps1*' })
if ($diger.Count -gt 0) { Yaz "başka bir bekçi zaten çalışıyor (PID $($diger[0].ProcessId)); çıkılıyor"; exit 0 }
Yaz "bekçi başladı (PID $PID)"
$sonBaslatmaGunu = ''
$sonArsivGunu = ''
$arsivBetik = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $here '..\..\..\claude_arsiv\konusma_arsivle.py')).Path
while ($true) {
    # Günde bir kez: Claude konuşmalarını okunabilir arşive al (claude_arsiv\konusmalar).
    if ($sonArsivGunu -ne (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd')) {
        python $arsivBetik 2>&1 | Out-Null
        $sonArsivGunu = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
        Yaz "konuşma arşivi güncellendi"
    }
    if (-not (Calisiyor)) {
        $son = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $v4 'logs') -Filter 'harita_zincir_*.log' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
        $bitti = $son -and (Select-String -Path $son.FullName -Pattern 'tüm işler tamamlandı' -Encoding utf8 -Quiet)
        if ($bitti) {
            Yaz "harita tamamlandı ($($son.Name)) -> paket + OpenClaw oturumu"
            python (Join-Path $here 'uxb_ajan.py') harita-paketle 2>&1 | Out-Null
            & (Join-Path $here 'uxb_oturum.ps1')
            Yaz "OpenClaw oturumu bitti; bekçi çıkıyor"
            break
        }
        $bugun = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd'
        # Normal bitiş ("Bitti.") yoksa süreç yarıda kesilmiştir (bilgisayar kapandı vb.) -> hemen devam et.
        $yarida = $son -and -not (Select-String -Path $son.FullName -Pattern '^Bitti\.' -Encoding utf8 -Quiet)
        $yeniGun = (-not $son) -or $son.LastWriteTime.Date -lt (Get-Date).Date
        if ($yarida -or ($yeniGun -and $sonBaslatmaGunu -ne $bugun)) {
            Yaz ("doldurma durmuş (" + $(if ($yarida) { 'yarıda kesilmiş' } else { 'yeni gün, kota yenilendi' }) + ") -> başlatılıyor")
            python (Join-Path $here 'uxb_ajan.py') harita-doldur --saglayici zincir 2>&1 | Out-Null
            $sonBaslatmaGunu = $bugun
        }
    }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds ($KontrolDakika * 60)
}

from __future__ import annotations
import json, shutil, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
from .common import atomic_write_json, atomic_write_text, stamp


def prepare_rag_config(cfg: dict) -> Path:
    legacy = Path(cfg["legacy_rag_root"])
    template = legacy / "config.json"
    if not template.exists():
        template = legacy / "config.example.json"
    base = json.loads(template.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if template.exists() else {}
    project = Path(cfg["project_root"])
    state = Path(cfg["state_root"])
    rag_dir = state / "rag"
    rag_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    base.update({
        "project_name": "UXB-CONTROL-CENTER-RAG",
        "ollama_base_url": cfg.get("ollama", {}).get("base_url", "http://localhost:11434"),
        "chat_model": cfg.get("ollama", {}).get("coder_model", "qwen2.5-coder:3b"),
        "embed_model": cfg.get("ollama", {}).get("embed_model", "nomic-embed-text"),
        "small_model": cfg.get("ollama", {}).get("small_model", "qwen3:0.6b"),
        "source_roots": [str(x) for x in [project / "src", project / "docs", project / "compiler", project / "tests", project / "runtime_ext", project / "libsx", project / "include"] if x.exists()],
        "chroma_path": str(rag_dir / "index" / "chroma_db"),
    })
    generated = rag_dir / "config.generated.json"
    atomic_write_json(generated, base)
    return generated


def run_python_tool(script: Path, args: list[str], cwd: Path, log: Path, timeout: int = 1800) -> dict:
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(script), *args]
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(cwd), text=True, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace", stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=timeout, check=False)
        output, code = proc.stdout or "", proc.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
        output, code = (exc.stdout or "") + (exc.stderr or ""), None
    log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    atomic_write_text(log, f"COMMAND={json.dumps(cmd, ensure_ascii=False)}\nEXIT={code}\n--- OUTPUT ---\n{output}")
    return {"command": cmd, "exit_code": code, "output": output, "log": str(log)}


def run_rag(cfg: dict, mode: str, question: str = "", symbol: str = "", timeout: int = 1800) -> dict:
    legacy = Path(cfg["legacy_rag_root"])
    script = legacy / "tools" / "uxb_pipeline_runner.py"
    if not script.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"RAG runner bulunamadı: {script}")
    generated = prepare_rag_config(cfg)
    args = ["--hat", mode, "--config", str(generated)]
    if question:
        args += ["--q", question]
    if symbol:
        args += ["--symbol", symbol]
    log = Path(cfg["state_root"]) / "logs" / f"rag_{mode}_{stamp()}.log"
    result = run_python_tool(script, args, legacy, log, timeout)
    result["generated_config"] = str(generated)
    latest_answer = generated.parent / "logs" / "latest_answer.md"
    latest_run = generated.parent / "index" / "latest_hybrid_run.json"
    for p in (latest_answer, latest_run):
        if p.exists():
            result.setdefault("artifacts", []).append(str(p))
    return result


def run_packager(cfg: dict, source_dir: str | None = None, size_kb: int = 4096, modules: str = "statik,davranissal,cli,topolojik,kalite,guvenlik,rag", timeout: int = 3600) -> dict:
    legacy = Path(cfg["legacy_rag_root"])
    script = legacy / "tools" / "Moduller" / "paketleyici31.py"
    if not script.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Paketleyici bulunamadı: {script}")
    src = Path(source_dir).resolve() if source_dir else Path(cfg["project_root"]) / "src"
    args = ["--dir", str(src), "--size", str(size_kb), "--modules", modules, "--json"]
    log = Path(cfg["state_root"]) / "logs" / f"paketleyici_{stamp()}.log"
    result = run_python_tool(script, args, legacy, log, timeout)
    result["source_dir"] = str(src)
    for candidate in (src / "tekdosyaklsoru", legacy / "tekdosyaklsoru"):
        if candidate.exists():
            result.setdefault("artifacts", []).append(str(candidate))
    return result

    generated = prepare_rag_config(cfg)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
uxb_token_manager.py — dış model sağlayıcılarının kota ve kullanım durumu (GERÇEK sayaçlardan).

Veri kaynağı: logs\\kota_<sağlayıcı>.json — uxb_harita_doldur.py'nin istemcisi (ve onu kullanan uxb_ek_amac.py,
dis_danis.py) her istekte buraya yazar; yani gösterilen sayılar gerçekten yapılan isteklerdir. Sınırlar
%USERPROFILE%\\.uxb\\api_anahtarlari.env içindeki UXB_<SAĞLAYICI>_RPD / _RPM değerlerinden (yoksa varsayılandan) okunur.

Sayaç yalnız o günün istek sayısını tutar; geçmiş için logs\\kullanim_gecmisi.jsonl'e günlük kayıt alınır
(`--kaydet`; günlük zincir bunu başta ve sonda çalıştırır). Geçmiş kaydı bugünden başlar; öncesi bilinmiyor.
Token: sağlayıcılar günlük sınırı İSTEK sayısıyla koyar; token yalnız dakikalık sınır içindir. `--tahmin` bir metnin
yaklaşık girdi tokenını (karakter/3,2 — istemcinin kullandığı tahminle aynı) ve hangi sağlayıcıya sığdığını gösterir.

  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py                  durum tablosu (bugün / sınır / kalan / toplam)
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --kaydet         bugünkü sayaçları geçmişe işle
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --tahmin dosya   dosyanın yaklaşık token sayısı ve uygun sağlayıcılar
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --csv cikti.csv  tablo + geçmiş toplamı CSV
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import uxb_harita_doldur as hd  # noqa: E402

V4 = hd.V4
GECMIS = V4 / "logs" / "kullanim_gecmisi.jsonl"
# Sağlayıcı türü (Mete'nin 2026-09-28 notu): Gemini ücretsiz katman; Kimi/ChatGPT/Claude ücretli
UCRET = {"gemini": "ücretsiz katman", "gemini2": "ücretsiz katman", "kimi": "ücretli", "chatgpt": "ücretli", "claude": "ücretli"}


def sinirlar(cfg: dict[str, str], sag: str) -> dict:
    key_var, def_model, def_rpm, def_rpd, def_tpm = hd.SAGLAYICILAR[sag]
    up = sag.upper()
    return {"model": cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_MODEL", def_model), "rpm": float(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_RPM", def_rpm)),
            "rpd": int(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_RPD", def_rpd)), "tpm": int(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_TPM", def_tpm)),
            "anahtar": bool(cfg.get(key_var))}


def sayac(sag: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    p = V4 / "logs" / f"kota_{sag}.json"
    try:
        d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return str(d.get("gun", "")), int(d.get("istek", 0))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return "", 0


def gecmis_oku() -> dict[tuple[str, str], dict]:
    res: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
    if GECMIS.exists():
        for line in GECMIS.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
            try:
                r = json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            res[(r["gun"], r["saglayici"])] = r  # aynı gün için son kayıt geçerli
    return res


def kaydet(cfg: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    gec = gecmis_oku()
    yeni = 0
    GECMIS.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with GECMIS.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for sag in hd.SAGLAYICILAR:
            gun, n = sayac(sag)
            if not gun or n <= 0:
                continue
            onceki = gec.get((gun, sag))
            if onceki and onceki.get("istek") == n:
                continue
            f.write(json.dumps({"gun": gun, "saglayici": sag, "istek": n, "model": sinirlar(cfg, sag)["model"],
                                "kayit": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            yeni += 1
    return yeni


def tablo(cfg: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict]:
    bugun = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    gec = gecmis_oku()
    rows = []
    for sag in hd.SAGLAYICILAR:
        s = sinirlar(cfg, sag)
        gun, n = sayac(sag)
        bu = n if gun == bugun else 0
        gunler = {g: r["istek"] for (g, sg), r in gec.items() if sg == sag}
        if gun:
            gunler[gun] = max(gunler.get(gun, 0), n)
        rows.append({"saglayici": sag, "model": s["model"], "tur": UCRET.get(sag, "?"), "anahtar": s["anahtar"],
                     "bugun": bu, "sinir": s["rpd"], "kalan": max(0, s["rpd"] - bu) if s["rpd"] else None,
                     "toplam": sum(gunler.values()), "gun_sayisi": len(gunler), "son_kayit_gunu": gun, "rpm": s["rpm"], "tpm": s["tpm"]})
    return rows


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Dış model kota ve kullanım durumu (gerçek sayaçlardan)")
    ap.add_argument("--kaydet", action="store_true", help="bugünkü sayaçları kullanım geçmişine işle")
    ap.add_argument("--tahmin", metavar="DOSYA", help="dosyanın yaklaşık token sayısı ve hangi sağlayıcıya sığdığı")
    ap.add_argument("--csv", metavar="DOSYA", help="tabloyu CSV'ye yaz")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    cfg = hd.ayarlari_oku()
    if a.kaydet:
        print(f"{kaydet(cfg)} yeni kayıt işlendi -> {GECMIS}")
        return 0
    if a.tahmin:
        metin = Path(a.tahmin).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        tok = int(len(metin) / 3.2) + 1
        print(f"{a.tahmin}: {len(metin):,} karakter ≈ {tok:,} girdi tokenı (karakter/3,2 tahmini)")
        for r in tablo(cfg):
            ok = tok <= r["tpm"]
            print(f"  {r['saglayici']:<8} dakikalık token sınırı {r['tpm']:>8,}  -> {'SIĞAR' if ok else 'SIĞMAZ (bölün)'}"
                  f"   bugün kalan istek: {r['kalan']}")
        return 0
    rows = tablo(cfg)
    if a.csv:
        with open(a.csv, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write("saglayici,model,tur,bugun,sinir,kalan,toplam,gun_sayisi\n")
            for r in rows:
                f.write(f"{r['saglayici']},{r['model']},{r['tur']},{r['bugun']},{r['sinir']},{r['kalan']},{r['toplam']},{r['gun_sayisi']}\n")
        print(f"yazıldı: {a.csv}")
        return 0
    print(f"Dış model kullanımı — {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}   (sayaç: logs\\kota_*.json; geçmiş: {GECMIS.name})\n")
    print(f"{'sağlayıcı':<9} {'model':<18} {'tür':<16} {'bugün':>6} {'sınır':>6} {'kalan':>6} {'toplam*':>8}  anahtar")
    for r in rows:
        print(f"{r['saglayici']:<9} {r['model']:<18} {r['tur']:<16} {r['bugun']:>6} {r['sinir']:>6} {str(r['kalan']):>6} {r['toplam']:>8}  {'var' if r['anahtar'] else 'YOK'}")
    print("\n* toplam = kayıtlı günlerin istek toplamı; geçmiş kaydı yeni başladı, öncesi bilinmiyor.")
    print("  Not: Google'ın ücretsiz katmanında gerçek günlük sınır, buradaki ayar değerinden (240) çok düşük olabilir; sağlayıcı reddederse araçlar sıradakine geçer.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

=== uxb_yama_uygula.ps1 ===
# Korumalı yama uygulayıcı (Mete kararı 2026-09-28: "korumalı otomatik").
# uxb_yama_danis.py'nin DRYRUN_TAMAM verdiği çalışma klasöründeki emir.txt'yi uygular:
#   1) yasak kontrolü: yalnız uxb\src, uxb\include, uxb\libsx, uxb\runtime_ext, uxb\native, uxb\tests altı; game\, bin\ YOK;
#      son 20 dakikada BAŞKA biri (Codex / Claude / Mete) tarafından değiştirilmiş dosyaya dokunmaz
#   2) taban: DEĞİŞİKLİKTEN ÖNCE mevcut kaynaktan taban derleyici + seçilen test paketleri (önceden düşen testler yamaya yazılmasın)
#   3) dry-run -> apply --yes -> yeni derleyici -> aynı test paketleri
#   4) derleme başarısız ya da YENİ test düşüşü varsa: YamaMotoru --rollback-last (kendiliğinden geri alma)
#   5) sonuç: uxb\ai_koordinasyon\OPENCLAW_YAMA_GUNLUGU.md (ek) + çalışma klasöründe UYGULAMA.json
#
#   .\uxb_yama_uygula.ps1 -Calisma .\yamalar\S-169_20260928_180000 -Testler uxraylib,routine_scope
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string]$Calisma,
    [Parameter(Mandatory = $true)][string[]]$Testler,
    [int]$BeklemeDakika = 20
)
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$env:PYTHONIOENCODING = 'utf-8'
$Testler = @($Testler | ForEach-Object { $_ -split ',' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ })
$here = $PSScriptRoot
$uxbc = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $here '..\..\..')).Path
$uxb = Join-Path $uxbc 'uxb'
$yama = Join-Path $here '..\tools\yama_v4\YamaMotoru_v4.py'
$gunluk = Join-Path $uxb 'ai_koordinasyon\OPENCLAW_YAMA_GUNLUGU.md'
$Calisma = (Resolve-Path $Calisma).Path
$sonuc = [ordered]@{ calisma = $Calisma; zaman = (Get-Date -Format 's'); durum = 'BASLADI'; adimlar = @() }
$danis = Get-Content (Join-Path $Calisma 'SONUC.json') -Raw -Encoding utf8 | ConvertFrom-Json
$sonuc.sorun = $danis.sorun
$etiket = ($danis.sorun -replace '[^A-Za-z0-9]', '')

function Adim([string]$ad, [string]$not) { $script:sonuc.adimlar += "$(Get-Date -Format 'HH:mm:ss') $ad :: $not"; Write-Host "[$ad] $not" }
function Bitir([string]$durum) {
    $script:sonuc.durum = $durum
    ($script:sonuc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5) | Set-Content (Join-Path $Calisma 'UYGULAMA.json') -Encoding utf8
    $satir = "| $(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') | $($script:sonuc.sorun) | $($danis.saglayici)/$($danis.model) | $durum | " +
             "$($script:sonuc.transaction) | $($script:sonuc.test_ozet) | $(Split-Path $Calisma -Leaf) |"
    if (-not (Test-Path $gunluk)) {
        @('# OpenClaw yama günlüğü (otomatik)', '',
          'Her satır bir OpenClaw yama denemesi. Durum: UYGULANDI / GERI_ALINDI / REDDEDILDI. Ayrıntı: çalışma klasöründe UYGULAMA.json.', '',
          '| Zaman | Sorun | Sağlayıcı/model | Durum | Transaction | Test (taban -> yeni düşen) | Çalışma |',
          '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|') | Set-Content $gunluk -Encoding utf8
    }
    Add-Content $gunluk $satir -Encoding utf8
    Write-Host "SONUC=$durum"
    exit $(if ($durum -eq 'UYGULANDI') { 0 } else { 1 })
}
function Yama([string[]]$a) { $o = & python $yama --workspace $Calisma @a 2>&1; return @{ kod = $LASTEXITCODE; cikti = ($o -join "`n") } }
function Dusen([string]$exe) {
    $o = & (Join-Path $uxb 'tools\claude\uxb_regression.ps1') -Uxb $exe -Only $Testler 2>&1
    $fails = @($o | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*FAIL ' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Sort-Object -Unique)
    return ,$fails
}

if ($danis.durum -ne 'DRYRUN_TAMAM') { Adim 'on_kosul' "danışman sonucu $($danis.durum)"; Bitir 'REDDEDILDI' }

# 1) hedefleri çıkar + yasak kontrolü
$dr = Yama @('--root', $uxb, '--emir', 'emir.txt', '--dry-run')
if ($dr.kod -ne 0) { Adim 'dry_run' 'başarısız'; $sonuc.dry_run = $dr.cikti; Bitir 'REDDEDILDI' }
$hedefler = @([regex]::Matches($dr.cikti, 'Emir \d+:\s+\S+\s+(\S+)') | ForEach-Object { $_.Groups[1].Value } | Sort-Object -Unique)
$sonuc.hedefler = $hedefler
$izinli = '^(src|include|libsx|runtime_ext|native|tests)/'
foreach ($h in $hedefler) {
    if ($h -notmatch $izinli) { Adim 'yasak' "izin verilmeyen yol: $h"; Bitir 'REDDEDILDI' }
    $p = Join-Path $uxb $h
    if ((Test-Path $p) -and ((Get-Date) - (Get-Item $p).LastWriteTime).TotalMinutes -lt $BeklemeDakika) {
        Adim 'es_zamanli' "$h son $BeklemeDakika dakikada başkası tarafından değişti"; Bitir 'REDDEDILDI'
    }
}
Adim 'hedef' ($hedefler -join ', ')

# 2) taban: değişiklikten önce
Push-Location $uxb
$b = & (Join-Path $uxb 'tools\claude\uxb_build.ps1') -Name "openclaw_${etiket}_taban" 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Pop-Location; Adim 'taban_derleme' (($b | Select-Object -Last 5) -join ' | '); Bitir 'REDDEDILDI' }
$tabanExe = Join-Path $uxb "bin\uxb_openclaw_${etiket}_taban.exe"
$tabanDusen = Dusen $tabanExe
Adim 'taban_test' "$($tabanDusen.Count) düşen kontrol"

# 3) uygula
$ap = Yama @('--emir', 'emir.txt', '--apply', '--yes')
if ($ap.kod -ne 0) { Pop-Location; Adim 'apply' ((($ap.cikti -split "`n") | Select-Object -Last 3) -join ' | '); Bitir 'REDDEDILDI' }
$sonuc.transaction = ([regex]::Match($ap.cikti, 'Transaction:\s*(\S+)')).Groups[1].Value
Adim 'apply' "transaction $($sonuc.transaction)"

$b2 = & (Join-Path $uxb 'tools\claude\uxb_build.ps1') -Name "openclaw_${etiket}" 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Adim 'derleme' (($b2 | Select-Object -Last 8) -join ' | ')
    $rb = Yama @('--rollback-last'); Adim 'geri_al' $rb.cikti; Pop-Location; Bitir 'GERI_ALINDI'
}
$yeniDusen = Dusen (Join-Path $uxb "bin\uxb_openclaw_${etiket}.exe")
Pop-Location
$yeniler = @($yeniDusen | Where-Object { $tabanDusen -notcontains $_ })
$duzelen = @($tabanDusen | Where-Object { $yeniDusen -notcontains $_ })
$sonuc.test_ozet = "taban $($tabanDusen.Count) -> yeni düşen $($yeniler.Count), düzelen $($duzelen.Count)"
$sonuc.yeni_dusenler = $yeniler
$sonuc.duzelenler = $duzelen
Adim 'test' $sonuc.test_ozet

# 4) karar
if ($yeniler.Count -gt 0) {
    $rb = Yama @('--rollback-last'); Adim 'geri_al' $rb.cikti
    Bitir 'GERI_ALINDI'
}
Bitir 'UYGULANDI'

# uXBasic development

The active compiler repository is `uxb/`; this directory also contains archives,
packages and RAG sources. Do not treat their copies as active compiler inputs.

As of Mete's instruction on 2026-10-06, Codex owns development. Historical
Claude/Antigravity CLAIM records are preserved but do not prevent takeover.
Do not invoke another AI environment. Do not delete workspace files.

Start with the latest entries in `uxb/ai_koordinasyon/DURUM.md`,
`SORULAR_CEVAPLAR.md`, `SORUN_TAKIP.md` and the decision log. New explicit
decisions override older plans. Preserve existing changes. Record code, test
evidence and remaining gaps in the coordination log.

For compact document retrieval:
`python uxb/tools/maintenance/uxb_context_index.py search "query" --chars 4000`.
Rebuild with `build` after document updates. The inventory and section index
are in `uxb/reports/context_index/`; indexing is not a semantic review.

For symbols, search `UxbRAG/UXB_HYBRID_RAG_V4_YORUMLU_JSON/ajan_paketi/rutinler.tsv`.
Consult `uxb/.claude/skills/uxb-harita/MIMARI.md` for pipeline orientation.
Verify symbol locations in live source before editing. Model-written purposes
are drafts. Read focused source sections instead of whole large files.

Build: `uxb/build_64.ps1 -Force`. Test from `uxb/` using
`tests/run_all_model_tests.ps1`. A passing rejection test does not prove a
working feature. Validate real AST/MIR/native/JS/WASM execution for claims
about parity. Keep baseline binaries separate while testing new builds.

# Memory Index

- [Git repo + MinGit](project_no_git_manual_zip_backups.md) — MinGit at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\MinGit\cmd; commit 07550bb (not pushed); placeholder identity in config; still move don't delete.
- [uXBasic type naming rules](feedback_uxb_type_naming_rules.md) — no LONG/INTEGER/DOUBLE, no $#%! suffixes; conversion is I8(x)/U8(x)/F32(x).
- [Dil Tanımı (tek kanonik belge) 2026-09-28](project_uxb_dil_tanimi_20260928.md) — YONERGE, alanlar/, birleştirici, ornek_dogrula, dis_danis; team = workflow + Codex CLI + Kimi/Gemini API; quota facts.
- [Codex + a second Claude are concurrent collaborators](project_codex_concurrent_collaborator.md) — this session is "Claude 1"; check mtimes, avoid game/ without asking.
- [User is not a programmer](user_not_a_programmer.md) — explain jargon in plain Turkish, negotiate before changes.
- [uXBasic fix-plan decisions log](uxb_fix_plan_decisions_2026_09.md) — decide-then-fix workflow + running decision log from the 3 audits.
- [Do once, near-perfect](feedback_do_once_near_perfect.md) — don't ship a fix just to check a box; favor complete implementations.
- [Git infrastructure is broken](project_git_infrastructure_broken.md) — 111k-line .gitignore, 0 commits, placeholder identity, remote URL mismatch to resolve.
- [uXBasic web-bridge vision](project_uxbasic_vision_web_bridge.md) — long-term goal: bidirectional native-exe/browser comms; guides need a WASM/JS/WAT working-commands list.
- [Verify before destructive action](feedback_verify_before_destructive_action.md) — investigate root cause + blast radius, then ask one final explicit confirmation, every time.
- [No placeholders, ever](feedback_no_placeholders_ever.md) — no stubs/TODOs/fake code under any name; see the whole picture before deciding a fix.
- [Clean-build repair effort](uxb_clean_build_effort.md) — running log of pre-existing, unrelated build-order bugs found while rebuilding from scratch; fix every layer, root-cause only.
- [Give frequent status updates](feedback_frequent_status_updates.md) — during long debugging loops, check in every few steps in plain Turkish, not just at the end.
- [No Bash tool — use PowerShell](project_no_bash_tool_use_powershell.md) — Git for Windows was uninstalled (2026-09-07) after heavy Bash usage strained RAM; use PowerShell for all shell work here.
- [uXBasic memory architecture (S-036)](uxb_memory_architecture_2026_09.md) — NATIVE=real memory primary, VIRTUAL=opt-in configurable RAM/disk region, single array backing storage.
- [Harita/RAG araç değerlendirmesi 2026-09-19](uxb_map_tooling_evaluation_2026_09_19.md) — tree-sitter-freebasic %90 hata (kullanma), ctags ~%97 uyumlu, purpose %4.5 dolu, embed hızı.
- [PowerShell "erase" alias trap](feedback_powershell_erase_alias_blocked.md) — any PowerShell command containing that word is rejected whole ("Remove-Item ... blocked"); use Edit/Write for such text.
- [uXBasic memory architecture (S-036)](uxb_memory_architecture_2026_09.md) — see also the S-077/S-079/S-056 entries appended to the fix-plan decisions log (U64 rule, type ABI table, MemoryRef registry).
- [Write status of every finding to the notebooks](feedback_notebooks_status_closed_open.md) — closed/partial/open/decision per S-xxx in ai_koordinasyon, continuously and at the end; never stop between items, pick the next one.
- [build\ deletion permission](feedback_build_folder_deletion_permission.md) — Mete 2026-09-20: previous days' build\<date-time> run folders deletable when disk is needed; old reports only after asking him; rest of build\ protected.
- [MIR interpreter perf + disk-full incident](project_mir_perf_and_disk_incident.md) — S-109: registry lookups memoized (string_memo.fbs), 100x faster; runaway PRINT loop filled C: (0.02 GB) — time-box probes, watch free disk.

- [PowerShell tr-TR / -split / removal-text traps](feedback_powershell_culture_and_split_traps.md) — .ToUpper() gives İ (use *Invariant), never rewrite files from a -split result, removal-cmdlet text in a script is blocked, glued PRINT/log lines.
- [S-146 Model D state 2026-09-26](project_s146_model_d_state_20260926.md) — step 1 done (auto-sync/LOCK/ATOMIC/MUTEX/UNSAFE, 3 engines); code map, pass order, open S-160/161/162.
- [S-030 task model state 2026-09-25](project_s030_task_model_state_20260925.md) — Faz 1B/2A done, S-146 isolation, where code/tests live, open objections İ1–İ6, DLL rebuild rule.
- [Konuşma arşivi + eski belgeler](feedback_arsiv_konusma_eski_belge.md) — transcript'leri asla silme; okunur kopya UXBc\claude_arsiv\konusmalar; eskiyen belgelerim eski_belgeler'e taşınır.
- [OpenClaw uxb yöneticisi 2026-09-28](project_openclaw_uxb_manager_20260928.md) — Kimi ajanı + korumalı yama hattı + harita zinciri; exec izin listesi yerel modda UYGULANMIYOR.
- [Claude otomasyon kurulumu 2026-09-27](project_claude_automation_setup_20260927.md) — hooks/izinler/skill'ler/motor-esitligi ajanı + MIMARI.md; derle/test yalnız tools\claude betikleriyle.
- [OmniRoute + harita kurulumu 2026-09-24](project_omniroute_and_map_setup_20260924.md) — .mcp.json with ${OMNIROUTE_API_KEY}, uxb-harita skill, purpose-fill run, disk-full note.
- [uxsdl3 finished 2026-09-23](project_uxsdl3_complete_20260923.md) — SDL3 wrapper complete (319 exports, 8 headless tests x 4 engines, guide in docs/); layout, generator, out-of-scope list; raylib 3D/Shaders still open.

Token: sağlayıcılar günlük sınırı İSTEK sayısıyla koyar; token yalnız dakikalık sınır içindir. `--tahmin` bir metnin
yaklaşık girdi tokenını (karakter/3,2 — istemcinin kullandığı tahminle aynı) ve hangi sağlayıcıya sığdığını gösterir.

  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py                  durum tablosu (bugün / sınır / kalan / toplam)
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --kaydet         bugünkü sayaçları geçmişe işle
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --tahmin dosya   dosyanın yaklaşık token sayısı ve uygun sağlayıcılar
  python tools\\uxb_token_manager.py --csv cikti.csv  tablo + geçmiş toplamı CSV
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import uxb_harita_doldur as hd  # noqa: E402

V4 = hd.V4
GECMIS = V4 / "logs" / "kullanim_gecmisi.jsonl"
# Sağlayıcı türü (Mete'nin 2026-09-28 notu): Gemini ücretsiz katman; Kimi/ChatGPT/Claude ücretli
UCRET = {"gemini": "ücretsiz katman", "gemini2": "ücretsiz katman", "kimi": "ücretli", "chatgpt": "ücretli", "claude": "ücretli"}


def sinirlar(cfg: dict[str, str], sag: str) -> dict:
    key_var, def_model, def_rpm, def_rpd, def_tpm = hd.SAGLAYICILAR[sag]
    up = sag.upper()
    return {"model": cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_MODEL", def_model), "rpm": float(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_RPM", def_rpm)),
            "rpd": int(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_RPD", def_rpd)), "tpm": int(cfg.get(f"UXB_{up}_TPM", def_tpm)),
            "anahtar": bool(cfg.get(key_var))}


def sayac(sag: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    p = V4 / "logs" / f"kota_{sag}.json"
    try:
        d = json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return str(d.get("gun", "")), int(d.get("istek", 0))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return "", 0


def gecmis_oku() -> dict[tuple[str, str], dict]:
    res: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
    if GECMIS.exists():
        for line in GECMIS.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
            try:
                r = json.loads(line)
            except ValueError:
                continue
            res[(r["gun"], r["saglayici"])] = r  # aynı gün için son kayıt geçerli
    return res


def kaydet(cfg: dict[str, str]) -> int:
    gec = gecmis_oku()
    yeni = 0
    GECMIS.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with GECMIS.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for sag in hd.SAGLAYICILAR:
            gun, n = sayac(sag)
            if not gun or n <= 0:
                continue
            onceki = gec.get((gun, sag))
            if onceki and onceki.get("istek") == n:
                continue
            f.write(json.dumps({"gun": gun, "saglayici": sag, "istek": n, "model": sinirlar(cfg, sag)["model"],
                                "kayit": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")}, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            yeni += 1
    return yeni


def tablo(cfg: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict]:
    bugun = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    gec = gecmis_oku()
    rows = []
    for sag in hd.SAGLAYICILAR:
        s = sinirlar(cfg, sag)
        gun, n = sayac(sag)
        bu = n if gun == bugun else 0
        gunler = {g: r["istek"] for (g, sg), r in gec.items() if sg == sag}
        if gun:
            gunler[gun] = max(gunler.get(gun, 0), n)
        rows.append({"saglayici": sag, "model": s["model"], "tur": UCRET.get(sag, "?"), "anahtar": s["anahtar"],
                     "bugun": bu, "sinir": s["rpd"], "kalan": max(0, s["rpd"] - bu) if s["rpd"] else None,
                     "toplam": sum(gunler.values()), "gun_sayisi": len(gunler), "son_kayit_gunu": gun, "rpm": s["rpm"], "tpm": s["tpm"]})
    return rows


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Dış model kota ve kullanım durumu (gerçek sayaçlardan)")
    ap.add_argument("--kaydet", action="store_true", help="bugünkü sayaçları kullanım geçmişine işle")
    ap.add_argument("--tahmin", metavar="DOSYA", help="dosyanın yaklaşık token sayısı ve hangi sağlayıcıya sığdığı")
    ap.add_argument("--csv", metavar="DOSYA", help="tabloyu CSV'ye yaz")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    cfg = hd.ayarlari_oku()
    if a.kaydet:
        print(f"{kaydet(cfg)} yeni kayıt işlendi -> {GECMIS}")
        return 0
    if a.tahmin:
        metin = Path(a.tahmin).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        tok = int(len(metin) / 3.2) + 1
        print(f"{a.tahmin}: {len(metin):,} karakter ≈ {tok:,} girdi tokenı (karakter/3,2 tahmini)")
        for r in tablo(cfg):
            ok = tok <= r["tpm"]
            print(f"  {r['saglayici']:<8} dakikalık token sınırı {r['tpm']:>8,}  -> {'SIĞAR' if ok else 'SIĞMAZ (bölün)'}"
                  f"   bugün kalan istek: {r['kalan']}")
        return 0
    rows = tablo(cfg)
    if a.csv:
        with open(a.csv, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write("saglayici,model,tur,bugun,sinir,kalan,toplam,gun_sayisi\n")
            for r in rows:
                f.write(f"{r['saglayici']},{r['model']},{r['tur']},{r['bugun']},{r['sinir']},{r['kalan']},{r['toplam']},{r['gun_sayisi']}\n")
        print(f"yazıldı: {a.csv}")
        return 0
    print(f"Dış model kullanımı — {time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')}   (sayaç: logs\\kota_*.json; geçmiş: {GECMIS.name})\n")
    print(f"{'sağlayıcı':<9} {'model':<18} {'tür':<16} {'bugün':>6} {'sınır':>6} {'kalan':>6} {'toplam*':>8}  anahtar")
    for r in rows:
        print(f"{r['saglayici']:<9} {r['model']:<18} {r['tur']:<16} {r['bugun']:>6} {r['sinir']:>6} {str(r['kalan']):>6} {r['toplam']:>8}  {'var' if r['anahtar'] else 'YOK'}")
    print("\n* toplam = kayıtlı günlerin istek toplamı; geçmiş kaydı yeni başladı, öncesi bilinmiyor.")
    print("  Not: Google'ın ücretsiz katmanında gerçek günlük sınır, buradaki ayar değerinden (240) çok düşük olabilir; sağlayıcı reddederse araçlar sıradakine geçer.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# Plan: Harita belgelerini Gemini ile dolduran sistem

## Context
Mete, uXBasic kaynak haritasının (UxbRAG V4 `ajan_paketi`) boş alanlarının dışarıdaki bir yapay zekâya
(Gemini) soru sorularak doldurulmasını istiyor: rutin amaçları (%81.5 boş), dosya/modül özetleri ve haritayı
kullanacak ajan için soru-cevap (SSS) sayfaları. İlk deneme, kaynak kodun dışarı gönderilmesi nedeniyle
Claude Code'un otomatik izin modu denetiminde "veri sızdırma" olarak engellendi. Mete izin verdiğini belirtti;
izin mekanizması netleşince (izin modu "Ask" / onay kutusu ya da /permissions kuralı) aşağıdaki iş yapılacak.
Kaynak kodun Google'a gitmesi Mete'nin bilinçli kararıdır; anahtarı Mete kendisi girer.

## Yaklaşım
1. **Yeni araç** `UxbRAG\UXB_HYBRID_RAG_V4_YORUMLU_JSON\tools\uxb_gemini_fill.py` (engellenen taslağın aynısı):
   - `uxb_purpose_fill.py`'deki envanter/gövde/önbellek yardımcılarını yeniden kullanır
     (`load_inventory`, `SourceCache`, `extract_body`, `body_key`, `load_cache`, `clean_answer`, `shorten`).
   - `--is amac|modul|sss|hepsi`; Gemini REST (`generateContent`, JSON şema çıktılı), anahtar `GEMINI_API_KEY`
     başlıkta (`x-goog-api-key`, URL'de değil); dakikalık/günlük kota, 429/503'te geri çekilme, kaldığı yerden devam.
   - amac: aynı dosyanın rutinleri toplu (≤30 rutin/≤45 bin karakter), bağlam = MIMARI.md özeti + dosyanın imza
     listesi; sonuç `ajan_paketi/amac_onbellek.jsonl`'a `source="gemini"`; yerel qwen taslakları yenilenir.
   - modul / sss: dosya başına özet+rol+önemli rutinler / 4-6 soru-cevap → `modul_ozet_onbellek.jsonl`, `sss_onbellek.jsonl`.
2. **`tools\uxb_ajan_paketi.py` güncellemesi:** kaynak etiketi önbellekteki `source`'tan (`[gemini]`/`[llm]`);
   modül sayfalarına dosya özeti + rol; yeni `sss/S*.md` sayfaları; `kapsam.md` ve `OKU_BENI.md`'ye gemini sayıları.
3. **Başlatıcı:** `scripts\42_gemini_doldur.bat` (dry-run → hepsi, BelowNormal öncelik, log `logs\gemini_*.log`),
   ardından paket yenileme.
4. **Skill/eğitim bağlantısı:** `uxb/.claude/skills/uxb-harita/SKILL.md` ve `EGITIM.md`'ye `[gemini]` etiketi ve
   SSS sayfalarının kullanımı.

## Çalıştırma sırası
1. `--dry-run` (anahtarsız): kaç rutin/dosya sorulacak.
2. Mete `GEMINI_API_KEY`'i kullanıcı ortam değişkenine yazar.
3. `--is amac --max-istek` küçük deneme (1-2 istek) → çıktı kalitesi kontrolü.
4. Tam koşu arka planda (`--rpm 8 --rpd 240`, günlük sınır dolarsa ertesi gün devam) → `uxb_ajan_paketi.py`.

## Doğrulama
- dry-run sayıları, `kapsam.md`'de `[gemini]` oranının artması.
- 10 rastgele Gemini amacını kaynakla karşılaştırma (uydurma var mı).
- `rutinler.tsv`'de Grep ile örnek sembol (`MIRSyncPassModule`) amacının dolu olduğu.
- Harita paketinin yeniden üretimi hatasız, "değişen dosya: 0".

2. **`tools\uxb_ajan_paketi.py` güncellemesi:** kaynak etiketi önbellekteki `source`'tan (`[gemini]`/`[llm]`);
   modül sayfalarına dosya özeti + rol; yeni `sss/S*.md` sayfaları; `kapsam.md` ve `OKU_BENI.md`'ye gemini sayıları.
3. **Başlatıcı:** `scripts\42_gemini_doldur.bat` (dry-run → hepsi, BelowNormal öncelik, log `logs\gemini_*.log`),
   ardından paket yenileme.
4. **Skill/eğitim bağlantısı:** `uxb/.claude/skills/uxb-harita/SKILL.md` ve `EGITIM.md`'ye `[gemini]` etiketi ve
   SSS sayfalarının kullanımı.

## Çalıştırma sırası
1. `--dry-run` (anahtarsız): kaç rutin/dosya sorulacak.
2. Mete `GEMINI_API_KEY`'i kullanıcı ortam değişkenine yazar.
3. `--is amac --max-istek` küçük deneme (1-2 istek) → çıktı kalitesi kontrolü.
4. Tam koşu arka planda (`--rpm 8 --rpd 240`, günlük sınır dolarsa ertesi gün devam) → `uxb_ajan_paketi.py`.

## Doğrulama
- dry-run sayıları, `kapsam.md`'de `[gemini]` oranının artması.
- 10 rastgele Gemini amacını kaynakla karşılaştırma (uydurma var mı).
- `rutinler.tsv`'de Grep ile örnek sembol (`MIRSyncPassModule`) amacının dolu olduğu.
- Harita paketinin yeniden üretimi hatasız, "değişen dosya: 0".


If this plan is relevant to the current work and not already complete, continue working on it.

skills.name: artifact-design
skills.content:
## Page contract — read before your first publish

These are the Artifact tool's own rules for the file you publish; the design guidance below builds on them.

**Format**: Always author the page as `.html`. Publish a `.md` file only when a loaded skill explicitly instructs it. When the user shares a markdown document or asks to turn one into an artifact, author an HTML page based on its content — preserve its substance, and design the page as you would any other artifact rather than transcribing the markdown one-to-one.

**Skeleton**: The file is wrapped in a `<!doctype html>…<head>…</head><body>` skeleton at publish time, so write the page content directly — no `<!DOCTYPE>`, `<html>`, `<head>`, or `<body>` tags of your own. Its head carries only a charset and viewport meta (with `viewport-fit=cover`) plus a small reset — light `color-scheme`, `:root` padded top and bottom by the phone's safe-area insets, zero body margin with a 14px system font on an off-white ground, `img{max-width:100%}`, and `[hidden]{display:none!important}` (toggle visibility with `el.hidden`, not `style.display`) — so put your own `<title>` and `<style>` at the top of the file. Keep the `:root` padding: a bar fixed to the top or bottom stays at `0` and adds `env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)` or `env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)` to its own padding, and a sticky page header uses `top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)`, not `0`.

**Title**: Put a `<title>` at the top of the HTML; only the first 8KB of the file is scanned for it. It is the artifact's name in the browser tab and the gallery, so write a name, not a summary: a short noun phrase, typically two to four words, specific enough to pick this page out among many, the way an app or a document is named. When the user already has a specific name for the thing, use that name for the title rather than coining a new one. Never use a generic category label alone, and never append an explainer after a dash or colon. If you shorten a title that pairs the name with a generic word, keep the name, not the generic word. A multi-word title that already reads as one specific name is finished; do not shorten it further. The explanation goes in the one-sentence `description` parameter, which becomes the gallery card's subtitle. The `title` parameter fills in only when an HTML file has no `<title>` tag (Markdown pages keep their filename). Keep the title stable across redeploys.

**External resources — CDN allowlist (CSP-enforced)**: external scripts load ONLY from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com (preferred), https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/, https://unpkg.com, https://cdn.tailwindcss.com (Tailwind's play-CDN script) and https://code.jquery.com; external stylesheets ONLY from https://fonts.googleapis.com, with the font files they pull from https://fonts.gstatic.com (give every face a real fallback stack). Everything else is blocked, with no visible error: every other host (esm.sh included) and, even on those CDNs, anything but a script — stylesheets, images, media, fetch/XHR/WebSocket, a library's runtime fetches. So inline all other CSS and JS and embed assets as data: URIs. **How to load a library**: `<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/<lib>/<exact version>/<file>">` — pick the UMD build, which defines a global (e.g. react/18.3.1/umd/react.production.min.js, then react-dom) — placed BEFORE any inline `<script>` that uses it; always pin an exact version. The viewer's sandbox also blocks any download the page starts itself — `<a download>` links (data:/blob: hrefs included) and script-driven saves are inert for viewers — so never offer a file through a plain link. Links to other websites (`https://…`) open in a new tab, but email, phone and app links (`mailto:`, `tel:`, `sms:`, other custom schemes) are unreliable inside an artifact: for many viewers (for example anyone outside the user's organization, or anyone viewing through a public link) following one, by link or by script, often does not work, and the page cannot tell whether it did. So show the address or number itself as selectable text (a copy button helps), treat such a link as a convenience that may do nothing, and never tell the viewer a message was sent or a call placed because the viewer tapped one. Artifacts render mermaid diagrams natively — markdown via ```mermaid fences, HTML via `<pre class="mermaid">` blocks — no library needed, don't load one. The viewer never shows `alert()`, `confirm()` or `prompt()` dialogs — `confirm()` returns false and `prompt()` returns null immediately — so build any confirmation step into the page itself.

**What the viewer's frame allows**: The page runs in a locked-down frame; what it refuses below, it refuses for every viewer (anonymous, signed-in, embedded, desktop and mobile apps), so build around these limits instead of detecting them. The page cannot open the print dialog — `window.print()` does nothing — so never offer a Print or "Save as PDF" button. Forms work as page UI (inputs, validation, submit events), but a real submission has nowhere to go: handle `submit` in script with `preventDefault()` and never point `action` at another site or a mailto: address. Copy buttons work when `navigator.clipboard.writeText` is called inside the click handler — catch its rejection (older desktop apps and some app views refuse it) and fall back to selecting the text; reading the clipboard never works, though the viewer's own Paste (the `paste` event) does. Camera, microphone, screen capture, location, motion, Web Share and similar device APIs are refused without a prompt — build on one only when this user has a runtime capability for that device (the `artifact-capabilities` skill lists them) and the page declares it; otherwise take photos, audio and data as uploaded files instead (file inputs, drag-and-drop of files and `FileReader` work in browsers). A screen wake lock may be granted while the page is visible: request it and tolerate rejection. Fullscreen and pointer lock work from a click in desktop browsers; treat both as optional (handle the rejection) since phones and some app views lack them. Sound plays only after the viewer interacts (muted autoplay is fine), so start audio from a button. Other sites cannot be embedded — no YouTube, map or form iframes, and no `<object>`/`<embed>`; link out instead: links open outside the artifact, normally in a new tab, while `window.open` works only for some signed-in viewers in the artifact's own organization and returns null for everyone else, so use real `<a href>` links. Web Workers work from your own files or `blob:` URLs; service workers and WebRTC do not. `fetch()` of files published alongside the page works with relative URLs; images from your own files, `data:` or `blob:` URLs draw to canvas and export cleanly. Only a plain `#anchor` (letters, digits, `.` `_` `~` `-`) from the artifact's link reaches `location.hash` — never `#key=value` state and never the query string — so deep-link to a tab or section with a bare token and keep all other state in the page.

**Browser storage**: `localStorage` (also `sessionStorage` and IndexedDB) works, but each artifact has its own origin and the data lives only in that viewer's browser — it survives republishes to the same URL and never reaches other viewers, other devices, or Claude. It can come back empty or the accessor can throw (a private window, cleared or blocked site data, previews or thumbnail capture), so wrap every read and write in try/catch and render the page correctly without it. Use it only for per-viewer conveniences (a remembered tab or filter, a collapsed section, an unsent draft), never for state that must persist reliably, be shared between viewers, or be read back by Claude — state like that belongs in a runtime capability when this user has one: load the `artifact-capabilities` skill before writing the page.

**Size**: The rendered page must be 16MB or smaller, and embedded data: URIs count toward that.

**Responsive**: The page must also work at phone width (about 400px), and the page body must never scroll horizontally. Keep a side gutter of at least 16px at every width: set it once as side padding on `body` or one outer wrapper, and give that element its vertical padding with `padding-block`, never a `padding` shorthand that zeroes the sides. Use relative units. Let flex and grid rows wrap or stack to one column when narrow, and give any flex or grid child that holds running text, code or a table `min-width: 0`, so long content wraps or scrolls inside it instead of pushing the page wider. Put `max-width: 100%` on images and on any `aspect-ratio` box, and give nothing a `min-width` wider than the screen. Only tables, diagrams and code blocks may be wider, each inside its own `overflow-x: auto` container.

**Theme-aware**: The page renders in the viewer's theme, which has three states: an explicit choice sets `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` on the root element, and the default "system" setting sets nothing, so for most viewers only `prefers-color-scheme` tells light from dark. Define every color as a token, in this shape (token names and count are the design's own):
```css
:root { --bg: …; --fg: …; --accent: … }  /* every token, light values */
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) { --bg: …; --fg: …; --accent: …; color-scheme: dark } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] { --bg: …; --fg: …; --accent: …; color-scheme: dark }  /* same dark values, so the toggle wins both ways */
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg) }
```
Every token gets its first definition on bare `:root`; the two dark blocks only redefine tokens, and their `color-scheme: dark` makes form controls and scrollbars follow. No color has its only definition inside a media or `[data-theme]` block, and no component rule uses a literal color that reads in one theme only. `body` keeps that explicit token background: the viewer paints its own ground behind the page, so a transparent body shows the host's theme instead. A dark-first design mirrors the whole shape, selectors included: dark values and `color-scheme: dark` on bare `:root` (the skeleton pins `light` there), light values and `color-scheme: light` under `(prefers-color-scheme: light)` guarded `:root:not([data-theme="dark"])` and again under `:root[data-theme="light"]`. A design that deliberately commits to a single look may drop the two dark blocks but still sets the background and every color explicitly, plus `color-scheme: dark` on `:root` if that look is dark.

**Icon** (on every first publish): Pass one short generic word as `icon` (e.g. `"chart"`, `"calendar"`, `"recipe"`) for the artifact's browser-tab icon — a plain signifier for what the page is, never a product or brand name, and never an emoji or markup. It stays the **same** for the life of an artifact, so on a redeploy (the same file path this session, or `url`) omit `icon` and the artifact keeps the one it has; pass a different one only when the user asks.

Work the way the design lead at a small, versatile studio would: give each client a visual identity at the level of treatment the task calls for. Make deliberate choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this subject, and avoid templated designs.

## Read the request first

Decide the treatment; designing is a given. A doc gets the same craft as a landing page; only the treatment differs. Format is a separate matter: author HTML, and publish Markdown only when a loaded skill explicitly instructs it. A Markdown publish keeps its filename as its title, uses almost none of the craft below, and is never a way to save time.

Many requests call for a more utilitarian treatment: a plan, a memo, a demo. Make it polished, with real typographic hierarchy, considered spacing, and a proper palette, but avoid over-designing. Most pages don't need a flashy, gigantic hero. Keep flourishes tasteful and limited.

Some requests call for an editorial treatment: a landing page, a game, an app or tool they'll keep or share.

If unsure: a well-composed page is always acceptable; an over-designed visual identity sometimes isn't.

Fundamentals below apply to everything. Follow the editorial process after them only when that reading calls for it.

## Fundamentals for every artifact

**Respect what already exists.** Look for an existing design system first: CLAUDE.md, a tokens or theme file, existing component styles. When one exists, apply it; everything below fills gaps and never overrides. Precedence is always the user's own words, then the project's existing system, then your choices.

**Ground it in the subject.** If the subject isn't already clear, define it: one concrete subject, its audience, and the page's single job. Distinctive choices come from the subject's own world: its materials, instruments, and vernacular. Whatever the treatment, include at least one detail only this subject would have (its real units and scales, its document conventions, its terms of art) as content rather than ornament; it costs nothing even on a plain page. Use real content throughout and never lorem ipsum.

**Pair typefaces.** Typography determines how the page reads even when the page isn't about typography. Google Fonts is the only font host the Artifact CSP allows; link it directly (`<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=...&display=swap">`). A face from anywhere else must be inlined as a @font-face data URI, or the browser silently uses a fallback. In both cases, declare a real fallback stack. Keep running text near 65 characters wide. Set a type scale and keep to it. Give headings `text-wrap: balance`, give body text comfortable spacing, and give uppercase labels a little letter-spacing.

**Load libraries instead of inlining them.** When the page really needs a library (React, a charting or highlighting package), load its UMD build from cdnjs with one pinned `<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/...">` placed before the inline script that uses its global; don't inline the library's source or hand-write a substitute. Only the script loads this way; a library's stylesheet still has to be inlined, and the page contract above lists the few other script hosts the CSP admits. The page's own CSS and JS, its images, and its data ship with the page. Most pages don't need any library; use one only when it does substantial work for the page.

**Choose neutrals deliberately.** A pure mid-grey looks unconsidered; a grey with a slight hue bias toward the page's accent looks intentional. Pure white and near-black are fine backgrounds when they suit the subject, as long as you chose the neutral deliberately instead of inheriting a default.

**Design both themes.** The page renders in the viewer's theme, and the viewer has three states: an explicit choice sets `data-theme="dark"` or `data-theme="light"` on the root element, and the default "system" setting sets *nothing*. Most viewers see the document with no `data-theme` attribute, where only `prefers-color-scheme` distinguishes light from dark. Structure the CSS at the token level for all three. The bare `:root` block defines the complete light palette (for a deliberately dark-first design, swap light and dark consistently through this whole pattern); `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` redefines only the tokens, guarded as `:root:not([data-theme="light"])` so an explicit light choice overrides a dark OS setting; `:root[data-theme="dark"]` redefines them again so the toggle also overrides in the other direction; wherever the dark palette applies - both dark blocks, or bare `:root` in a dark-first or single-dark design - also set `color-scheme: dark` (the skeleton pins `light` on `:root`), so native form controls and scrollbars follow the palette. Style components through the tokens, never directly inside a media or `[data-theme]` block: a color defined only inside `[data-theme]` never applies when no `data-theme` attribute is set, and the page then shows one theme's text on the other theme's background. Two more rules keep each theme consistent. First, the artifact is composited over a background the viewer paints in *its own* theme, so `body` must set an explicit `background` from a token; a transparent body shows the host's background with no warning. Second, every element that sets a color takes it from the same token set as the surface behind it, never from a literal that works in only one theme. Declare every token in the bare `:root` block before any media or `[data-theme]` block redefines it; a color that exists only inside one of those blocks is the classic unreadable-artifact bug. Give the second theme the same care as the first: don't simply invert it; keep contrast legible and keep the accent working on both backgrounds. A design that deliberately commits to one visual world (a neon arcade screen, a letterpress invitation) may stay single-theme: then omit the media query and `[data-theme]` blocks entirely but still set the background and every color explicitly, so the page looks right on either host background; do this by choice, never by omission.

**Use layout for spacing.** Lay out sibling groups with flex or grid and `gap` instead of per-element margins, which collapse or double without warning. Keep a side gutter of at least 16px at every width: set it once as side padding on `body` or one outer wrapper, whose vertical padding uses `padding-block` and never a `padding` shorthand that zeroes the sides. Let rows wrap or stack to one column at phone width (about 400px). Give images and any `aspect-ratio` box `max-width: 100%`, and don't give anything a `min-width` wider than the screen. Only wide tables, code, and diagrams may exceed it; give each `overflow-x: auto` on its own container so the page body never scrolls sideways. The publish skeleton pads `:root` top and bottom by the phone's safe-area insets (zero everywhere except a phone app) so the page runs edge to edge while its content stays clear of the system bars; keep that padding. A bar fixed to the top or bottom stays at `0` and adds `env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)` or `env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)` to its own padding. A sticky page header uses `top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px)` and never `0`. Size a one-screen app with `height: 100%` on `html` and `body` instead of `100vh`, so it fits inside that padding. A page that includes its own viewport meta gets this padding only when that meta declares `viewport-fit=cover`. Use `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` wherever digits line up in columns.

**Make repeated elements consistent.** For cards in a row, label/value pairs down a list, or badges on sibling items, use the same edges, baselines, and inner padding on each, and put any recurring element in the same place on each. Let content set a container's height and pick a column count the items fill, so nothing stretches over empty space or sits alone in a row. Make text that can outgrow its track wrap or scroll in its own container; clipped text is a bug.

**Use card styling selectively.** Border, fill, radius, and shadow each mark an element as a separate object. Apply them by role, to set off the one element that needs it; applying the same radius and shadow to every block flattens the hierarchy. Open with big-number tiles only when those figures are the point of the page.

**Draw charts to scale.** Place marks, ticks, and labels with one scale, and make every label name a value the chart actually reaches. Color chart text from the theme tokens so it is readable in both themes. Keep marks, labels, and edges clear of one another and inside the drawing's bounds; in SVG, leave room in the viewBox for the outermost labels and give every drawn shape an explicit fill.

**Make the page complete at rest.** Everything meant to be read is visible once the page has loaded, with
